title: How Should Diffusion Language Models Edit Code?
summary: Code editing requires a model to decide where to make changes, generate the new content, and preserve everything else. We study how masked diffusion language models divide these responsibilities across four editing interfaces: whole-file rewriting, search-and-replace, locate-then-infill, and token-level editing. Experiments on CanItEdit reveal a composition gap: diffusion models can generate coordinated changes when the correct edit locations are supplied, but much of this capability is lost when those locations must be predicted. Access to the intact original code helps the model fill multiple edit regions, yet does not resolve the difficulty of selecting those regions. By varying the editable regions while holding the generation model and decoding procedure fixed, we identify two distinct requirements for successful editing: covering every required change and placing precise boundaries around it. Missing a required region prevents the corresponding change, while widening regions to ensure coverage can sharply reduce success by requiring unchanged code to be regenerated. A sentence-level Wiki editing probe shows the same qualitative gap between supplied and predicted locations beyond code. These findings show why strong infilling capability alone does not ensure reliable editing: the interface must expose all required changes while limiting regeneration of unchanged code.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究掩码扩散语言模型在代码编辑中如何分配"决定改哪里、生成新内容、保留其余"三类职责，比较四种编辑接口，发现存在"组合鸿沟"。
AI.motivation: 代码编辑要求模型同时决定修改位置、生成新内容并保留未改部分。作者试图厘清扩散模型在这些子职责上的能力分布，并解释为何强填充（infilling）能力不足以保证可靠编辑。
AI.method: 在CanItEdit上实验，对比四种编辑接口：整文件重写、搜索替换（search-and-replace）、先定位后填充（locate-then-infill）、token级编辑。通过固定生成模型与解码过程、仅改变可编辑区域，分离出位置预测与内容生成两个因素；并做句子级Wiki编辑探针以验证跨领域泛化。
AI.result: 出现"组合鸿沟"：当提供正确的编辑位置时，模型能生成协调的多处修改；但需自行预测位置时，该能力大幅损失。完整的原始代码有助于填充多个编辑区域，却不能解决位置选择的困难。成功编辑依赖两个独立条件：覆盖所有必需修改，以及为其设定精确边界。漏掉必需区域会导致相应修改缺失；为保覆盖而扩大区域则会因需重新生成未变代码而成功率骤降。Wiki探针呈现同样的"给定位置 vs 预测位置"鸿沟。
AI.conclusion: 强填充能力本身不足以保证可靠编辑；编辑接口需同时暴露全部必需修改，并限制对未变代码的重新生成。

title: Zero2Repo: Can Coding Agents Build Repositories from Scratch?
summary: Coding agents are increasingly asked to build software rather than patch it, yet benchmarks for from-scratch repository construction are mostly limited to a single language and depend on manually curated tasks. We introduce Zero2Repo, a benchmark in which an agent receives a product requirements document, an interface contract, and an empty workspace, and must deliver a complete repository in the project's native ecosystem. Tasks are produced by a language-agnostic authoring pipeline that converts real, version-pinned open-source projects into behavioral specifications, reproducible environments, and hidden acceptance tests. Each task is validated by execution: a reference implementation derived from the upstream project must pass, and adversarial validation must show that the tests reject incorrect implementations. Evaluation runs production coding agents in isolated containers, withholds the acceptance tests until an explicit submission, and assigns a binary reward only when every test passes, with no LLM judge. The pipeline and harness make no language-specific assumptions and apply to mainstream programming ecosystems; the current release contains Python, TypeScript, Go, and C++ tasks. Even on 11 tasks drawn from repositories that frontier models have very likely seen during training, the strongest agent solves only 10, and every failing submission passes 90-99% of the hidden tests; for the two strongest agents, 67-100% of failed tests trace to a single omission or a low-frequency rule stated in the specification rather than to a missing subsystem, so each failure is a concrete target for improvement.

AI.tldr: Zero2Repo是一个从零构建代码仓库的跨语言基准，用自动化流水线将真实开源项目转为需求文档、接口契约和隐藏验收测试，在Python、TypeScript、Go、C++上评测。
AI.motivation: 现有从零构建仓库的基准多局限于单一语言，且依赖人工策划任务，难以跨生态、可扩展地评估编码智能体的端到端仓库构建能力。
AI.method: 提出Zero2Repo基准：智能体仅获产品需求文档、接口契约与空工作区，需在项目原生生态中交付完整仓库。任务由语言无关的编写流水线生成，将版本固定的真实开源项目转化为行为规格、可复现环境与隐藏验收测试；每个任务经执行验证（上游参考实现须通过，对抗性验证须证明测试能拒绝错误实现）。评测在隔离容器中运行生产级编码智能体，提交前不提供测试，全部通过才给二元奖励，不设LLM评判。
AI.result: 流水线与评测框架无语言特定假设，适用于主流生态，当前版本含Python、TypeScript、Go与C++任务；即便在11个很可能已被前沿模型训练见过的仓库任务上，最强智能体也仅解出10个，且所有失败提交通过了90%–99%的隐藏测试；对两个最强智能体，67%–100%的失败测试源于规格中单处遗漏或低频规则，而非缺失子系统。
AI.conclusion: 从零构建仓库对现有编码智能体仍是难题，失败点集中且具体，构成明确的改进目标；Zero2Repo提供了跨语言、可自动扩展的评测方案。

title: E2E-SWE: Benchmarking LLMs on Building Working Codebases from Scratch
summary: Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are evolving from making localized code changes to developing complete software repositories. However, evaluating repository-scale generation remains challenging: tasks must demand system-level reasoning while ensuring that all evaluated behaviors are precisely specified and independent of any particular implementation. We introduce E2E-SWE, a benchmark for evaluating whether coding agents can build complete, functional software repositories end to end. E2E-SWE contains 186 whole-repository generation tasks spanning 11 programming languages. Given only a natural-language specification and an empty workspace, an agent must implement a complete, installable project that satisfies a comprehensive suite of hidden tests. Each task is constructed by a software engineer in collaboration with an LLM; together, they develop the test suite and a corresponding implementation-independent specification. To ensure that tasks are well specified and practically solvable, we further subject them to an iterative verification process in which autonomous agents audit and repair task defects using static inspection and failures observed from real model rollouts. Evaluating 13 frontier models, we find substantial variation in end-to-end repository generation ability, with pass@1 ranging from 11.7% to 67.7%, providing strong model differentiation while leaving considerable headroom for future progress. Analysis of agent trajectories further reveals long, front-loaded reasoning patterns, highlighting the planning and system-level reasoning required to construct working codebases from scratch.

AI.tldr: E2E-SWE 是一个评估编程智能体端到端构建完整软件仓库能力的基准，包含 11 种编程语言的 186 个整仓库生成任务。13 个前沿模型 pass@1 介于 11.7%–67.7%，显示出强区分度与充足提升空间。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 编程智能体已从局部代码修改演进到整仓库开发，但仓库级生成评测困难：任务需同时具备系统级推理要求、行为规范精确、且与具体实现无关。现有基准难以兼顾这三点，因此需要新基准。
AI.method: 提出 E2E-SWE：186 个整仓库生成任务，覆盖 11 种语言。智能体仅获得自然语言规格说明与空工作区，需实现可安装的完整项目以通过隐藏测试。每个任务由软件工程师与 LLM 协作构建，产出测试套件与实现无关的规格说明；并通过迭代验证流程，由自主智能体基于静态检查与真实模型 rollout 的失败进行审计与修复任务缺陷。
AI.result: 评测 13 个前沿模型，端到端仓库生成能力差异显著，pass@1 从 11.7% 到 67.7%，具备强模型区分度，同时仍有较大提升空间。对智能体轨迹的分析揭示其推理呈长且前置（front-loaded）的模式，体现从零构建可用代码库所需的规划与系统级推理能力。
AI.conclusion: E2E-SWE 为仓库级端到端代码生成提供了规范精确、实现无关的评测基准，揭示了当前模型的显著能力差距与提升空间，并表明该任务高度依赖前期规划与系统级推理。

title: OpenCollab: A Multi-Agent Coding Framework with Programmable Collaboration and Controllable Runtime
summary: Multi-agent coding systems are designed to tackle complex software engineering tasks through collaboration. However, existing evaluations typically assume configured organizations are followed faithfully, whereas reality differs. This behavioral gap, combined with differences in underlying system components, prevents clear attribution of observed gains. To this end, we introduce OpenCollab, a multi-agent coding framework that provides a unified infrastructure for programmable collaboration and controllable runtime. Specifically, OpenCollab unifies organization design, enforces experimental control on a shared runtime, and tracks execution through fine-grained event streams. On this basis, we define Adherence to quantify whether the declared organization is actually realized. Our experiments reveal that agents collaborate very differently across configurations: changing any single dimension shifts Adherence, from 47.2% to as high as 97.2%. Furthermore, extensive agentic coding benchmarks show that a two-coder workflow built on OpenCollab establishes new SOTA performance compared to the mainstream harnesses such as Mini-SWE-agent, Codex CLI, and Claude Code, showing that a well-designed organization can outperform strong existing harnesses, while OpenCollab's single-agent configuration uses the fewest tokens across all evaluated suites. OpenCollab establishes a unified multi-agent infrastructure for easy programmable collaboration and controlled causal evaluation.

AI.tldr: OpenCollab：统一多智能体编码基础设施，提出Adherence度量声明组织是否真正实现，并证明双编码器工作流可超越主流harness达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有对多智能体编码系统的评估假设既定组织被忠实执行，但现实并非如此。这种"行为差距"叠加底层系统组件的差异，使得观测到的性能提升无法清晰归因。
AI.method: 提出OpenCollab多智能体编码框架，提供可编程协作与可控运行时的统一基础设施：统一组织设计、在共享运行时上施加实验控制、通过细粒度事件流追踪执行过程。在此基础上定义Adherence指标，量化声明的组织是否被真正实现。
AI.result: 实验表明不同配置下智能体协作方式差异显著：改变任一单一维度都会使Adherence发生变化，范围从47.2%到高达97.2%。在广泛的智能体编程基准上，基于OpenCollab构建的双编码器工作流相较Mini-SWE-agent、Codex CLI、Claude Code等主流harness取得新SOTA；其单智能体配置在所有评测套件中token消耗最少。
AI.conclusion: OpenCollab建立了面向易编程协作与受控因果评估的统一多智能体基础设施，说明良好设计的组织可超越强大的现有harness。

title: Improving OCR Faithfulness via Gated and Attenuated On-Policy Distillation
summary: Vision-language models may rewrite anomalous text in images into linguistically plausible expressions, compromising OCR transcription faithfulness. Sequence-level task rewards and local teacher guidance are complementary, but guidance from the same teacher may not remain equally effective as the student improves. Offline analysis shows that supervision from a fixed teacher becomes progressively less favorable as the student improves, both across training checkpoints and across response groups with different task rewards. Motivated by this observation, we introduce GAD-RL, which adaptively regulates teacher supervision during joint post-training according to the student's current task performance and local distributions. A frozen teacher conditions on reference transcriptions and student-generated prefixes. GAD-RL disables distillation for response groups containing an output with task reward at least 0.95 and continuously attenuates distillation strength as group-mean reward increases. It also weights forward KL by the student's probability of the teacher's Top-1 token, moderating local auxiliary updates when student support for that candidate is low. On Qwen3.5-2B, GAD-RL achieves 59.92% Micro Recall on CHAOS-Bench, surpassing GRPO and GRPO+OPD (fixed-weight) by 8.45 and 4.43 percentage points, respectively, while achieving an Overall score of 91.18 on OmniDocBench v1.6.

AI.tldr: 提出GAD-RL，在联合后训练中依据学生当前任务表现与局部分布自适应调节教师监督强度，缓解固定教师的知识蒸馏随学生变强而失效的问题，提升视觉语言模型OCR转录忠实度。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在图像文本识别中可能将异常文本改写成语言上合理的表达，损害OCR转录忠实性。序列级任务奖励与局部教师指导具有互补性，但同一教师的指导效果会随学生能力提升而下降；离线分析显示，固定教师的监督在训练检查点间以及不同任务奖励的响应组间均逐渐变得不再有利。
AI.method: GAD-RL在联合后训练中自适应调节教师监督：1）冻结教师以参考转录与学生生成前缀为条件；2）对包含任务奖励≥0.95输出的响应组禁用蒸馏；3）随组平均奖励升高持续衰减蒸馏强度；4）用学生对教师Top-1 token的概率对前向KL加权，在学生对该候选支持度低时减弱局部辅助更新。
AI.result: 在Qwen3.5-2B上，GAD-RL在CHAOS-Bench取得59.92% Micro Recall，分别超过GRPO与GRPO+OPD（固定权重）8.45和4.43个百分点；在OmniDocBench v1.6上Overall得分为91.18。
AI.conclusion: 通过按学生任务表现与局部分布动态调节教师监督，GAD-RL有效融合序列级奖励与局部蒸馏，显著提升OCR转录忠实度，优于固定权重的GRPO与GRPO+OPD基线。

title: LampAttention: Look-Ahead Mixed-Precision FlashAttention for Dedicated Accelerators
summary: While most attention logits can be computed in low precision without degrading numerical stability, current attention kernels fail to exploit this phenomenon. We introduce a novel hardware-algorithm co-design in the form of mixed-precision FlashAttention. Our method accumulates key-query products and evaluates their exponentials in 8-bit formats, then adaptively identifies sensitive sub-blocks and recomputes them in 16-bit formats. We propose the specifications for a dedicated accelerator capable of executing this pipeline efficiently. Simulated experiments with Qwen3 and Gemma 3 show that rerouting a selective minority of sub-blocks to high precision is sufficient to recover the baseline model performance.

AI.tldr: 提出混合精度FlashAttention硬件-算法协同设计：在8位格式下累加K-Q乘积并求指数，自适应识别敏感子块并以16位重算，仅需少量子块回退高精度即可恢复基线性能（Qwen3、Gemma 3模拟实验验证）。
AI.motivation: 多数注意力logits可在低精度下计算而不损害数值稳定性，但现有注意力核（attention kernels）未利用这一现象，存在精度利用不足、计算效率未充分释放的问题。
AI.method: 混合精度FlashAttention：以8位格式累加key-query乘积并计算其指数；自适应识别敏感子块并对其在16位格式下重算；同时给出可高效执行该流水线的专用加速器规格。
AI.result: 基于Qwen3与Gemma 3的模拟实验表明，仅将选择性的少数子块重路由至高精度，即可恢复基线模型性能。
AI.conclusion: 低精度注意力计算结合少量敏感子块的高精度重算，可在保持模型性能的同时提升效率；配套专用硬件设计使该协同方案具备可实现性。

title: TAGGRAPH: Tag-Augmented Graphs for Graph Retrieval of Agent Persistent Histories
comment: An earlier version was accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Lifelong Learning Agents (LLA)
summary: Long-term memory lets LLM agents recall past interactions and remain consistent across sessions, but memory systems are hard to compare because they often vary in representation, indexing, retrieval, and evaluation. We present a controlled evaluation framework based on shared 5W-style conversational memories. Localized graph configurations traverse a common base graph; AdaptiveGraph adds chronological edges and Personalized PageRank diffusion. We also evaluate BM25 over the same extracted notes and OpenClaw as a raw-input external reference. Retrieval rankings vary across memory settings. On LongMemEval-S, AdaptiveGraph is the strongest graph configuration at 0.844 MRR, but BM25 reaches 0.867 and OpenClaw 0.880. On ATANT Core, localized graph traversal outperforms diffusion and BM25, whereas BM25 leads the stress rounds. Reducing LongMemEval-S within the tested range does not reproduce the ATANT diffusion penalty, but the smallest tested store remains larger than ATANT Core, so store size cannot be ruled out. The penalty also persists under a permissive content-match criterion. Vocabulary normalization and extraction quality substantially affect graph retrieval, and missing extraction tags are common among top-five misses. Retrieval strategies should therefore be evaluated jointly with the memory setting and against strong lexical baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于共享5W式对话记忆的受控评测框架，用于公平比较不同长期记忆系统的检索策略，并发现检索排序随记忆设置而变化，图检索并非普遍优于词法基线。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体的长期记忆系统在表示、索引、检索和评测上差异很大，导致难以进行受控比较，因此需要一个统一框架来隔离记忆设置对检索效果的影响。
AI.method: 基于共享的5W式对话记忆构建受控评测框架；采用在公共基础图上进行局部化图遍历的配置，AdaptiveGraph进一步加入时序边与个性化PageRank扩散；同时在相同抽取笔记上评测BM25，并以OpenClaw作为原始输入的外部参照。
AI.result: 检索排序随记忆设置不同而变化。在LongMemEval-S上，AdaptiveGraph为最强的图配置（0.844 MRR），但BM25达0.867、OpenClaw达0.880。在ATANT Core上，局部化图遍历优于扩散与BM25，而BM25在压力轮次中领先。缩小LongMemEval-S未能复现ATANT中的扩散惩罚，但最小测试存储仍大于ATANT Core，故存储规模影响不能排除；该惩罚在宽松内容匹配标准下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 词汇归一化与抽取质量显著影响图检索，前五遗漏中普遍存在缺失抽取标签。检索策略应与记忆设置联合评测，并与强词法基线进行对比。

title: Travel Time Prediction in Supply Chain Management Using Machine Learning
summary: The purpose of this research is to find data and methods using machine learning and deep learning to correctly predict the estimated travel time for transportation and logistics in a supply chain system. The supply chain ecosystem is very complex and heavily relies on the transportation and logistics of raw materials and finished goods. Accurate travel time estimation is critical because it helps supply chain members to improve logistics consistency and performance. This helps in planning, demand forecasting, lead time management and assembly planning. The logistics on the delivery side of the customer also plays a crucial role in customer satisfaction and voice of customer. With the collection of huge historical data and using novel techniques, the research builds an accurate model to predict travel time of inventory.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在利用机器学习和深度学习方法，基于大规模历史数据构建模型，准确预测供应链运输与物流的行程时间，以提升物流一致性与绩效。
AI.motivation: 供应链生态系统复杂，高度依赖原材料与成品的运输和物流。准确的行程时间估计对供应链成员至关重要，可改善物流一致性与绩效，并支持计划、需求预测、提前期管理和装配计划。交付侧物流还直接影响客户满意度和客户之声。
AI.method: 收集大量历史数据，并采用机器学习和深度学习等新颖技术，构建库存/货物行程时间预测模型。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体实验结果或量化指标，仅指出研究构建了一个用于预测行程时间的准确模型。
AI.conclusion: 借助机器学习与深度学习及海量历史数据，可实现对供应链运输和物流行程时间的准确预测，从而有助于提升物流一致性、绩效及客户满意度。

title: From Codebase to Culprit (C2C): Reducing the Search Space for Bugs with Semantic Retrieval and Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce C2C (From Codebase to Culprit), a framework for precise bug localization that progressively reduces the debugging search space across multiple levels of granularity: files, functions, and lines of code. To mirror developer's natural top-down debugging workflows, C2C integrates semantic retrieval and Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) in a two-stage process. First, it performs recall-oriented retrieval of buggy candidates via semantic vector similarity search using bug-report text, including available stack-trace information, against a database of embeddings, where the embeddings are fine-tuned via contrastive learning with CodeBERT. Building on this reduced search space, the HRL framework incrementally localizes bugs, reasoning from files to functions and ultimately to individual lines of code. Unlike prior approaches which operate at a single granularity, C2C enables multi-resolution localization while maintaining contextual consistency across decisions. Experiments on real-world Java and Python datasets demonstrate that C2C improves retrieval precision and localization accuracy. Ablation studies further highlight the contributions of hierarchical decomposition, structured learning signals, and reward shaping in advancing multi-level bug localization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 C2C 框架，通过语义检索与分层强化学习实现从文件到函数再到代码行的多粒度精确缺陷定位。
AI.motivation: 现有缺陷定位方法通常仅在单一粒度（如文件或函数）上运行，难以匹配开发者自顶向下的调试工作流，且调试搜索空间庞大、定位精度受限。
AI.method: C2C 采用两阶段流程：首先利用基于缺陷报告文本（含堆栈跟踪信息）的语义向量相似度检索，召回候选缺陷，其中嵌入使用 CodeBERT 结合对比学习进行微调；随后在该缩减后的搜索空间上，引入分层强化学习（HRL），从文件到函数再到代码行逐步推理定位缺陷，并在决策间保持上下文一致性。
AI.result: 在真实 Java 和 Python 数据集上的实验表明，C2C 提升了检索精度与定位准确率；消融研究进一步验证了分层分解、结构化学习信号与奖励塑形对多级缺陷定位的贡献。
AI.conclusion: C2C 通过结合语义检索与分层强化学习，实现了多分辨率缺陷定位，在保持上下文一致性的同时有效缩小调试搜索空间，优于单粒度方法。

title: AREX-2: Advancing Self-Improving Agents through Long-Horizon Reflective Tasks
comment: Code will be released at https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/AREX-2 and models at https://huggingface.co/collections/BAAI/arex-2
summary: We present AREX-2, an effort to advance the self-improving capability of LLM agents, which we define as the ability to iteratively refine a solution at test time. This ability rests on two complementary capabilities: reflection, which produces a solution better than the current one, and long-horizon execution, which keeps the iteration effective over many rounds. We hypothesize that both capabilities are domain-agnostic, and can therefore be learned in scenarios that are well suited for supervision. Accordingly, we synthesize long-horizon improvement trajectories from machine learning and algorithmic programming tasks, two domains that offer verifiable feedback and reward sustained iteration. Trained on this data, our agent, built on Qwen3.8-27B, achieves strong results on MLE-bench Lite (81.8) and Frontier-CS (70.7), transfers to deep research with 84.0 on BrowseComp, 52.6 on HLE, 92.2 on GAIA, and 93.8 on DeepSearchQA, and keeps improving as its budget of rounds grows. These results show that long-horizon reflective data is an effective route toward self-improving agents.

AI.tldr: AREX-2 通过在机器学习与算法编程任务上合成长期反思改进轨迹，将"反思"与"长时程执行"两种领域无关能力注入基于 Qwen3.8-27B 的 LLM 智能体，在 MLE-bench Lite、Frontier-CS 以及多项深度研究基准上取得领先成绩，并随迭代轮数预算增加持续提升。
AI.motivation: 自改进智能体的核心是测试时对解进行迭代优化，其依赖反思（产出优于当前的解）与长时程执行（多轮迭代仍有效）两种能力。作者假设这两种能力是领域无关的，因而可在易于获取监督信号的情境中习得，而以往工作缺乏针对长时程反思改进数据的系统性构造与训练验证。
AI.method: 选取机器学习与算法编程两类具备可验证反馈、且能奖励持续迭代的领域，合成长期改进轨迹数据；以此训练一个基于 Qwen3.8-27B 构建的智能体，并考察其跨域迁移性与迭代轮数预算增长下的性能变化。
AI.result: 在 MLE-bench Lite 上达 81.8，Frontier-CS 达 70.7；迁移至深度研究任务后，BrowseComp 84.0、HLE 52.6、GAIA 92.2、DeepSearchQA 93.8；性能随迭代轮数预算增加而持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 长期反思型数据是通往自改进智能体的有效路径，表明反思与长时程执行确为可迁移的领域无关能力，可通过在合适领域合成监督数据来习得并泛化。

title: AdaM-Rec: Adaptive Modality Routing for Multimodal Recommendation
summary: While recent multimodal recommender systems have demonstrated the effectiveness of incorporating visual and textual information to improve downstream performance, most existing methods rely on static modality fusion, assuming that the relative importance of textual and visual signals remains stable across recommendation scenarios. This design may not fully account for an important variation across recommendation requests: some queries require fine-grained visual cues, whereas others are better served by textual or functional semantics, in which case indiscriminate modality fusion brings in uninformative cues and impairs recommendation quality. To address this, we propose AdaM-Rec, an LLM-based framework for adaptive modality routing in multimodal recommendation, which enables dynamic calibration of reliance on textual and multimodal evidence for user-specific queries. Built on structured natural-language representations of items and user preferences, it estimates modality reliability using proxy recall tasks. Specifically, it generates pseudo-queries that match the granularity of the actual query while pointing to the user's positively interacted items as verifiable proxy targets, evaluating which modality yields better recall performance in analogous scenarios and optimizing the routing strategy in an agentic manner. It then performs routed recall with optimized strategy, enriches results with collaborative items, and ranks candidates by their relevance to both the query and user preferences. Experiments demonstrate that AdaM-Rec delivers strong performance against state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness and broader potential of adaptive control over modality reliance in multimodal recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaM-Rec，一个基于LLM的自适应模态路由框架，用于多模态推荐，动态校准对文本与多模态证据的依赖，在实验中优于现有最先进基线。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推荐系统多采用静态模态融合，假设文本与视觉信号的相对重要性在各类推荐场景中保持稳定。但不同推荐请求的需求各异：部分查询需要细粒度视觉线索，另一些则更适合文本或功能语义。一刀切的模态融合会引入无关线索，损害推荐质量。
AI.method: 基于结构化自然语言表示（描述物品与用户偏好），利用代理召回任务估计模态可靠性：生成与实际查询粒度匹配的伪查询，以用户正向交互物品作为可验证代理目标，评估在类似场景下哪种模态召回表现更优，并以智能体方式优化路由策略。随后以优化策略执行路由召回，用协同物品丰富结果，并按候选与查询及用户偏好的相关性排序。
AI.result: 实验表明，AdaM-Rec 在性能上显著优于当前最先进基线，验证了自适应调控模态依赖的有效性与更广泛的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 自适应地控制多模态推荐中对文本与多模态证据的依赖可提升推荐效果，AdaM-Rec 提供了一个可行且有效的实现路径。

title: EHR2Trace: Auditable EHR Data Infrastructure for Patient World Models and Clinical Agents
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Code and experiment records: https://github.com/Yangxinyee/ehr2trace
summary: Patient world models and clinical agents aim to predict changes in patients' health and support clinical work. Developing these systems requires reliable histories of patient conditions, treatments, and the information available at each decision. Electronic health records (EHRs) contain these histories, but differences in how events are recorded make them difficult to use consistently. We present EHR2Trace, a system that converts EHRs from different sources into traceable patient events for model training and evaluation. It links events to source records, separates event time from information availability, and distinguishes medication orders, dispensing, and administration. A shared event representation supports both OMOP and MEDS exports, with automated validation and reproducible builds. Across three clinical datasets, EHR2Trace converted 846.4 million events, with every applicable check passing except one unit-consistency check on MIMIC-IV, and detected all 28 injected faults. A controlled prediction experiment showed that assigning later diagnoses to admission time substantially inflated measured performance, and that a model trained on such data lost accuracy when deployed on histories filtered by availability. EHR2Trace provides a reusable data foundation for patient world models and clinical agents, helping researchers inspect patient histories, check conversion decisions, and evaluate models with explicit data rules.

AI.tldr: EHR2Trace 将多源电子健康记录转换为可追溯的患者事件，支持 OMOP/MEDS 导出，经大规模验证并揭示数据规则对模型评估的影响。
AI.motivation: 患者世界模型与临床智能体需要可靠的患者病情、治疗及决策时可用信息的历史记录，但电子健康记录因事件记录方式不一致而难以被一致化使用，缺乏可复用、可追溯的数据基础。
AI.method: 提出 EHR2Trace 系统：将不同来源的 EHR 转换为可追溯患者事件；将事件链接至源记录；区分事件时间与信息可用时间；区分用药医嘱、发药与给药；采用共享事件表示以同时支持 OMOP 与 MEDS 导出，并配备自动校验与可复现构建流程。
AI.result: 在三个临床数据集上共转换 8.464 亿条事件，除 MIMIC-IV 上一项单位一致性检查外所有适用检查均通过，并检测出全部 28 个注入故障；受控预测实验显示，把较晚诊断归到入院时间会显著虚高模型性能，且此类数据训练的模型在按信息可用性过滤的历史上部署时准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: EHR2Trace 为患者世界模型与临床智能体提供了可复用的数据基础，可帮助研究者检查患者历史、审核转换决策，并以显式数据规则评估模型。

title: MallocSan: A Memory Safety Tool for Native Closed-Source Applications
comment: 28 pages. Submitted to ACM TOSEM; under review
summary: Memory-corruption errors remain a leading cause of high-impact vulnerabilities in C and C++ software. Deterministic detection, however, remains difficult to deploy: compiler-based sanitizers require source code and control of the build pipeline, hardware-assisted schemes depend on specific platforms, and dynamic binary translation can impose order-of-magnitude slowdowns. This paper presents MallocSan, a heap sanitizer for native, potentially closed-source x86-64 Linux applications that requires no source access, recompilation, or specialized hardware. MallocSan interposes on memory allocation through LD_PRELOAD and embeds an object identifier in the unused high bits of each protected pointer. Dereferencing the resulting noncanonical pointer faults at the offending instruction, which MallocSan decodes and patches at runtime so that subsequent executions perform per-object bounds checks entirely in userspace. Sites that cannot be patched fall back to in-handler emulation or single-stepping, while an optional profile-guided pass rewrites frequently executed residual sites offline. MallocSan also extends identity-based checking to vector gather/scatter instructions and supports policy-scoped coverage. Across seven SPEC CPU 2017 benchmarks, MallocSan outperforms Valgrind Memcheck on five, with a geometric-mean execution-time factor of 4.82x relative to native execution, compared with 18.55x for Memcheck, while preserving substantial parallel scaling on both evaluated multithreaded workloads: 644.nab_s and pigz. On the in-scope Juliet tests, MallocSan detects all seeded violations with no false reports on the good executions. It also detects heap-buffer errors in real-world applications, including a known one-byte overread in LibTIFF's tiffcrop utility.

AI.tldr: MallocSan：面向闭源x86-64 Linux应用的免源码堆内存错误检测系统，通过LD_PRELOAD与指针高位嵌入对象ID实现确定性检测，性能显著优于Valgrind Memcheck。
AI.motivation: 内存破坏错误是C/C++软件高影响漏洞的主要来源，但确定性检测难以部署：编译器sanitizer需源码与构建控制，硬件方案依赖特定平台，动态二进制翻译存在数量级性能开销。
AI.method: MallocSan通过LD_PRELOAD介入内存分配，在被保护指针未使用的高位嵌入对象标识符；解引用产生的非规范指针在出错指令处触发故障，运行时解码并修补该指令，使后续执行在用户态完成逐对象边界检查。无法修补的站点回退到处理器内模拟或单步执行，可选的profile-guided离线重写优化高频残留站点；同时扩展基于身份的检查至向量gather/scatter指令，并支持策略范围覆盖。
AI.result: 在7个SPEC CPU 2017基准上，MallocSan在5项上优于Valgrind Memcheck，相对原生执行的几何平均执行时间倍率为4.82x（Memcheck为18.55x），并在644.nab_s与pigz多线程负载上保持良好并行扩展性。在范围内Juliet测试中检出全部注入违规且无误报；在真实应用中检出堆缓冲区错误，包括LibTIFF tiffcrop工具的已知一字节越读。
AI.conclusion: MallocSan证明了无需源码、重编译或专用硬件即可在原生x86-64 Linux二进制上实现确定性堆内存错误检测，且性能开销远低于现有动态分析工具，具备现实可部署性。

title: MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation
summary: We study the generation of agentic workflows that jointly optimize multiple objectives, such as accuracy, cost, latency, robustness, and consistency. Existing methods for workflow generation typically optimize accuracy alone or a weighted sum of objectives, so each trained generator commits to one fixed trade-off and must be retrained from scratch when preferences change. To alleviate this, we propose MoFlow, which generates workflows optimized across varied preferences. Specifically, MoFlow formulates workflow generation as a multi-objective Markov decision process and solves it by leveraging Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search with optimistic set-valued backups, where every node stores a set of reachable trade-offs rather than one weighted score. A single search thus approximately covers the Pareto front, from which MoFlow can return a workflow for any preference by lookup without retraining. We evaluate MoFlow against six strong baselines on six benchmarks spanning mathematics, code, and question answering. Since the baselines are single-scalar optimizers by design, an apples-to-apples comparison is difficult. We instead adopt an evaluation setup that favors the baselines, in that they are rerun for each testing preference, which MoFlow never sees. Even under this stringent setup, MoFlow achieves the highest average hypervolume.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 MoFlow，将智能体工作流生成建模为多目标马尔可夫决策过程，通过凸包蒙特卡洛树搜索与乐观集合值回传，单次搜索即可近似覆盖帕累托前沿，从而针对任意偏好直接查表返回工作流而无需重训练。
AI.motivation: 现有工作流生成方法通常仅优化准确率或目标的加权和，导致每个训练好的生成器固定于单一权衡方案，偏好变化时需从头重训练，缺乏灵活性与可复用性。
AI.method: MoFlow 将工作流生成形式化为多目标马尔可夫决策过程，采用 Convex-Hull Monte Carlo Tree Search 与乐观集合值回传（optimistic set-valued backups），每个节点存储一组可达权衡而非单一加权分数；单次搜索近似覆盖帕累托前沿，再按任意偏好查表返回对应工作流。
AI.result: 在涵盖数学、代码与问答的六个基准上，与六个强基线对比。由于基线本质为单标量优化器，作者采用对基线有利的评测设置（每个测试偏好均重跑基线，而 MoFlow 从未见过这些偏好）。即便在此严苛设置下，MoFlow 仍取得最高的平均超体积（hypervolume）。
AI.conclusion: MoFlow 通过多目标建模与集合值搜索，在单次运行中近似获得帕累托前沿，实现任意偏好下的免重训练工作流生成，并在对基线有利的评测协议下仍优于单标量优化基线。

title: Re-ranking and Late Interaction Drive Retrieval Quality: A Controlled Comparison of RAG Strategies for Scientific Question Answering
comment: on September 21st submitted for consideration to the Elsevier Data and Information Management (DIM) journal (DIM-D-26-00430)
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is now the standard way to ground Large Language Models (LLMs) in external knowledge, yet the design space of retrieval pipelines is large and the trade-offs between variants are not well understood, especially on domain-specific corpora at realistic scale. In this work, we present a controlled comparison of six retrieval strategies for scientific question answering: (i) classic top-k dense retrieval, (ii) LLM-based query rephrasing, (iii) query rephrasing followed by LLM-based reranking, (iv) multi-query fusion via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), (v) an agentic tool-call pipeline in which the generator decides for itself whether to retrieve, and (vi) late-interaction retrieval with ColBERTv2. All six pipelines share the same generator (Meta-Llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct), prompt, and evaluation protocol; the five single-vector pipelines additionally share SPECTER2 embeddings and a Chroma vector store; and all six retrieve from the full corpus of 463,971 arXiv papers dated 2024-2025. To support reproducible, large-scale evaluation, we also release a synthetic question dataset of 19,484 problem-statement and methodology questions generated by Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct from a random sample of 10,000 papers across academic domains (query generation succeeded for 9,742 of them), and every strategy is evaluated on this same query set. We describe the architecture and implementation of each pipeline, release the code and the synthetic question dataset, and evaluate each strategy with an LLM-as-a-judge protocol along multiple quality dimensions, together with direct gold-paper retrieval metrics. The result is an open testbed for studying the cost and quality trade-offs of RAG design choices on a research-literature corpus, and a basis for future work on faithfulness, retrieval robustness, and agentic retrieval.

AI.tldr: 本文对六种检索策略在科学问答任务上进行受控对比，共享同一生成器、提示与评测协议，并构建了大规模合成问答数据集与开源测试平台。
AI.motivation: RAG已成为大模型外部知识锚定的标准方法，但检索流程的设计空间庞大，各变体间的权衡在真实规模的领域特定语料上仍缺乏清晰认知。
AI.method: 对六种检索策略进行受控比较：(i) 经典top-k稠密检索；(ii) 基于LLM的查询改写；(iii) 查询改写后接LLM重排序；(iv) 基于RRF的多查询融合；(v) 生成器自主决定是否检索的智能体工具调用流程；(vi) 使用ColBERTv2的后期交互检索。六条流水线共享同一生成器（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）、提示与评测协议；五条单向量流水线共享SPECTER2嵌入与Chroma向量库；均从2024-2025年463,971篇arXiv论文全量语料中检索。同时发布由Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct从10,000篇随机论文生成的19,484个合成问题数据集（9,742篇成功生成查询）。
AI.result: 描述了各流水线架构与实现，发布代码与合成问答数据集，并采用LLM-as-a-judge协议在多质量维度上评估每种策略，同时结合直接的金标准论文检索指标。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个开放测试平台，用于研究研究文献语料上RAG设计选择的成本与质量权衡，并为忠实性、检索鲁棒性与智能体检索等未来工作奠定基础。

title: A Moving-Horizon Approximate Branch-and-Reduce Method for Deep Classification Trees
summary: Despite the importance for interpretability, decision trees face severe scalability challenges. Existing global optimal methods are often limited by binary feature selection and shallow tree depths, whereas traditional heuristic approaches frequently sacrifice predictive accuracy. To overcome these limitations, this paper proposes a moving-horizon approximate branch-and-reduce method to train near-optimal deep classification trees on large-scale datasets with continuous features. Built on a hierarchical root-subtree optimization framework, the method solves the root-level problem via branch-and-reduce while approximating the induced subtree problem using greedy heuristics. Although the underlying framework is capable of guaranteeing global optimality, the approximation, which functions as a lookahead rollout in a reinforcement learning context, significantly boosts efficiency for deeper structures. A low-cost moving-horizon strategy is then employed to iteratively refine model accuracy. Extensive numerical results demonstrate that our method exceeds the testing accuracy of existing heuristic baselines while offering significantly greater scalability, in terms of both dataset size and tree depth, than global optimal solvers.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种移动视野近似分支-归约方法，在大规模连续特征数据集上训练近优深度分类树，兼顾可扩展性与预测精度。
AI.motivation: 决策树对可解释性很重要，但面临严重可扩展性问题：现有全局最优方法受限于二值特征选择与较浅树深，传统启发式方法则以牺牲预测精度为代价。
AI.method: 基于分层根-子树优化框架：根节点问题用分支-归约精确求解，诱导子树问题用贪心启发式近似（相当于强化学习中的前瞻 rollout）；再采用低成本移动视野策略迭代精化模型精度。
AI.result: 大量数值实验表明，该方法测试精度超过现有启发式基线，且在数据集规模与树深两个维度上均显著优于全局最优求解器的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 通过分支-归约与贪心近似结合的移动视野框架，可在保证近优性的同时突破深度与规模限制，为深度分类树的训练提供了兼具精度与可扩展性的方案。

title: An Empirical Study of Architectural Shift from Traditional to AI-Enabled Simulink Controllers
comment: Accepted at the 33rd Asia-Pacific Software Engineering Conference (APSEC 2026)
summary: Effective AI adoption in cyber-physical systems (CPS) depends on embedding design knowledge into engineering practice. Yet as AI-enabled components increasingly replace analytically derived control laws, this occurs without a systematic understanding of how controller architectures differ or remain similar across paradigms. We address this gap with an empirical study of traditional and AI-enabled Simulink controllers, guided by a literature-derived taxonomy of ten structural categories and nine functional roles. The study analyzes 62 real-world models spanning 8 controller types and 10 application domains, and surveys 13 practitioners, identifying three architectural tensions. First, subsystem organization dominates all controller structures regardless of paradigm, occupying 68-72% of controller footprint, while core control logic occupies minimal space. Second, AI-enabled controllers rely heavily on discrete dynamics and user-defined abstraction, categories largely absent from AI literature, exposing a gap between described and implemented architectures. Third, constraint enforcement blocks largely disappear from AI-enabled models despite practitioner expectations. This reveals a misalignment where safety mechanisms shift from explicit structure to implicit training-time artifacts, breaking traceability.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项实证研究，比较了传统与AI赋能的Simulink控制器架构，基于10个结构类别和9个功能角色的分类体系分析了62个真实模型（8类控制器、10个应用领域）并调研了13位从业者，识别出三类架构张力。
AI.motivation: AI赋能的组件正日益取代解析推导的控制律，但学界对传统与AI控制架构之间究竟如何不同或相似缺乏系统理解。这种知识缺口阻碍了将设计知识有效嵌入工程实践，从而影响AI在信息物理系统（CPS）中的落地应用。
AI.method: 采用文献推导的分类体系（10个结构类别、9个功能角色）指导实证研究；样本包括62个真实Simulink模型，覆盖8种控制器类型与10个应用领域；同时对13位从业者进行问卷调查。
AI.result: 发现三类架构张力：（1）子系统组织在所有控制器结构中占据主导，约占控制器规模（footprint）的68–72%，而核心控制逻辑占比极小，与范式无关；（2）AI赋能控制器高度依赖离散动态与用户自定义抽象，这些类别在AI文献中基本缺席，暴露了描述架构与实现架构之间的差距；（3）尽管从业者预期存在约束强制模块，但它们在AI赋能模型中大幅消失。
AI.conclusion: 上述发现揭示了一种错位：安全机制从显式结构转移到训练时的隐式产物，破坏了对安全约束的可追溯性。这提示AI赋能CPS控制器的工程实践需要显式、可追溯的安全约束表达。

title: AI Agents are Vulnerable to Radicalization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can influence people's beliefs, yet little is known about whether and how they can manipulate each other. To investigate this, we simulate conversations between two agents: a target LLM that role-plays a human persona based on demographic and psychological attributes, and an influencer LLM that aims to make the target's beliefs more extreme. We examine radicalization along two pathways: resonance, where the influencer reinforces a target's pre-existing belief, and persuasion, where the influencer promotes a belief the target initially considers unimportant. Across affective and behavioral metrics, we find that both mechanisms radicalize the target. However, resonance produces consistently stronger effects than persuasion. Different influence tactics, such as using sycophancy and unverified claims, produce different levels of radicalization, but not consistently across metrics. We further show that resonance propagates to related beliefs, suggesting interconnected belief structures within AI agents. These findings indicate that AI agents are susceptible to radicalization, particularly when messages align with their existing beliefs, raising concerns about the vulnerability of personalized AI agents and multi-agent AI ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过模拟两个大语言模型（LLM）智能体之间的对话，揭示了一个充当"影响者"的LLM可显著激进化扮演特定人格的"目标"LLM的信念，且"共鸣"（强化既有信念）比"说服"（推广原本不重视的信念）效果更强，并会扩散至相关信念。
AI.motivation: LLM已被证实能够影响人类信念，但其是否以及如何相互操纵、彼此激进化尚不清楚。随着个性化智能体与多智能体生态系统的兴起，这一空白带来潜在风险。
AI.method: 构建双智能体对话仿真：目标LLM依据人口统计学与心理属性进行人格扮演，影响者LLM意图使目标信念更极端。沿两条路径考察激进化——共鸣（强化既有信念）与说服（推广目标原本不重视的信念），并使用情感与行为指标进行评估。此外测试不同影响策略（如谄媚、未经证实的论断），并检验激进化是否传播至相关信念。
AI.result: 两条路径均能激进化目标，但共鸣的效果持续强于说服；不同影响策略导致的激进化程度不同，但跨指标不一致；共鸣还会扩散至相关信念，表明AI智能体内部存在相互关联的信念结构。
AI.conclusion: AI智能体易受激进化影响，尤其是当信息与其既有信念一致时，这对个性化AI智能体及多智能体AI生态系统的脆弱性提出了警示。

title: Exploring Forum Post Retrieval with Generative Modeling
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) has emerged as an alternative to embedding-based retrieval, building on the success of generative models in language and vision. We are exploring GR on Facebook Forum, a standalone application for medium-to-heavy users of Facebook Groups. Because Forum is a new surface, its own interaction data are too sparse to train a GR model from scratch. We address this with transfer along two axes: we train on a broader corpus of Facebook Groups engagements rather than Forum sessions alone, and we reuse hierarchical, prefix-based semantic IDs (SIDs) learned from cross-platform Facebook Feed data instead of fitting a Forum-specific tokenizer. A 3B-parameter instruction-tuned language model is then supervised-fine-tuned to generate SIDs directly from user context. We systematically ablate the design choices that matter most in practice, including SID construction, the composition and length of user history, and the inclusion of user-profile features. Our results show that cross-platform SIDs transfer to a new recommendation surface, and offer practical guidance for teams deploying GR on real-world social platforms.

AI.tldr: 在 Facebook Forum 这一新场景上探索生成式推荐（GR），通过跨场景与跨平台的迁移策略解决交互数据稀疏问题，并系统消融关键设计选择。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐（GR）作为基于嵌入检索的替代方案，在语言与视觉生成模型成功的推动下受到关注。但 Facebook Forum 是新独立应用，其自身交互数据过于稀疏，无法从零训练一个 GR 模型，因此需要研究如何将 GR 迁移到数据稀缺的新推荐场景。
AI.method: 采用两条迁移路径：一是训练数据从仅用 Forum 会话扩展到更广泛的 Facebook Groups 交互语料；二是复用从跨平台 Facebook Feed 数据中学到的分层、基于前缀的语义 ID（SID），而非为 Forum 单独拟合 tokenizer。然后将一个 3B 参数、经指令微调的语言模型进行有监督微调（SFT），直接从用户上下文生成 SID。并系统消融了 SID 构建方式、用户历史的组成与长度、以及是否引入用户画像特征等关键设计选择。
AI.result: 实验表明，跨平台学习的 SID 能够有效迁移到新的推荐场景（Forum），验证了跨平台语义 ID 的可迁移性；消融实验揭示了 SID 构建、用户历史组成与长度、用户画像特征等因素在实践中对效果的重要影响。
AI.conclusion: 跨平台语义 ID 可成功迁移至新的推荐场景，为在真实社交平台上部署生成式推荐提供了实践性指导。

title: A Data-Free Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Level-Set Interface Advection
summary: Operators for interfacial problems are trained on reference solutions produced by the solver they are intended to replace. This work develops a data-free physics-informed neural operator for level-set interface advection, in which the interface is the equation's unknown and the operator maps an initial interface to the full spatiotemporal trajectory under a prescribed flow. Training uses only the transport residual and a geometric constraint; no reference solution enters the objective at any point. A spacetime Fourier backbone emits the entire trajectory in one pass, and the initial condition is imposed by construction rather than by penalty, which removes the competition between the anchoring term and the residual that otherwise arises when no solution data are available. Supervised and hybrid operators are trained under an identical architecture, family, budget and test set, and are reported throughout as baselines that quantify what refusing labels costs. On a reversed single vortex the data-free operator reaches 1.614 +/- 0.067% relative L2 error on 100 held-out initial interfaces against 0.369 +/- 0.035% for the supervised baseline, a factor of 4.4; on solid-body rotation the corresponding figures are 3.804 +/- 1.075% and 2.576 +/- 0.159%, a factor of 1.5. The two benchmarks rank the arms differently, and the difference is attributable to the eikonal constraint: the exact solution violates |grad phi| = 1 over 0.3% of the domain under rotation and 86.9% under the vortex. Where the constraint is valid the physics-trained operator conserves enclosed area 2.7 times better than the supervised baseline despite a larger field error, and a hybrid arm using eight reference solutions outperforms a supervised arm using sixteen.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无数据物理信息神经算子用于水平集界面平流，仅用输运残差与几何约束训练，一次性输出整条时空轨迹，初始条件按构造施加；在反向单涡与刚体旋转基准上与监督/混合基线同架构对比，量化"拒绝标签"的代价。
AI.motivation: 现有界面问题的算子通常由其所要替代的求解器生成的参考解来训练，形成对标签数据的依赖。本文希望消除对参考解的依赖，并在无解数据条件下避免锚定项与残差项之间的竞争。
AI.method: 采用无数据物理信息神经算子：界面为方程未知量，算子将初始界面映射到给定流场下的完整时空轨迹。训练目标仅含输运残差与几何约束（eikonal 约束），不使用任何参考解。以时空 Fourier 主干一次前向输出整条轨迹，初始条件按构造施加而非惩罚项。监督与混合算子在同一架构、族、预算与测试集下训练并作为基线。
AI.result: 反向单涡上，无数据算子对100个留出初始界面的相对L2误差为1.614±0.067%，监督基线为0.369±0.035%（差4.4倍）；刚体旋转上分别为3.804±1.075%与2.576±0.159%（差1.5倍）。两基准对各方法排序不同，差异归因于eikonal约束：精确解在旋转下0.3%区域违反|grad phi|=1，在涡下为86.9%。约束成立处，物理训练算子包围面积守恒比监督基线好2.7倍，尽管场误差更大；使用8个参考解的混合臂优于使用16个参考解的监督臂。
AI.conclusion: 无数据物理信息神经算子可在不使用任何参考解的情况下学习水平集界面平流，其精度损失因基准而异，主要受eikonal约束有效性支配；在约束成立区域，它可获得优于监督基线的几何守恒性，且混合策略在少量参考解下即可超越纯监督方案。

title: Adaptive-GEPA: Make Your Harness Fit Heterogeneous Requests
summary:
Reflective optimizers such as GEPA improve language model prompts from execution traces and evaluator feedback; full-program extensions can also rewrite tools and control flow. In practice, a user hands the same endpoint heterogeneous requests whose effective solutions require different tools, reasoning modes, and control flow. Optimizing one shared program leaves this division of work implicit in source-code search, while optimizing a separate program per request family fixes it beforehand.
  We introduce Adaptive-GEPA, which learns both how to divide requests and how to solve them. It evolves a router and a library of specialist programs under one search budget. The router's instructions, each specialist's description, and its program code are plain, human-readable text, edited from feedback. To combine branches, it aligns specialists by the requests they handle and inherits descriptions together with programs. On a fixed mixture of four task families, the reported Qwen3-8B run evolves four experts without supplying family labels to the router or reflection model; its routing matches the task partition on all 651 test requests. Its family-mean test score (x100) rises from 52.6 to 70.6, compared with 62.5 for GEPA's full-program adapter and 54.0 for GRPO at a nominal budget of 18,000 scored calls. These counts do not equate total compute. Figure 1 summarizes the learning curves, final test scores, and routing agreement.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Adaptive-GEPA，在学习"如何解决请求"的同时学习"如何划分请求"，通过进化一个路由器与专家程序库来应对异构请求，并报告其在四项任务族混合基准上的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现实使用中，同一模型端点会收到异构请求，不同请求所需的有效解法依赖不同的工具、推理模式与控制流。现有做法存在两难：优化单一共享程序会把分工隐式地留给源码搜索，而按请求族分别优化程序则需事先固定划分。作者希望让"划分请求"与"求解请求"同时被学习。
AI.method: 提出 Adaptive-GEPA：在统一搜索预算下共同进化一个路由器（router）与一个专家程序库（specialist programs）。路由器的指令、每个专家的描述及其程序代码均为人类可读的纯文本，并依据反馈进行编辑。为合并分支，方法按专家所处理的请求进行对齐，并同时继承描述与程序。
AI.result: 在四个任务族的固定混合上，Qwen3-8B 运行结果进化出四个专家，且未向路由器或反思模型提供任务族标签；其路由在全部 651 条测试请求上与任务划分一致。任务族平均测试分数（×100）由 52.6 提升至 70.6，而 GEPA 的全程序适配器为 62.5，GRPO 在名义预算 18,000 次评分调用下为 54.0（作者声明这些计数不等同于总计算量）。
AI.conclusion: Adaptive-GEPA 表明，将请求划分与求解策略联合学习是可行且有效的：无需任务族标签即可自动形成与真实任务划分一致的专家路由，并在混合任务上取得优于全程序适配器与 GRPO 的测试表现。路由一致性、学习曲线与最终成绩见 Figure 1。

title: CARAT: Do Materials LLMs Reason or Recite?
summary: When a materials LLM answers a question about crystal structure, does it reason from the structure or copy an answer already printed in its input? Accuracy cannot tell: a structural description often prints the very field it is scored against. CARAT holds question and gold answer fixed across eight matched views, names each structural relation separately in GraphSpace, and adds matched fine-tuning, answer masking, evidence injection, paired inference, and a rule that can withhold claims. First, on the benchmark's hardest families the grounded view is worth 17.3 points over formula inputs. Second, we turn that scrutiny on ourselves. GraphSpace beats a plain periodic graph by 19.3 points, but that margin is two effects at once: where the plain rendering carries everything the question needs it is 1.96 points, and where it omits those fields entirely, 46.7 points. The headline mostly measures what the baseline lacked, not how evidence is presented. Third, we attack our own benchmark. A rule that skips the link and reads the list directly answers four of seven hardened families, so we rebuilt it until eleven such shortcuts sat near chance. The frozen model quotes that link yet answers the same when we redirect it, on 95.6% of paired cases: it repeats the relation without using it. After matched supervision it reaches 99.8%, and deleting the link drops it to 23.4%, below the 27.0% the best shortcut reaches: both steps are learnable.

AI.tldr: CARAT 通过八种匹配视图、成对推断与可拒答规则，证明材料 LLM 的"结构推理"多来自输入中已打印答案字段的复制，而非真正使用结构关系；经匹配微调后模型才会真正依赖结构链接。
AI.motivation: 材料领域 LLM 回答晶体结构问题时，准确率无法区分模型是"基于结构推理"还是"复制输入中已打印的答案"。因为结构描述文本往往直接印有被评分的那个字段，导致评测存在捷径与数据泄漏，宣称的高准确率可能只是基线缺失信息的度量。
AI.method: 提出 CARAT 基准与协议：(1) 固定问题与金标准答案，构建八种匹配视图；(2) 在 GraphSpace 中把每种结构关系单独命名；(3) 引入匹配微调、答案掩码、证据注入、成对推断，以及可拒绝声明（withhold）的规则；(4) 对自身基准进行攻击式消融：用跳过链接、直读列表的规则构造捷径族，并重新构建直到 11 个捷径接近随机水平。
AI.result: 在最难族上，有据视图比公式输入高 17.3 分。GraphSpace 比普通周期图高 19.3 分，但该差距是两种效应叠加：普通渲染已含所需字段时仅 1.96 分，完全缺失这些字段时达 46.7 分——即 headline 主要衡量基线的缺失，而非证据呈现方式。冻结模型在重定向链接后，95.6% 的成对样例给出相同答案，说明它重复关系却未使用关系；匹配监督后该比例升至 99.8%，删除链接则降至 23.4%，低于最佳捷径的 27.0%。
AI.conclusion: 准确率本身不足以证明结构推理；必须用匹配视图、成对干预和捷径攻击来分离"复制"与"使用"。结果表明：链接关系与依赖关系两个步骤都是可学习的，模型需要匹配监督才会真正使用结构证据。

title: PatchHolmes: Agentic Patch Retrieval via Listwise Selection
comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Code at https://github.com/Aizhouym/PatchHolmes
summary: Patch retrieval, the task of finding the commit that fixes a known vulnerability, is the foundation of vulnerability management workflows, yet 60% to 63% of CVEs in the major advisory databases lack a patch link. We present PatchHolmes, a two-phase patch retrieval system that pairs a hybrid first-stage retriever with an agentic second-stage inspection loop. Unlike pointwise prior work that scores each candidate independently, the Phase 2 agent reads the top-100 listwise: it sees the full candidate list at once and selectively reads 3 to 10 commits through four budgeted tools before submitting a single best commit. On GitHubAD, PatchHolmes beats the pointwise binary classifier Favia by 25.34% Recall@1 and the retrieve-and-CoT baseline IRCoT by 31.40%, at one agent conversation per CVE versus Favia's ten; with the candidate set held identical, the agent adds 27.32% Recall@1 over taking the retriever's top candidate, and the same agent, transferred unchanged to PatchFinder_top10, lifts Recall@1 from PatchFinder's own top-1 pick (24.28%) to 39.86%. Swapping the LLM backbone within the Qwen family changes Recall@1 by under 1%, and a second model family (gpt-oss) stays far above the no-agent floor, so the gain comes from the listwise agent loop; the entire system runs on a frozen open-weight model over a local Git repository, without fine-tuning or external search APIs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PatchHolmes，一个两阶段补丁检索系统：第一阶段混合检索器生成候选列表，第二阶段由LLM智能体以listwise方式审阅top-100并用四个预算受限工具选择性阅读3-10个commit，最终提交单一最佳commit。
AI.motivation: 补丁检索是漏洞管理流程的基础任务，但主流公告数据库中60%-63%的CVE缺乏补丁链接。现有pointwise方法独立地对每个候选打分，无法利用候选间的相对比较信息，检索效果受限。
AI.method: PatchHolmes采用两阶段架构：Phase 1为混合检索器产生候选集；Phase 2为智能体式审阅循环，一次性读取top-100的全部候选列表，通过四个有预算限制的工具选择性阅读3-10个commit，再提交唯一最佳commit。系统运行于冻结的开源权重模型和本地Git仓库之上，无需微调或外部搜索API。
AI.result: 在GitHubAD上，PatchHolmes较pointwise二分类器Favia提升25.34% Recall@1，较retrieve-and-CoT基线IRCoT提升31.40%，且每个CVE仅需一次智能体对话（Favia需十次）。在候选集相同条件下，智能体相较直接取检索器top候选提升27.32% Recall@1；同一智能体原样迁移到PatchFinder_top10，将Recall@1从PatchFinder自身top-1的24.28%提升至39.86%。在Qwen家族内更换LLM骨干，Recall@1变化小于1%；另一模型家族（gpt-oss）也远超无智能体的下限。
AI.conclusion: 性能增益来源于listwise智能体循环本身，而非特定模型骨干，且结果对模型替换具有稳健性；整个系统可在冻结开源模型与本地Git仓库上高效运行。

title: Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble
comment: Published in ICONIP 2024 (Neural Information Processing), LNCS 15287, Springer Nature, 2025
summary: Accurate time series forecasting is critical across various domains, yet traditional ensemble methods often suffer from the disproportionate influence of extreme forecasts. We introduce the Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble (CAGE), a novel framework that combines generative modeling, adversarial discrimination, and conformal prediction to enhance forecast reliability and accuracy. CAGE employs multiple generative models to produce initial forecasts, which are then evaluated by a discriminative component using conformal prediction techniques. P-values derived from nonconformity scores help dynamically adjust model weights, minimizing the impact of unreliable forecasts. This approach ensures that only the most credible predictions contribute to the final ensemble output. Our empirical and statistical analyses of time series data from New Zealand's milk collection and the global health data from the public owid-monkeypox dataset show that the CAGE outperforms traditional ensemble methods, especially in handling outliers and noisy data. By incorporating conformal prediction, CAGE delivers accurate and statistically rigorous forecasts, enhancing decision-making. We have demonstrated performance on two different datasets deliberately to showcase that the proposed method offers a versatile solution potentially applicable across finance, weather, and supply chain management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CAGE（Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble）框架，融合生成建模、对抗判别与保形预测，通过非一致性得分导出的 p 值动态调整各生成模型权重，抑制不可靠预测的影响，在牛奶收集与猴痘数据集上优于传统集成方法。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列集成方法易受极端预测的不成比例影响，导致整体预测可靠性下降。作者希望构建一种能自动弱化不可信预测贡献、并具备统计严谨性的集成框架。
AI.method: CAGE 由三部分组成：（1）多个生成模型产生初始预测；（2）判别组件借助保形预测技术对预测进行评估，基于非一致性得分计算 p 值；（3）利用这些 p 值动态调整模型权重，使仅最可信的预测进入最终集成输出。
AI.result: 在新西兰牛奶收集数据和公共 owid-monkeypox 全球健康数据上进行了实证与统计分析，结果表明 CAGE 优于传统集成方法，尤其在处理离群值和噪声数据时表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入保形预测，CAGE 能提供准确且具统计严谨性的预测，提升决策质量；在两个异构数据集上的表现说明该方法具有通用性，可潜在应用于金融、天气和供应链管理等领域。

title: Toward Quantum Software Automation: A Quantum-Aware Harness for LLM-Guided Evolution
summary: Quantum software is critical for improving the efficiency and reliability of scarce quantum hardware. However, its design still relies heavily on ad-hoc, handcrafted heuristics that are often suboptimal and quickly become obsolete as quantum hardware evolves. LLM-guided evolutionary search offers a promising way to automatically explore complex software designs, but existing search frameworks lack the quantum-specific support needed for efficient evolution: verification is expensive, feedback is sparse, and heterogeneous quantum programs require different optimization objectives. In this paper, we present QSA, a quantum-aware harness for LLM-guided evolutionary search toward automating quantum software design. QSA equips the search with three forms of quantum-specific guidance: an evolution-hardness-guided coreset and approximate scoring to reduce verification cost, static and snapshot analyses to provide fine-grained execution context, and task-specific rewards for compiler passes and runtime policies. We evaluate QSA on the IBM Quantum platform across three benchmark suites. For multiprogramming, QSA improves QPU utilization by 4.2%-9.5% and Hellinger fidelity by 15.2%-19.5% over the state of the art. For error mitigation, QSA reduces mitigation time by at least 96.8% while achieving comparable or better fidelity. These gains require only $6.9 in LLM API cost over 11.3 hours.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QSA——一种面向LLM引导进化搜索的量子感知框架，通过进化难度引导的核心集与近似评分、静态与快照分析、任务特定奖励三种量子专用引导来降低验证成本、利用细粒度执行上下文并区分优化目标，实现在IBM Quantum平台上的量子软件设计自动化。
AI.motivation: 量子软件对提升稀缺量子硬件的效率与可靠性至关重要，但其设计仍高度依赖手工启发式，往往次优且随硬件演进而迅速过时。LLM引导的进化搜索有望自动探索复杂软件设计，然而现有搜索框架缺乏量子专用支持：验证开销大、反馈稀疏、异构量子程序需要不同的优化目标。
AI.method: QSA为搜索引入三类量子专用引导：(1) 进化难度引导的核心集与近似评分，以降低验证成本；(2) 静态分析与快照分析，提供细粒度执行上下文；(3) 针对编译pass与运行时策略的任务特定奖励。在IBM Quantum平台上跨三个基准套件进行评估。
AI.result: 在多程序并发场景下，QPU利用率相较SOTA提升4.2%–9.5%，Hellinger保真度提升15.2%–19.5%；在误差缓解场景下，缓解时间至少减少96.8%，同时保真度相当或更优。上述收益仅需11.3小时内6.9美元的LLM API成本。
AI.conclusion: QSA通过将量子领域知识注入LLM引导的进化搜索，有效缓解了验证昂贵与反馈稀疏的瓶颈，在量子硬件上实现了显著的效率与保真度增益且成本极低，为量子软件设计的自动化提供了可行路径。

title: Examining Variation in How Guided AI Tutors Resolve Student Impasses
summary: When a student is stuck, a tutor faces the assistance dilemma: help given too early can hinder productive struggle, while help withheld too long leaves the student in a frustrating, persistent impasse (i.e., wheel spinning). Generative AI tutors increasingly use guardrails restricting answer-giving, yet little is known about how such tutors behave once an impasse persists. We analyze 20,462 student turns from 1,260 authentic sessions with a guided LLM chemistry tutor, identifying 6,630 impasse turns of three major types: conceptual errors, expressed uncertainty, or help-seeking. We then used these impasses to simulate three tutoring conditions to study variation in AI tutor guidance through impasses: baseline, no-direct-answer, and guided tutor. For a sample of 150 impasses, prompt specificity changed pedagogy: a baseline tutor provided the answer directly in 50.7% of responses, a no-direct-answer tutor asked a follow-up question every time, and the guided tutor responded in a wide variety of ways depending on the context. We then analyzed impasse trajectories in authentic interactions, finding that each additional impasse turn lowered the odds of next-turn recovery by 12.7% (AOR = 0.873, p < .001), and early dropouts were caught in recursive concept elicitation before reaching execution. The benefit of questioning decayed as impasses persisted (scripted question x depth AOR = 0.78; follow-up x depth AOR = 0.83), whereas addressing the student's error grew more beneficial (AOR = 1.14); after a failed scripted question, repeating it was followed by recovery in 28.1% of cases, compared with 39.8% when the tutor addressed the error instead. For learning analytics, these findings identify impasse depth and type as observable, turn-level dialogue signals that analytics can use to trigger graduated, state-sensitive assistance in real time.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析1,260次真实辅导会话中20,462个学生对话轮次（含6,630个僵局轮次），揭示了AI导师在僵局中的行为差异，并发现僵局深度与类型是可观测的实时信号，可用于触发渐进式、情境敏感的辅助策略。
AI.motivation: AI辅导面临"辅助困境"：过早帮助会阻碍有效挣扎，过晚帮助则导致学生陷入挫败的持续性僵局（wheel spinning）。尽管生成式AI导师日益采用限制直接给出答案的护栏机制，但其在僵局持续时的实际行为表现尚不明确。
AI.method: 分析1,260次真实会话中20,462个学生轮次，识别出6,630个僵局轮次，分为概念错误、表达不确定性和寻求帮助三种类型；基于这些僵局模拟基线、无直接答案、引导式导师三种条件，并对150个僵局样本进行深入分析；随后分析真实交互中的僵局轨迹。
AI.result: 提示具体性改变了教学行为：基线导师在50.7%的回应中直接给出答案，无直接答案导师每次都追问，引导式导师则根据情境做出多样回应。每个额外僵局轮次使下一轮恢复几率降低12.7%（AOR=0.873, p<.001），早期退出者陷入概念诱导的递归循环。提问的益处随僵局加深而衰减（预设问题×深度AOR=0.78；追问×深度AOR=0.83），而针对学生错误则愈发有益（AOR=1.14）；预设问题失败后重复提问的恢复率为28.1%，而针对错误处理的恢复率为39.8%。
AI.conclusion: 僵局深度和类型是可观测的轮次级对话信号，学习分析可借此在实时中触发渐进式、状态敏感的辅助，从而在"过早帮助"与"过晚帮助"之间取得平衡。

title: SkillSeek: Revisiting Agent Skill Retrieval at Marketplace Scale
comment: Accepted at AACL-IJCNLP 2026. Code at https://github.com/guanqun-yang/SkillSeek
summary: Anthropic's Agent Skills package reusable procedural know-how for an LLM agent into SKILL.md directories, and open-source aggregations have grown past 230,000 skills, making selection rather than authoring the bottleneck. The standing answer in the literature outsources selection to the agent itself: an LLM-mediated retrieval loop that rewrites queries and refines candidates inside the agent's decision loop, paying LLM tokens on every task. We present SkillSeek, an open-source two-stage skill retriever built from the standard IR recipe (a BGE-base bi-encoder feeding a small cross-encoder, exposed over MCP). Across a $4 \times 11$ grid of pool, backbone, and method on the 89-task SkillsBench benchmark, SkillSeek reaches observed parity with the LLM-mediated loop of Liu et al. at essentially no extra cost: plain bm25 alone records a pass rate at or above their refined loop on three of four settings, and a small cross-encoder covers the remaining difference on the fourth. A first-stage recall ceiling explains the pattern, and total per-trial spend drops from USD 51.30 to USD 27.54 (within fifty cents of the no-skill baseline). Under the SkillsBench tasks and OpenHands harness we tested, this positions the standard IR recipe as a strong default for agent-skill retrieval, with LLM-mediated alternatives a natural fit for cases where deterministic methods fall short.

AI.tldr: SkillSeek 用标准 IR 两阶段检索（BGE-base 双塔 + 小型交叉编码器，经 MCP 暴露）替代 LLM 中介的技能检索循环，在 SkillsBench 89 任务上以近乎零额外成本达到与后者相当的通过率。
AI.motivation: Agent 技能生态已积累超 23 万条开源技能，瓶颈从"编写技能"转向"选择技能"。现有文献的主流做法是把选择外包给 LLM 本身，即在 agent 决策循环内做查询改写与候选精炼的检索循环，导致每个任务都要消耗 LLM token。
AI.method: 提出开源两阶段技能检索器 SkillSeek，采用标准 IR 范式：第一阶段用 BGE-base 双塔编码器召回，第二阶段用小型交叉编码器重排，并通过 MCP 接口暴露。在 SkillsBench 的 89 个任务上进行 pool、backbone、method 的 4×11 网格实验。
AI.result: SkillSeek 与 Liu 等的 LLM 中介循环达到观察到的性能持平且几乎不增加成本：纯 BM25 在四类设置中的三类通过率不低于其精炼循环，第四类的差距由小型交叉编码器补齐。第一阶段的召回上限解释了这一现象。单次试验总开销从 51.30 美元降至 27.54 美元，与无技能基线的差距在 50 美分以内。
AI.conclusion: 在本文测试的 SkillsBench 任务与 OpenHands 框架下，标准 IR 范式可作为 agent 技能检索的强默认方案；LLM 中介方案更适合确定性方法失效的场景。

title: DualCast: A Dual-Path Language Model for Bimodal Financial Time-Series Forecasting
summary: Financial time-series forecasting must capture price dynamics across heterogeneous assets while incorporating news available at prediction time. We introduce DualCast, a dual-path framework that extends a frozen language model with a discrete financial vocabulary. Each log-return patch is represented by a learned summary token and three residual shape tokens, preserving local drift and volatility while allowing shape patterns to be shared across assets. To improve codebook utilization, we develop adaptive frequency-equalizing residual vector quantization, which rebalances overloaded codewords without compromising reconstruction accuracy. The fast path trains only the new financial-token embeddings and output heads on a frozen Qwen3-8B backbone. A toggleable LoRA adapter enables a slow path that conditions on the fast forecast and news available at the forecast origin to produce a revised prediction. The reviser is initialized by supervised fine-tuning and further optimized with a return-space group relative policy optimization objective that rewards improvements over the fast forecast. In zero-shot evaluations covering equities and energy prices at five-minute, daily, and weekly resolutions, the slow path achieves the lowest mean absolute percentage error among the compared methods in 8 of 12 dataset-horizon settings, including every longest-horizon setting. News ablations indicate additional gains in most tested settings, although their magnitude varies across markets. DualCast thus combines a fast numerical forecaster with an optional text-conditioned revision mechanism.

AI.tldr: DualCast：将冻结语言模型扩展离散金融词表，构建快慢双路径预测框架，快路径做数值预测，慢路径用LoRA在新闻条件下修正，在多数股/能源零样本设定中取得最低MAPE。
AI.motivation: 金融时序预测需同时应对异质资产的价�格动态并在预测时融入新闻；现有方法难以兼顾跨资产的形态共享、离散表征的高效利用以及文本条件化。
AI.method: 框架以冻结Qwen3-8B为骨干，将每个对数收益片段用1个学习摘要token与3个残差形态token表示；提出自适应频率均衡残差向量量化（AF-RVQ）重平衡过载码字并保持重构精度；快路径仅训练新金融token嵌入与输出头；可切换LoRA适配器构成慢路径，基于快路径预测与预测起点新闻进行修正，先SFT初始化，再用收益空间组相对策略优化（GRPO）以超越快路径预测为奖励进一步优化。
AI.result: 在5分钟、日、周三种频率的股票与能源价格零样本评测中，慢路径在12个数据集-预测跨度设定中的8个（含所有最长跨度设定）取得最低MAPE；新闻消融显示多数设定有额外增益，但幅度因市场而异。
AI.conclusion: DualCast将快速数值预测器与可选文本条件修正机制结合，验证了离散金融词表、频率均衡量化与新闻条件化RL修正的有效性。

title: Doing More with Less Tokens: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Efficient Coding Agents
summary: Recently, coding agents have emerged as a dominant paradigm for real-world software engineering (SWE) scenarios, which solve complex tasks through multi-turn interactions with development environments. However, frequent interactions with environments would inevitably introduce substantial token overhead, leading to high usage costs and latency. Although recent studies have explored reducing token usage by context manipulation and interaction limits at inference time, these approaches focus on improving token efficiency while overlooking the risk of discarding task-relevant information, thus struggling to balance the trade-off between resolution rate and token efficiency. In this paper, we study a more general paradigm without suffering from the limitation, i.e., training token-efficient coding agents with promising resolution performance, which is a highly-practical yet less-explored problem. To this end, we reveal two core observations in SWE scenarios: i) Efficiency Variation: successful resolution could be achieved with fewer tokens; ii) Entropy Correlation: unproductive behaviors are associated with turn-level entropy. Motivated by observations, we propose a novel reinforcement learning framework, dubbed HERO. Specifically, HERO prioritizes task resolution over token efficiency during policy optimization and encourages efficient reasoning patterns at both trajectory and turn levels. Extensive experiments on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Multilingual demonstrate that HERO achieves a favorable trade-off between resolution rate and token efficiency compared with state-of-the-art coding agents and reinforcement learning methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HERO，一个强化学习框架，通过轨迹级与轮次级熵引导机制训练token高效的编码智能体，在SWE-bench上实现解决率与token效率的更好权衡。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在真实SWE场景中通过多轮交互解决复杂任务，但频繁环境交互带来巨大的token开销，导致高成本和高延迟。现有推理阶段方法（上下文操作、交互限制）只关注token效率，却忽视丢弃任务相关信息风险，难以平衡解决率与token效率。因此作者提出训练token高效编码智能体这一更具通用性但研究不足的问题。
AI.method: 基于两个核心观察：i) 效率差异性——成功解决任务可用更少token完成；ii) 熵相关性——无产出行为与轮次级熵相关。据此提出强化学习框架HERO：在策略优化中优先考虑任务解决而非token效率，并在轨迹级和轮次级两个层面鼓励高效推理模式。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Multilingual上的大量实验表明，与最先进的编码智能体及强化学习方法相比，HERO在解决率与token效率之间取得了更优的权衡。
AI.conclusion: HERO验证了通过强化学习训练token高效编码智能体的可行性，为在不牺牲解决性能的前提下降低token开销提供了新范式，拓展了编码智能体效率优化的研究路径。

title: Beyond Mode Collapse: Generating Diverse Synthetic Expert Conversations via Generative Flow Networks
summary: High quality synthetic data is central to post training LLMs for adaptive AI applications that represent the diverse expert strategies and decisions in conversations. Prompting LLMs directly or conditioning them on end use scenarios yields low diversity data that collapses onto dominant modes. We propose a method to generate diverse high quality synthetic data using Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets). We show that training GFlowNets to generate latent conversation structure using a Gaussian mixture density over key interaction features (e.g., confusion episode dynamics, scaffolding directive balance) enables sampling expert strategies in proportion to their prevalence in the training data. Across two structurally distinct domains, tutoring and emotional support dialogues, our GFlow based synthetic data generation approach offers a better balance of fidelity, mode coverage and authenticity than reinforcement-learning and end to end LLM baselines, without copying training data. Evaluated on three downstream outcome prediction tasks, classifiers trained on synthetic GFlowNet generated conversations provide a stronger training signal than competitive synthesis baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用生成流网络（GFlowNets）生成多样化、高质量的合成对话数据，以克服直接提示LLM导致的数据多样性塌缩问题，在辅导和情感支持两个领域的下游任务上优于强化学习和端到端LLM基线。
AI.motivation: 高质量合成数据是LLM后训练的核心，用于构建能体现对话中多样化专家策略与决策的自适应AI应用。然而，直接提示LLM或以其终端使用场景为条件进行生成，会产生多样性低、集中于主导模式的数据，导致模式覆盖不足。
AI.method: 提出基于GFlowNets的合成数据生成方法。以关键交互特征上的高斯混合密度（如困惑情景动态、支架式指令平衡）为奖励，训练GFlowNet生成潜在的对话结构，从而按训练数据中专家策略的流行度成比例地进行采样。
AI.result: 在两个结构上差异明显的领域（辅导与情感支持对话）中，基于GFlow的方法在保真度、模式覆盖和真实性之间取得了比强化学习与端到端LLM基线更好的平衡，且不复制训练数据。在三个下游结果预测任务上，用GFlowNet生成的合成对话训练的模型比竞争性合成基线提供了更强的训练信号。
AI.conclusion: GFlowNets能够有效生成按流行度比例覆盖多样专家策略的高质量合成对话数据，为LLM后训练提供优于现有基线的训练信号，不依赖训练数据复制。

title: Text-Video Retrieval via Multi-Dimensional Saliency Assessment and Granularity-Aware Query Decomposition
summary: Text-video retrieval, which aims to bridge visual and textual modalities by learning a joint embedding space, has become a crucial task in multimodal intelligence. Despite extensive efforts to mitigate visual redundancy, previous methods typically rely on a single-aspect criterion to assess visual importance, overlooking the multifaceted spatiotemporal nature of video. In addition, encoding text into a single global embedding to align with videos compresses temporal events and spatial entities into a unified representation space, further aggravating cross-modal misalignment. To address these issues, we propose MMTI, a method that jointly mitigates visual redundancy and enables multi-grained text-video interaction to achieve accurate multi-grained semantic alignment. Specifically, a key feature selection (KFS) mechanism adaptively identifies and aggregates informative frames and patches by jointly evaluating multi-dimensional saliency and learnable importance scores, effectively compacting dense visual features and mitigating visual redundancy. Furthermore, our proposed multi-grained text-video interaction module (TVIM) employs a dynamic gating mechanism to decompose the text query into sentence, frame, and patch queries (SFP), enabling multi-grained text-video alignment. Complementary alignment at different granularities is thereby achieved. Extensive experiments on four standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method outperforms state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出MMTI方法，通过关键特征选择机制与多粒度文本-视频交互模块，联合缓解视觉冗余并实现多粒度语义对齐，在四个基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 文本-视频检索需学习联合嵌入空间，但现有方法存在两大问题：一是仅依赖单一维度准则评估视觉重要性，忽略了视频多维时空特性，导致视觉冗余未被充分消除；二是将文本编码为单一全局嵌入，压缩了时序事件和空间实体，加剧跨模态错位。
AI.method: MMTI包含两个核心组件：1）关键特征选择机制（KFS），通过联合评估多维显著性与可学习重要性分数，自适应地识别并聚合信息量大的帧和图像块，压缩稠密视觉特征；2）多粒度文本-视频交互模块（TVIM），采用动态门控机制将文本查询分解为句子、帧、图像块（SFP）三级查询，实现多粒度对齐。
AI.result: 在四个标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: MMTI通过联合缓解视觉冗余与多粒度文本-视频交互，实现了准确的多粒度语义对齐，验证了多维度视觉重要性评估与多粒度查询分解在文本-视频检索中的有效性。

title: FlashDiffusion: Fused Tiled Kernel Spectral Decomposition
summary: Diffusion maps, and kernel methods more generally, provide an interpretable nonlinear spectral representation basis for geometric learning. In the geometric limit, small bandwidth, these matrices tend to be high rank and thus require materializing dense Gaussian kernels requires $O(N^2)$ memory. We introduce FlashDiffusion, a matrix-free method that evaluates dense Gaussian kernel blocks in fused GPU tiles and couples the eigensolver to an empirical $β$-flow that selects the finite-sample resolution scale. A continuation over sample size and bandwidth warm-starts increasingly expensive spectral solves from coarser resolutions.

AI.tldr: FlashDiffusion：一种矩阵无关（matrix-free）的扩散映射方法，通过融合GPU分块计算稠密高斯核，并结合经验β-flow自适应选择有限样本分辨率尺度，利用样本量与带宽的continuation实现谱求解热启动。
AI.motivation: 扩散映射及核方法为几何学习提供可解释的非线性谱表示基，但在几何极限（小带宽）下相关矩阵趋于高秩，显式构造稠密高斯核需O(N^2)内存，成为可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出FlashDiffusion：1）矩阵无关方法，在融合的GPU tile中计算稠密高斯核块，避免显式存储整核矩阵；2）将特征求解器与经验β-flow耦合，用于选择有限样本分辨率尺度；3）在样本量与带宽上进行continuation，以粗分辨率的求解结果热启动（warm-start）逐渐昂贵的高分辨率谱求解。
AI.result: 在几何极限下通过分块核计算与分辨率continuation，规避了稠密核的O(N^2)内存需求，并借助β-flow自动确定有限样本下的合适分辨率尺度。
AI.conclusion: FlashDiffusion提供了一种可扩展的几何谱学习方法，兼顾扩散映射的可解释表示能力与大样本、小带宽场景下的计算与内存效率。

title: From Verification Failures to Reusable Guidance for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents need to establish that a program satisfies a specification and that the specification captures the requested behavior. We study how expert diagnosis of verification failures can become reusable guidance for this work. Our approach combines executable language definitions in the K framework with a kit of procedures for constructing specifications, repairing proofs, and auditing their adequacy. A human-guided development campaign on HumanEval, a benchmark of 164 Python programming tasks, achieves a 164/164 success rate with the semantics and the kit, measured by final AI audit Pass verdicts after two targeted repairs. To examine whether auditing detects problems that successful proofs leave unresolved, we construct 12 author-reviewed pairs of clean and defective packages. Every package passes its K proofs, and completed audits identify all defects and accept all clean packages. We then use KleverBench to test specification and proof construction for 31 programs with changed operator meanings. Comparisons with complete acceptance rules and equally long generic advice yield mixed results across two model and budget settings, motivating further work on selecting useful guidance within resource limits. Human-reviewed Optimism proofs establish expected pause reverts for six operations within declared input bounds under London semantics with unbounded gas. We report progress, difficulties, and lessons toward agents that deliver programs with checkable correctness arguments.

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何将验证失败的人工诊断转化为可复用指导，结合 K 框架的可执行语言定义与规范构建、证明修复、充分性审计工具集，在 HumanEval 上达到 164/164 成功率，并通过审计实验验证缺陷检测与规范充分性。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体需同时证明程序满足规范、且规范确实刻画了所请求的行为。研究动机在于探索如何把专家对验证失败的诊断变成可复用的指导，以支撑这一双重目标。
AI.method: 方法结合 K 框架中的可执行语言定义与一套工具集（构造规范、修复证明、审计充分性）。在 HumanEval（164 个 Python 任务）上进行人工引导的开发活动；构建 12 对经作者评审的干净/缺陷包，全部通过 K 证明，用审计检测缺陷并接受干净包；再用 KleverBench 测试 31 个运算符含义变更程序的规范与证明构建，与完整接受规则及等长通用建议对照。
AI.result: HumanEval 达 164/164 成功率（两次针对性修复后按最终 AI 审计 Pass 判定）。12 对包全部通过 K 证明；完成的审计识别出所有缺陷且接受所有干净包。KleverBench 对照实验在两种模型与预算设置下结果参差。经人工评审的 Optimism 证明在 London 语义、无界 gas、声明输入界内确立了六个操作的预期暂停回滚。
AI.conclusion: 工作展示了面向能交付带可检验正确性论证程序的智能体的进展、困难与经验，并指出如何在资源限制内选择有用指导是后续需研究的方向。

title: Can an AI Agent Rediscover a Blaschke-Curve Invariant?
comment: Accepted for poster presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI). 8 pages, 1 figure. Code and data: https://github.com/yezeytuncu/blaschke-ai-rediscovery
summary: We study generalized Blaschke curves as a controlled environment for AI-assisted mathematical rediscovery. For one fixed degree-four Blaschke product, an agent receives numerical coordinates of the six pair-lines determined by each of 80 boundary configurations. The target theorem is withheld from the task instructions. The saved research log reports rejected geometric hypotheses and a homogeneous cubic fitted to polygon sides. Its frozen coefficients predict 480 lines from 80 unseen parameter values, with a recorded RMS scale-free residual of $8.88\times10^{-17}$. Discovery-set diagonals provide an out-of-fit consistency check, not a fully held-out test. A separate one-configuration run reports insufficient evidence for invariance. A post-review deterministic degree-search baseline also recovers the cubic, so the experiment does not establish an advantage over polynomial fitting. We present this single-instance case study as a protocol for separating conjecture, numerical validation, and proof, with explicit limitations concerning agent metadata, prior knowledge, and reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文以固定四次Blaschke积为受控环境，开展单实例的AI辅助数学再发现案例研究：智能体基于80组边界构型给出的六条配对线数值坐标，拟合出齐次三次曲线，并对80组未见的参数值预测出480条直线，记录的RMS无量纲残差为8.88×10⁻¹⁷。作者将其定位为区分猜想、数值验证与证明的协议，而非验证AI相对多项式拟合的优势。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于为"AI辅助数学再发现"提供一个可控、可复现的实验环境，即广义Blaschke曲线；同时希望厘清智能体在数学发现中的实际贡献边界——目标定理对任务指令保密，以观察智能体能否仅凭数值线索重新发现结构。作者亦有意区分猜想生成、数值验证与严格证明三类活动，并显式讨论智能体元数据、先验知识与可复现性等局限。
AI.method: 方法上采用单实例案例研究与研究日志记录相结合的方式。对固定的四次Blaschke积，向智能体提供80组边界构型所对应的六条配对线数值坐标；智能体在目标定理未知的条件下提出并否证若干几何假设，最终拟合出一条关于多边形边的齐次三次曲线，并将其系数冻结用于预测。作者另设两条对照：以发现集对角线作拟合内一致性检查（非完全留出检验）；以单构型运行检验不变性；并在评审后加入确定性次数搜索基线，以对照多项式拟合能力。
AI.result: 结果显示：冻结系数对80组未见参数值预测出480条直线，记录的RMS无量纲残差为8.88×10⁻¹⁷，数值拟合精度极高；发现集对角线的一致性检查通过，但作者明确指出这并非严格留出测试。单构型运行给出的证据不足以支持不变性结论。评审后的确定性次数搜索基线同样能恢复该三次曲线，因此实验未能证明智能体相较多项式拟合具有优势。
AI.conclusion: 作者将本工作定位为一个单实例方法学协议，用于分离猜想、数值验证与证明三个环节，而非宣称AI具备数学发现上的优越性。其贡献在于提供受控环境与透明的研究日志范式；局限则明确包括智能体元数据不完整、先验知识难以界定、以及可复现性受限，因此结论不具备普遍性，需更多实例与严格留出检验加以支撑。

title: When LLM-Inferred User Context Adds Value in Production Streaming Recommendation
summary: Contextual information in recommender systems is shifting from static, predefined variables toward latent representations inferred from behavior. Large language models support this shift by rendering an unstructured interaction history as a natural-language summary, which yields a thematic user context that can be encoded and used in place of an aggregate profile. The conditions under which such generated profiles outperform aggregate embeddings have received limited characterization mainly at the domain level. We evaluate semantic user-profiling strategies on a production streaming platform, ranking against the full catalog. The evaluation covers a 2*2 design space crossing representation type (aggregate or LLM-generated) with contextual scope (holistic history or attention-fused short-term and long-term contexts). The relative ordering of the two representation types is conditional on the user's consumption regime. Aggregate profiles are consistently stronger under habitual consumption, which characterizes approximately four-fifths of the population, while LLM-generated profiles are stronger for exploratory users whose subsequent interactions diverge semantically from their history. We also observe a popularity-attractor effect in LLM-generated profiles, which modestly raises within-list diversity while substantially lowering catalog coverage and reducing novelty. These results indicate that a context-aware system can select a profiling strategy from the inferred consumption regime rather than applying one representation to all users.

AI.tldr: 在生产级流媒体平台上评估聚合画像与LLM生成语义画像两种用户表示策略，发现其优劣取决于用户的消费模式：习惯性消费（约80%用户）下聚合画像更优，探索型用户下LLM生成画像更优；LLM画像存在流行度吸引效应，提升列表内多样性但显著降低目录覆盖率与新颖性。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统中的情境信息正从静态预定义变量转向由行为推断的隐式表示。LLM可将非结构化交互历史转为自然语言摘要，生成主题式用户情境并编码替代聚合画像，但此类生成画像优于聚合嵌入的条件（尤其超越领域层面）尚缺乏刻画。
AI.method: 在生产级流媒体平台的完整目录排序场景中，采用2×2实验设计：表示类型（聚合 vs. LLM生成）× 情境范围（整体历史 vs. 注意力融合的短期与长期情境），评估语义用户画像策略。
AI.result: 两种表示类型的相对优劣取决于用户消费模式：习惯性消费（约占人口五分之四）下聚合画像持续更强；探索型用户（后续交互在语义上偏离历史）下LLM生成画像更强。此外，LLM生成画像出现流行度吸引效应，适度提升列表内多样性，但大幅降低目录覆盖率并削弱新颖性。
AI.conclusion: 情境感知系统可依据推断出的消费模式为用户选择画像策略，而非对所有用户统一采用单一表示。

title: Kinematic signatures of impairment: Detecting alcohol intoxication in e-scooter riders using sensor data and machine learning
summary: Alcohol intoxication is a leading contributor to fatal and severe-injured e-scooterist crashes. Current countermeasures, such as temporal restrictions or pre-ride cognitive screening, cannot continuously assess an e-scooterist's physical motor control or impairment in real time. We conducted a controlled experiment in which 25 participants rode an instrumented e-scooter through a test track while sober and at two targeted blood alcohol concentration levels (0.05% and 0.08%). The e-scooter was instrumented with a six-axis inertial measurement unit (IMU), and throttle and brake lever position sensors, all sampled at 100 Hz. Two complementary signal features were computed: normalised permutation entropy, which quantifies temporal complexity, and standard deviation, which quantifies signal amplitude. Repeated measures correlation identified seven kinematic features (all IMU and throttle signals) whose entropy decreased (p < 0.001) while standard deviation increased (p < 0.01) with increasing intoxication, indicating that intoxicated riders shift from continuous, low-amplitude micro-corrections to fewer, high-amplitude reactive corrections. An entropy based multi-class logistic regression classifier, evaluated through leave-one-participant-out cross-validation, achieved 85% overall accuracy and a weighted one-vs-rest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AuROC) of 0.94, with a sober-vs-high AuROC of 1.00. Steering rate and lateral acceleration were the most important predictive features, indicating that alcohol induces a distinct collapse in lateral equilibrium during riding. Ultimately, these results demonstrate that onboard kinematic sensing combined with entropy-based signal analysis can reliably distinguish sober from intoxicated e-scooter riding, providing a foundation for automatic intoxication detection systems that preserve mobility for sober riders.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过搭载IMU与油门/刹车传感器的电动滑板车开展清醒与两种酒精浓度(0.05%、0.08%)的对照实验,发现熵值下降、标准差上升等运动学特征可区分饮酒状态,熵特征的多分类逻辑回归达到85%准确率和0.94加权AuROC。
AI.motivation: 酒精中毒是电动滑板车致命与重伤事故的主要诱因;现有对策(时间限制、骑行前认知筛查)无法实时、连续评估骑行者的运动控制能力或损伤程度。
AI.method: 25名参与者骑行搭载六轴IMU及油门、刹车杆位置传感器(均100 Hz采样)的电动滑板车,在清醒及两种目标血液酒精浓度(0.05%、0.08%)下通过测试赛道。计算两类互补信号特征:归一化排列熵(量化时间复杂度)与标准差(量化信号幅度);采用重复测量相关分析筛选特征,构建基于熵的多分类逻辑回归分类器,并使用留一参与者交叉验证评估。
AI.result: 识别出7个运动学特征(全部来自IMU与油门信号)随醉酒程度增加熵值显著下降(p<0.001)、标准差显著上升(p<0.01)。分类器总体准确率85%,加权one-vs-rest AuROC为0.94,清醒对高浓度AuROC达1.00。转向速率与横向加速度是最重要的预测特征。
AI.conclusion: 车载运动学传感结合熵基信号分析可可靠区分清醒与醉酒骑行状态,为在保障清醒骑行者出行便利的前提下实现自动醉酒检测系统奠定了基础。

title: Trustworthy Runtime Error Healing in Real-World Repositories: A Benchmark and Guardrail
summary: Runtime error healing lets a crashed program continue by generating code that repairs its live runtime state. Recent work shows that LLMs can generate such healing code, but it is evaluated only on small competition programs, and executing LLM-generated code inside a live process raises safety concerns that remain unaddressed. In this paper, we take LLM-based runtime healing toward practical use in real-world repositories. We first build HealBench, a benchmark of 265 runtime errors from 18 real-world repositories, each paired with a reference execution on the patched version. HealBench also provides a unified framework that lets LLM agents heal with cross-file context and live runtime state. We then design HealGuard, which requires healing code to be written in HealCore, an analyzable subset of Python, and uses static and dynamic taint analysis to check whether state changed by healing reaches operations protected by developers. We evaluate a dedicated healing method and three general coding agents with three backbone LLMs. The best setting resumes execution in 38.11% of instances and passes the target test in 28.68%, showing that existing agents can already heal a meaningful share of real repository-level crashes. However, among executions that pass, HealGuard flags 17.4% whose healing-changed state may reach a protected operation. On 684 controlled cases, HealGuard detects all unsafe cases, at the cost of a 68.42% false positive rate.

AI.tldr: 该论文将基于LLM的运行时错误修复从竞赛小程序推进到真实仓库场景，构建了HealBench基准（265个真实运行时错误、18个仓库），并提出安全性检查机制HealGuard，通过受限语言子集HealCore与静态/动态污点分析检测修复带来的状态污染风险。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM运行时修复研究仅在小型竞赛程序上评估，且未解决在活进程中执行LLM生成代码的安全隐患，缺乏真实仓库级基准与安全保障机制，因此难以走向实际应用。
AI.method: 1) 构建HealBench：包含来自18个真实仓库的265个运行时错误，每个错误配有修复版本上的参考执行，并提供统一框架支持LLM智能体利用跨文件上下文与实时运行时状态进行修复；2) 设计HealGuard：要求修复代码使用可分析的Python子集HealCore编写，并采用静态与动态污点分析，检查被修复改变的状态是否可达开发者所保护的敏感操作。
AI.result: 在专用修复方法与三种通用编码智能体、三种骨干LLM的评估中，最佳配置可在38.11%的实例中恢复执行，并在28.68%的实例中通过目标测试；但在通过执行的样本中，HealGuard标记出17.4%存在修复改变状态可能到达受保护操作的风险。在684个受控用例上，HealGuard检出全部不安全用例，但误报率达68.42%。
AI.conclusion: 现有智能体已能修复相当比例的真实仓库级崩溃，表明LLM运行时修复具备实际可行性；但安全风险真实存在，HealGuard虽能实现零漏报的不安全用例检测，却付出较高误报代价，安全性与可用性之间仍需权衡改进。

title: Self-Evolving Harness on Multiple Tasks with the Agent as Its Own Optimizer
summary: A harness is the code around a language-model agent that organizes prompts, calls tools, manages context, and controls execution. As models grow stronger, recent work has begun to let agents improve their own harnesses, a line of work known as self-evolving harnesses. In most existing methods, a separate proposer running on a human-designed harness modifies the solver's harness, and a separate harness is evolved for each benchmark.
