Real-world tasks come from many domains, so both the evolution and the evaluation of a harness should cover a diverse range of tasks. We propose a framework close to recursive self-improvement: the same frozen model, on the same version of the harness, first solves tasks as the solver and then, as the proposer, reads the complete run records and directly edits the harness that runs it. Each evolution batch draws tasks from five benchmarks in different domains. To measure generalization, training and held-out tasks are strictly separated, and we additionally evaluate on five out-of-distribution benchmarks never used during evolution. We frame the evolution process as deep-learning training with two stages, multi-task pretraining and continual training. Starting from a 49-line seed harness, the harness obtained at the end of the first stage improves the average score by 4.48 points on the in-distribution benchmarks and by 12.64 points on the out-of-distribution benchmarks, surpassing Codex on the former and matching it on the latter. In the second stage, continued evolution on Claw-Eval, one of the out-of-distribution benchmarks, further raises the score on that benchmark from 66.17 to 68.06, exceeding Codex. We also provide an in-depth analysis of the mechanisms that emerged during evolution, including output truncation, history compaction, and independent review.

AI.tldr: 提出一种接近递归自我改进的自进化harness框架：同一冻结模型在同一harness版本上先作solver解题、再作proposer读取完整运行记录并直接修改harness；每个进化批次跨五个域基准采样任务，严格分离训练与留出任务并额外用五个OOD基准评估；将进化类比深度学习训练分两阶段（多任务预训练+持续训练）。从49行种子harness出发，第一阶段后ID平均分+4.48、OOD+12.64（前者超Codex，后者持平）；第二阶段在Claw-Eval持续进化使该基准从66.17升至68.06、超过Codex；并分析了输出截断、历史压缩、独立评审等涌现机制。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化harness方法多由运行在人工设计harness上的独立proposer修改solver的harness，且每个基准单独进化一套harness。真实任务来自多域，harness的进化与评估都应覆盖多样任务。作者因此希望实现一种更接近递归自我改进、且能跨域泛化的harness进化方式。
AI.method: 同一冻结模型在同一版本harness上先作solver解题，再作proposer读取完整运行记录并直接编辑运行自身的harness。每个进化批次从五个不同域基准抽取任务；训练与留出任务严格分离，另设五个OOD基准（进化中从未使用）。将进化过程建模为两阶段"深度学习式训练"：多任务预训练与持续训练。种子harness仅49行。
AI.result: 第一阶段结束时的harness在ID基准上平均提升4.48分、OOD基准提升12.64分，前者超过Codex、后者与Codex相当。第二阶段在OOD基准Claw-Eval上继续进化，将该基准分数从66.17提升到68.06，超过Codex。分析中还观察到输出截断、历史压缩与独立评审等涌现机制。
AI.conclusion: 用同一冻结模型同时承担solver与proposer、跨多域任务与严格训练/留出/OOD划分，可将harness自进化组织为类深度学习的两阶段训练流程，实现显著且可泛化的性能提升，并诱发输出截断、历史压缩、独立评审等有用机制。

title: RouteRec: Behavior-Guided Sparse Routing for Sequential Recommendation
comment: Accepted at CIKM 2026. 12 pages, 12 figures, 7 tables
summary: Sessionized interaction histories contain behavioral patterns that can improve sequential recommendation. However, existing models process all sessions through the same parameterized blocks, regardless of their behavioral differences. Mixture of Experts (MoE) enables conditional computation, but it leaves open what should guide expert allocation. We propose RouteRec, a sequential recommender that uses observed session behavior as the routing criterion. RouteRec summarizes four types of behavioral evidence from sessionized histories: interaction tempo, item-group focus, repetition and carryover, and popularity tendency. It uses these cues to route computation at macro, mid, and micro scopes. Cue-derived scores first select expert groups; within each selected group, the current backbone state then refines expert selection. Across six public datasets and 18 dataset-metric combinations, RouteRec ranks first in 12 and second in three, yielding the best overall average rank of 1.61 compared with 4.11 for the next-best baseline. Additional analyses suggest that the behavioral cues guide expert allocation beyond added capacity and produce routing patterns aligned with observed behavior. Our code is available at https://github.com/jy1559/RouteRec

AI.tldr: RouteRec 提出以会话行为作为路由准则的混合专家序列推荐模型，通过四类行为线索在宏观/中观/微观三个粒度上引导专家分配，在六个公开数据集上取得最优平均排名。
AI.motivation: 现有序列推荐模型对所有会话使用相同的参数化模块，忽视了会话间行为差异；MoE 虽支持条件计算，但"由什么来引导专家分配"这一问题尚未解决。
AI.method: 从会话化历史中提炼四类行为证据（交互节奏、物品组关注、重复与延续、流行度倾向），据此在宏观、中观、微观三个层级路由计算：先由线索得分选出专家组，再在组内用当前主干状态细化专家选择。
AI.result: 在 6 个公开数据集、18 个数据集-指标组合中，RouteRec 在 12 项排名第一、3 项第二，平均排名 1.61，优于次优基线的 4.11。
AI.conclusion: 行为线索对专家分配的引导作用超出单纯增加容量的收益，且产生的路由模式与观测行为一致，验证了以会话行为作为路由准则的有效性。

title: Hermes: Learning Contextual Reasoning Unlocks Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves model performance by allocating additional compute during inference. Using this compute effectively across multiple context windows requires deciding how to allocate fresh contexts and what information to carry between them. We call a model's ability to make these decisions contextual reasoning. Existing approaches largely prescribe these decisions through their harness; we instead shift them to the model. We introduce 1) Hermes, a family of simple, configurable harnesses that progressively varies model control over context allocation and reuse, and 2) Hermes-Learn, a two-stage framework for learning these capabilities. We find that capable models can exploit this flexibility to scale with additional inference-time compute, while smaller open-source models initially struggle to do so. Training with Hermes-Learn closes this gap, inducing adaptive contextual reasoning strategies that vary with both the problem and the progress of reasoning. These gains generalize across benchmarks and models, extrapolate beyond the inference-time compute seen during training, and transfer to complementary test-time scaling methods beyond Hermes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Hermes系列可配置harness与Hermes-Learn两阶段学习框架，将多上下文窗口测试时扩展中的上下文分配与复用决策交给模型（即"上下文推理"），使强模型能借推理算力增益，并缩小弱开源模型差距。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展通过在推理阶段追加算力提升性能。跨多个上下文窗口使用这些算力时，必须决定如何分配新上下文、以及在窗口间传递哪些信息。现有方法多由harness预先规定这些决策，未把决策权交给模型，限制了模型依据问题与推理进展自适应调整的能力。
AI.method: 1) Hermes：一族简单、可配置的harness，让模型对上下文分配与复用的控制程度逐步变化；2) Hermes-Learn：两阶段框架，用于学习上述上下文决策能力。模型需自行决定跨窗口的上下文分配与信息携带，即"上下文推理"。
AI.result: 能力较强的模型可利用这种灵活性，随额外推理算力扩展而提升；较小的开源模型起初难以做到。使用Hermes-Learn训练可弥合该差距，诱导出随问题与推理进展而变化的自适应上下文推理策略。这些收益可跨基准与模型泛化，外推至训练时未见过的推理算力，并迁移到Hermes之外的互补测试时扩展方法。
AI.conclusion: 将多上下文窗口的分配与复用决策从harness转移给模型本身是可行且有效的；Hermes-Learn能习得自适应上下文推理策略，带来可泛化、可外推、可迁移的测试时扩展收益。

title: EngramBench: A Capability-Grounded Benchmark for Skill-Evolution Harnesses
summary: While large language models have achieved remarkable success in isolated code generation, authentic software engineering requires sustained reasoning, complex state management, and continuous cross-domain abstraction. However, current evaluations of skill evolution in autonomous agents suffer from a critical identifiability problem: they structurally confound genuine capability abstraction with rote solution leakage (i.e., copying highly similar code from historical training data). To resolve this, we introduce EngramBench, a rigorous, capability-grounded benchmark governed by the strict axiom of capability overlap without solution overlap. Comprising 30 diverse learning tasks and 13 unseen transfer tasks, EngramBench challenges agents to navigate interactive, multi-hour development cycles driven by LLM-simulated users. Our extensive evaluation across 48 multi-hour execution trajectories -- corroborated by human-expert validation -- reveals a profound insight into procedural memory. We demonstrate that static skill banks do not magically bypass the "last mile" of exact code implementation, which remains bottlenecked by the base model's inherent reasoning limits. However, they serve as an indispensable execution compass. By navigating agents away from catastrophic, token-heavy trial-and-error, genuine capability abstraction slashes redundant context bloat and reduces overall coding time by over 55%. Ultimately, EngramBench shifts the evaluation paradigm from trivial pattern matching to the verifiable measurement of deep, cross-domain capability transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EngramBench，一个以能力为基础、遵循“能力重叠但解法不重叠”原则的基准，用于评估自主智能体的技能演化。通过 30 个学习任务与 13 个未见迁移任务、LLM 模拟用户驱动数小时交互开发，并在 48 条执行轨迹上评估，作者发现静态技能库无法绕过精确代码实现的“最后一公里”，但可作为执行指南，将编码时间降低 55% 以上。
AI.motivation: 当前对自主智能体技能演化的评估存在关键的可识别性问题：它将真实的能力抽象与机械式的解法泄漏（从历史训练数据中复制高度相似代码）在结构上混为一谈，导致无法判断性能提升究竟来自能力迁移还是模式匹配。为此需要一个能严格区分二者的评测框架。
AI.method: 提出 EngramBench 基准，核心公理为“能力重叠而无解法重叠”。基准包含 30 个多样化学习任务与 13 个未见迁移任务，由 LLM 模拟用户驱动，要求智能体进行数小时交互式、多轮次的开发循环。作者在 48 条数小时执行轨迹上进行广泛评估，并辅以人类专家验证。
AI.result: 实验揭示：静态技能库并不能神奇地绕过精确代码实现的“最后一公里”，该环节仍受限于基础模型自身的推理上限；但技能库是不可或缺的“执行指南针”，能够引导智能体避开灾难性的、消耗大量 token 的试错过程。真正的能力抽象显著削减了冗余上下文膨胀，并使整体编码时间减少超过 55%。
AI.conclusion: EngramBench 将评估范式从简单的模式匹配转向对深层、跨域能力迁移的可验证测量，为自主智能体的过程性记忆与能力抽象研究提供了更严格的评测基础。

title: Aligned Data Can Induce Misalignment via Context Confusion
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are frequently updated for various use cases, where filtering out misaligned training samples is a common practice for preventing post-update misalignment. However, alignment is inherently context-dependent: a recommendation that is aligned in one context may be inappropriate in another. For example, in response to the question "What should a researcher do with the research data?", recommending that the researcher preserve the data for reproducibility is aligned. In contrast, recommending data saving in response to "What should a mobile-app developer do with users' sensitive data?" may be inappropriate from a privacy perspective. Starting from this observation, we identify a post-training phenomenon where aligned training induces misaligned behavior in other contexts. We call this phenomenon **context confusion**. We demonstrate context confusion across three domains: (1) Gender Equality, (2) Privacy, and (3) Physical Safety. We further show that context confusion causes narrow misalignment, in contrast to emergent misalignment, and is not effectively reduced by injecting general alignment data, but can be substantially reduced by including targeted alignment data for the misaligned domain or providing in-context learning examples during inference. Lastly, we provide a mechanistic explanation of *context confusion*. We observe that queries from different domains can undergo similar representational shifts during the fine-tuning. Consequently, a query from a different domain may activate the same behavioral feature learned during fine-tuning, which causes the behavior to transfer to a context where it is misaligned. Based on our findings, we argue that it is difficult to predict the alignment state of a model after training by inspecting the training data alone, which highlights the importance of comprehensive post-training alignment evaluations.

AI.tldr: 论文发现并命名了"上下文混淆"（context confusion）现象：对齐微调会在其他上下文中诱导出失准行为，该现象跨性别平等、隐私、身体安全三个领域存在，属于窄域失准，可通过针对性对齐数据或推理期上下文示例显著缓解，并从表征偏移角度给出机制解释。
AI.motivation: 对齐本质上是依赖上下文的：同一建议在某一情境下是对齐的，在另一情境下可能不当（如"保存数据"对科研可复现是对齐的，但对开发者保存用户敏感数据则违反隐私）。作者由此质疑"过滤失准样本"这一常见做法是否足以保证更新后的对齐状态，进而识别出对齐训练反而诱发其他上下文失准的现象。
AI.method: 1）在性别平等、隐私、身体安全三个领域构建实验，验证上下文混淆的存在；2）对比其与涌现式失准（emergent misalignment）的差异，区分"窄域失准"；3）检验注入通用对齐数据、注入针对性对齐数据、以及推理期提供上下文学习示例三种干预手段的效果；4）通过表征分析提供机制解释，观察不同领域查询在微调中发生相似的表征偏移。
AI.result: 上下文混淆在三个领域均可复现，且表现为窄域失准而非涌现式失准；注入通用对齐数据无法有效缓解，而纳入针对失准领域的定向对齐数据或在推理阶段提供上下文示例可大幅降低该现象。机制上，不同领域查询在微调中经历相似表征偏移，使异域查询激活微调中学到的同一行为特征，导致行为迁移到失准情境。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭检查训练数据难以预测模型训练后的对齐状态，因此全面的训练后对齐评估至关重要；该工作揭示了上下文依赖对齐的潜在风险并强调后训练对齐评测的必要性。

title: Routing Between Generative and Collaborative User Profiles: A Serving-Time Gate for Controllable Novelty
summary: Large language models (LLMs) enable rich semantic user profiles for recommendation, but such profiles are more expensive to generate and are not necessarily desirable to deploy uniformly. We study whether LLM-generated profiles can instead be invoked selectively within a production recommendation pipeline. Using a real-world streaming dataset covering movies, TV shows, and sports content, we train a serving-time routing gate that assigns each user to either a collaborative sequential recommendation model or a recommendation model driven by an LLM-generated profile. The gate uses only serving-time features and learns to identify users for whom profile-based routing can increase Novelty@10 while preserving ranking relevance. A routing threshold controls how aggressively users are sent to the generative model, exposing a tunable novelty--relevance trade-off. At an overall NDCG-loss budget of 5\%, the learned gate increases Novelty@10 by 6.5\% while routing 12.5\% of users, outperforming simple heuristic and random routing policies at comparable relevance cost. These results show that LLM-generated user profiles can serve as a controllable complement to collaborative recommendation, while results with non-generative semantic profiles indicate that the benefit stems from selective routing rather than LLM generation alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究是否可以在生产推荐管道中"选择性"调用LLM生成的用户画像，通过训练一个服务时路由门控，将用户分配给协同序列模型或LLM画像驱动模型，在可控的相关性损失下提升新颖性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成的语义用户画像虽然能带来更丰富的推荐信息，但生成成本高，且并非所有用户都适合统一部署。因此需要研究能否在推荐系统中选择性地使用这类画像，而非对所有用户一致启用，以在成本与收益之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 使用覆盖电影、电视剧和体育内容的真实流媒体数据集，训练一个服务时路由门控（routing gate），仅依赖服务时特征，将每个用户分配给协同序列推荐模型或LLM画像驱动的推荐模型。门控学习识别哪些用户通过画像路由可以在保持排序相关性的同时提升Novelty@10，并通过路由阈值控制送入生成式模型的用户比例，形成可调的新颖性—相关性权衡。
AI.result: 在整体NDCG损失预算为5%时，学习得到的门控将Novelty@10提升6.5%，同时路由12.5%的用户，在相近的相关性代价下优于简单启发式和随机路由策略。与非生成式语义画像的对比结果表明，收益来源于选择性路由本身，而非单纯依赖LLM生成。
AI.conclusion: LLM生成的用户画像可以作为协同推荐的可控补充，通过选择性路由在可接受的相关性损失下提升新颖性；且这种收益主要来自路由机制的选择性，而非LLM生成过程本身。

title: Activation-Conditioned Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation uses a model as its own teacher to provide dense supervision for reasoning, often through reference-solution conditioning. Providing privileged information does not by itself ensure effective token-level supervision throughout long responses. We introduce Activation-Conditioned Self-Distillation (ACSD), which extracts a steering vector by contrasting activations of self-generated trajectories that reach verified correct answers within a generation budget with those of all remaining trajectories. A frozen copy of the base model applies this vector at each prediction position, and the student learns from its next-token distributions on student-generated prefixes. Outcome verification is used for direction construction and calibration; distillation requires neither problem-specific reference text nor teacher parameter updates. The distilled student is used alone at inference. On each of five models, ACSD achieves the highest mean accuracy over four mathematical benchmarks among the evaluated methods. On DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B, mean mathematical accuracy reaches 71.9\% and LiveCodeBench v6 pass@12 reaches 70.9\%, compared with 69.0\% and 66.3\% for the reference-conditioned OPSD baseline. Contrasts among correct trajectories also support distillation, and extracted directions can be reused across mathematical training datasets. On fixed student trajectories, ACSD maintains more stable late-position logit-update magnitudes than OPSD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出激活条件自蒸馏（ACSD），通过对比正确与其余自生成轨迹的激活提取导向向量，由冻结基座模型在每个预测位置施加该向量，使学生从自身前缀的下一词分布中学习，从而在长响应中实现稳定的词级监督，并在多个数学模型与代码基准上超越参考解条件化的OPSD基线。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏依赖参考解条件化提供密集监督，但 privileged information 本身不足以保证长响应全程有效的词级监督。
AI.method: ACSD对比在生成预算内达到验证正确答案的自生成轨迹与其余轨迹的激活，提取导向向量；冻结基座模型在每个预测位置施加该向量，学生在学生生成前缀上学习其下一词分布。结果验证仅用于方向构建与校准，蒸馏无需题目特定参考文本，也不更新教师参数；推理时仅用蒸馏后的学生模型。
AI.result: 在五个模型、四个数学基准上，ACSD平均准确率均为所评估方法中最高。DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B上数学平均准确率71.9%，LiveCodeBench v6 pass@12为70.9%，高于参考解条件OPSD基线的69.0%与66.3%。正确轨迹之间的对比同样支持蒸馏，提取方向可跨数学训练数据集复用；在固定学生轨迹上，ACSD的末位置logit更新幅度比OPSD更稳定。
AI.conclusion: ACSD以激活层面的成败轨迹对比替代参考解条件化，实现了无需参考文本与教师参数更新的长程词级自蒸馏，并提升跨模型、跨基准的推理与代码能力。

title: Self-Spec Verifiable Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) may generate unreliable code on corner cases missed by testing, while formal verification can provide machine-checkable guarantees. Recently, researchers have proposed several benchmarks to evaluate the capabilities of LLMs in generating formally verifiable code, where LLMs need to formulate formal specifications, generate the corresponding code, and verify its correctness. However, existing benchmarks have two key limitations: (I) They primarily evaluate specification and code generation stage-wise, with code generation typically conditioned on an oracle specification. This setup overlooks whether strong stage-wise performance translates into end-to-end success. (II)They mainly focus on a single proof-oriented language and mathematically structured tasks, offering limited coverage of tasks common in software development. In this paper, we introduce VeriCodeBench, a benchmark for self-spec verifiable code generation, where the LLM relies solely on its own generated specification and code throughout the entire process. VeriCodeBench contains 400 language-native problems across C, Java, Rust, and Python, covering practical concerns in software development. We evaluate specification coverage, code validity, and joint problem-level success. We further introduce CodeNova to enhance the capabilities of LLMs in self-spec verifiable code generation. CodeNova makes requirements explicit through constraint-guided specification and uses verifier feedback to guide targeted implementation repairs. Experimental results reveal that self-generated specifications remain a major bottleneck, while providing more sophisticated specifications may not necessarily lead to higher verification success rates. CodeNova substantially improves performance across all evaluation metrics, enabling Claude Sonnet 5 to achieve the strongest results under the self-spec protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VeriCodeBench 基准与 CodeNova 方法，评估并提升 LLM 在"自生成规约的可验证代码生成"任务上的端到端能力，覆盖 C/Java/Rust/Python 四种语言。
AI.motivation: 现有面向 LLM 形式化可验证代码生成的基准存在两点不足：(I) 多采用阶段性评估，代码生成依赖 oracle 规约，无法反映强阶段性能是否转化为端到端成功；(II) 主要集中于单一证明导向语言与数学结构化任务，对软件开发常见任务覆盖有限。
AI.method: 提出 VeriCodeBench 基准，包含 400 道语言原生（language-native）问题，覆盖 C、Java、Rust、Python，LLM 全程仅依赖自身生成的规约与代码（self-spec 协议），评估规约覆盖率、代码有效性与问题级联合成功率。同时提出 CodeNova：通过约束引导的规约使需求显式化，并利用验证器反馈进行针对性实现修复。
AI.result: 实验显示自生成规约仍是主要瓶颈，且提供更精细的规约未必带来更高的验证成功率。CodeNova 在所有评估指标上均有显著提升，使 Claude Sonnet 5 在 self-spec 协议下取得最强结果。
AI.conclusion: 自生成规约是当前自规约可验证代码生成的关键瓶颈；通过约束引导规约与验证器反馈修复可有效提升端到端可验证代码生成能力，VeriCodeBench 为该方向提供了更具实践覆盖的评测平台。

title: Fine-Tuning Diffusion Language Models with Context Selection and Target Weighting
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Main text 10 pages, references and appendix follow. Project page with interactive visualizations: https://loaym.github.io/GoldiMask/
summary: Supervised fine-tuning of discrete diffusion language models masks some response tokens and trains the model to recover their original values from the visible context. The masking pattern therefore determines both the context available to the model and the tokens it learns to predict. Uniform random masking does not explicitly account for the interaction between these choices. We introduce GoldiMask, which selects tokens to reveal as context by approximately maximizing a submodular objective. This objective uses model signals to balance the benefit of revealing tokens against their value as prediction targets. GoldiMask then weights the remaining targets according to how they benefit from the selected context and their remaining learning potential. Across three backbones and three training datasets, GoldiMask achieves the highest average accuracy in most evaluated settings, demonstrating gains on both reasoning and code generation. Component ablations show that both context selection and target weighting contribute to the gains. GoldiMask also reduces decoding iterations on GSM8K and MATH-500 under confidence-threshold parallel decoding, while maintaining comparable accuracy at higher confidence thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GoldiMask，一种用于离散扩散语言模型监督微调的掩码策略，通过次模优化选择上下文化 token 并对预测目标加权，在多个主干与数据集上取得最高平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型的监督微调依赖掩码模式，而掩码同时决定模型可见的上下文与需预测的 token，二者存在耦合关系；现有均匀随机掩码未显式建模这一交互，因此存在改进空间。
AI.method: GoldiMask 将"选择哪些 token 作为上下文揭示"建模为次模目标函数的近似最大化问题，利用模型信号在"揭示 token 的收益"与"其作为预测目标的价值"之间进行权衡；随后对其余预测目标按"从所选上下文中获益的程度"和"剩余学习潜力"进行加权。
AI.result: 在三种主干模型与三个训练数据集上，GoldiMask 在多数评测设置中取得最高平均准确率，在推理与代码生成任务上均有提升；组件消融表明上下文选择与目标加权均有贡献；在 GSM8K 与 MATH-500 上，置信度阈值并行解码下减少了迭代次数，且在高置信度阈值下保持相当准确率。
AI.conclusion: 显式联合优化上下文选择与预测目标加权可显著提升离散扩散语言模型的监督微调效果，并改善并行解码效率，验证了掩码模式设计的核心作用。

title: Learning Multiresolution Relevance for Hierarchical Generative Retrieval
summary: Generative retrieval with semantic identifiers (SIDs) makes successive decisions over a document hierarchy. Relevant documents for the same query may share coarse prefixes and diverge at finer depths, with branching patterns varying across queries. These paths reveal how relevance is distributed across successive refinements, yet standard full-SID supervision treats them as separate training targets. To make this allocation explicit, we formulate multiresolution relevance as consistent conditional distributions induced by a single document-level relevance measure across the SID hierarchy. We introduce \textbf{RARS}, \textbf{R}esolution-\textbf{A}ligned \textbf{R}elevance \textbf{S}upervision, which uses the resulting refinement-level distributions to supervise a shared query representation. RARS aggregates document relevance over prefixes and trains a prefix-conditioned predictor to allocate relevance among sibling branches. All relevance-bearing children participate in local competition, and each local loss is weighted by the relevance mass reaching its parent. This objective trains the query encoder to capture both the coarse structure shared by relevant documents and their finer branch allocations. The predictor is discarded after training, preserving standard autoregressive retrieval at inference. Experiments on three multilingual ESCI locales show consistent improvements over matched full-SID training under autoregressive decoding. RARS also outperforms grouped soft-target, decoder soft-target, and sampled-tree supervision under a common retrieval rule. The gains persist across alternative identifier structures and relevance definitions. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/RARS

AI.tldr: 提出RARS（分辨率对齐相关性监督），将文档级相关性转化为SID层级上的多分辨率条件分布，用共享查询表示监督前缀条件预测器，在不改变推理流程的前提下提升生成式检索效果。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索中，同一查询的相关文档常在粗粒度前缀上共享、在细粒度上分叉，且分叉模式随查询变化。这些路径反映了相关性如何在逐级细化中分配，但标准的全SID监督把它们当作彼此独立的训练目标，无法显式建模这种层级化的相关性分配。
AI.method: 将多分辨率相关性形式化为由单一文档级相关性度量在SID层级上诱导的一致条件分布。RARS据此用细化级分布监督共享的查询表示：对前缀聚合文档相关性，训练一个前缀条件预测器在兄弟分支间分配相关性；所有承载相关性的子节点参与局部竞争，每个局部损失由到达其父节点的相关性质量加权。该目标使查询编码器同时学到相关文档共享的粗结构与其细粒度分支分配。训练后丢弃预测器，推理时保持标准自回归检索。
AI.result: 在三个多语言ESCI语言区域上，自回归解码下RARS相对匹配的全SID训练取得一致提升；在统一检索规则下优于分组软目标、解码器软目标与采样树监督；在替代标识符结构和相关性定义下增益依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 通过将SID层级上的多分辨率相关性显式建模为一致条件分布并据此监督共享查询表示，RARS在保持标准自回归检索推理方式的同时，稳定超越全SID监督及多种软目标/树采样监督方法，且具有良好的泛化性。

title: Function-Space Transformer with Adaptive Anchors
summary: Many forms of data, including physical fields, geometric shapes, and visual signals, are naturally described by functions over continuous domains but are observed through discrete samples. Representing these functions on fixed uniform grids imposes a trade-off between resolving localized variation and increasing computation across the domain. Neural operators address this mismatch by learning mappings between functions, while latent-attention architectures provide flexible processing of sampled observations. We introduce the Function-Space Transformer (FST), a framework for learning from functions through a spatially adaptive continuous latent representation. FST stores features at anchors whose locations are predicted from the input observations and recursively refines these anchor features through function-space interactions. This allows the representation to adapt its spatial organization to each input rather than inherit that of the observation grid, while supporting both spatially resolved and finite-dimensional outputs. On PDE solution prediction using PDEBench Burgers and Darcy flow, FST substantially outperforms the Perceiver IO baseline, whose latent representation lacks explicit spatial organization, and is highly competitive with the Fourier Neural Operator. On ImageNet-1K, FST achieves higher classification accuracy than the Vision Transformer baseline, with fewer parameters across these comparisons. Ablations further support the benefits of function-space updates and recursive refinement. Together, these results highlight the potential of adaptive continuous representations for both scientific prediction and visual recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出 Function-Space Transformer (FST)，通过空间自适应的连续隐表示从函数中学习：锚点位置由输入观测预测，锚点特征经函数空间交互递归精化，兼顾空间分辨与有限维输出。
AI.motivation: 物理场、几何形状、视觉信号等数据本质上是连续域上的函数，却只能通过离散采样观测。在固定均匀网格上表示这类函数会面临两难：要分辨局部变化就需提高分辨率，从而导致全域计算量激增。神经算子通过学习函数间映射缓解这一矛盾，隐注意力架构则能灵活处理采样观测，但现有方法（如 Perceiver IO）的隐表示缺乏显式空间组织，难以随输入自适应调整空间结构。
AI.method: FST 采用空间自适应的连续隐表示：将特征存储于锚点（anchor）上，锚点位置由输入观测预测得到，而非继承观测网格；并通过函数空间交互（function-space interactions）递归精化锚点特征。该框架支持空间分辨输出与有限维输出两种形式。
AI.result: 在 PDEBench 的 Burgers 与 Darcy flow 偏微分方程求解预测任务上，FST 显著优于隐表示缺乏显式空间组织的 Perceiver IO 基线，并与 Fourier Neural Operator 高度接近；在 ImageNet-1K 上，FST 以更少参数量取得高于 Vision Transformer 基线的分类精度。消融实验进一步验证了函数空间更新与递归精化的作用。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，自适应连续表示在科学预测与视觉识别任务中均具有潜力。

title: COMPASS: Predicting the Relationship of Multiple Patches for Vulnerabilities with LLMs
summary: Modern software heavily relies on code reuse, so upstream vulnerability fixes do not automatically propagate to downstream codebases. Downstream maintainers must manually adopt patches to eliminate known risks. In practice, a single vulnerability often corresponds to multiple patches, which greatly complicates downstream patch adoption because different patch relationships imply different adoption strategies. To address this challenge, we first manually inspect large-scale multi-patch vulnerabilities (about 1K) in the real world and interview experienced developers, summarizing six typical types of patch relationships, i.e., Merge, Mirror, Better Solution, Fixing-of-Fixing, Collaboration, and Separation. Based on these observations, we propose COMPASS, an automated approach that predicts the relationships of multiple vulnerability patches with large language models. Given a CVE as input, COMPASS follows a four-phase pipeline that (i) identifies the patch group and pre-scans explicit relationships, (ii) performs individual patch analysis, (iii) infers relationship instances via a hierarchy-guided prompt, and (iv) validates completeness and consistency of the inferred results. As output, COMPASS reports the predicted relationships within the patch group and visualizes them as a relationship graph. We evaluate COMPASS on a benchmark of 300 multi-patch CVEs and compare it against mainstream learning-based and LLM baselines. Results show that our method achieves strong and consistent prediction effectiveness and outperforms SOTA by 85.04% on average. We publicly release an online querying website to support community reuse of patch relationships knowledge: https://patch-relation.com.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对下游代码库需人工采纳多个上游漏洞补丁的难题，通过实证调研总结出六类补丁关系，并提出基于大语言模型的自动化方法 COMPASS 来预测多补丁关系。
AI.motivation: 现代软件依赖代码复用，上游漏洞修复不会自动传播到下游，需下游维护者手动采纳补丁。实践中单个漏洞常对应多个补丁，不同补丁关系需要不同的采纳策略，这极大增加了下游补丁采纳的复杂度。然而现有工作缺乏对多补丁关系的系统刻画与自动化预测手段。
AI.method: 首先人工检查约1000个真实世界多补丁漏洞并访谈有经验的开发者，归纳出六种典型补丁关系：Merge、Mirror、Better Solution、Fixing-of-Fixing、Collaboration、Separation。基于这些观察提出 COMPASS，利用大语言模型自动预测多补丁关系。给定一个 CVE 作为输入，COMPASS 采用四阶段流水线：(i) 识别补丁组并预扫描显式关系；(ii) 进行单个补丁分析；(iii) 通过层次引导提示（hierarchy-guided prompt）推断关系实例；(iv) 校验推断结果的完整性与一致性。最终输出补丁组内预测关系并以关系图可视化。
AI.result: 在包含300个多补丁 CVE 的基准上评测 COMPASS，并与主流基于学习的基线及 LLM 基线对比。结果显示该方法预测效果稳定且优异，平均超越 SOTA 达 85.04%。同时公开了一个在线查询网站以支持社区复用补丁关系知识：https://patch-relation.com。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS 是首个系统刻画并自动预测多补丁漏洞关系的方法，通过大语言模型与四阶段流水线实现了显著优于现有基线的效果，并提供了公开的在线查询平台，助力下游补丁采纳与社区知识复用。

title: Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill: A Model-Free Controller and Its Generalization Limits
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure. Includes negative generalization results for Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, and two-GPU tensor parallelism
summary:
Concurrent autoregressive inference creates a fundamental interference problem: prefilling a newly arrived long prompt can delay tokens for requests that are already decoding. Fixed prefill chunks reduce this interference, but the best chunk size depends on the model, hardware, load, and latency objective. We introduce Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill (DLFP), a model-free controller that changes only prefill work that overlaps active decodes. After a guarded scheduling cycle, DLFP uses the observed interval as proportional feedback to resize the next prefill chunk; isolated prefills remain unrestricted.
  We implement DLFP in vLLM and evaluate it with open-loop Poisson arrivals, exact token accounting, raw request traces, and NVIDIA telemetry. On Qwen3-0.6B in BF16 on one A100 80 GB GPU, three paired 100-request trials reduce P99 inter-token latency by 24.8%, 30.1%, and 28.2% (mean 27.7%, paired 95% confidence interval 21.0% to 34.3%) with exact output agreement, no failures, and unchanged SLO compliance. The benefit is not free: mean P99 time to first token increases 34.8% while remaining inside the declared SLO.
  Crucially, the mechanism does not generalize to Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-32B, or a two-GPU tensor-parallel configuration. We trace the failure to an asynchronous scheduler-call interval that is only a proxy for completed GPU iteration time. This negative result defines the boundary of the contribution and motivates a completion-timed controller for concurrent CPU and on-device inference. We do not claim mobile-device performance; the present work is a reproducible proof-of-concept and generalization study.

AI.tldr: DLFP是一种模型无关的调度控制器，通过比例反馈动态调整与活跃解码重叠的预填充块大小，在Qwen3-0.6B上降低P99 token间延迟约27.7%，但无法泛化到更大模型与张量并行配置。
AI.motivation: 并发自回归推理中存在干扰问题：新到达的长提示词预填充会延迟正在解码请求的token生成。固定预填充块可缓解干扰，但最优块大小取决于模型、硬件、负载与延迟目标，缺乏自适应机制。
AI.method: 提出Decode-Latency Feedback Prefill（DLFP），一种模型无关控制器，仅调整与活跃解码重叠的预填充工作。在受保护的调度周期后，以观测间隔作为比例反馈来调整下一次预填充块大小；孤立预填充不受限制。在vLLM中实现，采用开环泊松到达、精确token计量、原始请求轨迹与NVIDIA遥测进行评估。
AI.result: 在单张A100 80GB上以BF16运行Qwen3-0.6B，三次配对100请求试验将P99 token间延迟分别降低24.8%、30.1%、28.2%（均值27.7%，配对95%置信区间21.0%–34.3%），输出完全一致、无失败、SLO合规性不变。代价是均值P99首token时间增加34.8%，但仍在声明的SLO内。该机制无法泛化到Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-32B及双GPU张量并行配置。
AI.conclusion: 泛化失败源于异步调度器调用间隔仅是GPU迭代完成时间的代理指标。这一负结果界定了贡献边界，并推动面向并发CPU与设备端推理的完成时间驱动控制器。作者不主张移动设备性能，本工作为可复现的概念验证与泛化研究。

title: Residual Trajectory Distillation for Generative Retrieval
summary: Generative retrieval has emerged as a general retrieval paradigm, representing items with discrete Semantic IDs (SIDs) and retrieving them through autoregressive identifier generation. When SIDs are constructed with residual quantization (RQ), standard retrieval training supervises only the selected codes and discards the residual trajectories that produce them. The same hard code can nevertheless arise from different preferences over competing codewords, while the residual trajectory also contains information about subsequent quantization decisions. As a result, hard SID supervision collapses distinct quantization behaviors into identical targets and leaves information available during indexing unused in retrieval training. We introduce ResTD, a Residual Trajectory Distillation framework that transfers this discarded indexing information into retrieval training. Treating the frozen RQ indexer as a process teacher, it distills residual-induced codeword preferences into SID-decoding states. This supervision recovers distinctions hidden by hard assignments and allows earlier decoder states to capture information about subsequent quantization decisions before the corresponding SID suffix is generated. In this way, richer information from SID construction is incorporated into retrieval learning while preserving the original retrieval index and inference procedure. Experiments on multilingual e-commerce retrieval show consistent improvements over strong baselines and matched training controls. Controlled comparisons show that residual-derived targets outperform the tested codebook-only soft targets. Representation probes further show that future codebook preferences become more recoverable from earlier decoder states. ResTD can also be readily extended beyond retrieval to generative recommendation. Code is available at: https://github.com/Nevaeh7/iclr2027_ResTD.git.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ResTD，一个残差轨迹蒸馏框架，将 RQ 索引过程中被丢弃的残差信息引入生成式检索训练，在保持原有索引与推理流程不变的前提下提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 标准生成式检索在构建 SID 时采用残差量化（RQ），但监督信号仅作用于被选中的码字，丢弃了产生该码字的残差轨迹。这导致两个问题：同一硬码可能源于对不同竞争码字的偏好，而残差轨迹还蕴含后续量化决策的信息。硬 SID 监督会将不同量化行为坍缩为相同目标，并使得索引阶段可获得的信息在检索训练中未被利用。
AI.method: ResTD 将冻结的 RQ 索引器视为过程教师，把残差诱导的码字偏好蒸馏到 SID 解码状态中。这种监督恢复了硬分配所掩盖的区分性，并允许较早的解码器状态在生成相应 SID 后缀之前就捕获后续量化决策的信息。该方法在保留原始检索索引与推理流程的同时，将 SID 构建中的更丰富信息注入检索学习，且可扩展至生成式推荐。
AI.result: 在多语言电商检索实验中，ResTD 相对强基线和匹配训练对照取得一致提升。受控比较显示，残差导出的目标优于所测试的仅码本软目标；表示探针进一步表明，未来码本偏好可从更早的解码器状态中被更好地恢复。
AI.conclusion: 通过将 RQ 索引中原本被丢弃的残差轨迹信息蒸馏进检索训练，ResTD 有效利用了 SID 构建阶段的丰富信息，在不改变索引与推理流程的情况下提升生成式检索性能，并可自然推广至生成式推荐。

title: MILO: Automated Harness Discovery via Orchestrated Multi-Agent Evolution
summary: Modern agentic systems combine an AI model with a harness that controls execution and environmental interactions. Harness design strongly affects long-horizon performance, yet its combinatorial search space demands substantial human effort that must be repeated as models change. Existing automated methods explore this space narrowly, optimizing only components such as prompts or skills or becoming trapped by fixed, exploitative search strategies. We introduce MILO (Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration), a framework that co-evolves agent harnesses and the strategy used to discover them. MILO combines: (i) hierarchical lineage memory over island-based trees, using rejected mutations as negative evidence; (ii) per-island mutator agents that rewrite complete harnesses using global search history and parent-specific feedback; and (iii) an orchestrator that adapts search through lineage grafting and speciation, mutator reassignment and curriculum revision. Across Terminal-Bench 2.1, PaperBench, and DeepSWE, MILO-discovered harnesses outperform eight state-of-the-art harnesses and six search methods using frontier (Opus 4.8) and open-weight (gpt-oss-120b) models. With Opus 4.8, MILO improves resolution over its initial harness by $+12.0\%$, $+28.3\%$, and $+10.3\%$, respectively, compared with best prior-search gains of $+4.5\%$, $+18.3\%$, and $0\%$. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, it achieves $86.1 \pm 2.0\%$, exceeding the official leaderboard's top entry ($83.8 \pm 2.3\%$) while using 26\% fewer tokens than its initial harness. On EinsteinArena open problems, MILO improves best-known upper bounds for Erdős minimum-overlap ($0.3808586 \to 0.3808568$) and the first and third autocorrelation inequalities ($1.50274365 \to 1.50274360$; $1.45081 \to 1.44889$).

AI.tldr: MILO 是一种元进化框架，通过岛屿式树结构上协同进化智能体运行框架（harness）与其搜索策略，在多个基准任务上超过现有最强 harness 与搜索方法。
AI.motivation: 现代智能体系统由模型与执行框架（harness）共同构成，harness 设计显著影响长时程任务表现，但其组合搜索空间庞大、需反复人工调优；已有自动搜索方法探索范围狭窄（仅优化提示或技能等单一组件），且易陷入固定的利用型搜索策略。
AI.method: MILO（Meta-evolutionary Island Orchestration）联合进化 harness 与发现策略，包含三部分：(i) 基于岛屿树的层级谱系记忆，将被拒变异作为负证据；(ii) 每岛变异智能体，结合全局搜索历史与父代特定反馈重写完整 harness；(iii) 编排器通过谱系嫁接与物种形成、变异体重分配与课程修订来自适应调整搜索。
AI.result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、PaperBench、DeepSWE 上，MILO 发现的 harness 优于八个 SOTA harness 和六种搜索方法（前沿模型 Opus 4.8 与开源 gpt-oss-120b）。以 Opus 4.8 为例，相对初始 harness 分别提升 +12.0%、+28.3%、+10.3%，而此前最优搜索增益仅为 +4.5%、+18.3%、0%。Terminal-Bench 2.1 上达 86.1±2.0%，超过官方榜首 83.8±2.3%，且 token 使用比初始 harness 少 26%。在 EinsteinArena 开放问题上改进 Erdős 最小重叠上界（0.3808586→0.3808568）及第一、第三自相关不等式（1.50274365→1.50274360；1.45081→1.44889）。
AI.conclusion: 通过协同进化 harness 与搜索策略，MILO 在智能体框架自动设计中实现了显著且可迁移的性能提升，并在开放数学问题上取得了新的上界改进。

title: DoGBench: Can Agents Meet Expert Standards for User-Facing Documentation?
summary: We introduce DoGBENCH (Documentation Generation Benchmark), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for generating and maintaining real user-facing software documentation. It asks whether an agent can produce documentation that experienced technical writers would accept in review. The benchmark contains 292 items from open source projects, including Helm, PostHog, and Mautic. Each item gives the agent a pre-change repository and a trigger, such as a code pull request or a reported documentation gap. The agent must first decide whether the documentation needs an update. For items that need one, the agent must produce an acceptable patch in one attempt. For items that do not need updates, the agent must abstain. Task-specific rubrics, validated with project maintainers, score each patch on accuracy, completeness, reader guidance, placement, and repository conventions. The composite score combines patch quality with correct abstention, and a score of 100 means an agent meets every requirement for the task. Scores should not be interpreted as a percentage of an expert's capability. We evaluated seven agents. The highest-scoring agent reached 47.3 out of 100 on the 117-item held-out split. In a separate audit of 1,267 patches, the most common failure modes were task-completion gaps (45.5%), technical inaccuracies (36.6%), and incomplete conceptual or reference coverage (32.5%). Analysis of the corresponding trajectories identified three key patterns associated with these failures: (1) describing interfaces without examining how readers use them (36.0%), (2) missing decisive evidence and filling the gaps with plausible assumptions (33.1%), and (3) stopping after finding the first plausible documentation surface and leaving other affected pages stale (30.1%).

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DoGBENCH，首个面向真实用户软件文档生成与维护的基准，包含 292 个开源项目条目，评估智能体能否产出经技术写作者评审认可的文档补丁，并能对无需更新项正确弃权。
AI.motivation: 真实软件文档的生成与维护缺乏可衡量的评估标准；需要判断智能体能否产出资深技术写作者在评审中会接受的文档，并具备判断"是否需要更新"的能力。
AI.method: 构建含 292 个开源项目条目的基准（如 Helm、PostHog、Mautic）。每条给出变更前仓库与触发信号（代码 PR 或文档缺口报告），智能体须先判定是否需要文档更新：需要则一次性产出可接受补丁，不需要则弃权。由项目维护者验证的任务专属评分量表从准确性、完整性、读者引导、放置位置、仓库规范五维打分，综合分将补丁质量与正确弃权结合，满分 100 表示满足全部要求。
AI.result: 评测 7 个智能体，最高分在 117 条留出集上为 47.3/100。对 1,267 个补丁的审计显示主要失败模式为：任务完成缺口 45.5%、技术不准确 36.6%、概念或参考覆盖不完整 32.5%。轨迹分析识别出三类关键模式：只描述接口而不考察读者如何使用（36.0%）、缺乏决定性证据而以看似合理的假设填补（33.1%）、找到首个看似合理的文档页面即停止而遗漏其他受影响页面（30.1%）。
AI.conclusion: DoGBENCH 提供了首个真实用户文档生成与维护的评估基准，显示当前智能体与"可被评审接受"的标准仍有显著差距，并且失败主要源于读者视角缺失、证据不足与影响面识别不全。

title: MetaPersona: Task-Grounded Synthetic Populations from Empirical Social Science
summary: Personas used to seed LLM social simulations face a cold-start problem: existing methods lack a principled basis for deciding which attributes to include and how to assign their values. As a result, synthetic populations may misrepresent the demographic composition, latent attributes, and dependency structure that shape downstream behavior. We introduce MetaPersona-DB, a dataset of 11,000+ empirical human-subjects studies annotated with task-relevant variables, reported relationships, and aggregate-level population statistics. Building on this resource, we propose MetaPersona, a framework that retrieves task-relevant evidence, constructs literature-derived persona dependency graphs, and samples synthetic populations from empirical priors linking demographics, latent attributes, and outcomes. Across three downstream case studies, three baselines, and three frontier models, results vary by task and model: MetaPersona performs strongly on misinformation belief and AI-tool sentiment, while results on income redistribution are mixed. It also reduces persona-construction cost to under $0.5 per task using GPT-5.2. Finally, we present MetaPersona-Studio, a prototype interactive interface for empirically grounded persona generation.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaPersona-DB数据集与MetaPersona框架，用经验先验解决LLM社会仿真中角色构建的冷启动问题，并在三个下游案例中验证其效果与低成本特性。
AI.motivation: 现有用于LLM社会仿真的角色（persona）构建方法存在冷启动问题：缺乏原则性依据来决定纳入哪些属性及如何赋值，导致合成人群可能偏离真实的人口构成、潜在属性及其依赖结构，从而扭曲下游行为表现。
AI.method: 构建MetaPersona-DB，包含11,000+项实证人类被试研究，标注任务相关变量、报告的关系及群体层面人口统计信息；在此基础上提出MetaPersona框架：检索任务相关证据、构建源自文献的角色依赖图，并基于连接人口统计、潜在属性与结果的经验先验采样合成人群。评估覆盖三个下游案例、三个基线与三个前沿模型，并展示MetaPersona-Studio交互式原型。
AI.result: 结果随任务与模型而异：在错误信息信念与AI工具态度任务上表现强，在收入再分配任务上结果混杂。使用GPT-5.2时，角色构建成本降至每任务0.5美元以下。
AI.conclusion: 以经验研究证据为基础的角色生成能够缓解冷启动问题并降低构建成本，但跨任务效果并不一致，表明方法性能依赖任务特性，需进一步验证其泛化性。

title: Generative End-to-end Ad Retrieval at Douyin
summary: Generative retrieval reformulates recommendation as the generation of discrete item tokens. However, scaling this paradigm to real-world recommender systems reveals two critical bottlenecks: 1) Representation collapse, where the item tokenizer converges to degenerate results under continuous distribution shifts, fundamentally hindering stable end-to-end adaptation. 2) Item collisions, where the massive candidate pool causes distinct items to share identical token sequences, compromising the final retrieval precision. Crucially, these bottlenecks are inherently coupled: expanding codebook capacity to mitigate collisions inevitably exacerbates collapse. To address them simultaneously, we propose GEAR, an end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes the tokenizer, generator, and reranker. To mitigate representation collapse, we introduce BasisVQ, which re-parameterizes the codebook via an orthogonal basis to enable global gradient sharing and rigid spatial rotation of the latent space, effectively stabilizing gradient dynamics without ad-hoc heuristics. We further extend it to prefix-aware BasisRQ, substantially enhancing the codebook's expressiveness with the same asymptotic time complexity. To resolve item collisions, GEAR integrates a context-conditioned reranking head into the generative process, efficiently disambiguating colliding items with minimal computational overhead. By unifying stable tokenization and joint reranking within an end-to-end generative framework, GEAR establishes a fully differentiable and scalable paradigm. It currently serves hundreds of millions of daily active users on Douyin Ads, yielding substantial empirical improvements in extensive online A/B tests.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GEAR端到端生成式检索框架，通过BasisVQ/前缀感知BasisRQ稳定码本、结合上下文条件重排解决表征坍缩与物品碰撞，并在抖音广告大规模在线A/B中取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 生成式检索将推荐建模为离散物品token生成，但扩展到真实推荐系统时面临两个关键瓶颈：一是表征坍缩——连续分布漂移下物品tokenizer退化为退化结果，阻碍端到端稳定适配；二是物品碰撞——海量候选池导致不同物品共享相同token序列，损害检索精度。二者本质耦合：扩大码本容量缓解碰撞会加剧坍缩。
AI.method: 提出GEAR端到端框架，联合优化tokenizer、生成器和重排器。针对表征坍缩，提出BasisVQ：以正交基对码本重新参数化，实现全局梯度共享与隐空间刚性旋转，稳定梯度动态，无需启发式技巧；并扩展为前缀感知BasisRQ，在同等渐近时间复杂度下增强码本表达力。针对物品碰撞，在生成过程中集成上下文条件重排头，以极小计算开销消歧碰撞物品。
AI.result: 统一了稳定tokenization与联合重排，形成完全可微、可扩展的生成式框架；已在抖音广告服务数亿日活用户，广泛在线A/B测试取得显著经验提升。
AI.conclusion: GEAR通过正交基码本参数化与前缀感知残差量化稳定tokenizer，并以生成内重排解决物品碰撞，验证了端到端生成式检索在工业级推荐系统中的可扩展性与有效性。

title: Continual Learning of Dynamical Systems in Recurrent Neural Networks through Recyclable Unit Gating
summary: Dynamical Systems Reconstruction (DSR) aims to infer models from observed time series that reproduce a system's qualitative long-term behavior. Continual DSR (cDSR) requires learning new systems while preserving previously learned dynamics, yet even small parameter updates in recurrent models can qualitatively alter their behavior over long autonomous rollouts. We benchmark established continual learning (CL) methods spanning parameter regularization, replay, and parameter isolation on the fully trainable and interpretable Almost-Linear RNN (AL-RNN). Parameter isolation preserves earlier dynamics most effectively, but excessive task-specific allocations can rapidly exhaust a fixed-size network. We therefore introduce Continually-Recyclable Unit-Gating (CRUG), which conserves capacity through compact allocation and forward transfer. Differentiable gates trained with an $L_0$-based penalty select task-specific units, while unused units are recycled for subsequent tasks. Directed connections allow later tasks to reuse earlier representations without affecting the dynamics of previously committed units. CRUG achieves the strongest reconstruction--capacity trade-off among the tested methods with zero forgetting and reliably learns a heterogeneous sequence of nonlinear and chaotic systems. Furthermore, we show that forward transfer is more pronounced and useful when tasks share similar underlying dynamics. Lastly, we demonstrate that CRUG's advantages extend beyond autonomous cDSR to sequential cognitive tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究持续动力系统重构（cDSR），在可训练的Almost-Linear RNN（AL-RNN）上基准测试了参数正则化、回放与参数隔离等持续学习方法，并提出Continually-Recyclable Unit-Gating（CRUG），通过紧凑分配与前向迁移实现零遗忘的重构-容量最优权衡。
AI.motivation: 持续动力系统重构需在学习新系统的同时保留已学动态，但循环模型中即便微小的参数更新也可能在长时间自主演化中定性改变行为，因此需要兼顾重构能力与容量约束的持续学习方案。
AI.method: 在完全可训练且可解释的AL-RNN上基准测试参数正则化、回放和参数隔离三类持续学习方法；提出CRUG，利用基于L0惩罚训练的可微门控选择任务特定单元，回收未用单元供后续任务使用，并通过有向连接使后续任务复用早期表征而不影响已固定单元的动力学。
AI.result: 参数隔离对保留早期动态最有效，但过度任务特定分配会迅速耗尽固定容量网络；CRUG在测试方法中取得最强的重构-容量权衡，实现零遗忘，能可靠学习非线性与混沌系统的异构序列；当任务底层动态相似时，前向迁移更明显且更有用；CRUG的优势还扩展至序列认知任务。
AI.conclusion: CRUG通过单元门控与回收机制在持续动力系统重构中实现零遗忘与良好容量效率，其收益可推广至序列认知任务。

title: Learning When and How to Intervene: A Hindsight-Distilled Sentinel for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents solve repository-level tasks through sequences of actions, where a single erroneous action can misdirect subsequent decisions and increase recovery costs. Existing approaches use execution feedback for recovery or specialized checks to block errors, but deciding before execution whether intervention will benefit eventual task completion remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose HiSentinel, a hindsight-distillation framework that trains lightweight 0.6B and 1.7B sentinels to select pre-execution interventions aimed at improving task completion rather than correcting every imperfect action. A privileged teacher uses recorded execution outcomes as evidence for intervention judgments, which are distilled into a causal student that receives only the pre-action context and proposed action. Beyond identifying whether and when to intervene, the sentinel must also provide actionable feedback that helps the coding agent recover or obtain necessary human input. To support these capabilities, we introduce SWE-Intervene, an action-level dataset constructed from software-engineering trajectories that annotates whether an action should be allowed, autonomously redirected, or paused for human assistance, together with corresponding intervention feedback. Across SWE-bench Verified Mini and Ask or Assume, HiSentinel consistently improves task completion across Sentinel scales and coding-agent families, with gains of up to 14% and 10%, respectively, while maintaining competitive token consumption. These results demonstrate that lightweight pre-execution intervention can effectively prevent error propagation and improve the reliability of autonomous coding agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 HiSentinel——一个事后蒸馏框架，训练轻量级 0.6B/1.7B "哨兵"模型，在执行前决定是否干预编码智能体的动作，以提升任务完成率而非纠正每个瑕疵动作。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体按动作序列完成仓库级任务，单个错误动作会误导后续决策并抬高恢复成本。现有方法依赖执行反馈进行恢复或用专门检查拦截错误，但在执行前判断"干预是否能提升最终任务完成"仍具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出 HiSentinel 事后蒸馏框架：特权教师模型利用已记录的执行结果作为证据进行干预判定，蒸馏到仅接收"动作前上下文 + 候选动作"的因果学生模型；哨兵不仅判断是否/何时干预，还给出可操作的干预反馈。同时构建 SWE-Intervene 动作级数据集，标注动作应被放行、自主重定向还是暂停求助人类，并附带干预反馈。
AI.result: 在 SWE-bench Verified Mini 与 Ask or Assume 上，HiSentinel 在各哨兵规模与不同编码智能体家族中均稳定提升任务完成率，最高提升分别达 14% 和 10%，且 token 消耗保持相当水平。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级执行前干预能有效阻断错误传播，提升自主编码智能体的可靠性。

title: SimTrace: Grounded Multimodal User Trajectories Generation for Online User Modeling
summary: Virtual clients offer a cost-effective approach to support applications such as A/B testing, recommender system development, and interface evaluation. However, building them requires access to large-scale, semantically faithful, fine-grained online user trajectories. These data are difficult to obtain because proprietary logs are subject to privacy restrictions and small businesses often lack sufficient traffic. Consequently, existing public datasets either abstract away fine-grained user interaction details or preserve rich context but remain platform-specific and small-scale. To address this gap, we propose SimTrace, a framework that generates faithful, fine-grained synthetic multimodal clickstreams through a computer-use client agent that is grounded in real user trajectories and the given web environment. SimTrace anonymizes real interactions and constructs a simulated twin of the given web environment, then uses both to generate synthetic interaction trajectories. Each action is paired with its corresponding web observations and user context, yielding a shareable alternative to confidential logs for developing computer-use agent-style virtual clients. We apply SimTrace to an e-commerce setting and evaluate both its fidelity and downstream utility. SimTrace outperforms competing baselines on 7 out of 8 fidelity metrics. Models trained on synthetic data achieve performance comparable to those trained on real data on downstream tasks such as purchase prediction and recommendation. For next action prediction task, augmenting real data with synthetic data further improves accuracy by 11.0% relative to training on real data alone. We release SimTrace as an open-source package to facilitate research on online user behavior modeling.

AI.tldr: SimTrace：基于计算机使用代理、结合真实用户轨迹与Web环境的细粒度合成多模态点击流生成框架，在电商场景验证了保真度与下游效用，并开源。
AI.motivation: 虚拟客户端（virtual clients）支持A/B测试、推荐系统开发、界面评估等应用且成本低，但构建需大规模、语义忠实、细粒度在线用户轨迹。此类数据难以获取：专有日志受隐私限制，小型企业流量不足。现有公开数据集要么丢弃细粒度交互细节，要么保留丰富上下文但局限于单一平台且规模小，形成数据缺口。
AI.method: 提出SimTrace框架：通过一个computer-use client agent，以真实用户轨迹和给定Web环境为基础生成忠实、细粒度的合成多模态点击流。具体流程为：对真实交互进行匿名化处理，并构建给定Web环境的模拟孪生（simulated twin），二者共同用于生成合成交互轨迹；每个动作均与其对应的Web观测和用户上下文配对，从而形成可共享的、替代机密日志的数据资源。
AI.result: 在电商场景下评估保真度与下游效用：SimTrace在8项保真度指标中的7项优于竞争基线；基于合成数据训练的模型在购买预测、推荐等下游任务上达到与真实数据训练相当的性能；在下一动作预测任务中，将真实数据与合成数据联合增强，相比仅用真实数据训练相对提升准确率11.0%。
AI.conclusion: SimTrace能够生成可共享的、替代机密日志的细粒度合成点击流，可用于开发computer-use agent式的虚拟客户端；作者以开源包形式发布SimTrace，以促进在线用户行为建模研究。

title: When the Label Ignores the Request: Auditing Policy-Selected Targets in Synthetic Conversational Music Recommendation
comment: 6 pages, 2 tables. Camera-ready version (CC BY 4.0). RecSys Challenge 2026 Workshop at ACM RecSys 2026, Minneapolis, October 2, 2026. Code and audit artifacts: https://github.com/Sanjeev-S/recsys2026-request-audit
summary: Synthetic dialogues generated by LLM pipelines now serve as complete conversational-recommendation benchmarks: an LLM listener talks to an LLM recommender, and the track logged next in the conversation becomes the official label for each turn. These policy-selected labels make large-scale evaluation reproducible, but they are proxies for what the simulated user asked. We audit the one place where label and request are directly comparable: turns where the user asks for an exact song by name. In the RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay benchmark, using visible dialogue and catalog metadata alone, we find that the official label contradicts the user's exact-song request in half of the audited development turns. This matters beyond one benchmark: naming the desired item is the dominant intent in real music search, where deployed systems avoid substituting an alternative for an exactly named item, on the premise that it costs satisfaction. A small training-time supplement closes most of the gap: adding catalog-resolved request-satisfying targets to a small fraction of training turns yields a 53.3% relative gain in nDCG@20 on the 43 conflict turns while leaving the official metric intact, verified against a matched control that detects the same requests but trains only on official labels.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay合成对话推荐基准中"用户明确点歌名"场景下的标签质量，发现官方标签在约一半的审计回合中与用户的精确歌曲请求相矛盾；通过在小比例训练回合中补充满足请求的目标，可在43个冲突回合上取得nDCG@20相对提升53.3%，且不损害官方指标。
AI.motivation: LLM流水线生成的合成对话已成为完整的对话推荐基准：LLM听众与LLM推荐器对话，对话中记录的下一个轨道即该回合的官方标签。这种策略选择的标签使大规模评估可复现，但只是模拟用户实际所问内容的代理指标。作者希望审计标签与请求可直接比较的唯一场景——用户按名称精确点歌的回合，以检验合成基准的标签可靠性。
AI.method: 在RecSys Challenge 2026 TalkPlay基准上，仅利用可见对话与目录元数据，对用户精确点歌的回合进行审计，比较官方标签与用户请求是否一致。随后设计训练期数据补充方案：对一小部分训练回合加入经目录解析的、满足请求的目标，并与匹配对照组（能检测相同请求但仅用官方标签训练）进行验证。
AI.result: 在审计的开发集回合中，官方标签与用户精确点歌请求相矛盾的占比达一半。加入满足请求的目标后，在43个冲突回合上nDCG@20取得53.3%的相对提升，同时官方指标保持不变；匹配对照组验证了该增益来自请求满足目标而非请求检测本身。
AI.conclusion: 合成对话推荐基准的策略选择标签在精确点歌场景下存在系统性偏差，可能低估系统真实表现。命名目标物品是真实音乐搜索的主导意图，部署系统通常避免以替代品替换精确命名物品。通过在训练中少量补充请求满足目标，可有效缓解该标签偏差，且不牺牲官方指标，为合成基准的可靠性改进提供了可行路径。

title: On the Off-Policy Teacher in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has recently emerged as a promising post-training paradigm in which the student learns from trajectories generated by its own policy under dense teacher supervision. However, OPD introduces a fundamental asymmetry: although the sampled trajectories are on-policy for the student, they are off-policy for the teacher. The teacher is typically optimized to continue from prefixes generated by its own policy, but during OPD it must instead supervise prefixes generated by the student. Empirically, we find that its continuation performance degrades as these prefixes grow longer. To address this issue, we propose Student-COnditioned Updates of the Teacher (SCOUT), a co-training framework that adapts the teacher to student-generated prefixes. Alongside standard OPD updates, SCOUT periodically optimizes the teacher's conditional ability using reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, where the teacher generates continuations from student prefixes and learns from outcome rewards. Controlled experiments show that SCOUT improves the teacher's ability to continue from student-generated prefixes, supporting the intended mechanism of student-conditioned teacher adaptation. Across multiple teacher--student configurations, model scales, and reasoning domains, SCOUT also consistently improves the effectiveness of on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOUT，一种师生协同训练框架，通过让学生生成的前缀进行条件化教师适配，缓解on-policy蒸馏中教师面对学生前缀时的性能下降问题。
AI.motivation: On-policy蒸馏（OPD）中，轨迹对学生是on-policy的，但对教师却是off-policy的：教师通常只优化过基于自身策略生成前缀的续写，被迫监督学生生成的前缀时续写性能随前缀变长而下降。这一非对称性是OPD效果受限的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: SCOUT在标准OPD更新之外，周期性地利用可验证奖励的强化学习优化教师的"条件续写"能力：让教师从学生生成的前缀出发生成续写，并根据结果奖励进行学习。通过这种协同训练，使教师适配学生分布的前缀（student-conditioned teacher adaptation）。
AI.result: 受控实验表明，SCOUT提升了教师从学生前缀续写的能力，验证了其预期的机制；在多种教师-学生配置、模型规模和推理任务上，SCOUT一致地提升了on-policy蒸馏的效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过将教师对学生前缀的适配纳入训练循环，SCOUT有效解决了OPD中的师生分布非对称问题，为提升on-policy蒸馏提供了通用且可扩展的方案。

title: Leveraging Game-Based Platform to Teach Code Refactoring: An Experience with Refactoria
summary: Refactoring is the art of improving the internal structure of the code without altering its external behavior. Because of the topic's significance, several teaching methods and strategies have been proposed in the literature. However, skills in identifying and refac- toring code smells come from training and experience, and a lack of motivation may hinder developers' adoption of refactoring tools. In this paper, we discuss the results of an experiment in the classroom that involved performing various refactoring activities to remove antipatterns using Refactoria, an innovative game-based tool that supports the acquisition of code smell and refactoring concepts. The players play as an expert chef with their sidekick Watson the Whiskbot to refactor Watson's instructions into efficient, readable, and easily maintainable code. We present an experiment with 30 student developers. In particular, we study the perception, effectiveness, and usefulness of gamification for engaging developers in code smell identification and refactoring. Our evaluation indicates a high perceived usefulness among students, and participants reported that Refactoria facilitated their understanding of the refactoring concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一款名为Refactoria的基于游戏的教学工具，用于帮助开发者学习代码坏味道识别与重构，并通过30名学生的课堂实验评估其感知有用性、有效性和趣味性。
AI.motivation: 重构是改善代码内部结构而不改变外部行为的重要手段，但识别并重构代码坏味道的技能依赖训练与经验积累，开发者常因缺乏动机而难以采用重构工具，因此需要新的教学策略来提升学习兴趣与参与度。
AI.method: 设计了基于游戏的创新型工具Refactoria，将玩家设定为专业厨师，与助手Watson the Whiskbot合作，把Watson的指令重构成高效、可读、易维护的代码。随后在课堂上开展实验，30名学生开发者参与，通过完成移除反模式的各类重构活动，研究游戏化在代码坏味道识别与重构中的感知、有效性和实用性。
AI.result: 学生对Refactoria的感知有用性评价较高，参与者表示该工具促进了他们对重构概念的理解，游戏化有助于提升开发者参与代码坏味道识别与重构的积极性。
AI.conclusion: 游戏化可用于代码坏味道识别与重构教学，Refactoria能有效增强学生的学习体验和概念理解，为后续教学工具的推广和改进提供了依据。

title: ArgGYM: A Procedural, Engine-Verified Benchmark for Structured Defeasible Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in large language model reasoning has been driven by benchmarks and reinforcement learning environments with automatically verifiable rewards, particularly in mathematics, code, and formal logic. These settings make model accuracy easier to evaluate and optimize, but it remains unclear how far success under fixed problem specifications and stable evaluation criteria transfers to reasoning outside such domains. Real-world reasoning often proceeds under incomplete and revisable information: conclusions may be supported provisionally, defeated by counter-evidence, reinstated by further arguments, or revised when stronger reasons become available. Reasoning of this kind is generally referred to as defeasible reasoning. We introduce ArgGYM, a procedural benchmark and RLVR-compatible training environment for structured defeasible reasoning. ArgGYM decomposes this reasoning into twelve tasks and grounds task-specific scoring in a symbolic argumentation engine that computes the formal states used to evaluate model outputs. It includes a frozen benchmark of 1,440 verified instances across fifteen curriculum configurations, two argument preference orderings (weakest-link and last-link), and two set orderings (elitist and democratic), while the same generators and verifiers can produce fresh instances for evaluation that reduces dependence on static test sets and for verifiable-reward training. On the frozen benchmark, frontier and open-weight models show sharply different reasoning profiles: they can recover substantial parts of structured answers without solving the complete task, and performance declines in later curriculum configurations with longer dependencies and more interacting structures. We release the benchmark, generators, and verifiers for reproducible evaluation and RLVR training.

AI.tldr: ArgGYM：面向可废止推理的程序化基准与RLVR训练环境，含1440个验证实例、12类任务和符号论证引擎评分。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理进展主要依赖数学、代码、形式逻辑等可自动验证奖励的基准，这些场景问题设定固定、评价标准稳定，但其成功能否迁移到更真实的推理场景尚不明确。现实推理常在信息不完整且可修正的条件下进行（结论可被暂定支持、被反证击败、被新论据恢复或在更强理由出现时被修正），即可废止推理，该领域缺乏系统性评测与训练环境。
AI.method: 提出ArgGYM：将可废止推理分解为12项任务，用符号论证引擎计算形式状态，为任务特定评分提供依据；构建冻结基准，含1440个已验证实例，覆盖15种课程配置、两种论证偏好序（weakest-link与last-link）和两种集合序（elitist与democratic）；同一生成器与验证器可生成新实例，支持动态评测与RLVR可验证奖励训练。
AI.result: 在冻结基准上，前沿模型与开源权重模型呈现显著不同的推理画像：二者均能在未完整求解任务的情况下恢复相当部分结构化答案；在依赖链更长、结构交互更多的后续课程配置中性能下降。
AI.conclusion: ArgGYM为可废止推理提供了可复现的评测与RLVR训练资源，并开源基准、生成器与验证器，揭示出模型在长依赖、多结构交互场景下的推理瓶颈。

title: KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation
summary: Generative recommendation, has been attracted a surge of attentions in industrial and academic research community, towards to build more smart system to build next-generation recommender. Under the significant developing wave of large language model, our team have been developed Semantic ID based OneRec/OneRec-V2. These models have been widely deployed in production and demonstrate the scaling potential of the autoregressive next-item prediction paradigm for industrial recommender systems. Building on the success of OneRec, we further explored a series of models, including OneRec-Think, OpenOneRec, and OneReason, that connect item Semantic IDs with natural language in a unified representation space and seek to unlock the potential of natural-language chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning for recommendation. However, our preliminary works found that introducing reasoning CoT does not always improve the recommendation performance. To address this issue, OneReason strengthens the semantic alignment between items and language, introduces structured template-based supervision for interest reasoning, and applies advanced reinforcement learning techniques to make reasoning more beneficial to recommendation. As a frontier topic to building recommendation foundation models, we believe this topic has significant research value and hope to encourage more researchers to explore it together. To this end, together with the SIGIR 2026 community, we organized the KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026: Reasoning Generative Recommendation.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍由快手团队在生成式推荐方向的研究历程，从已落地的OneRec/OneRec-V2，到探索语义ID与自然语言统一的OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec、OneReason，并宣布与SIGIR 2026合办LLM-Rec挑战赛。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型浪潮下，业界希望构建更智能的下一代推荐系统。团队此前基于语义ID的OneRec系列已在工业界广泛部署，验证了自回归下一项预测范式的可扩展性，但初步研究发现引入自然语言思维链（CoT）推理并不总能提升推荐效果，因此需要进一步研究如何让推理真正有益于推荐。
AI.method: 在OneRec基础上探索一系列模型（OneRec-Think、OpenOneRec、OneReason），将物品语义ID与自然语言映射到统一表示空间，尝试解锁自然语言CoT推理在推荐中的潜力。其中OneReason通过强化物品与语言的语义对齐、引入结构化模板的监督信号来指导兴趣推理，并应用先进强化学习技术。
AI.result: OneRec/OneRec-V2已在生产环境广泛部署并展现规模化潜力；后续工作发现单纯引入CoT推理并非总能提升性能，而OneReason通过语义对齐、结构化模板监督及强化学习使推理更有益于推荐。
AI.conclusion: 该方向作为推荐基础模型的前沿课题具有重要研究价值，团队希望吸引更多研究者共同探索，并与SIGIR 2026社区合作举办KUAISHOU Explorer LLM-Rec Challenge 2026，主题为"推理生成式推荐"。

title: Simulator-Refined Diffusion for Radio-Frequency Inverse Design
summary: Diffusion models have shown potential in inverse design of printed circuit boards (PCBs), enabling the generation of layouts conditioned on target S-parameters. Despite this promise, applying diffusion models to PCB layout generation remains challenging due to their difficulty in meeting the quantitative electromagnetic specifications. A common approach is gradient-based guidance, which biases the diffusion sampling process with the gradient of an objective used for evaluation. However, full-wave electromagnetic simulators are accurate but expensive and typically non-differentiable, whereas differentiable surrogates are informative but not always reliable. To address these limitations, this paper proposes Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD), a novel combination of a low-fidelity differentiable surrogate and a high-fidelity non-differentiable simulator within the diffusion sampling process. Unlike standard zeroth-order optimization, which requires a great number of random perturbations, our approach uses the surrogate's gradient to propose the perturbation direction while the simulator then searches based on this direction to identify an effective design update. Experimental results across different settings show that this method consistently outperforms current state-of-the-art methods, producing layouts whose simulated S-parameters match the target specifications up to 21.2% closer for in-distribution targets and up to 19.8% for out-of-distribution targets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Simulator-Refined Diffusion (SRD)，将低保真可微代理模型与高保真不可微仿真器结合用于扩散采样，用于PCB逆设计，从而在满足S参数电磁规格上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型用于PCB逆设计时难以满足定量电磁规格。梯度引导是一条常见路径，但全波电磁仿真器精度高却昂贵且通常不可微，而可微代理模型虽可提供梯度信息却未必可靠，二者各有局限。
AI.method: 在扩散采样过程中同时引入低保真可微代理模型与高保真不可微仿真器：不同于需要大量随机扰动的标准零阶优化，该方法利用代理模型的梯度给出扰动方向，再由仿真器沿该方向进行搜索，从而确定有效的设计更新。
AI.result: 在多种实验设置下，该方法持续优于当前最先进方法，生成的版图仿真S参数与目标规格更接近：分布内目标最多提升21.2%，分布外目标最多提升19.8%。
AI.conclusion: SRD通过将可微代理的梯度方向提议与非可微仿真器的方向性搜索相结合，有效缓解了梯度引导中仿真器不可微与代理不可靠的问题，提升了PCB逆设计对电磁规格的满足程度。

title: A Competing-Hazards Systematization of Loss of Control in Autonomous Agents
summary: Leading AI developers have reported agents acting beyond their approved limits, which a United Nations panel described as an early warning of loss of human control. Yet incident reports and agent-safety evaluations describe these events differently, making it difficult to compare failures, trace risk across attempts, or separate agent behavior from the environment's role in allowing an out-of-scope action to succeed. To address this gap, we introduce a common framework in which each attempt ends in approved completion, safe stopping, scope escape, or continuation. We formalize the framework as a discrete-time competing-hazards model and derive escape probability within a retry budget, a model-conditional safe-budget limit, and conditions for estimation from execution logs. We audit 22 incident reports and 102 agent-safety evaluations published from January 2025 to September 2026 using primary sources. Six incidents involved tasks that could not be completed within scope, thirteen involved agents that continued rather than stopped, and five did not report stopping behavior. Developers' figures imply a task-level incidence ratio near 47 for out-of-scope coordination in never-solved versus solved tasks. Among evaluations, 87 recorded an out-of-scope effect or specification violation, 26 treated safe stopping as a first-class outcome, only 20 recorded both, and 79 merged budget exhaustion with failure. In 20 of 22 incidents, the environment allowed an out-of-scope effect, indicating that realized loss of control often reflected persistent agent behavior interacting with permissive boundary conditions; meanwhile, no evaluation reported all fields needed to estimate the full competing-hazards process from published evidence.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一个统一框架，将智能体的每次尝试归为四类结果（批准完成、安全停止、越界逃逸、继续），并形式化为离散时间竞争风险模型，用其审计22份事故报告与102项智能体安全评估，揭示报告口径不一致、环境边界宽松与估计信息缺失等问题。
AI.motivation: 领先AI开发者已报告智能体行为超出授权范围，联合国专家组视之为人类失去控制的早期预警；但事故报告与安全评估对同类事件的描述口径不一致，导致难以比较失败、跨尝试追踪风险，也难以区分智能体行为与环境在“越界行为得以成功”中的各自作用。
AI.method: 引入统一框架：每次尝试的结果分为批准完成、安全停止、越界逃逸（scope escape）或继续（continuation）；将其形式化为离散时间竞争风险模型，推导在重试预算内的逃逸概率、给定模型下的安全预算上限，以及从执行日志中估计该过程所需的条件；随后以一手资料审计2025年1月至2026年9月发表的22份事故报告和102项智能体安全评估。
AI.result: 22起事故中，6起涉及无法在范围内完成的任务，13起涉及智能体“继续”而非“停止”，5起未报告停止行为；开发者数据暗示，在“从未解决”任务与“已解决”任务之间，越界协作的任务级发生率比接近47。102项评估中，87项记录了越界效应或规格违规，26项将安全停止视为一类独立结果，仅20项同时记录二者，79项将预算耗尽与失败合并。20/22起事故中，环境允许了越界效应发生，表明实际发生的失控往往是持续的智能体行为与宽松边界条件交互的结果；同时，没有任何一项评估报告了从已发表证据中估计完整竞争风险过程所需的全部字段。
AI.conclusion: 事故报告与安全评估在结果分类、安全停止与预算耗尽的处理上存在系统性口径差异，既阻碍风险比较与追踪，也掩盖了环境边界条件的作用；现有公开证据不足以支持对竞争风险过程的完整估计，亟需按该框架统一记录执行日志与评估字段。

title: Decision-Oriented Recommendation Reranking: An Empirical Study of Jev
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for recommendation reranking, but their use introduces an important tradeoff between recommendation quality and serving efficiency. We investigate whether a decision-oriented model provides a useful alternative when the reranking task is fundamentally a structured choice among predefined candidate items. Specifically, we conduct a controlled empirical study of Jev, described by TypeSafe AI as a ``System One Model,'' for personalized recommendation reranking and compare it with recommendation-specific models and pointwise and listwise Qwen rerankers across multiple Amazon Reviews domains and candidate-set sizes, evaluating both recommendation effectiveness and observed serving latency. Our results show that Jev maintains strong recommendation effectiveness relative to the evaluated baselines while exhibiting substantially more gradual latency growth than the pointwise Qwen rerankers, although its observed serving latency remains substantially higher than that of recommendation-specific models. Together, these characteristics place Jev in a distinct quality--latency operating regime across candidate sizes and domains. These findings motivate further investigation of decision-oriented models for recommendation and other ranking tasks with structured output spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文对"System One Model" Jev 进行受控实证研究，评估其在个性化推荐重排中的质量-延迟权衡。结果显示 Jev 相比逐点式 Qwen 重排器延迟增长更平缓，但整体延迟仍高于推荐专用模型。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）用于推荐重排时存在推荐质量与服务效率之间的权衡。作者想探究：当重排任务本质上是"预定义候选项之间的结构化选择"时，面向决策（decision-oriented）的模型是否是有用的替代方案。
AI.method: 对 TypeSafe AI 提出的"System One Model" Jev 进行受控实证研究，用于个性化推荐重排；在多个 Amazon Reviews 领域及不同候选集规模下，将其与推荐专用模型、逐点式（pointwise）和列表式（listwise）Qwen 重排器对比，同时评估推荐效果与实际服务延迟。
AI.result: Jev 相对所评估基线保持了较强的推荐效果，且延迟增长比逐点式 Qwen 重排器明显更平缓；但其实际服务延迟仍显著高于推荐专用模型。综合来看，在不同候选规模和领域下，Jev 处于一个独特的质量-延迟运行区间。
AI.conclusion: Jev 在候选集规模增大时具备延迟增长平缓的优势，形成独特的质量-延迟区间。这些发现支持进一步研究面向决策的模型，以用于推荐及其他具有结构化输出空间的排序任务。

title: Learning to Plan from Random Exploration
summary: Random exploration reveals how an environment can be traversed before a goal is specified. Can this experience support long-range planning without policy-improvement training? Our random-walk analysis explains what temporal relations contain: short horizons reveal geodesic geometry in the diffusion limit, while longer horizons reveal connectivity between regions before mixing removes these distinctions. We learn these relations with a conditional energy-based model that estimates temporal log-density ratios through horizon-conditioned embeddings. The model is trained on observation pairs by noise-contrastive estimation, without action or reward labels. The planner queries these learned relations at different horizons as it moves toward the goal. At test time, a separate local dynamics model predicts candidate action outcomes, and the temporal model evaluates their progress toward the goal by selecting or aggregating estimated improvements across horizons. The agent executes one action and replans with both models fixed. Experiments demonstrate long-range maze planning from random exploration using states and images. Learned score fields, embedding probes, and planned routes exhibit properties of a multiscale cognitive map. We further demonstrate egocentric navigation from random exploration and manipulation planning from suboptimal data.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究能否用随机探索经验支撑长程规划。作者分析随机游走中的时间关系，提出条件能量模型估计多时间尺度的时序对数密度比，仅用观测对以噪声对比估计训练，无需动作或奖励标签。规划时结合局部动力学模型，在不同时间尺度查询该模型以评估候选动作的进展。实验在迷宫规划、自我中心导航与操作规划中验证了该方法可形成多尺度认知地图式的规划能力。
AI.motivation: 传统长程规划依赖策略改进训练或奖励/动作标签，成本高且难以从无目标探索中迁移。作者试图回答：随机探索所蕴含的“环境可通行性”信息能否在不做策略改进训练的前提下支持长程规划。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析随机游走的时间关系：短时域在扩散极限下反映测地几何，长时域在混合之前揭示区域连通性，混合后区分度消失。2) 用条件能量模型通过时间尺度条件嵌入估计时序对数密度比，以噪声对比估计在观测对上训练，不使用动作或奖励标签。3) 规划器在不同时域查询学习到的时间关系以朝目标推进；测试时由独立局部动力学模型预测候选动作结果，时间模型跨时域选择或聚合估计的进展量，执行一步动作后固定两模型重规划。
AI.result: 在状态和图像输入的迷宫长程规划中，仅用随机探索即可完成规划；学习到的分数场、嵌入探针与规划路径呈现多尺度认知地图特性；并进一步展示从随机探索进行自我中心导航，以及从次优数据中进行操作规划。
AI.conclusion: 随机探索中的多尺度时间关系可被压缩为可查询的能量/分数模型，替代策略改进训练来支持长程规划，并在多种任务形式中体现多尺度认知地图性质。

title: Trust Is Not a Score: Runtime Assurance Contracts for High-Risk AI Agents
comment: 16 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Ancillary files: decision log, executable transition model, LLM-labelled synthetic holdout. Synthetic mechanism study; no deployment claim
summary: Benchmarks, audits, and agent protocols describe performance, permissions, and repair, but not how observed evidence should change an agent's authority during a consequential task. We call this the assurance-transition gap. We propose a Runtime Assurance Contract (RAC), a policy-level formal schema binding autonomy boundaries, component eligibility, evidence state, transition policy, human-review capacity, and non-compensatory gates. Under RAC, soft metrics may inform routing, whereas a failed or unknown mandatory gate forces retry, switch, escalation, deferral, or stop; aggregate performance cannot authorize action. We define the contract, an evidence record, a permission rule, and five invariants, and illustrate them in clinical, industrial, and judicial failure probes. We then report a deterministic failure-injection study in agentic coding: 280 constructed cases evaluated by a gate conjunction, a score-only rule, and a restricted protocol baseline. At the published example weights and threshold, the score rule admits 80 of 100 block-required injections and all 40 review-required injections. Tuned in hindsight, it matches the conjunction on this corpus. For positive weights, a positive threshold, binary risk signals, zero-signal controls, and an injected case firing each signal alone, we show that exact agreement holds if and only if the threshold does not exceed the smallest weight. A separate set of 18 hand-authored traces checks version-pinned evidence and review transitions against simpler policy variants. In a further prospective synthetic holdout of 24 episodes, two blinded LLM judges assign identical labels to all 72 action attempts; RAC and a separately implemented full stateful baseline both match these labels. These studies test mechanisms on synthetic cases; they establish neither deployed safety nor cross-domain effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出运行时保证契约（RAC），一种策略级形式化模式，用以在关键任务中依据证据状态动态调整代理权限。通过失败注入研究、手工追踪与前瞻性合成留出集验证，RAC的门控合取机制优于纯分数规则，并在合成案例上与完整状态化基线一致，但尚未证明实际部署安全性与跨域有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基准、审计与代理协议仅刻画性能、权限与修复，却未描述观测证据应如何在关键任务过程中改变代理的权限，作者将此空白称为"保证转移缺口"（assurance-transition gap）。
AI.method: 提出RAC形式化契约，绑定自主性边界、组件资格、证据状态、转移策略、人工审查容量与非补偿性门控；定义契约、证据记录、权限规则与五条不变量，并用临床、工业、司法失败探针示例说明。随后开展确定性失败注入研究（代理编码场景，280个构造案例，比较门控合取、纯分数规则与受限协议基线），并通过命题证明"当且仅当阈值不超过最小权重时精确一致"；另用18条手工追踪检查版本固定证据与审查转移，及24个前瞻性合成留出集由两名盲评LLM法官标注全部72次动作尝试。
AI.result: 在已发表权重与阈值下，分数规则放行了100个需阻断注入中的80个及全部40个需审查注入；事后调优后其在本语料上与合取一致。对正权重、正阈值、二值风险信号与零信号对照，精确一致的充要条件是阈值不超过最小权重。前瞻性留出集中，两名盲评法官对全部72次动作尝试标注一致，RAC与独立实现的完整状态化基线均与之匹配。
AI.conclusion: RAC可通过非补偿性门控防止聚合性能授权高风险动作。但研究仅基于合成案例测试机制，既未确立部署安全性，也未证明跨域有效性。

title: AIM: Agentic Idea Management for Automated Research
summary: Frontier LLMs are increasingly used to automate scientific research through iterative search. We distinguish idea-driven search from solution-driven search and identify three core challenges: organizing evolving research ideas, selecting promising directions, and maintaining alignment between ideas and their implementations. To address these challenges, we introduce the Agentic Idea Manager (AIM), a fully autonomous framework for managing and exploring research directions in idea-driven automated research. Inspired by Bayesian optimization, AIM uses an Agentic Surrogate and an Agentic Acquisition mechanism to organize discovered ideas and guide their selection. A Solution Auditor maintains idea-solution integrity, while a Resource Planner adaptively allocates the remaining experimental budget across parallel search branches. Experiments on 10 AutoLab benchmark tasks show that AIM surpasses the strongest baseline by 1.6 percentage points on System Optimization tasks and 4.9 percentage points on long-horizon Model Development & CUDA tasks. Notably, AIM reaches the best baseline performance up to 3.1x faster in wall-clock time. We further provide a theoretical analysis of when searching over ideas becomes beneficial. Our analysis shows that explicit idea-level allocation makes semantic coverage directly controllable, and that broader coverage becomes increasingly valuable when competitive research directions are sparse among many plausible alternatives. Project Page: https://imhgchoi.github.io/agentic-idea-manager/

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIM（Agentic Idea Manager），一个面向"想法驱动型"自动化科研的全自主框架，利用类贝叶斯优化机制管理并探索研究方向，在AutoLab基准上超越最强基线并显著提速。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型日益用于通过迭代搜索自动化科研。作者区分"想法驱动型"与"解法驱动型"搜索，并指出三大核心挑战：组织不断演进的研究想法、筛选有前景的方向、维持想法与实现之间的对齐。现有方法缺乏对这些挑战的系统性处理。
AI.method: 受贝叶斯优化启发，AIM包含四个组件：1）Agentic Surrogate与Agentic Acquisition机制，用于组织已发现的想法并指导其选择；2）Solution Auditor，维护想法-解法的一致性；3）Resource Planner，自适应地在并行搜索分支间分配剩余实验预算。
AI.result: 在10个AutoLab基准任务上，AIM在System Optimization任务上超过最强基线1.6个百分点，在长horizon的Model Development & CUDA任务上超过4.9个百分点；在墙钟时间上，AIM以最高3.1倍的加速达到最佳基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 作者进一步给出理论分析，说明何时"在想法层面搜索"是有益的：显式的想法级资源分配使语义覆盖度可直接控制，且当众多看似合理的候选方向中真正有竞争力的方向较为稀疏时，更广的覆盖度价值更大。

title: Component-Aware Feedback for Self-Evolving Programs
summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search can discover complex programs, but existing methods mostly only save candidate programs and fitness scores while discarding which component edits produced which fitness metric changes. Existing methods force the mutator LLM to infer the effect of prior edits from cluttered histories, making program search slow and unstable. This is especially true for locally servable LLMs to evolve multi-component systems. We introduce component-aware feedback, which compares each evaluated program with its parent, identifies the components that changed, and logs them with the associated metric differences into an attribution memory that later mutations read. The memory keeps each change in two reference frames, local against the parent it came from and global against the seed program, which shows both the immediate effect of a change and the cumulative progress made since the seed. We study this on LLM reranking, a multi-objective optimization problem where a multi-stage pipeline must balance quality against serving cost. Across twelve \textsc{Bright} datasets, our method reaches the strongest baseline's final quality after a median of one third of the search budget and ends 7.2\% higher in held-out nDCG@10, and under a cost-aware objective it finds pipelines that are on average more accurate while using 11\% fewer tokens per query, showing component-aware feedback to be a promising direction for more efficient self-evolving systems.

AI.tldr: 提出"组件感知反馈"机制：通过将评估程序与父代对比，识别发生变化的组件并将对应的指标差异记录到归因记忆中，供后续变异读取。该记忆以局部（相对父代）和全局（相对种子）两种参照系保存变化，从而揭示单个编辑的即时效果与自种子以来的累积进展。在LLM重排序（质量与成本的多目标优化）任务上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM引导的进化搜索虽能发现复杂程序，但只保存候选程序与适应度分数，丢弃了"哪一组件编辑导致了哪一指标变化"的信息。这迫使变异LLM从杂乱的历史中推断先前编辑的效果，导致程序搜索缓慢且不稳定，对本地可部署的LLM进化多组件系统尤为明显。
AI.method: 1) 组件感知反馈：将每个被评估程序与其父代比较，识别发生变化的组件，并将这些变化连同相关的指标差异记录进归因记忆；2) 后续变异操作读取该记忆；3) 记忆以双参照系保存每个变化——相对其父代的局部参照，以及相对种子程序的全局参照，从而同时呈现变化的即时效果与自种子以来的累积进展。
AI.result: 在十二个BRIGHT数据集上：所提方法在搜索预算中位数仅为三分之一时即达到最强基线的最终质量，并在留出集nDCG@10上高出7.2%；在成本感知目标下，找到的流水线平均更准确，同时每查询减少11%的token消耗。
AI.conclusion: 组件感知反馈是构建更高效自进化系统的有前景方向，能够显著提升搜索效率与最终性能，并在多目标（质量-成本）场景下实现更优的权衡。

title: LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression
summary: Verified proof edits offer a natural source of supervision for improving language-model-generated Lean proofs. Yet verification establishes that an edit is correct, not that its training signal is free of search artifacts. We introduce LeanPolish, a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases 33,402 accepted local edits and 65,596 same-state failed attempts, and use it to study what models learn from this supervision. First-success search admits a goal-independent rule with perfect ranking accuracy; teacher-selected evaluation sites also reward trivial deletions. Continuing menu evaluation beyond the first success removes the ordering shortcut: a trained ranker selects the best candidate on 70.1% of evaluated held-out states, versus 36.9% for the strongest frozen baseline. For compression, iterating the symbolic pass raises miniF2F savings from 19.7% to 27.5%, exceeding the neural hybrids we test there. Verified neural editing helps on other proof sources, but matched frozen-model controls show that its gains need not come from training. The supervision does improve whole-proof rewriting: fine-tuning raises verified token reduction from 2.8% to 5.5% on 19 PutnamBench proofs. Together, the released edits, complete candidate pools, and controlled evaluations separate learning to imitate a search policy from improving on that search. They provide a reproducible basis for studying proof improvement while keeping correctness, compression, and edit policy distinct.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LeanPolish——一个符号化 Lean 4 编辑流水线，发布 33,402 条被接受局部编辑与 65,596 条同状态失败尝试，并据此研究模型从"已验证编辑"监督中究竟学到了什么。
AI.motivation: 已验证的证明编辑可为语言模型生成 Lean 证明提供天然监督信号，但"验证通过"只说明编辑正确，并不保证训练信号不含搜索伪影（search artifacts），因此需厘清模型是在模仿搜索策略还是真正改进搜索。
AI.method: 构建符号化 Lean 4 流水线 LeanPolish，收集被接受编辑与同状态失败尝试；分析首成功搜索（first-success search）中的目标无关排序捷径与平凡删除问题，通过将菜单评估延续到首次成功之后来消除该捷径；训练排序器，并以冻结模型为基线对照；对压缩任务迭代符号化处理，并与神经混合方法比较，同时设置匹配的冻结模型控制组。
AI.result: 首成功搜索存在完美排序准确率的目标无关规则，教师选择的评估位点会奖励平凡删除；延续菜单评估后，训练排序器在 70.1% 的留出状态上选出最优候选，最强冻结基线为 36.9%；压缩任务中迭代符号化处理使 miniF2F 节省率从 19.7% 提升至 27.5%，超过所测神经混合方法；神经编辑在其他证明来源上有效，但匹配冻结模型对照表明其收益并非来自训练；整证明重写在 PutnamBench 的 19 个证明上把验证 token 缩减率从 2.8% 提升到 5.5%。
AI.conclusion: 所发布的编辑数据、完整候选池与受控评估将"模仿搜索策略"与"改进搜索"区分开来，为在保持正确性、压缩率与编辑策略相互独立的前提下研究证明改进提供可复现的基础。

title: Reach Into The CHOIR: Free-List Elicitation Uncovers Distinct Model Voices in LLM Ensembles
comment: 23 pages, 6 figures. Published in the Proceedings of the Third Conference on Language Modeling (COLM 2026)
summary: Open-ended LLM homogeneity can create false plurality when several systems appear to offer independent perspectives while returning the same familiar default. Single-pass answers obscure the distinction between agreement produced by a tightly constrained answer space, prompt-vocabulary echo, and broader answer spaces with stable alternatives beneath the surface. We introduce CHOIR (Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses), a framework that adapts free-list elicitation from cognitive anthropology to LLM ensembles.
