CHOIR repeatedly elicits ranked lists, clusters items into prompt-level concepts, and measures concept salience across models, prompt variants, and persona conditions. We evaluate CHOIR on Infinity-Chat 100, an external prompt bank from recent work on open-ended model homogeneity, and on a 27-question targeted diagnostic bank designed to isolate mechanism-level contrasts. On Infinity-Chat 100, CHOIR reproduces high surface agreement (93/100 prompts above chance) while separating narrow prompts from broad prompts with recoverable depth. Across targeted probes and the external prompt bank, base-model identity remains the strongest recoverable signature, and persona prompts shift surfaced concepts within base-model signatures. A source-blind ranking module prioritises rare-but-stable candidates for later inspection. CHOIR turns open-ended homogeneity into a diagnostic measurement problem by asking where models converge, why they converge, and what remains reachable under structured depth probing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CHOIR 框架，将认知人类学的自由列举法引入 LLM 集成评测，通过重复采集排序列表、聚类为提示级概念并测量概念显著性，把开放式同质化问题转化为可诊断的测量问题。
AI.motivation: 开放式 LLM 同质化会造成"虚假多元性"：多个系统看似提供独立视角，实则返回相同的默认答案。单轮回答无法区分三种情况——答案空间被严格约束导致的共识、提示词词汇回声、以及表层之下仍存在稳定备选的宽广答案空间。因此需要一种能刻画模型收敛位置、收敛原因及结构化深度探测下仍可达内容的方法。
AI.method: CHOIR（Collective Hierarchically-Ordered Inquiry Responses）将认知人类学的自由列举法适配到 LLM 集成：反复诱导模型生成排序列表，将条目聚类为提示级概念，并跨模型、提示变体与人格条件测量概念显著性。评测使用两个数据集：来自近期开放式同质化研究的外部提示库 Infinity-Chat 100，以及为隔离机制层面差异而设计的 27 题针对性诊断题库；此外还包含一个盲源排序模块，用于优先筛选稀有但稳定的候选。
AI.result: 在 Infinity-Chat 100 上，CHOIR 复现了高表层一致性（100 个提示中有 93 个高于随机水平），同时将狭窄提示与具有可恢复深度的宽广提示区分开。在针对性探针与外部提示库中，基础模型身份始终是最强的可恢复签名，人格提示则在基础模型签名内部改变表层概念。盲源排序模块能优先选出稀有但稳定的候选以供后续检查。
AI.conclusion: CHOIR 将开放式同质化转化为一个诊断性测量问题，回答模型在哪里收敛、为何收敛、以及在结构化深度探测下哪些内容仍然可达。

title: Learning to Route in Visual Space via Multi-Step Embedding Retrieval
summary: LLM agents rely on retrieval tools to access external knowledge, yet visual agentic search remains severely bottlenecked by standard single-step retrievers. In current pipelines, the agent must issue text queries for every intermediate step, struggling when visual clues are difficult to describe or when the retriever fails to surface necessary intermediate evidence within its top results. We hypothesize that offloading multi-step navigation across the entire embedding space directly to the retrieval tool resolves this performance bottleneck. To study this systematically, we introduce VHOP, a flexible data generation framework and benchmark with five core difficulty levels testing both visual matching and search planning. Using this framework, we develop VHOP-Router, an end-to-end training pipeline---combining supervised fine-tuning, online imitation learning, and reinforcement learning---that transforms a standard embedding model into an autoregressive multi-step retriever. Operating directly in the visual latent space, VHOP-Router retrieves linked image chains in a single tool call without requiring the agent to formulate intermediate text queries. Experiments show VHOP-Router boosts retrieval performance from under 5\% to 76.3\%. In agentic search, it improves task success rates by 52.7\% and reduces the average token length by 61\% from 1886 to 728, whereas upgrading the agent yields only a 3.7\% gain. Compared to a strong baseline where the agent retrieves the top 50 results per step, VHOP-Router maintains superior performance while reducing in-context images by $23\times$ and cutting the cumulative API payload by $35\times$. The models also generalize robustly to unseen difficulty levels and realistic test sets. Ultimately, VHOP and VHOP-Router provide an efficient and effective solution for visual agentic search that leaves native LLM capabilities entirely intact.

AI.tldr: 提出 VHOP 数据生成框架与基准，以及 VHOP-Router 端到端训练管线，将标准嵌入模型转化为在视觉潜空间中自回归多步检索的工具，显著提升视觉智能体搜索效率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉智能体搜索受限于单步检索器：智能体需为每一步中间过程单独发出文本查询，当视觉线索难以用文字描述，或检索器无法在 top 结果中呈现必要的中间证据时，性能成为严重瓶颈。作者假设把跨整个嵌入空间的多步导航直接下放给检索工具，可突破该瓶颈。
AI.method: 1) 提出 VHOP：灵活的数据生成框架与基准，包含五个核心难度等级，同时考察视觉匹配与搜索规划；2) 基于该框架开发 VHOP-Router：端到端训练管线，融合监督微调、在线模仿学习与强化学习，将标准嵌入模型改造为自回归多步检索器；3) 该检索器直接在视觉潜空间中运行，单次工具调用即可检索出关联图像链，无需智能体构造中间文本查询。
AI.result: 检索性能从不足 5% 提升至 76.3%。在智能体搜索中，任务成功率提升 52.7%，平均 token 长度由 1886 降至 728（减少 61%），而单纯升级智能体仅带来 3.7% 增益。相比每步检索 top 50 的强基线，VHOP-Router 在保持更优性能的同时将上下文图像减少 23 倍、累计 API 载荷削减 35 倍；并对未见难度等级与真实测试集具备稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: VHOP 与 VHOP-Router 为视觉智能体搜索提供了高效且有效的解决方案，且完全不影响原生 LLM 能力。

title: Which Tasks Survive Self-Supervised Learning?
summary: Same-instance self-supervised learning (SSL) learns representations by enforcing consistency across two views of the same underlying instance. This principle alone, however, does not determine which downstream tasks remain recoverable from the learned representation. We study this question through \emph{semantic recoverability}, defined as the amount of a task's posterior score captured by the represented function space. We show that, for centered and whitened representations, recoverability exactly determines directional class-distance-normalized variance (CDNV), controls few-shot nearest-centroid classification, and governs the strength of task-relevant semantic directions. The population linear probe and centroid axis coincide, and multiple well-recovered tasks approach a factorial centroid geometry. We then analyze a canonical two-view SSL objective and show that its population optimum spans the leading cross-view-stable modes of the associated two-view operator. This yields a closed-form spectral characterization of semantic recoverability: a downstream task is preserved to the extent that its posterior lies in the selected spectral subspace. We validate these predictions on synthetic and real datasets across several SSL methods, testing the predicted relationships among recoverability, directional geometry, spectral structure, and few-shot transfer. Together, these results give a task-level account of what information survives same-instance SSL and how the retained information appears in downstream geometry and transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"语义可恢复性"（semantic recoverability）框架，用以刻画同实例自监督学习（SSL）表示中哪些下游任务信息得以保留，并给出其谱刻画与几何、迁移预测。
AI.motivation: 同实例SSL仅通过强制同一实例两个视图的一致性来学习表示，但这一原则本身并不能决定哪些下游任务可从表示中恢复。作者希望从任务层面解释SSL究竟保留了什么信息。
AI.method: 定义语义可恢复性为任务后验分数被表示函数空间捕捉的比例；在中心化、白化表示下推导其与方向类距离归一化方差（CDNV）、少样本最近质心分类、任务相关语义方向强度的关系；分析典型两视图SSL目标，证明其总体最优解张成两视图算子的领先跨视图稳定模态，从而给出可恢复性的闭式谱刻画。
AI.result: 证明可恢复性精确决定方向CDNV、控制少样本最近质心分类、支配任务相关语义方向强度；总体线性探针与质心轴重合，多个良好恢复任务趋近因子化质心几何；下游任务被保留的程度取决于其后验是否落在所选谱子空间内；并在合成与真实数据集、多种SSL方法上验证了可恢复性、方向几何、谱结构与少样本迁移之间的预测关系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了同实例SSL中信息存活的任务级解释，并说明所保留信息如何体现在下游几何与迁移中。

title: PrivMeSA: Privacy-Aware Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for Medicine via Local-Remote LLM Collaboration
summary: Clinical large language model (LLM) agents deployed locally can consult more capable remote models, but doing so risks exposing patient information. Privacy-conscious delegation places disclosure decisions with a local agent, yet removing explicit identifiers is insufficient: quasi-identifiers can accumulate across multi-turn consultations and repeated patient visits to enable re-identification. We introduce PrivMeSA, a privacy-aware self-evolving multi-agent system that learns to control disclosure and retains remote expertise for local reuse. A local agent manages each encounter and consults remote specialists that may request additional information. Reinforcement learning balances task accuracy against direct disclosure and registry-based re-identification risk, with privacy evaluated over the complete outbound transcript of each encounter. A local lesson memory distills completed consultations into generalized clinical guidance and retrieves relevant lessons before transmission, allowing subsequent cases to reuse expertise without another remote exchange. Memory grows without additional outcome labels or parameter updates. On an emergency-department benchmark built from MIMIC-IV-ED records, PrivMeSA improves mean task accuracy over delegation by up to 15.8 percentage points. In the same setting, PrivMeSA reduces the disclosure of personal details from 98.0% to 0.2% of cases and the share of cases in which the patient can be narrowed to ten or fewer registry patients from 74% to 0%.

AI.tldr: 提出PrivMeSA——一种隐私感知的自演化多智能体系统，通过学习控制信息披露并以本地经验复用远程专家知识，在急诊分诊基准上同时提升任务准确率并大幅降低再识别风险。
AI.motivation: 本地部署的临床LLM智能体可向更强的远程模型咨询，但存在患者信息泄露风险。将披露决策交给本地智能体仍不足够，因为准标识符会在多轮咨询和重复就诊中累积，导致再识别。因此需要一种既能保留远程专业能力、又能控制整段外发对话披露的机制。
AI.method: PrivMeSA由本地智能体管理每次就诊，并按需向远程专家咨询，远程专家可请求补充信息。采用强化学习在任务准确率、直接披露风险与基于注册库的再识别风险之间权衡，隐私评估覆盖每次就诊完整的外发记录。设置本地经验记忆，将已完成咨询蒸馏为泛化临床指导，并在传输前检索相关经验，使后续病例无需再次远程交换即可复用专业知识；记忆增长无需额外结果标签或参数更新。
AI.result: 在基于MIMIC-IV-ED构建的急诊科基准上，PrivMeSA相比普通委托基线任务准确率最高提升15.8个百分点；个人细节披露比例由98.0%降至0.2%，可将患者缩小到注册库中十人或以下的病例占比由74%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将披露控制与经验复用相结合的隐私感知多智能体框架，能够在显著降低直接披露与再识别风险的同时，提升临床任务表现，并避免反复远程交互带来的隐私累积风险。

title: Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning for Image-Based Continuous Control with Gaussian and Beta Policies
summary: Purpose: Behavior cloning can accumulate errors when a learned controller visits states outside the demonstrated distribution. This study evaluates whether Disagreement-Regularized Imitation Learning (DRIL), which converts disagreement among cloned policies into a reinforcement-learning reward, improves image-based continuous control. Methods: A controlled CarRacing study combines Gaussian and Beta learner policies, demonstrations from either a clipped Gaussian expert or an intrinsically bounded Beta expert, one or 20 trajectories, deterministic and stochastic evaluation, and three retained stages: behavior cloning, the highest 10-episode training-score checkpoint, and the final DRIL checkpoint. The disagreement ensemble contains five Gaussian policies in every variant. Each retained policy is evaluated over 100 procedurally generated episodes. Results: Score-selected DRIL produced its largest gains in the few-demonstration setting, improving over the strongest behavior-cloning mean by 61% with clipped-action demonstrations and by 112% with bounded-action demonstrations. With 20 trajectories, the advantage of DRIL narrowed; in the bounded-action regime, Beta behavior cloning remained about 7% above the best DRIL checkpoint. The experiments also show that the informativeness of the disagreement reward changes with the learner representation and training stage. Conclusion: DRIL can substantially improve few-demonstration visual continuous control, while bounded Beta policies provide strong behavior-cloning performance when more demonstrations are available. The results highlight the joint importance of learner support,ensemble response, and checkpoint selection.

AI.tldr: 本文通过 CarRacing 图像连续控制实验评估 DRIL 在少样本模仿学习中的效果。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆在控制器进入示范分布之外的状态时会累积误差，研究希望检验将克隆策略间分歧转化为强化学习奖励的 DRIL 是否能改善基于图像的连续控制。
AI.method: 采用受控 CarRacing 实验，结合高斯与 Beta 学习器策略、来自裁剪高斯专家或内在有界 Beta 专家的示范、1 或 20 条轨迹、确定性与随机性评估，并保留三个阶段：行为克隆、最高 10 回合训练得分检查点、最终 DRIL 检查点；分歧集成始终包含五个高斯策略，每个保留策略在 100 个程序生成回合上评估。
AI.result: 按得分选择的 DRIL 在少示范设置中收益最大：相比最强行为克隆均值，裁剪动作示范提升 61%，有界动作示范提升 112%。20 条轨迹时 DRIL 优势收窄；在有界动作条件下，Beta 行为克隆仍比最佳 DRIL 检查点高约 7%。实验还显示分歧奖励的信息量随学习器表示与训练阶段变化。
AI.conclusion: DRIL 能显著改善少示范视觉连续控制，而有界 Beta 策略在更多示范时提供强行为克隆表现；结果突出学习器支撑、集成响应与检查点选择的联合重要性。

title: NAQD Env: A benchmark for selective withdrawal in language agents
comment: 16 pages. Code and evaluation artifacts: https://github.com/abouzamm/naqd
summary: Language agents must revise planned actions when evidence changes, permission is revoked, or a stop instruction arrives. A useful response is selective: suspend affected actions, preserve unaffected work, and resume only after sufficient repair. We introduce NAQD-Env, a synthetic environment that evaluates these decisions against a deterministic reference policy over explicit evidence, authorization, and constraint dependencies. Eleven dependency families support evaluation on development structures, held-out families, and held-out combinations of structures. Metrics distinguish attempted violations from violations permitted by a simulated execution gate and jointly report policy agreement, task value, withdrawal, resumption, and event reporting. We evaluate three open-weight instruction-tuned models from two families under three prompt conditions on 350 frozen scenarios, yielding 3,150 model-prompt episodes before gate replay. Across the reported conditions, withdrawal recall is at most 0.06, no valid resumption is observed at eligible opportunities, and only one episode matches the complete reference policy. Under the NAQD prompt, Qwen2.5-7B has fewer unsafe-attempt episodes than Qwen2.5-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, but also completes less useful work and preserves unaffected actions less accurately. Exploratory supervised fine-tuning probes increase Qwen2.5-3B decision accuracy from 0.45-0.54 to 0.83-0.92; separate diagnostics reveal inappropriate withdrawal after curriculum omissions and a loss of event reporting. These results motivate evaluating selective withdrawal as a distinct component of agent reliability. The setting measures policy application with trusted structured inputs and does not establish real-world containment or source-verification ability.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NAQD-Env合成环境，用确定性参考策略评估语言智能体在证据变化、权限撤销或停止指令下的"选择性撤回"能力，发现现有开源模型撤回召回率极低、几乎无有效恢复，唯有针对性微调可显著提升决策准确率但伴随副作用。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在证据变化、权限被撤销或收到停止指令时，必须修正已规划的行动。理想的响应应是"选择性"的：中止受影响动作、保留不受影响的工作、仅在充分修复后再恢复。然而现有评测缺乏对这种选择性撤回决策的系统化衡量手段，因此需要专门的环境与指标来检验智能体是否能正确应用显式依赖关系下的策略。
AI.method: 作者构建了NAQD-Env合成环境，基于显式的证据、授权与约束依赖关系，用一个确定性参考策略作为评判基准；设计了11个依赖家族，支持在开发结构、留出家族和留出结构组合上进行评估。指标区分"尝试违规"与"经模拟执行门允许的违规"，并联合报告策略一致性、任务价值、撤回、恢复与事件报告等维度。实验评估了两个家族共三个开源指令微调模型，在三种提示条件下运行350个冻结场景，得到3,150个模型-提示回合（执行门重放前）。另外进行了探索性的监督微调（SFT）探针以及单独的行为诊断。
AI.result: 在所有报告条件下，撤回召回率最高仅为0.06，在符合条件的时机未观察到任何有效恢复，仅有一个回合完全匹配参考策略。在NAQD提示下，Qwen2.5-7B的不安全尝试回合数少于Qwen2.5-3B和Llama-3.1-8B，但其完成的有用工作量更少、对不受影响动作的保留也更不准确。探索性SFT将Qwen2.5-3B的决策准确率从0.45-0.54提升到0.83-0.92；但单独诊断显示出现"课程遗漏后不当撤回"以及事件报告能力丧失的问题。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果说明应将"选择性撤回"作为智能体可靠性的一个独立组成部分加以评估。需要指出的是，该设定是在可信结构化输入下衡量策略应用能力，并不能证明真实世界中的遏制能力或来源验证能力。

title: Synthesis Without Training: An Inference-Only Pipeline for Tabular, Temporal, and Relational Synthetic Data
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 workshop: Beyond Private Training: The New Landscape of AI Privacy
summary: Synthetic data generation is dominated by the fit-then-sample paradigm: a generative model is trained on a private dataset and then sampled from. Despite its widespread adoption, this paradigm faces three challenges: (1) a new training run is required for every dataset; (2) different data modalities, such as single tables, time series, and relational databases, require task-specific models and feature engineering; and (3) the resulting model is opaque, making its behavior under data constraints difficult to inspect. We propose GENSCRIPT, an inference-only pipeline that eliminates model training. GENSCRIPT computes a deterministic statistical profile of the source data (column types, ranges, missingness, categories, correlations, etc.) and passes it--rather than raw rows--to a language model to infer field semantics and cross-column integrity constraints. A coding agent then compiles the profile and constraints into an executable, auditable sampler. This unified approach supports single-table, temporal, and relational data without task-specific modeling. Across four single-table benchmarks, GENSCRIPT builds generators in 2 minutes and samples 50k rows within 6 seconds, while remaining within a few points of leading methods in marginal fidelity. Notably, it is the only method that perfectly preserves a 1-to-1 mapping between columns in the Adult dataset. On a smart-building dataset, it produces conditional time series that more closely match the real distribution than two baselines and perfectly preserves primary- and foreign-key relationships in the corresponding relational database.

AI.tldr: 提出无需训练、仅推理的合成数据生成流程 GENSCRIPT：基于确定性统计画像与语言模型推断约束，再由编码智能体编译为可执行采样器，统一支持单表、时序与关系数据。
AI.motivation: 现有合成数据生成以“先拟合后采样”为主流范式，但存在三大挑战：(1) 每换一个数据集都需重新训练；(2) 不同数据模态（单表、时序、关系数据库）需要任务专用模型与特征工程；(3) 模型不透明，难以在数据约束下检查其行为。
AI.method: GENSCRIPT 取消模型训练：先对源数据计算确定性统计画像（列类型、取值范围、缺失率、类别、相关性等），将该画像而非原始行输入语言模型，用于推断字段语义与跨列完整性约束；随后由编码智能体把画像与约束编译成可执行、可审计的采样器。
AI.result: 在四个单表基准上，2 分钟即可构建生成器、6 秒内采样 5 万行，边缘保真度与领先方法相差仅几个百分点，且是唯一在 Adult 数据集上完美保持列间 1 对 1 映射的方法；在智能建筑数据集上，其条件时序比两个基线更接近真实分布，并在相应关系数据库中完美保持主键与外键关系。
AI.conclusion: GENSCRIPT 证明无需训练、以画像与约束驱动的推理式流程可统一处理多种模态，在效率、可审计性与约束保真度上具备竞争力。

title: VAmoS Part Deux: Harder, More Realistic Voice-Agent Simulation
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables. Agent implementations: https://github.com/veris-ai/rory-agent
summary: Voice agents in production must handle several requests, background speech, and customers who lose patience. We introduce VAmoS Energy, a benchmark that combines these challenges in 100 calls about utility billing and payment assistance. Each caller makes two to four requests. The agent has sixteen tools backed by a stateful Stripe billing twin and the Apache Fineract loan engine, with account access blocked until caller verification succeeds. The tasks use public household electricity data and a policy based on Pennsylvania's residential billing rules. An LLM-as-a-verifier checks the agent's actions and spoken figures against explicit requirements. On a calibration run, it agrees with a code verifier on 99.1% of checks. Across fourteen voice stacks and three repeats per task, completion ranges from 17.3% to 44.7%. Grok Voice leads, and Gemini 3.8 Live and GPT-Live follow at about the same cost per call. Background television reduces pooled completion from 38.7% to 8.6%. The simulated caller often accepts an incorrect result because it hears the agent's words but cannot inspect its actions. These findings show why voice agents need evaluation across the whole call, including what they say, what they change, and how they handle competing speech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VAmoS Energy基准，将多请求、背景语音与用户耐心流失等挑战整合进100通公用事业账单与支付协助通话中，用于端到端评估语音代理的言语、操作与竞争语音处理能力。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的语音代理需同时应对多请求、背景人声和失去耐心的客户，但现有评测往往只覆盖单一维度，无法反映真实通话中"说了什么、改了什么、如何应对竞争语音"的综合表现，因此需要端到端基准。
AI.method: 构建VAmoS Energy基准：100通关于公用事业账单与支付协助的通话，每位来电者提出2–4项请求；代理配备16个工具，后端为有状态的Stripe账单孪生系统与Apache Fineract贷款引擎，账户访问须先通过来电者身份验证；任务基于公开家庭用电数据和宾夕法尼亚州住宅账单规则的政策；采用LLM-as-a-verifier对照明确需求核验代理动作与口头金额，并用代码验证器作校准。
AI.result: 校准运行中，LLM验证器与代码验证器在99.1%的检查项上一致；在14个语音栈、每任务3次重复下，完成率介于17.3%–44.7%，Grok Voice领先，Gemini 3.8 Live与GPT-Live紧随且单次通话成本相近；背景电视使汇总完成率从38.7%降至8.6%；模拟来电者常因只听到代理话语、无法检查其操作而接受错误结果。
AI.conclusion: 语音代理评估必须覆盖整通通话，包括其所说内容、所执行的操作以及应对竞争语音的能力，单看语音质量或最终答复不足以发现上述失败模式。

title: Graph Anomaly Detection as Finite-Horizon Control: Training-Free Scoring via Empirical Bayes
summary: Node-level graph anomaly detection (GAD) identifies nodes whose attributes and interactions deviate from dominant graph regularities. Existing GAD models encode normality and anomaly scoring indirectly through architectures, message passing, reconstruction or contrastive objectives, and tuned score families. This entangles graph trust (how strongly graph structure should define normality), graph-spectral weighting, and anomaly-score choice, yielding scores that are costly, opaque, and unstable across graph regimes. We propose EB-GAD (Empirical-Bayes GAD), a training-free framework that models normality as graph-aware generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (GOU) relaxation toward a graph-filtered template. Empirical Bayes fits the graph precision from the residual-field likelihood; the GOU then turns scoring into a closed-form finite-horizon control energy, the minimum effort to steer a feature-neutral node to its observed endpoint along graph-spectral relaxation. Sweeping relaxation horizon and endpoint tolerance yields a bank of scores that share one fitted prior: equilibrium Mahalanobis scoring is one limit, while finite-horizon control-energy and scale-normalized ratio scores reveal anomalies that static equilibrium scoring can mask. A label-free selector chooses the score family from feature homophily, edge density, and feature dimension, then ranks candidates by fitted-null deviation and rank stability. On 11 benchmarks and without labels at any step, EB-GAD has the best or tied-best AUROC on 9: the four financial fraud networks (up to 3.7M nodes), the YelpChi and Amazon review graphs, Weibo, Reddit and Facebook, with margins of up to 21.7 points. It is second on BlogCatalog and ACM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EB-GAD，一种无需训练的节点级图异常检测框架，将正常性建模为图感知广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck(GOU)松弛，通过经验贝叶斯拟合图精度，并将异常打分转化为闭式有限时域控制能量，实现免标签、可解释、跨图机制稳定的异常检测。
AI.motivation: 现有图异常检测(GAD)模型通过架构、消息传递、重构或对比目标以及调优的分数族间接编码正常性与异常分数，导致图信任(graph trust)、图谱加权与异常分数选择相互纠缠，产生代价高、不透明且在不同图机制下不稳定的分数。
AI.method: 提出EB-GAD：无需训练，将正常性建模为面向图滤波模板的图感知广义Ornstein-Uhlenbeck(GOU)松弛。用经验贝叶斯由残差场似然拟合图精度；GOU把打分转化为闭式有限时域控制能量（即沿图谱松弛将一个特征中性节点引导至观测终点的最小代价）。扫掠松弛时域与终点容差得到共享同一拟合先验的分数族：平衡态Mahalanobis打分为其一个极限，有限时域控制能量与尺度归一化比值分数可揭示静态平衡打分掩盖的异常。采用无标签选择器，依据特征同质性、边密度和特征维度选择分数族，再按拟合零假设偏差与排名稳定性对候选排序。
AI.result: 在11个基准上且全程不使用标签，EB-GAD在9个数据集上取得最佳或并列最佳AUROC：四个金融欺诈网络（最多370万节点）、YelpChi与Amazon评论图、Weibo、Reddit和Facebook，最大领先幅度达21.7个百分点；在BlogCatalog和ACM上位列第二。
AI.conclusion: EB-GAD通过将正常性建模为图感知GOU松弛并以经验贝叶斯拟合先验、以控制能量闭式打分，将图信任、谱加权与分数选择统一到单一先验下的分数族中，实现了免训练、免标签、可解释且跨图机制稳定的节点级图异常检测，在多数基准上达到领先性能。

title: Demographic Pluralism: Inference-Time Modeling of Pluralistic Human Preference Distributions
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in culturally sensitive settings, where alignment requires representing diverse preferences within populations. Yet existing methods model populations at coarse demographic or community levels and overlook within-group variation. We introduce Demographic Pluralism, an inference-time framework that estimates population-level opinion distributions without opinion-distribution training data or task-specific fine-tuning by generating multiple perspectives within demographically grounded groups. Across four backbones on GlobalOpinionQA and VITAL, it reduces Jensen-Shannon distance by 8.4%-26.4% over Modular Pluralism. Among weighted, equal-weighted, and inverse-weighted aggregation, equal weighting performs best overall; group-level error also increases with group weight, helping explain weighted aggregation's weaker performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Demographic Pluralism 推理期框架，无需观点分布训练数据或任务微调，通过在人口统计群体内生成多视角来估计人口级观点分布，在四个基座模型上优于 Modular Pluralism。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 文化对齐方法在粗粒度人口统计或社区层面建模群体，忽视群体内部差异，难以准确表征多样偏好。
AI.method: Demographic Pluralism：推理期框架，在人口统计基础上分组的群体内部生成多种观点视角，从而估计人口级观点分布；无需观点分布训练数据，也无需任务特定微调。同时比较加权、等权与逆加权聚合策略。
AI.result: 在 GlobalOpinionQA 与 VITAL 上，使用四个基座模型，相较 Modular Pluralism 将 Jensen-Shannon 距离降低 8.4%–26.4%；等权聚合总体最优；组级误差随组权重增加而上升，解释了加权聚合表现较弱的原因。
AI.conclusion: 群体内部视角多样性对人口级观点分布估计至关重要；等权聚合优于加权与逆加权；组权重与组级误差的关联是加权方法性能受限的关键因素。

title: What Pretraining and Midtraining Make Learnable from Rewards?
summary: A reward can identify a correct answer while leaving the computation needed for new inputs undetermined. We study how pretraining and midtraining supply the information and computation that make reward adaptation effective. In sequential state computation and contextual memory, we characterize mechanisms that agree on every training reward yet demand different held-out answers. Task-independent source observations resolve this ambiguity. We construct finite sampled Adam paths from specified random initializations through source prediction and reward adaptation in the same parameters, proving how prediction acquires execution or retrieval and rewards learn their task-specific use. Experiments with pretrained Qwen2.5 checkpoints test this division of labor. Across eight worlds, Sequential models trained with correct source and first-operation supervision reach 82.61% success, versus 44.15% for a private-random source control. Memory replay preserves retrieval during reward adaptation, and an independent eight-world confirmation achieves 75.32% task success versus 49.86% after matched alternative-retrieval training. GSM8K and HotpotQA separate accuracy at reward entry, subsequent gain and final performance. Together, these results connect information acquisition, executable computation and reward-guided task learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨预训练与中间训练如何提供信息与计算，使奖励适配有效。作者在序列状态计算与上下文记忆两类任务中刻画了"训练奖励一致但泛化答案不同"的机制，并提出任务无关的源观测可消除歧义。实验基于Qwen2.5验证了预测获得执行/检索能力、奖励学习任务特定用法的分工。
AI.motivation: 奖励信号只能标示正确答案，却无法确定处理新输入所需的计算过程。因此需要理解预训练与中间训练如何为奖励适配提供必要的信息与可执行计算，以及何种监督能消除仅凭奖励无法区分的机制歧义。
AI.method: 在序列状态计算和上下文记忆两类设定中，刻画在所有训练奖励上一致却需要不同留出答案的机制，并用任务无关的源观测解决歧义。构造从指定随机初始化出发的有限采样Adam路径，使源预测与奖励适配共享同一参数，证明预测如何获得执行或检索能力、奖励如何学习任务特定用法。使用预训练Qwen2.5检查点进行实验，涉及八个world、源与首操作监督、私有随机源对照、记忆回放、替代检索训练对照，以及GSM8K、HotpotQA。
AI.result: 八个world中，使用正确源和首操作监督训练的Sequential模型成功率达82.61%，而私有随机源对照仅44.15%。记忆回放能在奖励适配中保持检索能力；独立八world确认实验达到75.32%任务成功率，匹配的替代检索训练后为49.86%。GSM8K与HotpotQA区分了奖励入口准确率、后续增益与最终表现。
AI.conclusion: 结果将信息获取、可执行计算与奖励引导的任务学习联系起来，表明正确源信息与执行/检索机制是奖励适配有效性的关键，任务无关源观测可消除奖励歧义。

title: Defining and Categorising Human-AI Interactions in Clinical Trials: A Multidimensional Human-AI Classification Approach
summary: This paper examines human-AI interactions (HAIIs) in clinical trials and presents a multidimensional categorisation framework that classifies interactions according to AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups. We define HAII, examine existing taxonomies and extend existing categorisation approaches through this novel multidimensional framework. We purposively sampled 15 clinical trials from a previously reported dataset. Each trial was independently categorised by two human reviewers and six large language model (LLM) classifiers. The proposed categorisation provides a structured method for the consistent identification, comparison and synthesis of human-AI interactions across clinical-trial records. The framework is intended to support more consistent comparison and synthesis of AI-related clinical trials and to make explicit the different forms of human involvement associated with AI interventions. The results demonstrate the potential for LLM-assisted categorisation while indicating the continuing importance of human judgement where trial records are incomplete or ambiguous. The principal contribution is a proposed multidimensional framework that brings together AI tasks, human-AI relationships, interaction configurations and interacting human groups within a single approach designed for clinical-trial records. Its significance lies in its potential to support more systematic identification, comparison and synthesis of how humans and AI interact in clinical trials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多维度分类框架，用于对临床试验中的人机交互（HAII）进行分类，并通过15项试验的双人评审与6个LLM分类器验证其可行性与LLM辅助分类的潜力。
AI.motivation: 临床试验中人与AI的交互形式多样，但缺乏统一、结构化的分类方式，导致跨试验记录的识别、比较与综合难以保持一致。
AI.method: 界定HAII概念，梳理既有分类法，并构建涵盖AI任务、人机关系、交互配置和交互人群四个维度的新框架；从既有数据集中目的性抽取15项临床试验，由两名人工评审和六个大语言模型分类器分别独立分类。
AI.result: 该框架为跨临床试验记录一致地识别、比较和综合人机交互提供了结构化方法；结果显示LLM辅助分类具有潜力，但在记录不完整或含糊时人工判断仍不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是面向临床试验记录、整合四个维度的多维度分类框架，其意义在于支持更系统地识别、比较与综合临床试验中人类与AI的交互方式。

title: An Input-Frugal Deep Learning Framework for Weather-Driven National Crop-Yield Forecasting: A Case Study of Brazilian Soybean
summary: Reliable, timely crop-yield forecasts are essential for market stability and risk management, yet many approaches rely on costly or hard-to-scale inputs. We present a frugal, transferable, and architecture-agnostic deep learning framework that uses routine weather as the only time-varying input plus two lightweight static context inputs (crop year and an agro-environmental label) to capture long-run change and regional heterogeneity, while supporting multiple sequence encoders under identical data requirements. Using a 20-season Brazilian soybean case study (2001/02-2020/21) with leave-one-year-out cross-validation, we benchmark MLP, CNN, LSTM, CNN-LSTM, a Transformer encoder and the Mamba state-space model against linear ridge regression and a five-year moving-average "farmer" baseline. All deep learning variants outperform ridge, and all sequential encoders surpass the non-sequential MLP. The Transformer achieves the best national accuracy (RMSE 149 kg ha^-1; rRMSE 5.3%; R^2 = 0.784), reducing error by 47.6% relative to the farmer baseline. In-season forecasts improve monotonically from early- to late-season issuance, reaching approximately 50% lower error than the baseline at the latest forecast point. Ablations indicate that the agro-environmental label and spatial instance expansion (multiple grid-node weather sequences per municipality-year) contribute positively without increasing input complexity. SHAP diagnostics suggest crop year explains most of the long-run trajectory, whereas within-season weather and agro-environmental context primarily drive interannual deviations, with moisture/cloud and thermal-demand variables dominating. Overall, the framework is straightforward to deploy across other crops and geographic regions and is naturally compatible with operational weather forecasts for routine monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出一种仅用常规气象数据（加两个轻量静态上下文输入）的节俭、可迁移、架构无关深度学习框架，用于作物产量预测，并以巴西大豆20季案例验证其优于岭回归和农户基线。
AI.motivation: 可靠的作物产量预报对市场稳定与风险管理至关重要，但现有方法多依赖成本高或难以规模化的输入数据，因此需要一种廉价、可规模化且易于迁移的预测方法。
AI.method: 以常规气象为唯一时变输入，辅以作物年份和农业环境标签两个轻量静态上下文输入以刻画长期变化与区域异质性；框架架构无关，支持多种序列编码器。基于巴西大豆2001/02–2020/21共20季数据，采用留一年交叉验证，对比MLP、CNN、LSTM、CNN-LSTM、Transformer编码器和Mamba状态空间模型与线性岭回归及五年移动平均"农户"基线，并进行消融实验与SHAP诊断。
AI.result: 所有深度学习变体均优于岭回归，所有序列编码器均优于非序列MLP。Transformer全国精度最佳（RMSE 149 kg/ha，rRMSE 5.3%，R²=0.784），较农户基线误差降低47.6%。季内预报精度从早期到后期单调改善，最新预报点误差较基线降低约50%。消融显示农业环境标签与空间实例扩展（每市-年多条格点气象序列）有正向贡献且不增加输入复杂度。SHAP表明作物年份主导长期趋势，季内气象与农业环境上下文主导年际偏差，湿度和云量及热需求变量作用最强。
AI.conclusion: 该框架数据需求低、部署简单，可自然对接业务化气象预报用于常规监测，并能便捷迁移至其他作物与地理区域。

title: Towards Model as a Library: Offline, Community-Sourced AI for Low-Resource African Languages
summary: Large language models are frequently proposed as a route to AI-powered services for African communities, but they are least reliable exactly where the need is greatest: all African languages remain low-resource by any standard measure, and models trained on scraped, standardised text systematically misrepresent the dialectal and regional variation of how people actually speak. We introduce \textbf{Model as a Library (MaaL)}, a software architecture that packages small, community-enrolled speech models as versioned on-device dependencies, enabling offline structured data collection that cannot generatively hallucinate, for populations that current language models serve worst. Rather than relying on web-scraped corpora, MaaL's vocabulary is enrolled directly from a small number of example recordings by the speakers themselves, at the point of deployment. We describe the architecture and its central mechanism - keyword spotting that turns a closed-vocabulary text form into a voice form, filled and submitted entirely on-device - and propose transpiling the closed-vocabulary elements already present in widely-deployed digital form tools into MaaL schemas, a low-friction path to voice-first, offline data collection for the low-literacy populations these tools already reach. This is a position and system-design paper: we describe the concept, the mechanism, and an analytical feasibility case, and identify what a working implementation still requires.

AI.tldr: 提出MaaL架构，将小型社区录入的语音模型打包为设备端依赖，实现离线、不可生成幻觉的结构化数据采集，服务低资源非洲语言人群。
AI.motivation: 非洲语言均为低资源，基于网络抓取的标准文本训练的模型系统性忽视方言与地区差异，而需求最大之处恰是LLM最不可靠之处。
AI.method: MaaL为软件架构：将小型、社区录入的语音模型作为可版本化的设备端依赖；词表由说话者在部署现场用少量示例录音直接录入；核心机制为关键词检测，把闭词表文本形式转为语音形式，全程在设备端填写与提交；并提出将已广泛部署的数字表单工具中的闭词表元素转译为MaaL模式。
AI.result: 无实验结果；提供概念、机制与分析性可行性论证，并指出可用实现仍所需的条件。
AI.conclusion: 这是一篇立场与系统设计论文，为低识字率人群提供语音优先、离线的数据采集低摩擦路径。

title: Grokking through the Lens of Minimum-Norm Interpolation
summary: Grokking shows that fitting the training data and learning the underlying signal can occur at very different stages. However, existing theories offer limited quantitative insight into how this delayed generalization depends on inductive bias and signal structure. Our work addresses the gap by developing a statistical theory that characterizes how regularization geometry and signal sparsity govern generalization near interpolation. In particular, we focus on the prototypical setting of high-dimensional regression and identify regimes in which sparsity-promoting regularization makes exact interpolation much more accurate than approximate fitting. In strongly overparameterized noiseless problems, we prove a zero--one generalization law and construct a family of convex norms whose interpolators transition from the trivial risk of the all-zero predictor to exact recovery, while keeping the training error equal to $0$. Furthermore, when feature dimension and sample size are proportional, we provide a precise characterization of training and generalization errors along $\ell_r$-regularization paths. This in turn allows us to quantify the generalization gain that remains near interpolation: we show that this gain increases as the norm becomes more sparsity-promoting and as the target becomes sparser, with a sharp drop in generalization reached for noiseless data and $\ell_1$ regularization. Experiments on diagonal linear networks and transformers trained on modular arithmetic demonstrate the generality of our theoretical predictions. Finally, beyond grokking, our work reveals a statistical instability in minimum-norm interpolation: small perturbations in the regularization strength can lead to drastically different generalization, while preserving small training error.

AI.tldr: 该文建立统计理论，刻画正则化几何与信号稀疏性如何决定插值附近的泛化，揭示 grokking 的延迟泛化规律，并发现最小范数插值的统计不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有 grokking 理论难以定量解释延迟泛化如何依赖归纳偏置与信号结构。作者旨在填补这一空白，定量刻画正则化几何与信号稀疏性对插值附近泛化的影响。
AI.method: 以高维回归为原型设定，研究促进稀疏的正则化在强过参数化无噪声问题中的行为。证明零—一泛化律，构造使插值器从全零预测器的平凡风险过渡到精确恢复的凸范数族；在特征维数与样本量成正比的条件下，精确刻画沿 ℓ_r 正则化路径的训练误差与泛化误差。并在对角线性网络与模运算 Transformer 上开展实验验证。
AI.result: 证明强过参数化无噪声下存在零—一泛化律，并构造凸范数族使插值器由全零预测器平凡风险转为精确恢复且训练误差保持为 0。沿 ℓ_r 正则化路径精确刻画训练与泛化误差，量化插值附近的泛化增益：范数越促进稀疏、目标越稀疏，增益越大；无噪声数据与 ℓ_1 正则化时泛化出现急剧下降。实验在对角线性网络和模运算 Transformer 上验证了预测的普适性。此外发现最小范数插值存在统计不稳定性：正则化强度的微小扰动可导致泛化剧变而训练误差仍很小。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 grokking 提供了定量的统计理论框架，阐明正则化几何与信号稀疏性对延迟泛化的支配作用，并揭示最小范数插值的统计不稳定性，其理论预测在网络与 Transformer 实验中具有普适性。

title: Conditional Generation of Creative Chess Puzzles with Diffusion Models
summary: While modern language models demonstrate impressive generative capabilities, they often struggle with constrained, counter-intuitive creative tasks. To address this limitation, we explore chess puzzle generation as a rigorous testbed for computational creativity and reasoning, a domain where altering a single piece can invalidate an entire solution. We propose a novel approach for conditional generation of creative chess puzzles using masked diffusion models. Unlike previous methods, our non-directional diffusion approach allows for conditioning on specific tactical themes and partial board positions. We introduce a novel auxiliary task of simultaneous best-move prediction, which improves solution uniqueness by 11.6% and theme-conditioning accuracy by 2.5%. To further optimize solution uniqueness and theme conditioning, we establish a reinforcement learning framework adapted from Denoising Diffusion Policy Optimization (DDPO). This RL training increases the yield of unique and theme-matching positions by 89.1%. Finally, we release the first open-weights models (Appendix B) for chess puzzle generation, offering a new pathway for controllable, creative generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于掩码扩散模型的国际象棋谜题条件生成方法，通过辅助最优走子预测任务与DDPO强化学习训练，显著提升谜题解的唯一性和主题条件匹配度，并开源首批谜题生成模型。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型虽具备强大生成能力，但在受约束且反直觉的创造性任务上表现不佳。国际象棋谜题生成是理想测试平台：改动单个棋子即可使整个解法失效，对计算创造力和推理构成严格挑战。
AI.method: 采用非方向性掩码扩散模型实现国际象棋谜题的条件生成，支持以特定战术主题和部分棋盘局面为条件；引入同时最优走子预测的辅助任务；并基于去噪扩散策略优化（DDPO）构建强化学习框架进一步优化。
AI.result: 辅助最优走子预测任务使解的唯一性提升11.6%，主题条件准确率提升2.5%；DDPO强化学习训练使唯一且主题匹配局面的产出率提升89.1%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明扩散模型结合辅助任务与强化学习可有效实现可控、创造性的国际象棋谜题生成，并发布首个开放权重的谜题生成模型，为可控创造性生成提供新路径。

title: Does Gradient Conflict Predict the Understanding--Generation Trade-off? A Controlled Audit of Conflict-Metric Validity in Unified Multimodal Models
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Code will be made publicly available upon acceptance
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) are increasingly designed around gradient conflict between understanding and generation objectives. The premise that reducing these metrics improves the downstream understanding-generation trade-off has never been tested directly. We audit it in a controlled testbed, GRIDUMM, which mirrors key structural ingredients of UMM training while making the ground-truth trade-off exactly computable. Across 63 configurations and 372 measured checkpoints, no directional conflict metric reaches an absolute Spearman correlation of 0.3 with a confidence interval excluding zero for conflict measured during training against the eventual trade-off. A dose-response intervention that monotonically suppresses conflict leaves the trade-off flat, separating correlation from causation. The norm ratio is a generation-failure detector and becomes null among configurations that master generation. Functional interference measures outperform directional conflict metrics, while training loss tracks the trade-off strongly. Our results do not show that conflict is useless; they show that its validity as a diagnostic target must be established, not assumed, and we release the audit protocol as a reusable standard.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过受控测试平台GRIDUMM检验了"降低理解与生成目标间的梯度冲突能改善下游权衡"这一前提，发现在63种配置、372个检查点中，训练期间的梯度冲突指标与最终权衡几乎无相关性，且抑制冲突的干预对权衡无影响，表明冲突作为诊断目标的有效性必须被验证而非默认假设。
AI.motivation: 统一多模态模型（UMMs）的设计普遍围绕理解与生成目标间的梯度冲突展开，并默认减少这类冲突指标能够改善理解-生成权衡，但这一前提从未被直接检验。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个受控测试平台GRIDUMM，它复现了UMM训练的关键结构要素，同时使真实权衡可被精确计算。随后在63种配置、372个检查点上系统测量了训练期间的梯度冲突指标与最终权衡的相关性，并开展了剂量-响应干预来验证因果性。
AI.result: 没有任何方向性冲突指标与最终权衡达到绝对Spearman相关0.3以上且置信区间排除零。单调抑制冲突的剂量-响应干预后权衡保持不变，从而将相关性与因果性分离。范数比是一个生成失败检测器，但在已掌握生成的配置中失效。功能干扰度量优于方向性冲突度量，而训练损失能强烈追踪权衡。
AI.conclusion: 结果并非表明冲突毫无用处，而是强调其作为诊断目标的有效性必须被建立而非假设，作者同时发布了该审计协议作为可复用的标准。

title: Sense and Sensitivity: Benchmarking LLM Clinical Triage Recommendations with Physician Experts
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in clinical settings, it is critical to evaluate their reliability under realistic variation in clinical text. We study this question in clinical triage, comparing LLMs to practicing physicians under text perturbations that preserve the underlying clinical setting. We introduce a benchmark of over 6,000 clinical scenarios, 7,000 physician annotations, and 225,000 model responses. Using this benchmark, we make two key observations. First, LLMs are more likely than physicians to recommend unnecessary care at baseline, and this tendency increases under perturbed inputs. Further, we find that LLM recommendations are more sensitive to gender and tone perturbations than human recommendations. Together, these results demonstrate that LLMs can vary under clinically irrelevant textual changes, highlighting the need for deployment-oriented evaluations grounded in expert physician behavior.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了包含6000+临床场景、7000条医师标注和225000条模型响应的基准，研究LLM在临床分诊中对文本扰动的鲁棒性。发现LLM在基线时比医师更易推荐不必要的医疗，且在扰动下该倾向加剧，同时对性别和语气扰动比人类更敏感。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM越来越多地应用于临床场景，亟需评估其在真实临床文本变化（扰动）下的可靠性。本文以临床分诊为切入点，通过与执业医师对比，考察LLM在保持临床情境不变但文本形式改变时的稳定性。
AI.method: 引入一个包含超过6000个临床场景、7000条医师标注和225000条模型响应的基准，在保持底层临床情境不变的前提下对临床文本施加扰动，将LLM与执业医师的推荐进行对比分析。
AI.result: LLM在基线时比医师更倾向推荐不必要的医疗，且该倾向在输入扰动下进一步增强；LLM的推荐对性别和语气扰动比人类推荐更敏感。
AI.conclusion: LLM会因临床无关的文本变化而产生输出波动，说明需要面向部署、以专家医师行为为基准的评估方法。

title: RetroGEF: Dynamic Graph Edit Flow for Single-Step Retrosynthesis
summary: Retrosynthesis enables the discovery of viable synthetic routes to target molecules. It plays a central role in modern drug discovery and materials design. Retrosynthesis involves molecular graph transformations that can change both connectivity and graph size. These transformations may introduce reactant components absent from the target while revising the product-derived structure. To model these transformations, we propose RetroGEF, a flow-based generative model for single-step retrosynthesis. Starting from the target molecule, it constructs possible reactants by adding atoms and changing bonds in the molecular graph. RetroGEF models molecular transformations and changes in graph size within the same generative process, rather than relying on a fixed-size graph canvas. It learns this process directly from product--reactant pairs without requiring a prescribed edit order. Experiments on representative retrosynthesis benchmarks demonstrate that RetroGEF achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出RetroGEF，一种基于流的单步逆合成生成模型，从目标分子出发，通过添加原子和改变键来构建反应物，在统一生成过程中同时建模分子变换与图规模变化，无需固定尺寸图画布和预设编辑顺序，在主流基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 逆合成在药物发现与材料设计中处于核心地位。其分子图变换既改变连接性又改变图的规模，并可能引入目标分子中不存在的反应物组分。现有方法依赖固定尺寸的图表示或预先指定的编辑顺序，难以自然刻画这些变化，因此需要新的建模方式。
AI.method: 提出RetroGEF，一种基于流的生成模型用于单步逆合成。以目标分子为起点，在分子图上通过添加原子和修改键来构建可能的反应物；在同一生成过程中对分子变换与图规模变化进行联合建模，不依赖固定尺寸的图画布；直接从产物—反应物配对数据中学习该过程，无需预设编辑顺序。
AI.result: 在代表性逆合成基准上的实验表明，RetroGEF取得了最先进的性能（state-of-the-art）。
AI.conclusion: RetroGEF能够灵活建模变规模分子图上的逆合成变换，避免固定尺寸图与预设编辑顺序的限制，并在基准上验证了其有效性，为单步逆合成提供了新的建模范式。

title: When Scientific Contradictions Are Lost in Translation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 AI for Science Workshop: Verification in the Age of AI Scientists. This version is not included in the official NeurIPS proceedings
summary: Two scientific findings can disagree without contradicting each other. Determining whether they conflict requires knowing whether they describe comparable measurements. We study how language models behave at this decision point. In a controlled task, we generate an unsatisfiable XOR constraint system and translate its constraints into scientific reports from different laboratories. One assignment satisfies more constraints, while another satisfies fewer but better matches expected biology. This creates a simple dilemma: does the model choose the assignment that best fits the constraints, or the one that better matches biological expectations? When the constraints are stated directly, GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Opus 5 recover the best-supported assignment in 90% and 96% of cases, respectively. In scientific prose, however, the models behave differently. Claude Opus 5 often prefers the biologically expected assignment. Removing that biological preference increases recovery of the better-supported assignment from 27% to 79% (p<.001); recovery reaches 92% when the same Biology-favored record is accompanied by a formalization request and an explicit paired-design cue (p<.001). GPT-5.6 Sol is less sensitive, with neither corresponding change reaching statistical significance. These results suggest that reliable scientific verification depends not only on formal reasoning, but also on how models decide which findings should be compared and what relations they imply.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过构造可满足性不可达的 XOR 约束系统并将其改写为不同实验室的科研报告，考察大语言模型在"两项发现是否冲突"这一判断节点上的行为：约束以显式形式给出时模型识别更优支持分配的比例很高（GPT-5.6 Sol 90%、Claude Opus 5 96%），但以科研散文形式给出时出现分歧，Claude Opus 5 常偏好符合生物学预期的分配。
AI.motivation: 两项科学发现可以彼此不一致却并不构成矛盾，判断其是否冲突的前提是确认它们描述的是可比较的测量。作者关注模型在这一"决策点"上的行为，即模型如何决定哪些发现应当被比较、以及它们蕴含何种关系；而现有对模型形式推理能力的评估往往忽视这一前置判断环节。
AI.method: 设计受控任务：生成一个不可满足的 XOR 约束系统，并将其约束翻译成来自不同实验室的科研报告文本。系统存在两种分配，一种满足更多约束，另一种满足较少约束但更契合预期的生物学结果，由此构成"依约束最优"与"依生物学预期最优"的二择困境。随后比较约束以直接形式陈述（显式约束）与以科研散文陈述两种条件，并采用消融与提示操纵：移除生物学偏好、附加形式化请求、以及显式成对设计线索，分别测量模型恢复更受支持分配的比例并做显著性检验。
AI.result: 约束显式给出时，GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude Opus 5 分别有 90% 与 96% 的案例能恢复最受支持的分配。在科研散文条件下行为出现差异：Claude Opus 5 常偏好符合生物学预期的分配；移除该生物学偏好后，最优分配恢复率由 27% 提升至 79%（p<.001）；当同一"偏好生物学"的记录附加形式化请求与显式成对设计线索时，恢复率达 92%（p<.001）。GPT-5.6 Sol 敏感度较低，上述两项变化均未达到统计显著。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的科学核验不仅依赖形式推理能力，还取决于模型如何判定哪些发现应被比较、以及它们所蕴含的关系。模型在自然语言科研表述下可能受语义先验（如生物学预期）牵引，从而偏离形式约束给出的最优解，而形式化请求与显式设计线索可显著缓解这一偏差；不同模型对该偏差的敏感度存在差异。

title: Role-guided Speaker Deletion Verification in Clinical Psychiatry Speech Recordings with Audio Language Models
summary: Clinical research in psychiatry increasingly relies on large scale collection of spoken language data to identify acoustic and linguistic biomarkers. Yet evolving consent and protocol requirements can oblige investigators to remove a designated speaker from multi-speaker recordings and to verify said removal at a scale infeasible for manual review of entire corpora. We study this verification problem for role-driven dyadic clinical dialogue in psychiatry and investigate it with two parallel, symmetric pipelines: confirming that clinician speech has been removed from psychiatric interview recordings, and confirming that patient speech has been removed from the same recordings. Each pipeline redacts the raw audio for its target role and then scans the surviving output with audio-language and large-language models to identify missed deletions. We evaluate this approach on a corpus of 48 dyadic recordings drawn from psychiatry settings, testing four open-weight models in an inference-only setting: Gemma-4-12B, Gemma-4-31B, Nemotron-3-Nano, and Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni. A disjunctive OR ensemble over fourteen model-view configurations had a combined F1 of 0.478 (precision 0.330, recall 0.870), an improvement over individual model estimates driven by recall gains that point to substantial complementarity across models and context views.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对精神科双人访谈录音中"指定说话人语音是否被彻底删除"的验证问题，构建了对称的双流水线（验证医生语音已删除、验证患者语音已删除），先对目标角色原始音频做遮蔽处理，再用音频-语言模型与大语言模型扫描残余音频以识别漏删片段，并在48段真实精神科双人录音上对四个开放权重模型进行仅推理评测，最终通过十四个"模型-视图"配置的析取OR集成取得F1=0.478（精确率0.330、召回率0.870）。
AI.motivation: 精神科临床研究日益依赖大规模口语数据来挖掘声学与语言学生物标志物，但不断演变的知情同意与协议要求可能迫使研究者从多人录音中移除指定说话人，并在整个语料库规模上验证移除是否彻底；这一规模远超人工逐条审听的可承受范围，因此需要自动化的漏删验证方法。
AI.method: 面向精神科角色驱动的双人临床对话，设计两条平行且对称的流水线：一条确认医生语音已从访谈录音中移除，另一条确认患者语音已从同一批录音中移除。每条流水线先对目标角色的原始音频执行遮蔽（redaction），再用音频-语言模型与大语言模型扫描残留输出以定位漏删片段。在由48段精神科双人录音构成的语料上做仅推理（inference-only）评测，涉及四个开放权重模型：Gemma-4-12B、Gemma-4-31B、Nemotron-3-Nano、Nemotron-3-Nano-Omni，并考察多种模型与上下文视图组合。
AI.result: 在十四个"模型-视图"配置上采用析取OR集成，整体F1为0.478，精确率0.330、召回率0.870；相较于单个模型的估计，集成方案有所提升，提升主要由召回率增益驱动，表明不同模型与不同上下文视图之间存在显著互补性。
AI.conclusion: 将音频-语言模型与大语言模型用于"目标角色语音是否已彻底删除"的自动验证在精神科双人临床对话场景中具备可行性；析取OR集成能借助模型与视图间的互补性显著提高召回，适合作为高风险漏删筛查的第一道防线，但其精确率偏低意味着仍需后续人工或更精细的策略来控制误报。

title: Autoregressive Frontier Expansion: Growing Trees with Graph Machine Learning
summary: Tree-like branching structures are common in nature, from botanical trees to neurons, blood vessels and respiratory trees. Their branching shape often reflects function, making structural modelling central to understanding how these systems work. Because acquiring real-world 3D data is often expensive or infeasible, realistic generative models are valuable for simulation and data augmentation. Existing morphology-specific models either constrain how topology is generated or rely on hand-tuned, mechanistic procedures. Generic 3D graph generators, by contrast, do not exploit or enforce the structure of trees. We propose Autoregressive Frontier Expansion, a generative framework that constructs trees through an iterative expansion process, simulating the biological growth of real trees. At each step, a flow-matching model parameterised by an SO(2)-equivariant GNN expands the frontier by predicting whether each active branch bifurcates or terminates. We evaluate our method on cortical neurons and botanical trees in unconditional, class-conditioned, and morphology-guided generation. Across both domains, the generated morphologies agree closely with the reference distributions and, in conditional experiments, with the specified targets.

AI.tldr: 提出 Autoregressive Frontier Expansion 生成框架，用等变 GNN 与流匹配逐步扩展树的前沿，实现神经元与植物树的真实形态生成。
AI.motivation: 树状分支结构（植物树、神经元、血管、呼吸道）的形态反映其功能，结构建模对理解这些系统至关重要；但真实三维数据获取成本高或不可行，因此需要高保真的生成模型用于仿真与数据增强。现有形态专用模型限制拓扑生成方式或依赖手工调参的机制化流程，而通用三维图生成器又未利用或约束树的特殊结构。
AI.method: 提出 Autoregressive Frontier Expansion 生成框架，通过迭代扩展过程构建树，模拟真实树木的生物学生长。每一步使用由 SO(2)-等变图神经网络参数化的流匹配模型，对当前边界（frontier）上的每条活跃分支预测其分叉或终止，从而逐步扩展前沿。
AI.result: 在皮层神经元与植物树上进行无条件生成、类别条件生成与形态引导生成实验；两个领域中生成形态与参考分布高度吻合，在条件实验中亦与指定目标高度一致。
AI.conclusion: 将树的生长过程显式建模为自回归前沿扩展，并结合 SO(2) 等变图神经网络与流匹配，可在不依赖手工机制化规则的前提下生成符合真实分布的树状形态，适用于无条件与多种条件生成任务。

title: ChartRevise: A Dataset and Evaluation Protocol for Exact Chart Editing via Code
summary: Chart editing requires cross-modal edit grounding, realizing a requested visual change in the code that draws it, with necessary related updates and without altering unrelated content. Existing benchmarks emphasize either code executability or chart quality, but their metrics do not clearly distinguish request completion from missed coupled updates and gratuitous changes. We introduce ChartRevise, a structured dataset and evaluation protocol for exact program-grounded chart editing. For dataset construction, we build on the grammar of graphics to systematically cover chart-editing operations, using source-program checks to verify their applicability across chart types and libraries. To improve edit exactness, our pipeline checks individual requirements and guides repair or exclusion when they are unmet. The resulting dataset contains 92,438 records covering 344 edit types across 20 chart types and three plotting libraries. For evaluation, our reference-free protocol separately measures atomic requirement completion, identifies gratuitous changes, and detects missed coupled updates. These checks are combined with successful execution and rendering to determine exact-edit success. Across five models and four external benchmarks, fine-tuning yields relative gains of 16\% in mean requirement recall and 22\% in mean exact-edit rate.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChartRevise 数据集与评测协议，用于"程序级精确"的图表编辑，分别度量原子需求完成、冗余改动与遗漏的耦合更新，并以可执行可渲染的精确编辑成功率作为最终指标。
AI.motivation: 图表编辑属于跨模态编辑定位任务：需在绘图代码中实现所请求的视觉变更，同时完成必要的关联更新且不修改无关内容。现有基准要么侧重代码可执行性，要么侧重图表质量，其指标无法清晰区分"需求完成""遗漏耦合更新"与"无端改动"这三类情况。因此缺少一个以程序为基准、能精确刻画编辑正确性的数据集与评测协议。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建：基于图形语法（grammar of graphics）系统化覆盖图表编辑操作，并用源程序检查验证各操作在多种图表类型与绘图库上的适用性；2) 精确性提升：流水线逐条检查需求是否满足，对不满足者引导修复或予以排除；3) 评测协议：无参考（reference-free）地分别度量原子需求完成度、识别冗余改动、检测遗漏的耦合更新，并将这些检查与成功执行、成功渲染结合，判定"精确编辑成功"。
AI.result: 数据集包含 92,438 条记录，覆盖 344 种编辑类型、20 种图表类型与 3 个绘图库。在 5 个模型与 4 个外部基准上，微调后平均需求召回率相对提升 16%，平均精确编辑率相对提升 22%。
AI.conclusion: ChartRevise 通过结构化数据构建与解耦式评测指标，为图表编辑提供了可区分需求完成、冗余改动与耦合更新的精确评价框架，并能显著提升模型在精确编辑任务上的表现。

title: Does Text Steer Neural PDE Surrogates? A Controlled Diagnostic with OperatorCLIP
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Representation for the Physical Sciences
summary: Lower error from a text-conditioned neural surrogate does not, by itself, show that the model uses the meaning of the text. We examine this attribution problem with OperatorCLIP, comparing an unconditioned FNO, a constant-sentence FiLM control, and a fixed task description trained with contrastive alignment. Three-seed experiments cover Darcy2D, ShallowWater2D, and three-dimensional compressible Navier-Stokes (CNS3D). Constant conditioning has lower mean test error on both 2D tasks. Relative to this control, task text plus alignment has a similar mean on ShallowWater2D and CNS3D and a higher mean on Darcy2D; these descriptive comparisons have substantial seed uncertainty. The latter comparison changes both prompt content and loss, so it isolates neither effect. The text encoder is trained from scratch, and each conditioned model sees only one description during training. In this regime, pairwise InfoNCE cannot identify matched pairs and has minimum $\log B$. Prompt interventions show no reliable semantic ordering. This methodological caution demonstrates why pathway controls are needed; it neither establishes semantic competence of the encoder nor tests the effectiveness of text under varying physical context.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过OperatorCLIP的控制实验表明，文本条件神经代理的更低误差本身不能证明模型使用了文本语义；固定任务描述加对比对齐并未优于常量条件控制，提示干预也无可靠的语义排序。
AI.motivation: 文本条件神经代理误差更低，常被解读为模型利用了文本含义，但这种归因存在混淆：误差下降可能来自条件通路本身而非语义理解，因此需要严格的路径控制来检验语义归因是否成立。
AI.method: 以OperatorCLIP为框架，比较三种模型：无条件FNO、常量句子FiLM控制、以及用对比对齐训练的固定任务描述模型。在三类任务（Darcy2D、ShallowWater2D、三维可压缩Navier-Stokes）上做三种子实验；文本编码器从头训练，每个条件模型训练时仅见一个描述；进行提示干预并分析InfoNCE在配对识别上的表现。
AI.result: 常量条件在两个2D任务上平均测试误差更低。相对于该控制，任务文本加对齐在ShallowWater2D和CNS3D上均值相近，在Darcy2D上均值更高，且这些描述性比较存在较大的种子不确定性。该比较同时改变了提示内容与损失，无法分离单一效应。成对InfoNCE在此设定下无法识别匹配对，损失下界为log B。提示干预未显示可靠的语义排序。
AI.conclusion: 这是一项方法论警示：文本条件收益不能直接归因于语义利用，必须设置路径控制。研究既未确立编码器的语义能力，也未检验文本在不同物理情境下的有效性。

title: AgBench: Agentic AI Benchmarks for Personal AI Devices
summary: Agentic AI systems increasingly rely on cloud-hosted large language models for planning, tool use, and iterative execution, raising concerns about API cost and data exposure. Advances in personal AI devices enable agents to execute locally, but limited resources on device may affect task success and performance. Existing benchmarks are inadequate for systematically characterizing these trade-offs across devices, workloads, and deployment architectures. We present AgBench, a benchmark suite and open artifacts for reproducible evaluation of agentic AI on personal devices. Using AgBench, we evaluate local, hybrid, and cloud execution across agentic workloads, examining task success, latency, cloud API cost, and data exposure. Our results, drawn from over 162.07 million data points, show that personal AI devices can complete many agent tasks locally, but local-only execution generally has lower task success and longer completion times than cloud-only execution, especially as concurrency increases. Local-only execution eliminates cloud model API costs and sensitive-information exposure to cloud agents. Hybrid execution can improve task success, but its cloud cost and data exposure depend on how agents divide work and share information. No single architecture performs best across task success, goodput, cloud cost, and data exposure; deployment choices should reflect the intended workload and device capabilities. AgBench is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgBench-2777.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgBench 基准套件，用于在个人设备上可复现地评估 Agentic AI 在本地、混合与云端三种部署架构下的权衡，涵盖任务成功率、延迟、API 成本与数据暴露等指标，基于 1.62 亿余数据点得出：本地执行可完成多数任务但成功率与完成时间较差；混合架构可提升成功率但成本与暴露取决于任务划分与信息共享方式；不存在单一最优架构。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI 系统日益依赖云端托管的大语言模型进行规划、工具调用与迭代执行，引发 API 成本与数据暴露担忧；个人 AI 设备虽支持本地执行，但设备资源有限可能影响任务成功率与性能。现有基准无法系统刻画不同设备、工作负载与部署架构之间的这些权衡。
AI.method: 提出 AgBench——面向个人设备上 Agentic AI 可复现评估的基准套件与开放工件；基于 AgBench 在多种 agentic 工作负载上评估本地、混合与云端三种执行架构，测量任务成功率、延迟、云 API 成本与数据暴露，数据规模超过 1.6207 亿个数据点。
AI.result: 个人 AI 设备可在本地完成许多 agent 任务，但纯本地执行相比纯云端通常在任务成功率上更低、完成时间更长，且随并发增加尤为明显；纯本地执行消除了云模型 API 成本与敏感信息向云端 agent 的暴露；混合执行可提升任务成功率，但其云成本与数据暴露取决于 agent 如何划分工作与共享信息；在任务成功率、有效吞吐、云成本与数据暴露方面，没有任何单一架构表现最优。
AI.conclusion: 部署架构选择应反映预期工作负载与设备能力，不存在普适最优方案；AgBench 提供可复现的评估基础，已公开于 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/AgBench-2777。

title: ShamAN-Q: Shampoo Augmented NanoQuant for Sub-1-bit LLM Weights
summary: We introduce ShamAN-Q, a sub-1-bit post-training quantization method that extends NanoQuant by replacing each its diagonal reconstruction geometry with a tractable dense curvature metric, using a general paradigm popularized by the Shampoo optimizer. For each linear weight, ShamAN-Q fits a Kronecker product to the empirical Fisher information matrix of a small calibration set by Kullback--Leibler minimization, forming a Mahalanobis reconstruction loss from the result. The continuous ADMM updates from NanoQuant become solutions to Sylvester equations, while its discrete projection and deployment format remain unchanged. Because the curvature is local to a given set of weights, ShamAN-Q re-measures the input curvature statistic for each layer immediately before layer factorization, periodically refreshing all statistics on the partially quantized model. ShamAN-Q also redistributes the uniform rank from NanoQuant across layers at the same total number of bits. On Qwen3-Base, ShamAN-Q lowers WikiText-2 perplexity at $\approx$1 bpw from 27.56 to 22.96 (0.6B), 19.21 to 16.72 (1.7B), and 14.29 to 13.80 (4B) while matching or improving zero-shot accuracy on the Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness. On 0.6B, ShamAN-Q at $\approx$0.8 bpw matches the published perplexity of NanoQuant at $\approx$1.0 bpw.

AI.tldr: ShamAN-Q是一种亚1比特训练后量化方法，通过用可处理的稠密曲率度量替换NanoQuant的对角重构几何，在保持原有离散投影与部署格式不变的前提下，显著降低多尺寸Qwen3-Base模型的WikiText-2困惑度。
AI.motivation: NanoQuant使用对角重构几何进行亚1比特训练后量化，其曲率建模过于简化（仅对角近似），无法充分捕捉权重空间中各维度间的相关性，制约了量化精度。作者希望借助Shampoo优化器中流行的Kronecker积稠密曲率范式，提升重构损失的表达能力。
AI.method: ShamAN-Q对每个线性权重，用KL最小化将Kronecker积拟合到小校准集的经验Fisher信息矩阵，由此构造Mahalanobis重构损失；NanoQuant的连续ADMM更新转化为Sylvester方程求解，离散投影和部署格式保持不变。由于曲率依赖当前权重，方法在每层分解前重新测量输入曲率统计，并在部分量化模型上周期性刷新所有统计量。此外，将NanoQuant的均匀秩在总比特数不变的约束下跨层重新分配。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-Base上，ShamAN-Q在约1 bpw下将WikiText-2困惑度从27.56降至22.96（0.6B）、19.21降至16.72（1.7B）、14.29降至13.80（4B），同时在Eleuther LM Evaluation Harness上的零样本准确率持平或提升。在0.6B模型上，约0.8 bpw的ShamAN-Q达到NanoQuant约1.0 bpw已发表的困惑度水平。
AI.conclusion: 以Kronecker积稠密曲率替代对角几何、并将ADMM更新转化为Sylvester方程是可行且有效的，配合曲率重测量与跨层秩重分配，能在亚1比特乃至约0.8 bpw的极低比特预算下实现优于NanoQuant的量化质量，同时不改变部署格式。

title: EvoSteer: Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration via Reference-Anchored Credit Assignment
summary: In recent years, LLM-based multi-agent systems have been widely applied to orchestrate tool-using agents into executable communication graphs. However, existing self-evolving orchestration still faces key challenges, including post-hoc evolution that revises the team only after the trajectory ends, credit diffusion that gives every action the same terminal advantage under confounded baselines, and skill admission that is uncalibrated and never retired. To address these challenges, we propose EvoSteer, a new paradigm of Online Self-Evolving Graph Orchestration -- the orchestrator builds a running team and repairs its plausible but failing steps from execution features and a learned value estimate. To support this paradigm, we introduce Anchored Trajectory Balance (AnchorTB), a regression-style flow-matching loss that assigns each orchestration action a coefficient by balancing subtrajectories against a frozen reference. Built on the learned flow, we further propose Validated Skill Admission, in which a candidate skill is tried before promotion and promoted only if paired evidence passes a sequential test under a shared nominal testing budget. Moreover, AnchorTB combines measured task-level reference reward statistics with prefix-dependent corrections. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that EvoSteer significantly outperforms baselines across question answering, mathematical reasoning, code generation, and interactive decision making. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/evosteer.

AI.tldr: 提出EvoSteer在线自演化图编排范式及AnchorTB回归式流匹配损失与Validated Skill Admission技能准入机制。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体编排存在三大问题：事后演化（仅在轨迹结束后修订团队）、信用扩散（混淆基线导致所有动作获得相同终端优势）、技能准入未校准且从不淘汰。
AI.method: EvoSteer构建在线运行团队，依据执行特征与学习到的价值估计修复看似合理但失败的步骤；核心为Anchored Trajectory Balance（AnchorTB），通过将子轨迹与冻结参考平衡，为每个编排动作分配系数，并结合任务级参考奖励统计与前缀相关校正；进一步提出Validated Skill Admission，技能需先试用，仅当配对证据在共享名义测试预算下通过序贯检验才被晋升。
AI.result: 在十二个数据集上，EvoSteer在问答、数学推理、代码生成与交互式决策任务中显著优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 在线自演化图编排结合锚定轨迹平衡与验证式技能准入，可有效缓解事后演化、信用扩散与技能准入失校准问题，代码已开源。

title: MM-FinEval: A Multi-Task Multimodal Benchmark for Real-World Financial Forecasting
summary: Financial forecasting from earnings conference calls requires models to reason over complex corporate disclosures, market expectations, and subtle communication signals. However, existing financial benchmarks are often limited to unimodal inputs or single-task settings, making it difficult to evaluate whether multimodal large language models (LLMs) can support real-world financial analysis. In this paper, we introduce MM-FinEval, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal LLMs across multiple financial tasks. MM-FinEval spans a diverse timeline from 2019 to 2022. The entire proposed dataset contains 2,045 S\&P 500 conference earning calls as inputs and 12 financial task labels as outputs. Each input contains three modalities: a word-to-word text transcript of the earning call, the corresponding presentation slides used during the call, and the entire audio recording. To establish a rigorous evaluation framework, we analyze 19 baseline models across three distinct model categories: Image-Text, Audio-Text, and Any-to-Any configurations. We observe that small-size Any-to-Any models processing all three modalities achieve strong performance, even when compared against larger proprietary models restricted to two-modality inputs. This indicates that our tri-modal dataset design introduces useful, non-redundant information. These results validate that text, audio, and visual data serve as important, complementary signals that mimic the decision-making process of expert human analysts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MM-FinEval，一个面向财报电话会议的多模态金融基准，涵盖2019–2022年2,045场标普500电话会议，输入含文本转录、演示幻灯片和音频三种模态，输出12类金融任务标签，并评测19个基线模型。
AI.motivation: 金融预测需对复杂企业披露、市场预期与沟通信号进行推理，但现有金融基准多局限于单模态输入或单任务设置，难以评估多模态大语言模型能否支撑真实金融分析。
AI.method: 构建MM-FinEval基准：收集2019至2022年的标普500财报电话会议，形成2,045条样本；每条输入包含词对词文本转录、对应演示幻灯片和完整音频录音三种模态，输出为12个金融任务标签；按Image-Text、Audio-Text、Any-to-Any三类配置评测19个基线模型。
AI.result: 小型Any-to-Any模型在处理全部三种模态时表现强劲，甚至可媲美仅支持两模态输入的大型专有模型，说明三模态设计引入了有用且非冗余的信息。
AI.conclusion: 文本、音频与视觉数据是重要且互补的信号，可模拟专家人类分析师的信息整合与决策过程，MM-FinEval为多模态金融分析提供了严格评测框架。

title: Where Scientific Search Agents Fail: Decision-Checkpoint Auditing of Exposure and Inspection Attempts
summary: Final-answer accuracy does not reveal whether a scientific-search agent failed to encounter a target paper, attempt to inspect it, or return an accepted answer after inspection. We introduce decision checkpoints that record observations and tool actions without benchmark labels during inference, then join target identities and evaluator labels to assign outcome categories from recorded events. Across five conditions on 540 answerable AutoResearchBench Deep questions in a fixed, target-enriched environment, keyword search achieves 24.6\% accuracy, compared with 17.8\% for raw search. The keyword condition has fewer incorrect answers with neither target exposure nor inspection, but more incorrect answers after the target is exposed and left uninspected. Compared with keyword search, read-first has 27.4\% more recorded evidence-search calls. Target inspection attempts occur on 199 questions under read-first and 191 under keyword search; both conditions achieve 24.6\% accuracy. The checkpoint protocol makes these question-level differences explicit, distinguishing target exposure and inspection from aggregate accuracy and total tool use.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"决策检查点"协议，追踪科学搜索智能体在推理过程中的观察与工具动作，并结合目标身份与评估标签对结果分类，从而揭示最终答案准确率无法反映的过程性差异。
AI.motivation: 最终答案准确率无法区分失败原因：智能体究竟是未遇到目标论文、遇到但未尝试查看，还是查看后仍给出被接受的答案。这种过程黑箱导致难以诊断搜索智能体的真实行为差异。
AI.method: 引入决策检查点，在推理过程中记录观察与工具动作（不使用基准标签）；随后在离线阶段拼接目标身份与评估标签，将录得的事件分配到不同结果类别。在固定且目标增强的环境中，对AutoResearchBench Deep的540道可答题进行五种条件对比。
AI.result: 关键词搜索准确率24.6%，原始搜索17.8%。关键词条件下，"既未暴露目标也未查看"的错误答案更少，但"目标已暴露却未查看"的错误答案更多。相比关键词搜索，read-first的记录证据搜索调用多27.4%；目标查看尝试在read-first下出现于199题、关键词搜索下191题，二者准确率均为24.6%。
AI.conclusion: 检查点协议将题目层面的差异显式化，把目标暴露与查看行为从总体准确率和工具调用总量中区分开来，为细粒度诊断科学搜索智能体提供了可行手段。

title: Revisiting scaling laws for reward optimization
summary: Scaling laws for optimization against reward models in AI alignment have pinned down how performance depends on optimization effort---measured by a KL-divergence budget relative to a reference policy. Beyond a certain budget, over-optimization (or reward hacking) can arise: because we optimize against a proxy reward model (distinct from true rewards), performance can plateau or degrade. Naturally, the proxy reward's accuracy depends on how much preference data (often in the form of pairwise comparisons) was used to train it. However, existing research does not cleanly identify how performance jointly scales with the amount of training data and the divergence budget. Our main contribution is to provide an empirically accurate and theoretically grounded scaling law in such context. Performance roughly scales as $Θ(\sqrt{\min\{\log(M),K\}})$, where $M$ is the number of comparisons in training data and $K$ is the policy's divergence budget. We develop an information-theoretic model to establish this upper bound and prove it is tightly achievable through a constructive procedure. Informed by this, we conduct extensive empirical evaluations using a real-world annotation setup, whereby a large 70B gold reward model generates feedback data and proxy reward models are trained from less capable models (0.6B to 4B). Our scaling law provides an excellent fit (R2 from 97\% to 99\%), outperforms alternative specifications, and remains robust across model sizes, noise, and optimization procedures (best-of-$N$ or policy tilting). Our evidence suggests that reward optimization is analogous to a surprisingly simple selection task: choosing from a sequence of IID Gaussian random variables using noisy preference feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个联合刻画训练数据量与散度预算对奖励优化性能影响的标度律，性能约为 Θ(√min{log M, K})。
AI.motivation: 既有AI对齐标度律仅关注优化努力（以相对参考策略的KL散度预算衡量），指出过度优化会导致性能停滞或下降；但代理奖励模型的准确度取决于偏好数据量，而现有研究未清晰刻画性能如何同时随训练数据量与散度预算缩放。
AI.method: 构建信息论模型推导性能上界，并通过构造性程序证明该上界可达；使用真实标注设置进行实证：70B金标准奖励模型生成反馈数据，用0.6B至4B的较弱模型训练代理奖励模型，横跨不同模型规模、噪声与优化程序（best-of-N与policy tilting）。
AI.result: 性能大致按 Θ(√min{log M, K}) 缩放（M为训练比较数，K为散度预算）；标度律拟合优度R²达97%–99%，优于替代规格，并在模型规模、噪声及优化程序上保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 奖励优化可类比为一个简单选择任务：用带噪偏好反馈从IID高斯随机变量序列中选择；该标度律在经验上准确且理论上有据。

title: Concept-Grounded Attention: A Controlled Evaluation of Graph-Injected Attention, Temporal Versioning, and Epistemic Status
summary: Knowledge-intensive language-model systems typically represent external knowledge as text chunks or static graphs, with limited support for concept evolution, point-in-time reasoning, and distinctions between validated and inferred knowledge. We introduce the Concept Lifecycle Model (CLM), which represents concepts as persistent, graph-grounded, temporally versioned entities with explicit provenance and epistemic status, and Concept-Grounded Attention (CGA), which injects concept-graph structure into transformer computation through graph-biased self-attention (Form A) and gated cross-attention over concept nodes (Form B). We evaluate the framework in controlled settings using disabled-mechanism baselines. On 200 MuSiQue and HotpotQA questions with retrieval fixed, concept-graph retrieval recovers explicit multi-hop paths but does not improve evidence recall. Form A appears to steer attention, with 2.76 times more attention on gold than distractor concepts, but the same ratio occurs when Form A is disabled; the learned bias is negligible and no answers change. An identity-preserving Form B improves F1 from 0.188 to 0.221, but control concepts yield 0.213, indicating that most of the gain reflects added capacity. On LongMemEval, explicit temporal representation improves answer accuracy by 13 to 25 points across all tested generators, up to 122B parameters, while simplified CLM version resolution performs similarly to dated serialization because concept identity is not established reliably. On a synthetic source-independence task, protocol-derived epistemic status reduces unsupported assertions from 28% to 0.1% in a fine-tuned small model and from 19-68% to 0-5% in 72-122B models. Overall, the results support making temporal validity and epistemic status explicit, while showing that graph-attention diagnostics are not informative without disabled-mechanism controls.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出概念生命周期模型（CLM）与概念锚定注意力（CGA）框架，将概念表示为带时间版本、来源与认知状态的知识图谱实体，并通过消融对照实验评估各机制的贡献；结果显示时间有效性与认知状态的显式化确有收益，而图注意力机制本身在当前实现下贡献甚微。
AI.motivation: 现有知识密集型语言模型系统多以文本块或静态图表示外部知识，难以支持概念演化、时点推理，以及区分已验证知识与推断知识。作者希望以显式的概念版本、溯源和认知状态来弥补这些不足。
AI.method: 提出CLM：将概念建模为持久、图锚定、带时间版本、显式溯源与认知状态的实体；提出CGA：通过图偏置自注意力（Form A）与对概念节点的门控交叉注意力（Form B）将概念图结构注入Transformer计算。评估采用受控设置与"机制禁用"基线，在MuSiQue、HotpotQA（固定检索）、LongMemEval、合成来源独立性任务上进行。
AI.result: 在200道MuSiQue与HotpotQA问题（检索固定）上，概念图检索能恢复显式多跳路径但不提升证据召回率。Form A中gold概念注意力是干扰概念的2.76倍，但禁用Form A时该比例相同，学到的偏置可忽略且无答案变化。保持身份不变的Form B将F1从0.188提升至0.221，但控制概念也达0.213，说明增益主要来自容量增加。LongMemEval上显式时间表示在至多122B参数的各生成器上提升准确率13–25点；简化版CLM版本解析与日期序列化效果相近，因概念身份未被可靠确立。合成来源独立性任务上，协议推导的认知状态使小模型无依据断言从28%降至0.1%，72–122B模型从19–68%降至0–5%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将时间有效性与认知状态显式化，同时表明若无机制禁用对照，图注意力的诊断性指标并不具信息量。

title: Does This Action Still Explain the Task? Reverse Scoring for Diffusion Language Model Agents
summary: Diffusion-based large language models (dLLMs) promise to break the sequential latency bottleneck of autoregressive agents through parallel decoding, but recent evaluations show this efficiency does not transfer to embodied agentic competence: dLLM-backed agents repeatedly fall into retry loops, re-issuing an action long after it has failed. We give a mechanistic account of this failure and a training-free remedy. We trace the retry loop to the adaptivity of masked decoding: the sampler commits the positions it is most confident about and defers the uncertain ones, and at a failure state the context already offers a confident fill for the deferred decision, i.e. the failed action itself, so the retry is committed without the failure feedback ever being confronted. We model the resulting distortion of the action distribution as a task-blind corruption: contextually salient actions (e.g., the action just taken) receive inflated probability by a factor that depends on the state and the action but not on the task. Under this model, we analyse an invariance proposition: the task-blind factor cancels exactly from the reverse conditional, i.e. the likelihood of the task given the state and a candidate action, which coincides with the task posterior of an idealized uncorrupted model. Masked dLLMs evaluate the reverse conditional natively, unlike autoregressive models, by masking the task tokens and denoising, at the cost of a few parallel passes per candidate. We instantiate the rule as Reflect Reverse and evaluate it on four multi-turn embodied benchmarks, where it improves task success and progression rates over forward-scoring baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了扩散式大语言模型（dLLM）驱动的具身智能体陷入"重试循环"的机制，并提出一种无需训练的解码修正方法 Reflect Reverse。
AI.motivation: dLLM 通过并行解码有望打破自回归智能体的顺序延迟瓶颈，但实测显示该效率优势并未转化为具身智能体能力：智能体反复陷入重试循环，在动作已失败很久后仍重复发出同一动作。作者希望给出该失败的机制性解释并提供补救方案。
AI.method: 将重试循环归因于掩码解码的自适应性：采样器优先提交高置信度位置、推迟不确定位置，而在失败状态下上下文已为被推迟的决策提供了高置信度填充（即失败动作本身），导致重试在未面对失败反馈时即被提交。作者将该动作分布扭曲建模为"任务无关的腐蚀"——上下文显著动作的概率被放大一个仅依赖状态与动作、而非任务的因子。据此分析一个不变性命题：该任务无关因子在反向条件（给定状态与候选动作时任务的可能性）中恰好抵消，等价于理想未腐蚀模型的任务后验。掩码 dLLM 可通过屏蔽任务 token 并去噪，以每个候选若干并行轮次原生计算该反向条件。
AI.result: 将上述规则实例化为 Reflect Reverse，并在四个多轮具身基准上评测，相比前向打分基线，任务成功率和推进率均得到提升。
AI.conclusion: dLLM 的重试循环源于掩码解码中任务无关的置信度腐蚀；利用掩码 dLLM 原生可算的反向条件可消除该偏差，无需训练即可改善具身智能体表现。

title: GATE-ST: Gene-Aware Text-image Encoder for Spatial Transcriptomics
summary: Spatial transcriptomics enables spatially resolved gene expression analysis from slide-level images while preserving morphological features, providing valuable information for studying disease mechanisms and developing treatments. However, spatial gene expression profiling typically requires expensive and time-consuming tests. While existing image-based prediction optimizations mostly revolve around including positional embeddings and further image-based changes, text-based optimizations remain relatively unexplored. We present GATE-ST, which incorporates text-based inputs into image-based spatial gene expression predictions. With this approach, generated text descriptions of genes are utilized to better spatial transcriptomics prediction results. Gene summaries are put through a text encoder, generating embeddings that integrate with image embeddings through cross-attention layers to align with morphological features. We demonstrate the effectiveness of such text inputs by benchmarking performance against random gene embeddings and multiple other image-text fusion architectures, and show that GATE-ST outperforms these alternatives. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of GATE-ST in pathology imaging, which may greatly reduce the time and cost of accurate spatial transcriptomic predictions, proving the potential of text-guided spatial gene expression prediction.

AI.tldr: GATE-ST 将基因的文本描述引入基于图像的空间转录组预测，通过文本编码器与图像嵌入的交叉注意力融合，提升预测精度，降低空间基因表达分析的时间与成本。
AI.motivation: 空间转录组能在保留形态特征的同时实现空间分辨的基因表达分析，对疾病机制研究与治疗开发有重要价值，但其检测昂贵且耗时。现有基于图像的预测优化主要集中于位置嵌入与图像层面的改进，基于文本的优化尚缺乏探索。
AI.method: 提出 GATE-ST，在基于图像的空间基因表达预测中引入文本输入。将基因的文本描述（gene summaries）经文本编码器生成文本嵌入，再通过交叉注意力层与图像嵌入融合，从而与形态学特征对齐。
AI.result: 通过与随机基因嵌入以及多种其他图文融合架构进行基准对比，验证了文本输入的有效性，且 GATE-ST 的性能优于这些替代方案。
AI.conclusion: GATE-ST 在病理成像中表现出有效性，有望大幅降低精准空间转录组预测的时间与成本，证明了文本引导的空间基因表达预测的潜力。

title: ReLaG: A Scalable Framework Generalizing Random Splits to Data with Latent Relations
summary: Random splitting can yield non-independent train--test subsets when a dataset contains related samples, as is common in certain applications such as biochemical studies. This leads to overly optimistic generalization estimates. Here, we introduce ReLaG, a modality-agnostic framework that models sample relatedness through a hierarchical latent-variable process and infers groups of related samples using proximity graphs and community detection to produce independent train--test subsets. Across molecular and protein datasets, ReLaG matches existing relation-aware methods while scaling substantially better, enabling splits at previously impractical dataset sizes. We further introduce a label-free procedure that adapts the splitting resolution to production data, aligning evaluation with the intended deployment setting. ReLaG's inferred groups provide a cheap estimate of effective dataset size, enabling diversity-aware dataset scaling. ReLaG is open source and can be installed with pip install relag.

AI.tldr: ReLaG：一种模态无关的框架，通过层次潜变量过程建模样本相关性，结合近邻图与社区检测推断相关样本分组，生成独立的训练-测试子集，并可自适应生产数据的划分分辨率。
AI.motivation: 随机划分在含相关样本的数据集（如生化研究）中会产生非独立的训练-测试子集，导致泛化估计过于乐观。现有关系感知方法在扩展性上受限，难以处理大规模数据集。
AI.method: ReLaG 通过层次潜变量过程建模样本相关性，利用近邻图（proximity graphs）与社区检测（community detection）推断相关样本分组，从而产生独立的训练-测试子集；并引入无标签程序，自适应调整划分分辨率以匹配生产数据与预期部署场景。
AI.result: 在分子与蛋白质数据集上，ReLaG 达到与现有关系感知方法相当的性能，同时扩展性显著更优，可在以往不切实际的数据集规模上进行划分；推断的分组还能廉价估计有效数据集规模，支持多样性感知的数据集扩展。
AI.conclusion: ReLaG 是一个模态无关、开源（pip install relag）的框架，能生成更可靠的独立划分、对齐部署评估，并支持多样性感知的数据集缩放。

title: Budget Boundary Effects in Test-Time Mathematical Reasoning
comment: Accepted as a poster at the 6th Workshop on Mathematical Reasoning and AI (MATH-AI), NeurIPS 2026. 11 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Includes additional post-acceptance accounting and selection diagnostics
summary: A cumulative token cap can fall inside a mathematical derivation, forcing a test-time controller to choose between stopping at the cap (strict) and allowing the current attempt to finish (advisory). We measure this boundary choice with paired offline replays of 19,200 public traces: 120 AIME, BrUMO and HMMT problems and two archive configurations of one model. Candidate order and a 16-attempt cap are fixed, and answer selection is blind to reference answers and correctness labels. Three findings emerge. First, at the 4k cap, most advisory accuracy gains replace abstention with a correct answer; strict stopping pays for an unfinished prefix that the completed-only selector cannot use. Second, comparisons along realized cost differ from same-cap comparisons: advisory 4k in low has higher accuracy than strict 8k at comparable mean completion cost, while in high its observed accuracy is 0.42 points below strict 32k using 59% of its mean tokens. These aggregate comparisons do not establish equal-compute superiority or accuracy equivalence. Third, increased candidate coverage does not guarantee higher answer accuracy: a log-probability selector loses accuracy while coverage rises, including after a source-grade consistency repair. Same-cap majority-accuracy differences shrink below 1.3 percentage points at 32k. Budget curves should jointly state the cap, realized cost, eligible candidates, stopping rule and selector information.

AI.tldr: 论文测量测试时算力上限处的“严格停止 vs 建议式完成”边界选择：基于19,200条公开轨迹的配对离线回放（120道AIME/BrUMO/HMMT题、两套模型归档配置、固定候选顺序与16次尝试上限），发现建议式在4k上限下多以正确答案替换弃权、同上限比较与同实际成本比较结论不同、候选覆盖增加不一定提升答案准确率；同上限多数投票准确率差异在32k下缩小至1.3个百分点以内。作者建议预算曲线应同时报告上限、实际成本、可用候选、停止规则与选择器信息。
AI.motivation: 测试时控制器遇到累计token上限恰好落在数学推导中途时，必须在“严格在上限处停止”与“建议式让当前尝试完成”之间抉择，但这一边界选择对准确率与成本的影响缺乏系统测量。作者希望厘清该选择在真实成本约束下的收益来源，并纠正同上限比较与同成本比较、候选覆盖与答案准确率之间被混淆的关系。
AI.method: 采用配对离线回放（paired offline replays）：19,200条公开轨迹，包含120道AIME、BrUMO与HMMT题目，以及同一模型的两套归档配置。固定候选顺序与16次尝试上限；答案选择对参考答案与正确性标签盲化，仅依赖可用的选择器信息，对比严格停止与建议式完成在不同token上限（4k、8k、32k）下的表现，并分析实际成本、候选覆盖与选择器（如对数概率选择器、源码级一致性修复）的影响。
AI.result: （1）在4k上限下，建议式带来的准确率增益主要来自用正确答案替换弃权；严格停止则因未完成的推理前缀无法被“仅完成样本”选择器利用而付出代价。（2）沿实际成本比较与同上限比较结论不同：低配置中建议式4k在相近平均完成成本下准确率高于严格8k；高配置中建议式观测准确率比严格32k低0.42个百分点，但仅用其59%的平均token。这些聚合比较不能证明等算力优越性或准确率等价。（3）候选覆盖增加不保证答案准确率提升：对数概率选择器在覆盖率上升时准确率反而下降，即使经过源码级一致性修复亦然。在32k下，同上限多数投票准确率差异缩小至1.3个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: 关于预算边界的结论应谨慎表述：聚合成本比较无法确立等算力优势或准确率等价。报告预算曲线时应联合给出token上限、实际成本、可用候选集合、停止规则与选择器可获取的信息，以避免由比较口径不同导致的误导性结论。

title: When a Flatness Proxy Is Not a Function: Robustness Certificates and Training Interventions
summary: A valid curvature upper bound need not justify either a robustness certificate or an intervention on an intrinsic predictor property. We demonstrate this distinction for a last-layer relative-flatness proxy used in both settings. First, empirical-risk stationarity does not eliminate pointwise first-order loss terms: at a finite global empirical-risk minimum, the retained certificate expression underestimates a loss increase by over $210\times$. We derive a globally valid, gauge-invariant feature-space repair. Second, common-row softmax shifts preserve predictions and the exact contraction while making the proxy unbounded. Even standard reference-class choices double it on average relative to the centered representation. For a single fixed-feature example with at least three classes, scalar retuning generically cannot align the induced probability updates. Row centering gives the orbit-minimized bound and restores value and full-model gradient invariance under this symmetry. Across 45 paired one-step tests on algorithmic and image models, amplified shifts separate raw-regularized predictors while quotient-regularized predictors remain aligned. Long-horizon CIFAR-10 experiments show substantial, reversible suppression of generalization, while evidence for selective delay after memorization is less consistent. Together, these results show that validity as a curvature upper bound does not by itself justify either inversion into a robustness certificate or differentiation into an intrinsic training intervention.

AI.tldr: 该文区分了"曲率上界有效性"与"鲁棒性证书/内在干预正当性"：一个用于最后一层的相对平坦度代理虽可为有效曲率上界，却不足以支撑证书反演或训练干预，作者给出规范不变的修复并提出行中心化方案。
AI.motivation: 最后一层相对平坦度代理被同时用于构造鲁棒性证书和作为内在训练干预（正则化），但"是有效的曲率上界"与"可正当化这两种用途"是两回事。论文旨在揭示这种推理跳跃中的失效，并给出可修复、规范不变的替代方案。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：检验全局经验风险极小点处代理的证书表达（点式一阶损失项未被消除）；2) 构造并证明全局有效、规范不变的特征空间修复；3) 分析常见"行共享 softmax 平移"对称性（保持预测与收缩性，却使代理无界），比较参考类选择与中心化表示；4) 单固定特征、≥3类情形下考察标量重调的不可对齐性；5) 提出行中心化得到轨道最小化上界并恢复值与全模型梯度不变性；6) 实验：45组配对一步测试（算法与图像模型）、长时程 CIFAR-10。
AI.result: 在有限全局经验风险极小点处，保留的证书表达把损失增幅低估超过210倍；常见行共享 softmax 平移使代理无界，标准参考类选择平均使代理翻倍；单固定特征、≥3类时标量重调一般无法对齐诱导的概率更新；行中心化给出轨道最小上界并恢复不变性。45组配对一步测试中，放大的平移分离了原始正则化预测器，而商（quotient）正则化预测器保持对齐；长时程 CIFAR-10 显示对泛化的大幅且可逆抑制，而"记忆后选择性延迟"的证据不够一致。
AI.conclusion: 作为曲率上界的有效性本身并不足以正当化将其反演为鲁棒性证书或微分为内在训练干预；需要规范不变、轨道最小化的修复形式（如行中心化）才能在相应用途下保持合理性与不变性。

title: Staying on Task: Testing the Foundations of Long-Horizon Agent Reliability
summary: Long-horizon agentic workflows require models to sustain repeated state-dependent actions all while the context grows, sub-task complexity changes, and new data arrives. Each situation represents an independent axis along which an agent may fail. An agent reconciling a long ledger, for example, must repeatedly read its state, update the correct record, and preserve alignment across thousands of outputs. A model may accept the entire ledger yet lose its place or stop applying the operation consistently as generation proceeds.
