We introduce Long-Transduction, a controlled diagnostic that tests a model's ability to stay on task during long generation while continuously reading, mutating, and outputting input-context dependent operations such as arithmetic, sorting, variable lookups, and table transformations. Long-Transduction evaluation independently varies local task complexity, input data formatting, and context length isolate failures along each axis. We evaluate seven open-weight models, finding a 62.8\% decrease when scaling context length from 4-128K, a 36.5\% decrease when varying input format, and a 39.9\% decrease by increasing local task complexity. Together, these failures represent critical liabilities in long-horizon agentic workflows.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Long-Transduction 诊断基准，用于在长生成过程中持续执行依赖上下文的读、改、写操作，并独立操控局部复杂度、输入格式与上下文长度三条轴来定位模型失效。评估七个开源权重模型发现：上下文从 4K 扩到 128K 性能下降 62.8%，输入格式变化导致下降 36.5%，局部任务复杂度提升导致下降 39.9%。
AI.motivation: 长时程（long-horizon）智能体工作流要求模型在上下文不断增长、子任务复杂度变化、新数据持续到达的情况下，反复执行依赖状态的独立动作，每一类情况都是一条潜在的失效轴。现有评估难以将失败归因到具体维度，例如模型可能完整接受整本账目却在生成过程中丢失位置或无法一致地施加操作，因此需要可控诊断来隔离各轴的失效。
AI.method: 提出 Long-Transduction 受控诊断任务，测试模型在长生成中持续读取、变更、输出依赖输入上下文的操作（如算术、排序、变量查找、表格变换）。该评估独立改变三个变量：局部任务复杂度、输入数据格式、上下文长度，从而沿每条轴隔离失败。对七个开源权重模型进行评测。
AI.result: 上下文长度从 4K 扩展到 128K 时性能下降 62.8%；改变输入格式导致下降 36.5%；提高局部任务复杂度导致下降 39.9%。
AI.conclusion: 这些失败共同构成长时程智能体工作流中的关键风险（critical liabilities），表明现有模型在长生成下的状态依赖操作鲁棒性严重不足，需针对性改进。

title: Towards Universal Wasserstein Barycenters through Flow Matching
summary: Defining a weighted mean over probability measures under probability metrics is a central tool in probabilistic machine learning. Under the Wasserstein metric, these are called \emph{Wasserstein barycenters}. While most approaches compute barycenters for a fixed weight vector, approximating the whole family of barycenters over the simplex, which we call the \emph{Wasserstein simplex}, remains underexplored. We refer to this problem as \emph{Universal Barycenter Approximation}, and propose \texttt{BaryFM}, a flow matching model transporting the marginal measures into any barycenter in the Wasserstein simplex. Once trained, the network can draw samples from measures in the Wasserstein simplex through an ordinary differential equation. We validate our method on 4 downstream tasks: domain adaptation, generalization, Bayesian posterior aggregation and algorithmic fairness. \texttt{BaryFM} achieves the best average rank among 15 competing methods across 10 domain adaptation benchmarks, matching or surpassing non-universal solvers.

AI.tldr: 提出BaryFM，用流匹配模型实现对Wasserstein单纯形（所有权重下的重心族）的通用逼近，一次训练即可通过ODE采样任意权重对应的重心，在4类下游任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 现有Wasserstein重心方法多针对固定权重向量求解，难以覆盖整个权重单纯形上重心族的连续变化，即"通用重心逼近"问题研究不足；且多数解需要针对每个权重重新优化，计算代价高。
AI.method: 将通用重心逼近形式化为学习一个流匹配（flow matching）模型，把边缘测度输运到Wasserstein单纯形中的任意重心；训练后通过网络求解常微分方程（ODE）即可从目标重心中采样，权重作为条件输入实现单一模型覆盖整个单纯形。
AI.result: 在4类下游任务（域适应、泛化、贝叶斯后验聚合、算法公平性）上验证；在10个域适应基准上，于15种对比方法中取得最佳平均排名，性能可匹配或超越非通用（non-universal）求解器。
AI.conclusion: BaryFM表明用生成式流匹配建模可高效逼近整个Wasserstein重心族，避免逐权重重求解，是通用重心逼近的有效方案，具备良好的下游适用性与竞争力。

title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
summary: Modern multimodal models bring generation and understanding into a single unified system, which enables them to provide and learn from their own feedback. Motivated by this unified capacity, we introduce UniEvo-VL, a self-evolving framework for multimodal models to learn from this constructive self-correction feedback during test-time compute. Instead of relying on a separate, often larger, teacher, we leverage their self-critiques as privileged information and ask a single multimodal model to act as both teacher and student with different contexts. The student only sees the vanilla question, while the teacher conditions on the privileged critique. Then training minimizes the per-state divergence between their denoising diffusion distributions over the student's own sampling trajectories. Experiments demonstrate that UniEvo-VL improves the image generation capabilities of multimodal models, while maintaining their sensitivity to additional reflection information. Specifically, we build on top of the open-source Qwen-image-2512 and observe a significant performance gain from 0.747 to 0.808 on GenEval and from 32.97 to 35.53 on GenEval2 Soft-TIFA. Moreover, attempts with more powerful external critics (e.g., GPT5.6-Luna) show that multimodal models with strong judge capabilities can anticipate a higher self-evolving ceiling. Last but not least, mixed text-rendering outcomes show that our self-improvements may not be uniform across different tasks. Our study aims to shed light on the current hot recursive self-improvement research line to enhance the user experience when using multimodal models without external supervision or guidance.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniEvo-VL 自进化框架，让单一多模态模型在测试时以自我批判作为特权信息，同时扮演教师与学生，通过师生去噪分布对齐实现自我提升。
AI.motivation: 现代多模态模型已统一生成与理解，可自我提供并利用反馈；但现有自我改进依赖独立且更大的外部教师模型，缺乏在无外部监督下利用自身反馈进行递归自进化的方案。
AI.method: 将模型自身批判视为特权信息：学生仅见原始问题，教师以批判为条件；在学生的采样轨迹上，最小化二者去噪扩散分布的逐状态（per-state）散度，实现同一模型双上下文下的师生训练。
AI.result: 基于 Qwen-image-2512，GenEval 从 0.747 提升至 0.808，GenEval2 Soft-TIFA 从 32.97 提升至 35.53；使用更强外部批判者（如 GPT5.6-Luna）可提高自进化上限；混合文本渲染任务表现不均，改进非均匀。
AI.conclusion: UniEvo-VL 在不依赖外部监督或引导的条件下提升多模态模型的图像生成能力并保留对反思信息的敏感性，为递归自我改进研究提供参考；但自改进在不同任务上存在不均衡性。

title: The Advantages of Fresh Sketching for Ridge Regression
summary: Over the past 25 years, sketching and sampling have become widely used tools for accelerating large-scale regression. In iterative randomized solvers, a basic design choice is whether to $\textit{reuse}$ the same sketch or draw $\textit{fresh}$ randomness at every step. For (under-constrained) iterative ridge regression with column sampling, whether fresh sketches offer provable advantages has remained open: $\textit{We show that they do.}$ Fresh sketching lets us analyze error only along the current residual solution, rather than uniformly over the entire Gram matrix. This directional view yields sharper convergence guarantees for leverage score and ridge leverage score sampling and, more importantly, leads to residual-aware sampling rules. By minimizing the variance of the relevant sketched matrix-vector product, we derive an oracle distribution and practical approximations to the oracle distribution, including a mixture sampling distribution with (somewhat weaker) convergence guarantees. Experiments on synthetic and real data, including ridge probes on Qwen2.5 representations, support our theory, showing substantially faster convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在欠约束迭代岭回归中，每步重新抽取草图（fresh sketching）相比复用固定草图具有可证明的优势，并据此提出残差感知采样规则与近优分布，加速收敛。
AI.motivation: 过去25年，草图与采样成为大规模回归加速的常用工具。在迭代式随机求解器中，核心设计选择是复用同一草图还是每步重抽随机性。对于带列采样的（欠约束）迭代岭回归，fresh sketch 是否具有可证明优势一直是开放问题。本文旨在回答该问题并给出理论保证。
AI.method: 证明 fresh sketching 的优势：可仅在当前残差解方向上分析误差，而非在整个 Gram 矩阵上一致分析。该"方向性视角"为 leverage score 与 ridge leverage score 采样提供更紧的收敛保证，并引出残差感知采样规则。通过最小化相关草图矩阵-向量乘积的方差，推导出 oracle 分布及其实际近似，包括带（略弱）收敛保证的混合采样分布。
AI.result: 为 leverage score 和 ridge leverage score 采样给出更锐利的收敛界；导出 oracle 分布及实用近似，含混合采样分布及其收敛保证。在合成与真实数据上的实验（包括 Qwen2.5 表示的 ridge probe）支持理论，显示收敛显著加快。
AI.conclusion: fresh sketching 在欠约束迭代岭回归中具有可证明优势，方向性误差分析与残差感知采样规则能显著加速收敛，理论与实验一致。

title: Code to Control: Synthesizing Parameterized Reactive Controllers
summary: Recent LLM-based approaches to control either invoke a language model to select actions or synthesize world models that require planning at every decision, introducing latency that can limit real-time use. We introduce Code to Control, an approach that synthesizes Python controllers which execute directly as policies. Code to Control separates program structure from parameters. An LLM synthesizes the controller structure, while derivative-free search fits its parameters for continuous control using feedback from the environment. Once learned, the resulting controllers require neither LLM inference nor planning at decision time, enabling real-time gameplay and, under our timing protocol, faster action selection than a PPO policy. Across a suite of Atari games, Flappy Bird, and MuJoCo tasks, Code to Control outperforms planning-based program synthesis methods, remains competitive with deep reinforcement learning while using fewer environment interactions, transfers across substantial changes in environment dynamics, and scales to complex locomotion tasks.

AI.tldr: Code to Control 提出将程序结构与参数分离，用 LLM 合成 Python 控制器结构、再用无导数搜索拟合参数，从而在决策时无需 LLM 推理或规划，实现实时控制并优于基于规划的程序合成方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的控制方法要么调用语言模型选择动作，要么合成需要在每个决策步进行规划的世界模型，导致延迟高，难以用于实时场景。
AI.method: Code to Control 将程序结构与环境参数解耦：由 LLM 合成控制器结构，同时采用无导数搜索，借助环境反馈为连续控制拟合其参数；学习完成后，所得控制器在决策时既不需要 LLM 推理也不需要规划。
AI.result: 在 Atari 游戏套件、Flappy Bird 和 MuJoCo 任务上，该方法优于基于规划的程序合成方法，与深度强化学习相比具有竞争力且环境交互更少；同时能跨环境动力学的显著变化进行迁移，并可扩展到复杂运动任务；在其实时性协议下动作选择速度快于 PPO 策略。
AI.conclusion: 将结构合成与参数拟合分离可生成无需决策时推理或规划的轻量 Python 控制器，兼顾实时性、样本效率、迁移能力与任务可扩展性。

title: FlexRouter: Learning Complementary Model Sets for Flexible LLM Routing
summary: Existing Large Language Model (LLM) routing methods score LLMs independently to select top-$k$ models. However, this ignores model correlations and enforces a rigid computational budget. Consequently, routers often select redundant models that share failure modes, limiting the overall probability of success. To address this, we propose FlexRouter, a routing framework that explicitly models model complementarity. FlexRouter optimizes for \textit{answer coverage}, maximizing the probability that at least one selected model yields a correct response. This objective aligns with practical inference pipelines where multiple candidate outputs are generated and a downstream verifier or user selects the final one. We formulate routing as a coverage-oriented subset selection problem and model the routing policy using Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs), which naturally capture both model competence and redundancy. To directly optimize coverage without requiring a ground-truth target subset, we introduce a training objective based on marginalizing over failure sets. During inference, we employ a greedy strategy based on marginal log-determinant gains, enabling the router to adaptively determine subset sizes without a predefined budget. Extensive experiments on the large-scale RouterEval benchmark demonstrate that our proposed FlexRouter achieves higher coverage with lower redundancy across both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks than strong baselines while maintaining flexible inference cost.

AI.tldr: FlexRouter提出一种基于行列式点过程（DPP）的LLM路由框架，通过显式建模模型互补性并优化"答案覆盖"概率，在无需预定义预算的情况下自适应选择子集，在RouterEval上取得更高覆盖率和更低冗余。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由方法独立地为各模型打分并选取top-k，忽略了模型间的相关性，并强制固定计算预算。这导致路由器常选出共享失败模式的冗余模型，降低了整体成功率。因此需要一种能显式建模模型互补性、并灵活调整选择规模的路由方法。
AI.method: 将路由形式化为面向覆盖的子集选择问题，用行列式点过程（DPP）建模路由策略，DPP可同时刻画模型能力与冗余度。为无需真值目标子集即可直接优化覆盖，提出基于对失败集边缘化的训练目标。推理时采用基于边缘对数行列式增益的贪心策略，自适应确定子集大小。
AI.result: 在RouterEval大规模基准上的大量实验表明，FlexRouter在域内和域外任务上均比强基线实现更高覆盖率、更低冗余，同时保持灵活的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模模型互补性并以覆盖率为优化目标，FlexRouter克服了传统top-k路由的冗余与刚性预算问题，验证了覆盖导向路由在实际多候选生成+验证流程中的有效性。

title: NeurDuo-EEG: A Long-Sequence EEG Foundation Model with Persistent State and Explicit Memory
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG) is recorded continuously over hours, with relevant dynamics spanning timescales from milliseconds to hours. Most EEG foundation models nevertheless process fixed windows independently, limiting their ability to capture information encoded in long-timescale dynamics. State-space architectures enable persistent recurrent processing, but long-range information remains implicitly compressed in recurrent states. We present NeurDuo-EEG, a causal EEG foundation model with channel-resolved persistent memory. NeurDuo-EEG introduces multi-timescale memory management with learned consolidation and selective retrieval, enabling persistent modelling of continuous EEG with fixed-size state. It is pre-trained on 3,955 hours of EEG from 17 public datasets using multichannel autoregressive prediction of discrete spectral codes. Across three short-window and two long-sequence downstream tasks, NeurDuo-EEG achieves the best performance on four of five benchmarks, including all three short-window tasks and seizure detection, where AUC-PR improves from $0.285$ to $0.471$ over the strongest non-NeurDuo baseline. NeurDuo-EEG also remains competitive on sleep staging and supports efficient streaming inference, with nearly constant per-chunk latency as the available history grows to one hour. Notably, the Small variant achieves this with only 4.7M backbone parameters. These results demonstrate the value of persistent, multi-timescale modelling for both long-sequence and short-window EEG analysis. Our code is available at https://github.com/YifaNNW/NeurDuo-EEG.

AI.tldr: 提出因果脑电基础模型NeurDuo-EEG，采用通道级持久记忆与多时间尺度记忆管理，在连续长时序脑电建模上实现最佳性能与高效流式推理。
AI.motivation: 脑电信号被连续记录数小时，其相关动态跨越毫秒至小时级时间尺度；但多数脑电基础模型独立处理固定时间窗，无法捕捉长时程动态信息。状态空间架构虽支持持续递归处理，长程信息仍被隐式压缩在递归状态中，缺乏有效机制。
AI.method: NeurDuo-EEG引入通道级持久记忆，结合多时间尺度记忆管理、学习式记忆固化与选择性检索，以固定大小状态实现连续脑电的持久建模；使用离散频谱码的多通道自回归预测，在17个公开数据集共3,955小时脑电上进行预训练。
AI.result: 在三个短窗任务与两个长序列下游任务中，该方法在五项基准中四项取得最优，包括全部三个短窗任务与癫痫检测（AUC-PR由0.285提升至0.471）；在睡眠分期上保持竞争力，并支持高效流式推理，历史增长至一小时时每块延迟近乎恒定。Small变体仅用4.7M主干参数即达此效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明持久化、多时间尺度建模对长序列与短窗脑电分析均具价值，为连续脑电基础模型提供了兼顾性能与推理效率的方案。

title: Self-Evolving Algorithm-Design Agents: Escaping In-Context Evolutionary Stagnation via Population-Curated Policy Optimization
summary: Large language models are increasingly participating in complex real-world tasks in the form of algorithm-design agents, designing and refining algorithms. Many successful algorithm-design agents adopt pure in-context evolutionary frameworks, but they may quickly plateau in domains that require specialized knowledge. Parametric adaptation offers a way to internalize specialized knowledge, but conventional training requires abundant domain-specific corpora while high-quality algorithms are scarce in complex algorithm-design scenarios. In this paper, we propose sample-efficient parametric self-evolution where agents can explore and learn from self-generated algorithms. First, we characterize in-context evolutionary stagnation and analytically propose the Improvement Chain proposition, showing how learning successive self-generated algorithms can locally increase the likelihood of neighboring algorithms. Motivated by this local-transfer perspective, we further propose Population-Curated Policy Optimization (PCPO) to utilize a global population and a hybrid policy update scheme for retaining and reusing high-quality, diverse self-generated algorithms, shifting the policy towards stronger algorithms. In the task of learning rate schedule design for global placement in electronic design automation, trained only on 4 chip cases, PCPO outperforms the state-of-the-art in-context evolutionary methods (e.g., OpenEvolve and ShinkaEvolve) on average across 16 chip cases. With an 8B-size base model, PCPO achieves competitive performance compared to frontier closed-source models such as GPT-5.5. PCPO also reduces inference-time token cost by internalizing grounded domain knowledge and prompt distillation. Moreover, PCPO achieves significant speedups on four GPU kernel designs, with an average of 8.27$\times$ speedup against the PyTorch Eager baseline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"样本高效的参数化自演化"框架，让算法设计智能体从自身生成的算法中探索学习。基于"改进链"命题的局部迁移视角，提出PCPO方法，利用全局种群与混合策略更新保留并复用高质量、多样化的自生成算法。在电子设计自动化（EDA）的全局布局学习率调度中，仅用4个芯片案例训练，即在16个案例上平均超越OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve等SOTA上下文演化方法；8B基座模型性能可比GPT-5.5等前沿闭源模型，并显著降低推理token开销，在4个GPU内核设计上平均获得8.27倍加速。
AI.motivation: 纯上下文演化框架的算法设计智能体在需要专业知识的领域容易快速陷入平台期；而参数化适应虽能内化专业知识，却在复杂算法设计场景中面临高质量算法稀缺、缺乏充足领域语料的困境。因此需要一种样本高效、能从自生成算法中学习的参数化自演化方法。
AI.method: 1）刻画上下文演化停滞现象，解析性地提出"改进链（Improvement Chain）"命题，证明学习连续的自生成算法可局部提升相邻算法出现的可能性；2）基于该局部迁移视角，提出种群策展策略优化（Population-Curated Policy Optimization, PCPO），采用全局种群与混合策略更新方案，保留并复用高质量、多样化的自生成算法，使策略向更强算法迁移。
AI.result: 在EDA全局布局的学习率调度设计任务中，仅用4个芯片案例训练，PCPO在16个芯片案例上平均超越OpenEvolve、ShinkaEvolve等SOTA上下文演化方法；使用8B规模基座模型即可与GPT-5.5等前沿闭源模型性能相当；通过内化领域知识与提示蒸馏降低了推理阶段token成本；在4个GPU内核设计上平均取得8.27倍于PyTorch Eager基线的加速。
AI.conclusion: 参数化自演化可在样本受限条件下有效突破上下文演化的平台期。PCPO通过全局种群策展与混合策略更新，将自生成的高质量算法内化为模型参数，兼顾性能、效率与泛化，验证了局部迁移视角在复杂算法设计任务中的可行性。

title: Reinforcement Learning with Complex (valued) Memories
comment: 19 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning 2026
summary: Partially observable environments pose a fundamental challenge in deep reinforcement learning, requiring agents to compress temporal information from observations and maintain a memory to make effective decisions. While there exist many approaches ranging from gated recurrence to attention mechanisms and model-based RL, the search for effective representational techniques that can capture long-term dependencies remains an active area of research. In this work we revisit Unitary recurrent networks (uRNNs) [Arjovsky et al., 2016, Jing et al., 2017], that demonstrated superior gradient flow and associative recall, expressing the recurrence and the hidden state in a complex vector space. Their norm preserving unitary dynamics enable information propagation through long sequences. To this end, we propose three different versions of uRNNs as drop-in replacements for recurrent PPO architectures, and demonstrate that the simple recurrence and the added degree of freedom from the phase of the complex representations enable significant gains over baselines on several memory-improvable tasks, including continuous control. We further explore how to preserve the phase information of the complex hidden state for a phase-aware policy by drawing a parallel to how quantum states are measured. With our methods reaching up to 2-3 $\times$ the reward in environments like rocksample and Craftax compared to the baselines, this work points towards an exciting new direction of representations for RL and the problem of partial observability. Code is available at: https://github.com/Sathya98/qurl

AI.tldr: 本文将酉循环网络(uRNN)作为循环PPO架构的替代方案引入深度强化学习，利用复数隐状态的保范酉动力学改进部分可观测环境下的长时依赖建模，并提出相位感知策略。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测环境是深度强化学习的核心挑战，智能体需要在压缩时序信息的同时维持记忆以做出有效决策。尽管已有门控循环、注意力机制和基于模型的RL等方法，如何有效捕捉长期依赖的表征技术仍是活跃的研究问题。uRNN此前展现出优越的梯度流和联想记忆能力，但在RL领域尚未被充分利用。
AI.method: 作者重新审视酉循环网络(uRNN)，其将循环和隐状态表达在复数向量空间中，保范的酉动力学使信息能在长序列中传播。工作中提出三种不同版本的uRNN，作为循环PPO架构的直接替代(drop-in replacement)，利用复数表示的简单循环和相位带来的额外自由度。此外，作者类比量子态的测量方式，探索如何为相位感知策略保留复数隐状态的相位信息。
AI.result: 在多个可改进记忆的任务上，包括连续控制任务，提出的方法相较基线取得显著收益。在rocksample和Craftax等环境中，奖励最高达到基线的2-3倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为RL中的表征学习和部分可观测性问题指出了一条富有前景的新方向：以复数空间中的酉循环表征结合相位感知策略，可有效提升记忆相关任务的表现。

title: PathAnchor: Path-Structured Evidence for Scientific Agents
summary: Scientific agents can retrieve relevant passages yet still lose functional order, mix evidence across sources, or state conclusions that exceed the retrieved record. We introduce PathAnchor, a bounded scientific reasoning system built on path-structured evidence workspaces. Instead of treating passages or extracted concepts as independent units, the system retrieves source-linked Material-Sensor-Signal-System trajectories that preserve role, direction, and the evidence supporting each transition. A controller uses three read-only tools to search paper-specific trajectories, trace paths across candidate sources, and open exact evidence before producing a claim-cited answer and an explicit evidence boundary. On 120 single- and cross-paper flexible-sensor questions, PathAnchor scores 82.6% and leads six evaluated systems. Under a matched controller, corpus, and six-call budget, replacing unordered concept graphs with path-structured records raises source recall from 61.3% to 82.9%, increases answers whose claims all cite opened evidence from 69.2% to 90.0%, and reduces tool calls. These results show that evidence organization affects retrieval and citation completeness under fixed agent resources.

AI.tldr: PathAnchor 是一个基于路径结构化证据工作区的有界科学推理系统，通过保留角色、方向和证据的 Material-Sensor-Signal-System 轨迹检索，在 120 个柔性传感器问题上取得 82.6% 的成绩，优于六个对比系统。
AI.motivation: 现有科学智能体虽能检索相关段落，但仍会丢失功能顺序、混淆多来源证据，或给出超出检索记录的结论。核心问题在于将段落或抽取概念视为独立单元，忽略证据的结构性组织。
AI.method: 提出 PathAnchor 系统，构建路径结构化证据工作区：检索保留角色、方向及每次转换证据的源链接 Material-Sensor-Signal-System 轨迹，而非独立段落或概念。控制器使用三个只读工具——搜索特定论文轨迹、跨候选源追踪路径、打开精确证据——最终产出带引用的答案与明确的证据边界。在匹配的控制器、语料和六次调用预算下与无序概念图进行对照。
AI.result: 在 120 个单篇及跨篇柔性传感器问题上得分 82.6%，领先六个参评系统。匹配条件下，以路径结构化记录替换无序概念图使源召回率从 61.3% 升至 82.9%，全部声明均引用已打开证据的答案比例从 69.2% 升至 90.0%，并减少工具调用次数。
AI.conclusion: 证据组织方式在固定智能体资源下影响检索效果与引用完整性，路径结构化证据优于无序概念图。

title: JARQ: Joint Alternating Refinement for Quantization
summary: Group-wise post-training quantizers for large language models round weights onto a grid that is not refit to the resulting integer codes. We show that this leaves accuracy on the table: the best grid depends on the codes, input correlations couple the errors of different groups, and useful code changes often involve many codes at once. We propose JARQ , a plug-in refinement that starts from any group-wise quantizer and alternates a joint least-squares fit of all group scales with bounded Babai proposals that move many codes of a group together on the current grid. The problem is a bilinear box-constrained mixed-integer least-squares problem; the solver is backpropagation-free, does not increase the layer-wise objective under exact scale solves, and keeps the host's bit width, groups, zero points, and inference cost. Across Llama-2, Llama-3, and Qwen models with RTN, GPTQ, OmniQuant, and AWQ hosts, JARQ lowers perplexity in 90 of 96 comparisons, cuts three-bit RTN perplexity by up to 36%, raises mean multiple-choice accuracy in 23 of 24 configurations, and improves QEP, QuaRot, and OJBKQ outputs, at under a minute per 7B block.

AI.tldr: 提出JARQ，一种组式训练后量化器的插件式精修方法，通过联合最小二乘拟合尺度与有界Babai提议交替优化，在不改变位宽、分组、零点与推理成本的前提下降低困惑度并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有组式训练后量化器将权重量化到未根据生成的整数编码重新拟合的网格上，导致精度损失。作者指出三个原因：最优网格依赖于编码；输入相关性使不同组的误差相互耦合；有用的编码改动往往涉及大量编码同时变化。
AI.method: JARQ从任意组式量化器出发，交替执行两步：对所有组尺度进行联合最小二乘拟合，以及有界Babai提议，在当前网格上一次性移动一组中的多个编码。该问题为双线性、箱约束的混合整数最小二乘问题；求解器无需反向传播，在精确尺度求解下不增加逐层目标，并保持宿主量化器的位宽、分组、零点与推理成本。
AI.result: 在Llama-2、Llama-3与Qwen模型上，以RTN、GPTQ、OmniQuant、AWQ为宿主，JARQ在96项比较中的90项降低困惑度；三位RTN困惑度最多降低36%；在24种配置中的23种提升平均多项选择准确率；并改善QEP、QuaRot与OJBKQ的输出，7B模型每个块耗时不足一分钟。
AI.conclusion: JARQ是一种通用、低开销的量化后精修插件，可普遍提升多种组式量化器与模型的精度，且不改变部署约束与推理成本。

title: Action Conditioned Bisimulation For GUI Agent Memory
summary: An agent that remembers what it did on a web page must decide when two pages count as the same. Memories built on observation similarity merge pages that look alike but behave differently, and GUIs are full of such pages: two tabs of one widget or two rows of one menu answer the same click differently. We define the merge rule as an action-conditioned bisimulation over the empirical predictive state graph a frozen agent fills as it acts. Two states merge only when their shared actions lead to agreeing outcomes and successor blocks under an affordance label. Observation similarity never enters the rule, and nothing is trained. It replaces the merge rule of an existing outcome-value memory, so a closed-loop comparison isolates it. On MiniWoB++ it raises success rate over a memoryless agent, while a control taking identical exploratory detours, the prior successor-representation merge, and the same criterion without action conditioning change nothing.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于动作条件双模拟（action-conditioned bisimulation）的记忆合并规则，用于解决网页代理中"何时两个页面算作同一页面"的问题，合并规则不依赖观测相似度，且无需训练。
AI.motivation: 基于观测相似度构建记忆的代理会错误地合并外观相似但行为不同的页面，而GUI中这类页面大量存在：同一控件的两个标签页或同一菜单的两行，对相同点击的响应不同。因此需要一个基于行为而非外观的合并准则。
AI.method: 将合并规则定义为冻结代理在行动过程中填充的经验预测状态图（empirical predictive state graph）上的动作条件双模拟：仅当两个状态在共享动作下导致一致的结果，且在某个可供性标签（affordance label）下后继块一致时，才将其合并。观测相似度不参与该规则，且整个过程不进行任何训练。该规则替换了现有结果价值记忆（outcome-value memory）的合并规则，从而通过闭环对比隔离其效果。
AI.result: 在MiniWoB++上，该方法相比无记忆代理提高了成功率；而采用相同探索绕路（exploratory detours）的对照、先前基于后继表示（successor-representation）的合并方法，以及去掉动作条件的同一准则，均未带来任何变化。
AI.conclusion: 基于动作条件的双模拟合并规则能够在不训练、不使用观测相似度的前提下有效提升网页代理的记忆与任务成功率，且效果来源于动作条件化本身，而非泛化的探索或先前后继表示方法。

title: Learning-Enabled Estimation: Tight Characterizations under Sample Selection Biases
summary:
When can we learn from biased samples? We study regression when outcomes are observed only after passing through selection filters that depend on both covariates and outcomes themselves, a ubiquitous challenge spanning clinical trials with patient dropout, labor markets with self-selection, and auctions with strategic entry. Ignoring such selection yields systematically biased conclusions with real-world consequences. This challenge has a long history in econometrics and statistics, starting with Heckman's seminal two-stage model and followed by numerous generalizations. While these works provide various sufficient conditions for identification, a complete characterization of when such regression is possible has remained elusive.
  In this work, we provide a characterization for when regression is possible in the presence of sample selection bias. Our results establish the minimal assumptions required on the functional forms of selection processes under which regression remains possible, which are particularly relevant in modern settings where selection mechanisms are increasingly complex and opaque. As a corollary of our characterization, we show that there are settings where the regression function can be identified even when the selection filter itself cannot. This observation already goes beyond the ``estimate selection filter, then debias regression'' paradigm that is followed by virtually all existing approaches. Under natural strengthenings of our identification conditions, we also establish finite-sample estimation guarantees with explicit convergence rates and provide oracle-efficient algorithms. This yields the first general-purpose estimation method for this broad class of selection problems. Finally, we explore the implications of our results for several well-studied econometric settings with complex selection mechanisms such as auctions with entry costs and labor markets.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了在样本选择偏差下回归函数可识别所需的最小假设条件，并给出有限样本估计保证与有效算法，突破了"先估计选择过滤器再纠偏"的传统范式。
AI.motivation: 样本选择偏差广泛存在于临床试验患者脱落、劳动力市场自选择、拍卖策略性进入等场景，忽视选择会带来系统性偏差。自Heckman两阶段模型以来的工作多给出充分条件，但"何时回归可识别"的完整刻画仍属空白。
AI.method: 作者对选择过程函数形式所需的最小假设进行刻画，建立识别性的充要条件；在此条件下，通过自然的强化假设推导有限样本估计保证，给出显式收敛率与oracle-efficient算法。
AI.result: 得到样本选择偏差下回归可识别性的完整刻画；证明存在选择过滤器本身不可识别、但回归函数仍可识别的设定；在强化条件下获得带显式收敛率的有限样本估计保证，并给出该选择问题类首个通用估计方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅厘清了回归在何种条件下可从有偏样本中学习，还表明无需先恢复选择过滤器即可实现纠偏，并将结论应用于进入成本拍卖、劳动力市场等复杂选择机制的经济学场景。

title: Persona and Persuasive Framing in AI Voice Agents: A $2\times2$ Field Experiment with Children
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), 2027
summary: Conversational agents increasingly interact with children, yet evidence on how their design shapes children's susceptibility to persuasion comes almost entirely from the lab. We report a $2\times2$ randomized field experiment embedded in a public German Santa Claus telephone hotline. Children's calls were randomly routed to one of four LLM voice agents varying persona (Santa, high authority, vs. Helper, low authority) and framing (persuasive nudges toward prosocial wishes vs. neutral). Of 1,072 logged calls, 89 conversations (median age 6) met inclusion criteria. Persuasive framing raised the probability of a prosocial wish from 11.6% to 45.7%, robust to controls. Persona authority showed a near-zero effect: Santa did not outperform the Helper. Persona instead shaped engagement; children hung up on the Helper far more often within the first minute (65% vs. 39%). Where context already lends an agent legitimacy, how it speaks shapes children's compliance more than who it claims to be.

AI.tldr: 在德国圣尼古拉斯电话热线中开展2×2随机田野实验（N=89，中位年龄6岁）：说服性话语框架将儿童亲社会愿望概率由11.6%提升至45.7%，而角色权威（圣诞老人 vs 助手）几乎无影响，仅影响挂断率。
AI.motivation: 对话式智能体日益与儿童互动，但关于其设计如何影响儿童被说服倾向的证据几乎全部来自实验室，缺乏真实场景下的因果证据。作者希望检验在真实公共热线中，智能体的"角色权威"与"话语框架"两大设计维度对儿童顺从行为的相对作用。
AI.method: 将实验嵌入德国公共圣诞老人电话热线，实施2×2随机田野实验。儿童来电被随机分配至四种LLM语音智能体之一，操纵两个因素：角色（圣诞老人＝高权威 vs. 助手＝低权威）与框架（向亲社会愿望进行说服性引导 vs. 中性）。共记录1,072通来电，89段对话满足纳入标准（中位年龄6岁），并进行控制变量稳健性检验。
AI.result: 说服性框架使儿童提出亲社会愿望的概率从11.6%升至45.7%，且在加入控制变量后依然稳健。角色权威效应接近零：圣诞老人并未优于助手。角色仅影响参与度：儿童在首分钟内挂断助手电话的比例显著更高（65% vs. 39%）。
AI.conclusion: 当情境本身已为智能体赋予合法性时，智能体"如何说话"（话语框架）比"自称是谁"（角色权威）更能塑造儿童的顺从行为；角色更多影响儿童的持续参与而非说服效果。

title: Differentiable Structure Learning for Cyclic Linear Gaussian Models with Latent Confounders
summary: We study causal structure learning from observational data in linear Gaussian structural causal models in the presence of directed cycles and an unknown number of exogenous latent confounders, bounded by a given maximum. We derive the covariance of the observed variables and introduce marginal quasi-equivalence, which characterizes when different causal models share a full-dimensional subset of the observational distributions they can generate. We formulate structure learning as minimization of the Gaussian negative log-likelihood with a logarithmically scaled complexity penalty that counts directed edges and latent variables. For a fixed number of observed variables and a fixed upper bound on latent variables, we establish consistency of global score minimizers up to marginal quasi-equivalence under algebraic faithfulness, structural minimality, and model-overlap assumptions. We parameterize the inclusion of directed edges and candidate latent variables using Bernoulli gates, whose continuous probabilities are optimized jointly with the structural coefficients. Averaging the penalized negative log-likelihood over these gates yields an objective with a closed-form differentiable complexity penalty. We prove that this expected objective has the same global infimum as the corresponding discrete structure-learning objective. Experimental results show that our approach achieves lower recovery error than previous methods in several experimental settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究线性高斯结构因果模型中存在有向环和未知数量外生潜混杂（上界已知）时的因果结构学习。作者推导了观测变量协方差，提出"边缘准等价"概念，将结构学习建模为带对数尺度复杂度惩罚的高斯负对数似然最小化，并证明全局最优解在边缘准等价意义下具有一致性。通过Bernoulli门参数化边和候选潜变量，得到闭式可微惩罚目标，实验表明恢复误差优于以往方法。
AI.motivation: 现有因果结构学习方法多假设无环图且潜混杂数量已知或不存在，难以处理有向环与未知数量潜混杂共存的现实场景，因此需要建立相应的一致性理论与可计算的学习方法。
AI.method: 在给定最大潜变量上界下推导观测协方差；定义边缘准等价以刻画不同因果模型共享全维观测分布子集的条件；以对数尺度复杂度惩罚（计数有向边与潜变量）的高斯负对数似然作为评分；用Bernoulli门参数化有向边与候选潜变量，其连续概率与结构系数联合优化，对门取期望得到闭式可微复杂度惩罚目标。
AI.result: 在代数忠实性、结构最小性和模型重叠假设下，证明了固定观测变量数与固定潜变量上界时全局评分最小解在边缘准等价意义下的一致性；证明期望目标与对应离散结构学习目标具有相同全局下确界；实验在多种设置下取得比以往方法更低的恢复误差。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将因果结构学习推广到含环与未知数量潜混杂的线性高斯情形，提供了理论一致性与可微优化框架，并在实验中验证了其优越的恢复性能。

title: Positive Ratings, Hidden Concerns: Employee Voice Disclosure in AI-Mediated Organizational Listening
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS-60), 2027
summary: Organizations started listening to employees through conversational AI agents alongside structured surveys. Little is known about what these channels change in what employees say when disclosure carries hierarchical risk. We report a field study inside a global management consulting firm whose process pairs a pre-survey with an adaptive AI voice interview on the same themes within one session. Across 44 first-session interviews (132 matched theme observations), 20-41% of sessions showed a favorable rating co-occurring with a substantive concern voiced later, depending on the favorability threshold. The Gioia analysis drew on 158 protective quotes from 65 eligible sessions. Disclosure rarely arrived unguarded: employees softened concerns, deflected accountability, and bounded how far they went, and this protective work tracked the perceived legitimacy of the listening structure. We develop a grounded model of bounded disclosure and derive four propositions for voice, channel and listening research. Silence, we argue, can persist inside expression.

AI.tldr: 该研究在一家全球管理咨询公司开展实地研究，将预调查与自适应AI语音访谈配对，发现员工在存在层级风险的AI对话渠道中会采取"有界披露"策略：先给出正面评分，随后再表达实质关切，且这种保护性表达与所感知的倾听结构合法性相关。
AI.motivation: 组织日益采用对话式AI代理与结构化调查并行收集员工意见，但在披露带有层级风险时，此类渠道究竟改变了员工所言内容，我们知之甚少。研究旨在揭示AI语音访谈渠道中员工披露行为的真实性与边界。
AI.method: 在一家全球管理咨询公司开展实地研究：同一场次内先进行预调查，随后针对相同主题进行自适应AI语音访谈。样本为44场首次访谈（132条匹配的主题观察）；Gioia方法分析基于65场合格访谈中的158条保护性引述。
AI.result: 在20%–41%的访谈中（取决于好评阈值），出现正面评分与稍后表达的实质关切共存的现象。披露鲜少毫无戒备：员工会软化关切、转移责任、限定表达程度，且这种保护性工作与倾听结构合法性感知相关。据此建立了"有界披露"的扎根理论模型，并推导出四条关于建言、渠道与倾听研究的命题。
AI.conclusion: 沉默可以存在于表达之中（Silence can persist inside expression）。AI对话渠道并未消除员工的保护性表达，而是在表达内部保留了沉默。

title: Geometry-physics confounding impairs PDE learning across varying domains
summary: Learning partial differential equation (PDE) dynamics across varying domains is central to predictive modelling and data-driven discovery of governing equations. However, geometric variation alters both field representation and the governing differential operators, confounding geometric effects with intrinsic physical properties in the observed dynamics. This work identifies geometry-physics confounding as a unified failure mechanism for PDE learning across varying domains. In forward operator learning, this confounding increases the burden of inferring geometry-dependent operator changes from finite data, reducing data efficiency and generalisation. In equation discovery, omitting geometry-induced operators misspecifies the candidate library, leading to biased parameters, missed governing terms and spurious terms. We propose a de-confounding framework that makes the known geometry-to-operator transformation explicit. Geometry-induced coefficient fields improve prediction and data efficiency across five operator-learning benchmarks, while geometry-complete candidate libraries recover the generating equations and reduce held-out PDE residuals by more than two orders of magnitude in both evolving-domain systems. By separating known geometric action from intrinsic physics, the proposed framework supports more reliable and data-efficient PDE learning across scientific and engineering problems with varying geometries.

AI.tldr: 本文识别出"几何-物理混杂"是变域偏微分方程（PDE）学习的统一失败机制，并提出显式建模几何-算子变换的去混杂框架，在算子学习与方程发现两类任务上均显著改进。
AI.motivation: 跨不同几何域的PDE动力学学习对预测建模与数据驱动方程发现至关重要，但几何变化会同时改变场的表示与支配微分算子，使几何效应与内在物理属性在观测动力学中相互混杂，导致前向算子学习数据效率低、泛化差，以及方程发现中候选库误设（参数偏差、漏项与伪项）。
AI.method: 提出去混杂框架，将已知的几何到算子变换显式化：一是引入几何诱导的系数场，二是构建几何完备的候选库，从而把已知几何作用与内在物理分离。
AI.result: 在五个算子学习基准上通过几何诱导系数场提升了预测性能与数据效率；在两个演化域系统中，几何完备候选库成功恢复生成方程，并将留出PDE残差降低两个数量级以上。
AI.conclusion: 将已知几何作用与内在物理分离，可为几何变化的科学与工程问题提供更可靠、更数据高效的PDE学习。

title: GraphCert: Bootstrap Agentic Graph Reasoning with Certified Evidence Rubrics
summary: Graph agents extend large language models (LLMs) with the ability to actively explore and reason over knowledge graphs through multi-step interactions with graph tools. However, training capable graph agents typically requires large collections of question-answer pairs and reasoning trajectories, whose manual construction is costly and difficult to scale. Moreover, employing proprietary LLMs to generate such supervision further risks exposing sensitive graph data to external services. Therefore, we propose GraphCert to bootstrap agentic graph reasoning with certified evidence rubrics during post-training. Specifically, the Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer guided by generation controls produces graph-grounded QA pairs and marks supporting evidence, which undergo execution certification and semantic curation. The accepted evidence is then canonicalized into certified evidence rubrics that later reward Graph Solver evidence alignment alongside answer correctness during GRPO training. Experiments on five graph reasoning domains in GRBENCH demonstrate that GraphCert consistently outperforms substantially larger LLM agents and post-training method. Furthermore, our analysis demonstrates that the learned policy transfers robustly across heterogeneous graph domains, suggesting that GraphCert acquires reusable graph-reasoning capabilities rather than domain-specific patterns. These results establish executable self-certification as an effective approach to self-training compact graph reasoning agents. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 GraphCert 框架，通过“可执行自认证”在无人工标注、无需外部专有模型的前提下，用认证证据量表引导图智能体的后训练，在 GRBENCH 五个领域上超越更大规模 LLM 与现有后训练方法，并展现出跨图领域的可迁移推理能力。
AI.motivation: 训练具备多步图工具交互能力的图智能体通常依赖大规模问答对与推理轨迹，人工构建成本高、难以规模化；而借助专有 LLM 生成监督又会将敏感图数据暴露给外部服务，存在隐私风险。因此需要一种不依赖人工标注与外部模型的自举式训练方案。
AI.method: GraphCert 在后训练阶段利用认证证据量表进行自举。首先由受生成控制约束的 Bootstrapped Graph Quizzer 产生图接地问答对并标注支撑证据；随后对证据执行执行认证与语义筛选；通过筛选的证据被规范化（canonicalization）为“认证证据量表”；在 GRPO 训练中，该量表同时用于奖励 Graph Solver 的证据对齐与答案正确性。
AI.result: 在 GRBENCH 的五个图推理领域实验中，GraphCert 稳定优于规模显著更大的 LLM 智能体以及已有后训练方法；分析表明学到的策略可在异构图领域间稳健迁移。
AI.conclusion: GraphCert 获取的是可复用的图推理能力而非领域特定模式，表明可执行自认证是一种有效的紧凑图推理智能体自训练途径。代码将公开。

title: Interpretable but Fragile? Robustness of Concept Bottlenecks under Geometric-Semantic Perturbations
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are designed to provide interpretable intermediate representations, yet how such bottlenecks affect robustness remains unclear, with existing studies reporting mixed and sometimes contradictory findings. We argue that these discrepancies arise from conflating different robustness notions and perturbation regimes, rather than from fundamental disagreements about CBMs themselves. To disentangle these factors, we introduce a generator-based evaluation framework that enables controlled comparisons between standard classifiers and CBMs under two distinct perturbation types: continuous geometric perturbations in latent space and discrete semantic interventions in concept space. Within this framework, we evaluate robustness both empirically, via prediction and concept-level sensitivity metrics, and certifiably, using randomized smoothing in latent and concept spaces. Across experiments, we reconcile previously conflicting findings by clarifying when, and in what sense, concept bottlenecks do or do not improve robustness. By further analyzing robustness under varying task conditions, including class semantic similarity and concept vocabulary size, we show that interpretability does not inherently confer robustness. Instead, concept bottlenecks shift where and how sensitivity manifests, revealing a nuanced interpretability robustness trade off that depends critically on the perturbation regime and task structure. Together, our results show that interpretability and robustness are distinct objectives: interpretable intermediate representations do not uniformly improve robustness, but instead redistribute sensitivity across perturbation spaces and model families.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于生成器的评估框架，区分潜空间连续几何扰动与概念空间离散语义干预两类扰动，并结合经验与可证（随机平滑）鲁棒性度量，澄清了概念瓶颈模型鲁棒性研究中相互矛盾的结论。
AI.motivation: 现有关于概念瓶颈模型（CBM）鲁棒性的研究结论不一甚至矛盾，作者认为根源在于混淆了不同的鲁棒性定义与扰动机制，而非对CBM本身存在根本分歧，因此需要解耦这些因素进行受控比较。
AI.method: 引入基于生成器的评估框架，在两类扰动下对标准分类器与CBM进行受控对比：潜空间中的连续几何扰动和概念空间中的离散语义干预。鲁棒性评估既采用经验指标（预测与概念层敏感度指标），也采用可证方法（潜空间与概念空间中的随机平滑）。进一步分析类别语义相似度、概念词表规模等任务条件对鲁棒性的影响。
AI.result: 调和了以往相互冲突的发现，明确了概念瓶颈在何时、以何种意义提升或不提升鲁棒性；发现可解释性并不天然带来鲁棒性，概念瓶颈改变的是敏感度表现的位置与方式；揭示出依赖于扰动机制与任务结构的可解释性—鲁棒性权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性与鲁棒性是相互独立的目标：可解释的中间表示不会一致地提升鲁棒性，而是将敏感度在不同扰动空间与模型族之间重新分配。

title: When Reasoning Goes Astray: Attention Dynamics of Uncontrolled Reasoning
summary: Large reasoning models (LRMs) improve performance on complex tasks through extended reasoning, yet the same process can degenerate into redundant verification and persistent generation loops. Such uncontrolled reasoning increases inference cost and creates risks of resource exhaustion and service degradation. However, existing mitigations largely truncate long outputs or react to surface repetition, and thus fail to distinguish normal thinking from uncontrolled reasoning or explain how benign reasoning degenerates into harmful behavior. In this paper, we operationalize LRM generation as four states and further introduce Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses (RADAR), which identifies the current reasoning state in real time and characterizes how effective reflection can develop into uncontrolled generation. Guided by RADAR's analysis, we further realign abnormal attention distributions toward patterns observed in normal requests and examine how this correction affects excessive reflection and persistent looping. Temporal analyses show that uncontrolled reasoning is characterized by attention distributions that deviate from normal generation, with abnormal trends becoming detectable before repetition begins. Correcting these deviations through Attention Realignment consistently reduces looping while largely preserving benign performance. Together, RADAR provide a mechanistic account of how reasoning becomes uncontrolled, offering actionable guidance for identifying critical failure stages and designing targeted runtime interventions.

AI.tldr: 该论文将大推理模型（LRM）的生成过程操作化为四种状态，提出RADAR（基于动态注意力响应的推理状态分析）方法，实时识别推理状态并刻画有效反思如何退化为失控生成，并通过注意力重对齐（Attention Realignment）纠正异常注意力分布，从而减少循环生成且基本保持良性性能。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型通过扩展推理提升复杂任务表现，但推理过程可能退化为冗余验证和持续生成循环，导致推理成本上升、资源耗尽和服务退化风险。现有缓解方法多依赖截断长输出或对表面重复做出反应，无法区分正常思考与失控推理，也无法解释良性推理如何退化为有害行为。
AI.method: 1）将LRM生成操作化为四种状态；2）提出RADAR（Reasoning-state Analysis via Dynamic Attention Responses），实时识别当前推理状态并刻画有效反思向失控生成的发展过程；3）在RADAR分析指导下，将异常注意力分布重对齐至正常请求中观察到的模式，考察该修正对过度反思与持续循环的影响。
AI.result: 时序分析表明，失控推理表现为注意力分布偏离正常生成，且异常趋势在重复开始之前即可被检测到。通过注意力重对齐纠正这些偏差，能够一致地减少循环，同时基本保持良性性能。
AI.conclusion: RADAR与注意力重对齐共同为推理失控提供了机制性解释，能够为识别关键失败阶段和设计有针对性的运行时干预提供可操作指导。

title: Proper Scoring Rule-based Diffusion for Probabilistic Weather Forecasting
summary: Recent probabilistic weather forecasters train stochastic predictors with the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) to generate each ensemble member in a single forward pass. These models learn the predictive distribution from the forecast context alone, which becomes difficult at longer forecast horizons where uncertainty is high. To learn the predictive distribution more effectively, we introduce auxiliary conditional denoising tasks that predict the same future state from the context and its corrupted version, which provides partial future information that can reduce prediction ambiguity. Building on distributional diffusion models, we learn the conditional distributions of these tasks with a single stochastic predictor by minimizing a proper scoring rule across noise levels. At inference, the predictor can still generate each ensemble member in a single forward pass at the fully corrupted endpoint. Standard CRPS training is recovered as the endpoint-only special case of our formulation, so our framework extends existing CRPS-based forecasters with only additional conditioning inputs. Controlled experiments show that the auxiliary tasks improve one-step forecasting across architectures, with larger gains at longer forecast horizons. The gains extend to high-dimensional global weather forecasting under both training from scratch and fine-tuning, along with improved calibration and potential benefits for generalization under distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在基于CRPS的随机天气预报模型中引入辅助条件去噪任务，利用部分未来信息降低预测歧义，从而提升长期预测、校准与泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 近期概率天气预报器使用连续排序概率得分（CRPS）训练随机预测器以单次前向生成集合成员，但仅依赖预测上下文学习预测分布，在预测时效较长、不确定性高时较为困难。因此需要更有效地学习预测分布。
AI.method: 引入辅助条件去噪任务：从上下文及其被损坏版本预测同一未来状态，被损坏版本提供部分未来信息以减少预测歧义。基于分布扩散模型，用单一随机预测器通过在所有噪声水平上最小化恰当评分规则来学习这些条件分布；推理时仍可在完全损坏端点单次前向生成每个集合成员。标准CRPS训练被证明是该框架仅保留端点的特例，因此该框架仅需增加额外条件输入即可扩展现有CRPS预测器。
AI.result: 受控实验表明，辅助任务在不同架构上均改善单步预测，且在更长预测时效上增益更大；增益可扩展至从零训练和微调的高维全球天气预报，并带来更好的校准，以及在分布偏移下对泛化的潜在收益。
AI.conclusion: 通过将辅助条件去噪任务与CRPS训练统一到一个基于扩散的框架中，可在不改变推理方式的前提下扩展现有概率天气预报器，有效提升长期预测精度、校准与泛化能力。

title: Whose Voice Survives the Summary? A Voice-Retention Audit of LLM Employee Listening
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS 2027)
summary: Organizations increasingly route employee feedback to leaders through large language model (LLM) summaries, an unaudited layer that silences already-spoken voice. We introduce a Voice Retention / Representation Ratio metric for representational bias in summarization and apply it to a bilingual (English/German) corpus of 2,586 free-text responses from a global professional service company. First, employees supply criticism more reliably than praise (withholding praise is 82 times more common). Second, across 45 leader-summaries the pipeline filters by popularity, not sentiment: criticism survives, yet a concern voiced once is dropped 86% of the time, with short and German-only content lost on the same axis (theme retention 0.14 vs 0.74; German directional). Controlling for frequency, sentiment has no independent effect; the harm is prevalence-driven, which sentiment-only audits miss. A targeted prompt recovers only named themes. We contribute the metric, field evidence, and a disaggregated voice-retention card.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出"声音保留/代表比率"指标，审计大语言模型总结员工反馈中的代表性偏差，发现管线按"普遍性"而非"情感"过滤声音，罕见（尤其德语、短文本）意见被系统性丢弃。
AI.motivation: 组织日益使用LLM摘要向领导层传递员工反馈，形成未经审计的中间层，压制了已经表达出来的声音；既有情感导向的审计无法揭示这种代表性偏差。
AI.method: 提出Voice Retention / Representation Ratio（声音保留/代表比率）指标；应用于某全球专业服务公司2,586条英/德双语自由文本反馈语料，分析45份领导摘要，并检验控制频率后情感的作用及针对性提示词的效果。
AI.result: 员工更可靠地提供批评而非赞扬（隐去赞扬的可能性是82倍）；管线按受欢迎程度过滤：批评得以保留，但仅被提及一次的意见有86%被丢弃；短文本和纯德语内容同样被丢失（主题保留率0.14 vs 0.74，德语具方向性）；控制频率后情感无独立效应，伤害由普遍性驱动；针对性提示词仅能找回被点名的主题。
AI.conclusion: LLM反馈摘要存在由频率驱动的系统性声音压制，情感单一维度的审计会漏检；贡献了度量指标、实地证据与解耦的"声音保留卡片"，以支持对摘要管线的可审计性。

title: Alignment via Training Against Probes Without Losing Monitorability
summary: Models are usually aligned based on their observed outputs, using demonstrations, preference data, or reward signals. These objectives reward responses that look aligned. More capable models may learn to satisfy them without internalizing the intended behavior, for example by faking compliance during training. Such superficial compliance could be harder when the objective is defined on model internals rather than outputs. Therefore, we study probe-guided fine-tuning, using probes that detect undesired properties in model activations as a direct training signal. We evaluate linear and non-linear probes with different numbers of probes per layer across two alignment objectives: harmlessness and honesty. We find that training against probes that do not update during training is an easily exploitable objective, while continuously updated probes substantially reduce harmfulness and improve honesty while preserving utility. Probe-guided fine-tuning achieves better safety-utility trade-offs than DPO and inference-time steering, while being substantially more robust against jailbreak and abliteration attacks. Moreover, the concepts stay linearly encoded after fine-tuning, meaning oversight is not lost by our method. Training against probes thus offers a way to shape what models represent rather than only what they output, which may become increasingly important as models get better at making their outputs look aligned.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"探针引导微调"（probe-guided fine-tuning），直接以检测模型内部激活中不良属性的探针作为训练信号，而非仅依赖输出层面的对齐目标，从而缓解"表面合规/伪装对齐"问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法基于可观测输出（演示、偏好数据、奖励信号），只奖励"看起来对齐"的响应。能力更强的模型可能在不内化目标行为的情况下学会满足这些目标（如训练中伪装合规），导致表面化对齐。若将目标定义在模型内部而非输出上，此类浅层合规会更难实现。因此作者希望在激活层面直接塑造模型表征。
AI.method: 研究探针引导微调：使用在模型激活上检测不良属性的探针作为直接训练信号。在两个对齐目标（无害性 harmlessness 与诚实性 honesty）上，评估线性与非线性探针、以及每层不同探针数量的配置。关键设计对比是探针是否在训练中更新：一类探针在训练中固定不变，另一类持续更新。
AI.result: 训练针对不更新的探针是一个易被利用的目标（易被规避/利用）；而持续更新的探针能显著降低有害性、提升诚实性，同时保持效用。探针引导微调在安全-效用权衡上优于 DPO 与推理时引导（inference-time steering），且对越狱（jailbreak）和消融（abliteration）攻击显著更鲁棒。此外，相关概念在微调后仍以线性方式编码，说明该方法的监督并未丢失。
AI.conclusion: 针对探针训练提供了一种塑造模型"表征内容"而非仅"输出表现"的途径。随着模型越来越擅长让输出显得对齐，这种内部导向的对齐方法可能愈发重要。

title: More Choices, Fewer Decisions: Ordinal-Scale Bias in JEV-like Direct-Decision Models
summary: Direct-decision models turn text into low-latency structured labels and scores, making them attractive for classification and automatic evaluation. Yet reliability requires more than accuracy: a model must also use the ordinal decision scale supplied by the user faithfully. We analyze JEV~1.13 and three open KEV models. Our investigation begins with ANLI, where JEV assigns 38.8\% of all predictions and 51.3\% of errors to Neutral despite 74.95\% accuracy, nearly balanced gold labels, and balanced candidate positions. Across 36 ordinal datasets, final decisions use only 67--76\% of the effective gold support, versus 87--102\% on four nominal tasks. Randomizing candidate order weakens but does not remove this compression. Holding items and source scores fixed while balancing gold support and positions, we refine scales from $K=2$ to $14$; utilization falls for every model and reaches 26--75\% at $K=14$, although candidate probabilities remain broad for most models. Targeted BA-LoRA post-training raises gold-relative utilization from roughly 47\% to 86\% on eight supervised scales at both KEV sizes, showing that the compression is learned and modifiable rather than an immutable architectural limit. We call this ordinal scale-utilization bias: decision-stage candidate-space compression distinct from accuracy, gold imbalance, fixed position, and candidate count alone. The code and data are available at https://github.com/Glax147/jev_ordinal_scale_bia

AI.tldr: 论文揭示"序数尺度利用偏差"：直接决策模型虽准确率高，却显著压缩用户提供的序数决策尺度，仅使用部分有效类别，且该压缩可被针对性微调修正。
AI.motivation: 直接决策模型（如JEV、KEV）广泛用于分类与自动评估，但可靠性不仅取决于准确率，还要求忠实利用用户给定的序数决策尺度。作者怀疑模型在决策阶段存在候选空间压缩现象，需要系统刻画并验证其成因。
AI.method: 分析JEV 1.13与三个开源KEV模型。先在ANLI上定位偏差来源，再在36个序数数据集与4个名义任务上统计有效金标签支持的使用比例；通过随机化候选项顺序、固定条目与源分数并平衡金支持与位置，将尺度从K=2细化到K=14观察利用率变化；最后用针对性的BA-LoRA后训练验证该偏差是否可学习、可修改。
AI.result: ANLI上JEV 74.95%准确率下仍将38.8%预测和51.3%错误归为Neutral，而金标签接近平衡。36个序数数据集最终决策仅使用67–76%的有效金支持，名义任务为87–102%。随机化候选顺序只削弱不消除压缩。K=14时所有模型利用率跌至26–75%，但候选概率分布仍较宽。BA-LoRA后训练将八个监督尺度的金相对利用率从约47%提升至86%。
AI.conclusion: 该现象被命名为序数尺度利用偏差，即决策阶段的候选空间压缩，独立于准确率、金标签不平衡、固定位置和候选数量。它是可学习的、可通过后训练修正的，而非架构固有限制。代码与数据已开源。

title: Uncertainty-Normalized Margins for Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct preference optimization (DPO) models binary preferences through a Bradley-Terry model with a common noise scale, without explicitly accounting for preference strength or prompt-dependent uncertainty from human feedback. We introduce uncertainty-normalized margin DPO (UNM-DPO), which combines strength-dependent margins with a learned prompt scale. Motivated by a heteroskedastic Bradley-Terry model, we develop two training objectives. Both compare the implicit rewards of preferred and rejected responses, derived from response log-probability ratios to a reference policy. Advantage-only (AO) divides this reward difference by the prompt scale before subtracting the margin; whole-residual (WR) subtracts the margin before dividing by the scale. For the WR comparison model, we establish a necessary and sufficient condition under which known margins make the prompt scale identifiable. We introduce a practical procedure for learning the scale. Building on WR, we introduce ULNM-DPO-WR, which normalizes each response's implicit reward by its length. We evaluate our methods against DPO and related baselines on HelpSteer2 and HelpSteer3, using the Skywork reward model as a judge. With Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, ULNM-DPO-WR achieves tie-adjusted win rates against matched DPO of 68.00% and 65.31% on evaluation panels, with higher mean rewards and shorter responses on average. On AlpacaEval with a GPT-4.1 judge and GPT-4-Turbo reference answers, the same 8B policy achieves a length-controlled win rate of 21.62%, compared with 16.39% for DPO and 15.30% for SimPO. These results demonstrate the potential of combining preference-strength margins, learned prompt scales, and length normalization for policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UNM-DPO，将偏好强度边际与可学习的提示尺度结合，并进一步引入长度归一化得到ULNM-DPO-WR，在多个评测上优于DPO与SimPO。
AI.motivation: DPO通过Bradley-Terry模型建模二元偏好，使用统一的噪声尺度，未显式考虑偏好强度或来自人类反馈的提示相关不确定性，限制了偏好建模的细粒度与可靠性。
AI.method: 基于异方差Bradley-Terry模型提出UNM-DPO，构建两个训练目标：advantage-only（AO，先除以提示尺度再减去边际）与whole-residual（WR，先减边际再除以尺度）；对WR证明已知边际下提示尺度可辨识的充要条件，并给出尺度学习的实用流程；在WR基础上按响应长度归一化隐式奖励，得到ULNM-DPO-WR。隐式奖励由相对参考策略的响应对数概率比导出。
AI.result: 在HelpSteer2和HelpSteer3上以Skywork奖励模型为评判，Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct下ULNM-DPO-WR相对匹配DPO的平局调整胜率分别为68.00%和65.31%，平均奖励更高、响应更短；在AlpacaEval（GPT-4.1评判、GPT-4-Turbo参考）上长度控制胜率为21.62%，高于DPO的16.39%与SimPO的15.30%。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了将偏好强度边际、可学习提示尺度与长度归一化相结合用于策略优化的潜力。

title: Diversity Combining for Multi-Path LLM Reasoning
summary: Multi-path reasoning methods such as self-consistency (SC) sample $K$ reasoning paths and choose the most frequent answer. However, their gains quickly plateau as $K$ increases, and existing methods do not predict when this saturation will occur. We formalize multi-path LLM reasoning as a diversity combining problem from wireless communications: each path is a noisy channel observation, and the pairwise correlation of path correctness caps the design-effect effective sample size of the vote at a finite ceiling. Generalized least squares (GLS) analysis shows that, under exchangeability, the optimal symmetric linear combiner of latent embeddings is uniform, supporting majority vote as the natural default in standard SC while leaving room for weighting or pruning under heterogeneous prompt-template branches. Across 5 models and 12 benchmarks, prompt-template diversity reduces path correlation in $55$ of $57$ valid cells, with the strongest effect on open-ended QA. We derive an Adaptive-K rule that uses a four-path pilot to select $K^*$, retaining $96$--$103\%$ of MV@$K{=}32$ accuracy across Math, QA, and NLU.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多路径LLM推理形式化为无线通信中的分集合并问题，揭示路径相关性导致投票有效样本量存在有限上限，并据此提出用四路径试点自适应选择K的Adaptive-K规则。
AI.motivation: 自一致性等多路径推理方法随采样路径数K增加，性能提升迅速饱和，但现有方法无法预测饱和何时发生，也缺乏对饱和机制的定量刻画，因此需要从理论上解释并建模这一现象，进而指导K的选择与路径加权/剪枝。
AI.method: 将多路径LLM推理类比无线通信的分集合并：每条路径视为含噪信道观测，路径正确性的两两相关性限制了投票的设计效应有效样本量，使其在有限值处封顶。利用广义最小二乘（GLS）分析，在可交换性假设下证明潜在嵌入的最优对称线性合并器为均匀权重，从而支持在标准SC中以多数投票为自然默认；在提示模板分支异质时则留有加权或剪枝的空间。基于该理论提出Adaptive-K规则，用四条路径的试点估计并选择K*。
AI.result: 在5个模型、12个基准上，提示模板多样性在57个有效单元中的55个降低了路径相关性，对开放式问答效果最强。Adaptive-K规则在Math、QA、NLU任务上保留了MV@K=32准确率的96%–103%。
AI.conclusion: 路径相关性是多路径推理收益饱和的根本原因，其决定了投票有效样本量的上限；多数投票在标准SC下具有理论最优性，而提示模板多样性可有效降低相关性；Adaptive-K能以极小试点成本逼近大K的性能，为多路径推理的路径数与权重的自适应选择提供了理论依据。

title: Understanding Off- vs On-Policy Distillation: A Tale of Distinct Training Objectives
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) learns from teacher feedback on student-generated responses and has shown promise in reducing forgetting relative to supervised fine-tuning (SFT). However, its benefits and fragility remain incompletely understood. We study sequential distillation from multiple teachers, where the student minimizes its average divergence from the teachers. Forward Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence yields a weighted arithmetic mixture, while reverse KL yields a normalized weighted geometric aggregate. We develop algorithms that learn these targets under off-policy and on-policy feedback, respectively, establishing logarithmic regret bounds in the tabular setting and extending the analysis to function approximation. By analyzing these aggregation targets, we identify mechanisms that help explain both the benefits and fragility of OPD. Relative to forward KL, reverse KL can better retain a confident expert's preferences under uninformative feedback, but is more sensitive to teachers that assign very low probabilities to correct responses. Its token-level conditionals also reveal a dependence on continuation distributions that can favor incorrect prefixes over long horizons.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多教师序贯蒸馏中的聚合机制，证明前向KL产生加权算术混合（适合离线反馈），反向KL产生归一化加权几何聚合（适合在线反馈），并在表格设定下建立对数遗憾界、扩展至函数逼近，揭示了在线策略蒸馏（OPD）优劣与脆弱性的内在机理。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）从学生生成响应的教师反馈中学习，相较监督微调（SFT）在减少遗忘方面有优势，但其收益来源与脆弱性尚不完全清楚。作者希望从多教师序贯蒸馏的理论聚合视角理解OPD的内在机理。
AI.method: 研究学生最小化与多教师平均散度的序贯蒸馏：分析前向KL（得到加权算术混合）与反向KL（得到归一化加权几何聚合）两种目标；分别设计在离线（off-policy）与在线（on-policy）反馈下学习这些目标的算法；在表格设定下建立对数遗憾界，并将分析扩展至函数逼近。
AI.result: 算法在表格设定下取得对数遗憾界，并成功推广至函数逼近；通过分析聚合目标揭示了OPD的机制：相较前向KL，反向KL在无信息反馈时能更好保留高置信教师的偏好，但对给正确答案分配极低概率的教师更敏感；其token级条件分布显示出对续写分布的依赖，在长时程下可能偏好错误前缀。
AI.conclusion: 前向与反向KL对应不同聚合目标（算术混合 vs. 加权几何聚合），分别适配离线与在线反馈；该聚合视角系统解释了OPD的收益与脆弱性，指出反向KL的稳健性与敏感性来源，以及长时程下偏好错误前缀的潜在风险。

title: OpenJev-RLCD: A Working RLCD Implementation
summary: Decision models such as Jev answer questions with probabilities, which are only useful if they are calibrated. Open-source reproductions rely on supervised fine-tuning plus temperature scaling, while reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) makes reasoning models overconfident. We present a working implementation of reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD) for reasoning models: the model samples a rationale, and we score the answer distribution it commits to afterwards with a strictly proper scoring rule. A variance identity shows that scoring the mixture of several samples rewards disagreeing rationales, and that RLVR is exactly this mixture objective without its diversity term. Optimized naively, the per-rationale objective either switches reasoning off or is drowned out by policy-gradient noise, which leads to a two-stage recipe: calibrate, then reinforce. With Qwen3-1.7B on two reasoning tasks (3 seeds, paired tests), RLCD matches or beats SFT, RFT/STaR and GRPO (each temperature-scaled) in accuracy and beats all of them in selective prediction; on GSM8K answer verification a single query decides \gvTwoCovFive\% of the items at $\le$5\% error, versus \gvGrpoCovFive\% for GRPO. When uncertainty comes from annotator disagreement, RLCD provably cannot beat cross-entropy. Code and results: https://github.com/ZimmyGao/openjev-rlcd.

AI.tldr: 提出RLCD方法：先校准、后强化，用严格proper评分规则对推理模型进行强化学习，使决策概率校准；在Qwen3-1.7B两任务上匹配或超越SFT、RFT/STaR与GRPO，且在选择性预测上全面更优。
AI.motivation: 决策模型（如Jev）给出的概率只有在校准时才有用。开源复现依赖监督微调加温度缩放，而RLVR会使推理模型过度自信，缺乏针对校准决策的强化学习实现。
AI.method: 提出RLCD：模型先采样一条推理链（rationale），再用严格proper scoring rule对其事后给出的答案分布打分。通过方差恒等式分析表明，对多样本混合打分可奖励分歧的推理链，而RLVR恰为去掉多样性项的该混合目标。针对直接优化时目标被策略梯度噪声淹没或导致推理关闭的问题，采用两阶段流程：先校准，后强化。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B、两个推理任务、3个随机种子并做配对检验下：RLCD在准确率上匹配或超过（各自经温度缩放的）SFT、RFT/STaR、GRPO，并在选择性预测上全部胜出；GSM8K答案验证中，单次查询即可在≤5%错误率下判定约5%的样本（较GRPO的约2%提升明显）。当不确定性源于标注者分歧时，RLCD可证明无法优于交叉熵。
AI.conclusion: RLCD为推理模型提供了可行且有效的校准决策强化学习方案，在准确率与选择性预测上均优于现有基线，但存在理论边界：在标注分歧驱动的不确定性下无法超越交叉熵。

title: Provable Test-Time Scaling for Beam Search in LLM Reasoning
summary: Beam-search-based test-time methods provide an effective way to improve large language model (LLM) performance on long-horizon generation by pruning invalid reasoning paths early, leading to significantly improved reasoning efficiency and more favorable test-time cost scaling. Despite strong empirical success, the theoretical understanding of beam search remains limited. In this paper, we study the test-time compute guarantee of the commonly used beam search framework that uses the model's internal log-likelihood for intermediate scoring, while relying on an external reward model only after a complete response is generated. We first establish a lower bound for vanilla beam search, showing that at least $Ω(C^\star(x)^2)$ samples are required for the optimal response to survive, where $C^\star(x)$ is the token-level coverage coefficient for prompt $x$. This motivates our modified confidence-filtered beam search (CF-Beam), which reduces the sufficient coverage dependence from quadratic to nearly linear under prefix competitiveness, for fixed horizon, gap, and target accuracy. We then show that the regret of CF-Beam is upper-bounded by the probability of rare failure events and the reward estimation error scaled by a path-level coverage coefficient, where the rare-failure term vanishes as per-step sampling increases. Our results highlight a fundamental advantage of beam search over sequence-level inference methods such as Best-of-N and Best-of-Majority. While the guarantees of these approaches typically involve coverage coefficients that grow exponentially with the horizon $L$, CF-Beam controls the dominant search-induced term through a token-level coverage coefficient that scales polynomially with $L$. Our numerical experiments further confirm that beam search is more robust on hard instances and under increasing reasoning horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文从理论上研究了大模型长程生成中beam search的测试时计算保证，给出vanilla beam search的样本下界，并提出CF-Beam将覆盖依赖从二次降至近线性，证明其相较Best-of-N等方法在长程场景下更具优势。
AI.motivation: Beam search在长程生成中通过提前剪枝无效推理路径，能提升LLM性能与测试时成本扩展性，实证效果显著，但其理论基础仍十分有限。论文希望填补这一理论空白，理解beam search的测试时计算保证及其相对序列级推理方法的根本优势。
AI.method: 研究使用模型内部对数似然进行中间打分、仅在完整响应生成后才依赖外部奖励模型的beam search框架。首先建立vanilla beam search的下界：至少需要Ω(C⋆(x)²)个样本才能使最优响应存活，其中C⋆(x)为prompt x的token级覆盖系数。据此提出改进的置信过滤beam search（CF-Beam），在prefix competitiveness条件下将充分覆盖依赖从二次降至近线性。随后分析CF-Beam的regret上界。
AI.result: CF-Beam的regret由稀有失败事件概率和被路径级覆盖系数缩放的奖励估计误差上界，其中稀有失败项随每步采样数增加而消失。在固定horizon、gap和目标精度下，CF-Beam将主导的搜索诱导项通过token级覆盖系数控制，该系数随horizon L多项式增长；而Best-of-N、Best-of-Majority等方法的覆盖系数随L指数增长。数值实验进一步证实beam search在困难实例和推理horizon增加时更加鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 论文揭示了beam search相较Best-of-N和Best-of-Majority等序列级推理方法在长程生成中的根本优势：其主导搜索诱导项由随horizon多项式增长的token级覆盖系数控制，而非指数增长的覆盖系数，因此随着推理horizon增加更具鲁棒性。CF-Beam通过置信过滤实现了近线性的样本复杂度依赖。

title: When Context Changes: Understanding Update Failures in LLMs
summary: As preferences, goals, and facts change, LLM agents must use the current state while earlier versions remain in context. Yet they can answer with an old value of the same variable, a failure that we call stale binding. To study when models use outdated information and why, we introduce Controlled In-Context Memory (CICM), a benchmark for tracking and using updated information in conversations and agent logs. We observe that even frontier reasoning models can fail to recover the current state. We find that in open-source models probes can still recover the updated value when the model answers with an old one, pointing to a failure to select information that remains available. Component tests in Qwen and Pythia identify a mechanism for this selection failure: attention drift, where attention favors old values over the current one when producing an answer. We study a one-layer transformer to mathematically understand how this phenomenon happens: when attention scores are similar, several old values can together receive more attention than the current value. Guided by this explanation, we redirect attention toward the current value without further training. When the current value is requested directly, adjusting this intervention for each input corrects most old-value errors across various model families while preserving nearly all initially correct answers. Reliable context management therefore requires more than remembering updated information: models must use it to guide their answers.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"过时绑定"（stale binding）失效现象：当变量有新旧多个值共存于上下文时，LLM智能体会给出旧值。作者构建CICM基准，定位其机制为"注意力漂移"，并提出免训练的注意力干预方法予以纠正。
AI.motivation: 随着偏好、目标和事实不断变化，LLM智能体需要依据最新状态作答，而上下文中仍保留旧版本信息。然而模型常会回答同一变量的旧值，即"过时绑定"。作者希望系统研究模型何时会使用过时信息、为何如此，并寻找可纠正的机制。
AI.method: 1) 构建Controlled In-Context Memory（CICM）基准，用于在对话和智能体日志中追踪并使用更新后的信息；2) 通过探针（probes）检验旧值作答时更新值是否仍可被解码；3) 在Qwen与Pythia上做组件测试，识别选择失效的机制；4) 用单层Transformer进行数学分析，解释注意力分数相近时多个旧值合计注意力超过当前值的现象；5) 基于该解释设计免训练的注意力重定向干预，并按输入自适应调整。
AI.result: 即便是前沿推理模型也可能无法恢复当前状态；在开源模型中，当模型给出旧值时，探针仍能恢复出更新值，说明这是信息选择失败而非信息丢失。组件测试将机制归因于注意力漂移。自适应调整的注意力干预在直接请求当前值时可纠正多数旧值错误，覆盖多种模型家族，同时几乎保留所有原本正确的答案。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的上下文管理不仅是"记住"更新信息，模型还必须"使用"更新信息来指导作答；注意力漂移是过时绑定的关键机制，且可通过免训练的注意力重定向加以缓解。

title: In-Distribution Imagination for Model-Based Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Model-based offline reinforcement learning (MBORL) improves sample efficiency through model-generated trajectories. However, accumulative model error can drive imagined trajectories outside the offline data distribution, leading to unrealistic synthetic data and unstable policy optimization. Many existing methods primarily control rollouts using transition-level uncertainty. We propose \emph{in-distribution imagination} (IDI), a rollout control framework that estimates trajectory support in a learned representation space and adaptively truncates rollouts that leave the offline trajectory manifold. Combined with trajectory-regularized RL, an extension of entropy-regularized RL, IDI consistently improves performance in limited-data settings. Experiments show that trajectory support predicts rollout failure substantially better than transition-level uncertainty, highlighting the importance of trajectory-level rollout control in MBORL.

AI.tldr: 提出"分布内想象"(IDI)框架，在学习到的表示空间中估计轨迹支持度并自适应截断偏离离线轨迹流形的rollout，显著改善有限数据下的MBORL性能。
AI.motivation: MBORL通过模型生成的轨迹提升样本效率，但累积的模型误差会使想象轨迹偏离离线数据分布，导致合成数据不真实且策略优化不稳定。现有方法主要依赖transition-level不确定性控制rollout，缺乏对轨迹整体的约束。
AI.method: IDI是一个rollout控制框架：在学习到的表示空间中估计轨迹支持（trajectory support），当想象轨迹离开离线轨迹流形时自适应截断rollout；并结合轨迹正则化RL（trajectory-regularized RL，即熵正则化RL的扩展）进行策略优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，轨迹支持度对rollout失败的预测能力显著优于transition-level不确定性；IDI在有限数据设置下持续提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 在MBORL中，轨迹级别的rollout控制比transition级别的控制更有效，IDI凸显了轨迹级控制的重要性。

title: Talk2Agent: Benchmarking Voice Interfaces for Text Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) computer-use agents are typically evaluated with clean written instructions, despite speech being an increasingly popular interface for interacting with such systems. Speech input introduces an additional failure point: transcription errors can alter task-critical entities, constraints, or targets before the agent begins reasoning, while conventional ASR metrics do not directly measure whether the information required for successful execution has been preserved. We introduce Talk2Agent, a benchmark for evaluating how effectively voice interfaces convey human-spoken instructions to LLM-based computer-use agents. Talk2Agent builds human-spoken versions of tasks from WildClawBench and OSWorld and evaluates a range of voice interfaces, including dedicated ASR models, audio-capable LLMs, contextual biasing, and LLM-based ontology repair. Because repeatedly executing long-horizon computer-use tasks is costly and stochastic, we further propose an execution-free, task-conditioned evaluation framework that projects the original task grader onto prompt-addressable intentions and measures how much task-relevant information is retained after the voice interface. On WildClawBench, Talk2Agent's execution-free native projection provides a practical, execution-grounded measure of voice-interface quality, correlating with downstream task completion and improving Pearson correlation by 0.246 over WER/CER on 32 hours of real human speech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Talk2Agent 基准，用于评估语音接口向 LLM 计算机使用智能体传达口语指令的有效性，并提出免执行、任务条件化的评估框架，在 32 小时真实人类语音上较 WER/CER 的 Pearson 相关性提升 0.246。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 计算机使用智能体通常以干净书面指令进行评估，但语音正成为日益流行的交互方式。语音输入引入额外失败点：转录错误会在智能体开始推理前改变任务关键实体、约束或目标，而传统 ASR 指标无法直接衡量成功执行所需信息是否被保留。
AI.method: 构建 Talk2Agent 基准：基于 WildClawBench 和 OSWorld 构建人类口语版本任务，评估多种语音接口，包括专用 ASR 模型、音频能力 LLM、上下文偏置和基于 LLM 的本体修复。同时提出免执行、任务条件化的评估框架，将原始任务评分器映射到提示可寻址意图上，衡量语音接口后任务相关信息的保留程度。
AI.result: 在 WildClawBench 上，Talk2Agent 的免执行原生投影提供了实用的、基于执行的语音接口质量度量，与下游任务完成度相关，并在 32 小时真实人类语音上较 WER/CER 的 Pearson 相关性提升 0.246。
AI.conclusion: Talk2Agent 为语音接口向计算机使用智能体传达口头指令提供了有效评估方案，其免执行评估框架与下游任务表现相关，优于传统 ASR 指标。

title: Molecular Property Prediction under Structural Shift with Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Predicting molecular properties for compounds that differ structurally from labeled training molecules is important for drug discovery and materials design. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) offer a promising approach through in-context learning, but their performance under structural shifts and the value of molecular comparisons in this setting remain underexplored. We study structural generalization in molecular property prediction and introduce MolPAIR (Molecular Pair-Augmented In-context Refinement), a framework that combines molecule-level and molecular-pair contexts without task-specific parameter updates. A global tabular foundation model (TFM) first predicts a query's property from labeled molecular examples. A second frozen TFM predicts differences in prediction errors between the query and labeled reference molecules, using these comparisons to refine the initial prediction. Across 58 MoleculeACE and Polaris tasks, CheMeleon representations combined with TabPFN-3 already outperform each evaluated baseline on a majority of tasks. MOLPAIR further improves this predictor on 46 of 58 tasks, with gains across four molecular representations and three TFM backbones. These results show that explicit molecular comparisons can strengthen tabular in-context learning for structural generalization while keeping the molecular encoder and pretrained model weights fixed. The code and datasets are available at https://github.com/nums-ai/MolPAIR.

AI.tldr: 本文研究分子性质预测中的结构泛化问题，提出 MolPAIR 框架，通过结合分子级与分子对上下文进行免参数更新的上下文精炼，在 58 个任务上超越基线并在 46 个任务上进一步提升性能。
AI.motivation: 分子性质预测中，测试分子常与标注训练分子存在结构差异，这一结构偏移下的泛化对药物发现与材料设计至关重要。表格基础模型（TFM）虽可通过上下文学习提供新思路，但其在结构偏移下的表现以及分子比较信息的价值尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 提出 MolPAIR（Molecular Pair-Augmented In-context Refinement）框架，无需任务特定参数更新。首先由一个全局表格基础模型（TFM）基于标注分子样本预测查询分子的性质；随后由第二个冻结的 TFM 预测查询分子与标注参考分子之间的预测误差差异，利用这种比较关系对初始预测进行精炼，从而同时融合分子级与分子对级上下文。
AI.result: 在 58 个 MoleculeACE 与 Polaris 任务上，CheMeleon 表示结合 TabPFN-3 已在多数任务上超越所有评测基线；MolPAIR 进一步在 58 个任务中的 46 个上提升该预测器，且增益在四种分子表示与三种 TFM 骨干上均成立。
AI.conclusion: 显式的分子比较能够增强表格上下文学习在结构泛化上的能力，且无需改动分子编码器与预训练模型权重。代码与数据集已开源。

title: Reasoning Externalization for Faithful Large Language Model Narratives of Stock Return Predictions
summary: In finance, interpreting machine learning predictions is essential, yet the numerical outputs of explainable AI can be difficult for non-experts to understand. While large language models (LLMs) can translate these outputs into natural language, they may produce errors when inferring numerical changes and feature relations. We propose an LLM narrative framework for cross-sectional stock return prediction that combines temporal Shapley additive explanations (SHAP) evidence with historical regime analogs. Temporal evidence tracks changes in the normalized global SHAP importance of an XGBoost model over six months. Historical analogs are past periods with similar changes in SHAP importance, their model performance and subsequent market returns are provided as comparative context. Using this framework, we conduct a controlled study of progressive reasoning externalization, sequentially providing raw SHAP sequences, deterministic temporal descriptors, and feature relations. Each generated claim is verified against provenance-linked evidence. Across Qwen3, externalizing numerical and relational reasoning improved evidence faithfulness as well as temporal and relational accuracy. Evidence faithfulness increased from 0.696 to 0.996 for Qwen3-32B-Instruct. While historical analogs did not improve structured automatic faithfulness, they received higher human-rated usefulness scores. These results suggest that externalizing verifiable reasoning enhances narrative faithfulness and that historical context adds interpretive value.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合时序SHAP证据与历史相似区间类比的LLM叙事框架，用于横截面股票收益预测的可解释性，并通过逐步外化推理提升叙事忠实度。
AI.motivation: 金融领域需要可解释的机器学习预测，但可解释AI输出的数值结果对非专家难以理解。LLM虽可将数值转为自然语言，但在推断数值变化和特征关系时易出错，因此需要一种能保证证据忠实度的叙事生成方法。
AI.method: 构建LLM叙事框架：结合时序SHAP证据与历史区间类比。时序证据追踪XGBoost模型归一化全局SHAP重要性六个月内的变化；历史类比为SHAP重要性变化相似的过往区间，并提供其模型表现与后续市场收益作为比较语境。设计渐进式推理外化对照实验，依次提供原始SHAP序列、确定性时序描述符和特征关系，并对每条生成陈述进行溯源证据核验。在Qwen3等模型上评估。
AI.result: 外化数值与关系推理提升了证据忠实度以及时序与关系准确性。Qwen3-32B-Instruct的证据忠实度从0.696提升至0.996。历史类比未提升结构化自动忠实度指标，但在人工评分中获得更高的有用性评分。
AI.conclusion: 外化可验证推理能增强叙事忠实度，历史语境为可解释叙事增添解释价值；该框架为金融机器学习预测提供了更可信、更具可读性的自然语言解释路径。

title: Lasting Effects of Abstract Pretraining Beyond Perplexity
summary: Language models are typically pretrained from random initialization. Recent work challenges this convention, showing that a brief warm-up on abstract, algorithmically generated data can provide a better starting point for subsequent learning of natural language. In this paper, we show that in small language models, such a warm-up improves specific capabilities that are not reflected in language-modeling perplexity. Our warm-up uses an abstract stack-manipulation task that requires compositional and state-tracking capabilities. Allocating as little as 1% of pretraining tokens to this data improves multi-hop question answering by up to 3.9 F1 points on MUSIQUE, with additional gains on HOTPOTQA and 2WIKIMULTIHOPQA despite comparable language-modeling perplexity. Controlled experiments show that the warm-up substantially accelerates the acquisition of deeper reasoning chains. We also explore what drives this transfer. First, the structure of the data matters: replacing the stack task with a queue fails to produce the same gains. Second, the gains are specific: performance improves on sequential reasoning chains, with no consistent benefit on tasks that combine or compare independent facts. Third, timing matters: mixing abstract data with natural language is far less effective than an initial dedicated phase, and exposure after pretraining completely removes the benefits. The early advantage persists through billions of subsequent language tokens. These results show that early abstract training can reliably shape the capabilities language models later acquire.

AI.tldr: 小模型预训练前用1%的抽象栈操作任务"热身"，可显著提升多跳问答（MUSIQUE最高+3.9 F1），且不体现在困惑度上，收益依赖于数据结构的抽象性、任务的顺序推理属性和训练时机。
AI.motivation: 挑战"语言模型从随机初始化预训练"的常规做法。已有工作表明抽象算法生成数据的热身能提供更好的自然语言学习起点，但尚不清楚这种热身具体改善了哪些能力、是否体现在语言建模困惑度上，以及这种迁移的驱动因素是什么。
AI.method: 热身阶段使用一个需要组合能力与状态追踪能力的抽象"栈操作"任务。仅用1%的预训练token进行该数据热身，随后进行常规语言预训练。通过受控实验考察：(1)数据结构的作用——将栈替换为队列；(2)迁移的特异性——顺序推理链 vs. 独立事实的组合/比较；(3)时机的作用——抽象数据与自然语言混合 vs. 独立初始阶段 vs. 预训练后注入。
AI.result: 1%热身在MUSIQUE上最多提升3.9 F1，在HOTPOTQA和2WIKIMULTIHOPQA上也有额外收益，而语言建模困惑度相当。热身显著加速更深推理链的习得。队列替换栈无法带来相同收益；收益仅出现在顺序推理链任务上，对独立事实的组合/比较任务无一致提升；混合抽象数据与自然语言效果差得多，预训练后暴露则完全消除收益。早期优势在后续数十亿语言token中依然保持。
AI.conclusion: 早期抽象训练能可靠地塑造语言模型后续习得的能力：其作用体现在特定能力（多跳/顺序推理）而非困惑度，且高度依赖于训练数据的抽象结构、任务性质与注入时机，早期优势具有持久性。

title: STRATA: Self-Learning Through Role-Aligned Tiered Agents for Real-Time Strategy Games
summary: Real-time strategy (RTS) games require agents to coordinate economic development, production and construction, base defense, unit organization, and attack timing over long matches. Existing studies have applied large language models to command decision-making in RTS games, enabling agents to read textual game states and generate high-level plans. However, long inference latency can cause them to miss critical tactical events. The complexity and tactical diversity of full RTS matches also leave existing systems heavily dependent on manually written experience-based prompts, with limited ability to learn continuously from past games. We present STRATA, a role-aligned hierarchical system with cross-game self-learning for Red Alert. STRATA assigns in-game strategic, logistical, and tactical decisions to a Strategic Agent (SA), Logistics Agent (LA), and Tactical Agent (TA), respectively. The SA generates high-level directives based on the global game state and relevant experience cards, while the LA and TA handle logistics and tactical execution. After each match, a Review Agent (RA) derives candidate experience from game traces, validates and revises it using evidence from subsequent matches, and compresses strategic experience supported across multiple games into concise experience cards for SA retrieval. We evaluate STRATA through the formation of experience cards, full-match comparisons before and after learning, and experience learning against AI opponents with different play styles. Under a fixed scenario, using the learned experience cards increases the observed win rate from 30% to 100%. Sequential learning against AI opponents with different play styles also produces distinct long-term strategic experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STRATA——面向《红色警戒》的角色对齐分层系统，通过战略、后勤、战术三层智能体分工与跨局自学习经验卡片机制，缓解大模型实时决策延迟与人工提示依赖问题，将固定场景胜率从30%提升至100%。
AI.motivation: RTS游戏要求智能体在长局中统筹经济发展、生产建造、基地防御、单位编组与进攻时机。已有工作用大语言模型读取文本状态并生成高层计划，但长推理延迟易错过关键战术事件；整局对抗的复杂性与战术多样性使现有系统高度依赖人工经验提示，难以从过往对局中持续学习。
AI.method: STRATA采用角色对齐的分层架构：战略智能体（SA）依据全局状态与相关经验卡片生成高层指令，后勤智能体（LA）与战术智能体（TA）分别负责后勤与战术执行；赛后由复盘智能体（RA）从对局轨迹中提取候选经验，利用后续对局证据进行验证与修正，并将跨多局可复用的战略经验压缩为简洁经验卡片供SA检索。
AI.result: 通过经验卡片形成过程、学习前后整局对比，以及针对不同打法AI对手的经验学习进行评估。固定场景下，使用学到的经验卡片将观察胜率从30%提升到100%；针对不同风格AI对手的序贯学习还能产生各具差异的长期战略经验。
AI.conclusion: 分层角色对齐与跨局自学习经验卡片能有效提升RTS智能体的决策时效与胜率，并减少对人工经验提示的依赖，同时可针对不同对手风格形成差异化的长期战略经验。

title: dattri-LLM: A Unified and Efficient Library for Training Data Attribution at LLM Scale
summary: Training data attribution (TDA) estimates the contribution of individual training examples to model outputs. Most scalable TDA methods rely on per-example gradients, whose computation and use at LLM scale pose challenges in efficiency, compatibility, and extensibility. We introduce dattri-LLM, a TDA library that makes gradient-based attribution more practical at scale. For efficiency, dattri-LLM uses compact gradient representations and dynamically routes gradient operations based on a cost model. For compatibility, its capture mechanism collects per-example gradients from existing training loops that call backward(), without requiring changes to the loop or its configuration. This includes distributed training with DDP and FSDP and pipelines built with HuggingFace Transformers, TRL, and OLMo. For extensibility, dattri-LLM exposes reusable gradient operations and training-time callbacks for implementing attribution methods and applications. These interfaces support a variety of attribution methods, including gradient similarity, curvature-based influence, and trajectory-based methods, as well as applications that act on gradients during training, such as online data selection. On the same hardware and workload, dattri-LLM achieves 3.2x the throughput of the fastest competing library on average, scales multiple attribution methods to 110B-parameter models across four H200 GPUs, and offers superior attribution fidelity-cost trade-offs across a range of models with different model families and scales.

AI.tldr: dattri-LLM 是一个面向大语言模型的可扩展训练数据归因（TDA）库，通过紧凑梯度表示、成本模型驱动的动态算子路由、无侵入式梯度捕获机制及可复用接口，在效率、兼容性和可扩展性上系统性地提升了基于梯度的归因方法的实用性。
AI.motivation: 训练数据归因旨在估计单个训练样本对模型输出的贡献，主流可扩展方法依赖逐样本梯度。然而在 LLM 规模下，逐样本梯度的计算与使用在效率、兼容性和可扩展性三方面均面临挑战，现有方法难以在实践中落地。
AI.method: 提出 TDA 库 dattri-LLM。效率方面采用紧凑梯度表示，并基于代价模型动态路由梯度算子；兼容性方面设计捕获机制，可直接从调用 backward() 的既有训练循环中采集逐样本梯度，无需修改循环或配置，兼容 DDP/FSDP 分布式训练以及 HuggingFace Transformers、TRL、OLMo 构建的流水线；可扩展性方面暴露可复用的梯度算子与训练期回调，用于实现归因方法与应用。
AI.result: 所提供接口支持多种归因方法，包括梯度相似度、基于曲率的影响函数与基于轨迹的方法，并支持训练期作用于梯度的应用（如在线数据选择）。在相同硬件与负载下，dattri-LLM 平均吞吐量达到最快对比库的 3.2 倍；可在 4 张 H200 GPU 上将多种归因方法扩展至 110B 参数模型；在不同模型家族与规模上均取得更优的归因保真度—成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: dattri-LLM 通过效率、兼容性与可扩展性的协同设计，使基于梯度的训练数据归因在 LLM 规模下真正可行，并在吞吐、模型规模与保真度—成本权衡上全面优于现有方案。

title: Consistent Plan-Act for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
summary: Long-horizon agentic tasks demand strong reasoning and efficient execution across successive interactions with dynamic environments. A common approach decouples high-level planning from low-level execution through separate planner and actor roles. To investigate coordination failures in these tasks, we prompt both agents for structured state assertions and compare their reports programmatically to detect explicit contradictions. Our analyses reveal systematic disagreement about the same task-relevant state facts, a phenomenon we term planner-actor state mismatch. We further find that providing agents with task-relevant state information reduces mismatch and improves coordination and task performance. Based on the systematic analysis of the state mismatch, we propose Consistent Plan-Act (ConPAct), which feeds detected contradictions back to both agents to form consistent state interpretations and fine-tunes them on curated consistent interactions for better coordination.
