ConPAct improves performance across various environments and model configurations, e.g., increasing MiniGrid success rate from 38.6% to 54.4% with GPT-5.6-sol/terra as planner and actor respectively, demonstrating that state consistency can guide both inference-time correction and coordination training.

AI.tldr: 论文发现规划者与执行者对同一任务状态的事实性描述存在系统性矛盾（planner-actor state mismatch），提出 ConPAct：将检测到的矛盾反馈给双方以形成一致状态解释，并在筛选后的一致交互上微调，从而提升长时程智能体任务表现。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体任务需要在动态环境中进行多轮交互，既要求强推理也要求高效执行。常见做法是把高层规划与低层执行解耦为独立的 planner 和 actor。但两个角色之间的协调失败原因尚不清晰，作者希望从状态一致性角度定位这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 方法分两步。分析层面：让 planner 与 actor 分别输出结构化的状态断言，通过程序化比对两者的报告，检测显式矛盾。方法层面：提出 Consistent Plan-Act（ConPAct），将检测到的矛盾反馈给两个智能体，使其形成一致的状态解释；同时在经过筛选的一致交互数据上对二者进行微调，以改善协调能力。
AI.result: 分析发现智能体对同一任务相关状态事实存在系统性分歧。提供任务相关状态信息可减少不匹配、改善协调与任务表现。ConPAct 在多种环境和模型配置下均带来性能提升，例如以 GPT-5.6-sol/terra 分别作为 planner 和 actor 时，MiniGrid 成功率从 38.6% 提升至 54.4%。
AI.conclusion: 状态一致性既可用于推理时的纠错，也可用于协调训练，是理解和改进 planner-actor 解耦式智能体系统的有效切入点。

title: Learning Under Forgetting: Statistical Support-Selective Retention in Stochastic Training Dynamics
summary: Prior work has shown that neural networks exhibit implicit biases toward low-complexity structure (e.g., spectral bias), memorization dynamics, and compression-like effects during training, but a unified dynamical account of selective retention remains incomplete. We propose Repeated Reinforcement with Persistent Forgetting (RPF) dynamics, a minimal framework in which repeated exposure reinforces patterns and structures that recur in the data, while persistent forgetting attenuates learned information. This view treats forgetting not merely as a failure mode, but as a selection mechanism. We build the theory in three successive layers. First, in an independent-feature model, we derive an exposure-selective survival law and a support-dependent retention boundary characterizing which patterns persist under forgetting. Second, in a shared-parameter model, we show that forgetting induces spectral filtering over covariance modes, preserving strongly supported shared components while suppressing weak ones. Third, under small-step and norm/coding approximations, we show how RPF dynamics induce an implicit trade-off between data fitting and the cost of stored information, yielding Minimum Description Length (MDL)-like compression. Controlled experiments provide evidence for this reinforcement--forgetting selection mechanism in scalar memories and a nonlinear shared network. Joint reinforcement and attenuation interventions shift conditional retention, while matched exposure counts reveal forgetting-dependent effects of reinforcement timing and changes in the composition of the retained set. Together, these results show that repeated reinforcement and persistent forgetting jointly provide a controllable source of inductive bias beyond neural architecture and scale.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"重复强化+持续遗忘"（RPF）动力学，将遗忘视为选择机制，从独立特征、共享参数与MDL压缩三层理论刻画选择性保留，并用实验验证。
AI.motivation: 已有工作观察到神经网络的谱偏置、记忆动力学与压缩效应，但缺乏关于"选择性保留"的统一动力学解释。
AI.method: 构建RPF最小框架，分三层理论：独立特征模型中推导曝光选择性存活律与支持依赖保留边界；共享参数模型中证明遗忘对协方差模式产生谱滤波；在小步长与范数/编码近似下推出数据拟合与信息存储代价的隐式权衡，得到类MDL压缩。开展标量记忆与非线性共享网络的受控实验，进行强化与衰减联合干预。
AI.result: 实验支持强化-遗忘选择机制；联合干预可改变条件保留，匹配曝光次数下强化时机呈现遗忘依赖效应，并改变保留集合的组成。
AI.conclusion: 重复强化与持续遗忘共同构成超越架构与规模的、可控的归纳偏置来源。

title: Composing Task-specific Agent Harnesses at Test Time with Reusable Primitives
summary: Agent harnesses govern how large language models (LLMs) gather context, invoke tools, verify results, preserve state, and terminate, largely affecting agent performance. However, the value of each harness mechanism can differ across heterogeneous tasks: a mechanism that improves one task may impose overhead or context distraction on another, leading to the suboptimality of a global harness. We characterize this suboptimality as a mismatch induced by fixed mechanism choices, motivating task-specific harness construction. Nonetheless, generating harness code for each task introduces generation and debugging costs, with execution risks that can compound as more mechanisms are generated. To address those challenges, we introduce Harness Primitives, reusable harness mechanisms with clear application scope and composition contract mined from failed task trajectories. Based on Harness Primitives, we propose STITCH, a framework that Selects suitable primitives given Task Information and compiles them into Task-speCific Harnesses at test time. This separation enables task-specific harnesses without generating or repairing mechanism code at test time. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STITCH not only improves harness adaptability and robustness, but also scales with the primitive library size, boosting task success rates by up to 12 points over fixed harness baselines, surpassing human-designed harnesses like Codex CLI while maintaining a minimal test-time harness composition overhead of only 2.7%, 638 times more efficient than generating task-specific harnesses from scratch. Ultimately, our work demonstrates that building task-adaptive harnesses can be beneficial for completing diverse tasks and that building reusable primitives can be a promising path towards this goal.

AI.tldr: 提出 Harness Primitives 与 STITCH 框架，实现按任务选择并编译可复用机制，构建任务特定 harness，成功率最多提升 12 点且测试时开销仅 2.7%。
AI.motivation: Agent harness 决定 LLM 如何获取上下文、调用工具、验证结果、保持状态与终止，直接影响性能。但各机制价值随任务而异：对某任务有效的机制在另一任务上可能带来开销或上下文干扰，导致全局统一 harness 次优。作者将此归因于固定机制选择引起的错配，进而需要任务特定的 harness 构建。然而，为每个任务生成 harness 代码存在生成与调试成本，且随机制增多执行风险会累积。
AI.method: 从失败任务轨迹中挖掘 Harness Primitives——具有明确适用范围与组合契约的可复用 harness 机制。基于此提出 STITCH 框架：在测试时根据任务信息选择合适原语，并将其编译为任务特定 harness（Task-speCific Harnesses）。该“选择—编译”分离设计使任务特定 harness 无需在测试时生成或修复机制代码。
AI.result: 实验表明 STITCH 提升了 harness 的适应性与鲁棒性，并随原语库规模扩大而扩展；相比固定 harness 基线，任务成功率最多提升 12 个百分点，超过 Codex CLI 等人工设计 harness；测试时 harness 组合开销仅 2.7%，比从零生成任务特定 harness 高效 638 倍。
AI.conclusion: 构建任务自适应 harness 有助于完成多样化任务，而构建可复用原语是实现该目标的一条有前景的路径。

title: Distilling Diffusion Score Discrepancy for Efficient Training Data Attribution
summary: Training data attribution for diffusion models aims to identify the training samples that influence a generated instance, but existing methods either require costly per-sample gradient computation or query-specific model optimization. Moreover, most methods attribute changes in a proxy loss rather than changes in the actual model's generative behavior. We address these limitations by formulating attribution directly with a local score discrepancy measure, which applies to any diffusion variant (including DDPM, EDM, and flow matching), and by showing that such measure can be estimated without retraining, as a preconditioned gradient similarity. We instantiate this estimator as Training-data Influence via score Discrepancy (TID), which uses Kronecker-factored curvature to avoid random projections and per-sample gradient storage. We then distill TID into TIDE, a forward-only student trained online to reproduce the teacher's rankings from the diffusion model's internal activations. Under counterfactual evaluation on CIFAR-10, ArtBench-10, and MS-COCO, TID matches or outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, while TIDE retains most of TID's accuracy at four to five orders of magnitude lower per-query cost, attributing generated samples in milliseconds and faster than the generation itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对扩散模型训练数据归因问题，提出直接以局部得分差异（local score discrepancy）定义归因，可适用于 DDPM、EDM、flow matching 等变体，并证明该差异无需重训练即可用预条件梯度相似度估计。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型训练数据归因方法存在两大局限：一是需要昂贵的逐样本梯度计算或针对每个查询进行模型优化；二是多数方法归因的是代理损失的变化，而非模型实际生成行为的变化。
AI.method: 作者首先将归因直接形式化为局部得分差异度量；随后证明该度量可无重训练地估计为预条件梯度相似度，并实例化为 TID（Training-data Influence via score Discrepancy），利用 Kronecker 分解曲率避免随机投影与逐样本梯度存储；最后将 TID 蒸馏为 TIDE，一个在线训练的前向学生模型，从扩散模型内部激活中复现教师排序。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10、ArtBench-10 与 MS-COCO 上的反事实评估表明，TID 达到或超越当前最优方法；TIDE 在每查询成本低四到五个数量级的情况下保留了 TID 的大部分准确率，可在毫秒级完成生成样本归因，且快于生成本身。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以局部得分差异统一了扩散模型归因度量，并通过 Kronecker 曲率估计与在线蒸馏，在保持归因精度的同时将查询成本降低数个数量级，实现了快速、与生成变体无关的训练数据归因。

title: Risk-Aware Adaptive Evaluation: Finding High-Impact Failures Under Limited Budgets
comment: Accepted to 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: Evaluation of Interactive Agents
summary: Evaluating interactive agents is expensive. Agent behavior is stochastic, so reliability must be measured over repeated trials, but failures are rare and differ widely in how much they matter. Standard benchmarks spend this budget uniformly: a read-only lookup is sampled as often as an irreversible payment action. We instead formulate evaluation as a sequential allocation problem. Given a fixed trial budget and a set of scenarios whose failure behavior is unknown, which scenarios should be run, and run again? We propose a risk-aware contextual Thompson Sampling policy that combines a pre-execution scenario context vector and a fixed impact score with the failure outcomes observed during evaluation, and we test it by offline replay over 70 $τ$-bench airline scenarios and 824 recorded trials. Our main result is at the smallest budget: with only 50 trials ($6\%$ of the corpus), the policy recovers $86\%$ of the impact-weighted failures an oracle could find, compared to $25\%$ for uniform allocation. It discovers $3.5\times$ more impact-weighted failures (215.4 vs. 62.2) with the same number of trials, delivers $5\times$ the discovery per dollar, and cuts the budget wasted on scenarios that never fail from $34\%$ to $2.8\%$. The rest of our analysis demonstrates and qualifies this result: a budget sweep shows the advantage shrinks as the budget approaches the corpus size, and paired significance tests show that scenario context helps mainly at small budgets while posterior-based exploration helps at moderate ones. Risk-aware adaptive allocation therefore helps most exactly where evaluation budget is scarcest.

AI.tldr: 本文将交互式智能体评测建模为序贯分配问题，提出风险感知的情境Thompson Sampling策略，在有限预算下优先运行高影响、易失败的场景。在70个τ-bench航空场景、824条记录试验上的离线回放显示，50次试验预算下可恢复oracle能发现的86%影响加权失败（均匀分配仅25%）。
AI.motivation: 评测交互式智能体成本高昂：智能体行为具有随机性，可靠性需通过重复试验衡量，而失败稀少且影响差异极大；但标准基准采用均匀采样，把只读查询与不可逆支付动作同等对待，造成预算浪费。
AI.method: 将评测形式化为序贯分配问题：给定固定试验预算与一组失败行为未知的场景，决定运行及重复运行哪些场景。提出风险感知的情境Thompson Sampling策略，将执行前的场景上下文向量与固定影响分数，结合评测中观测到的失败结果进行采样决策。
AI.result: 通过70个τ-bench航空场景、824条记录试验的离线回放验证：在最小预算（50次试验，仅占语料6%）下，该策略恢复oracle可达影响加权失败的86%，均匀分配为25%；同等试验数下发现的影响加权失败多3.5倍（215.4对62.2），单位成本发现量提升5倍，浪费在永不失败场景上的预算从34%降至2.8%。预算扫描显示优势随预算接近语料规模而缩小；配对显著性检验表明场景上下文主要在小预算下有用，基于后验的探索在中等预算下有用。
AI.conclusion: 风险感知的自适应分配在评测预算最稀缺时收益最大，可为交互式智能体评测提供更高效的预算使用方式。

title: ChartDensity-Bench: Benchmarking MLLMs for Numerical Data Reconstruction under Visual Density
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising approach for recovering numerical data from scientific charts, but their ability to reconstruct chart data from visually dense figures remains poorly understood. Existing chart understanding benchmarks primarily evaluate question answering or chart-level reasoning and provide limited support for evaluating structured numerical reconstruction from scientific figures. We introduce \textbf{ChartDensity-Bench}, a benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on structured numerical data reconstruction from compound chart figures under controlled visual density. Built from charts paired with source-level ground-truth data, ChartDensity-Bench systematically varies the number of simultaneously presented charts ($k\in{1,3,6,9}$), enabling controlled evaluation of density-induced degradation. We further propose a multi-dimensional evaluation framework covering structural reliability, reconstruction completeness, parseability, and numerical fidelity. Experiments on five recent MLLMs show that numerical reconstruction generally degrades as visual density increases, while the magnitude of degradation varies substantially across models. Chart-level paired comparisons further show that the same source chart can incur higher reconstruction error when embedded in denser visual contexts. These findings highlight visual density as an important and previously underexplored factor in MLLM chart data reconstruction and provide a systematic benchmark for evaluating model robustness in this setting.

AI.tldr: 提出ChartDensity-Bench基准，在受控视觉密度下评测MLLM从复合图表中重建结构化数值数据的能力，并揭示视觉密度是导致重建性能退化的重要且此前被忽视的因素。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在科学图表数值数据恢复方面具有潜力，但从视觉密集图形中重建图表数据的能力仍缺乏深入理解。现有图表理解基准主要评测问答或图表级推理，对从科学图形中结构化数值重建的支持有限，且未考虑视觉密度这一因素。
AI.method: 构建ChartDensity-Bench基准，基于带源级真值数据的图表，系统变化同时呈现的图表数量（k∈{1,3,6,9}），以受控方式评测密度引发的性能退化。同时提出多维度评测框架，涵盖结构可靠性、重建完整性、可解析性和数值保真度四个维度，并在五个近期MLLM上进行实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，随着视觉密度增加，数值重建性能总体呈退化趋势，但退化幅度在不同模型间差异显著。图表级配对比较进一步显示，同一源图表在嵌入更密集的视觉上下文时会产生更高的重建误差。
AI.conclusion: 视觉密度是MLLM图表数据重建中一个重要且此前未被充分探索的影响因素，ChartDensity-Bench为该场景下的模型鲁棒性评测提供了系统化基准。

title: How Much Can Reliability Drift Under a Fixed Confidence Distribution?
summary: A classifier's conditional accuracy can change while its confidence distribution stays exactly the same. We study the worst-case movement of the reliability relation under covariate shifts that preserve the distribution of the confidence score, constraining the reweighting within each confidence level by a $χ^2$ budget; the resulting worst case, as a function of the budget, is a fragility profile. On an interval of budgets that can be computed from the source distribution, the profile equals exactly the square root of the budget times the within-level variance of the correctness propensity -- the grouping-loss term of calibration-refinement decompositions. Beyond this interval the profile is governed by the tails of the propensity law, and the entire upward profile determines the centred within-level law; consequently, calibration residual and grouping variance do not determine fragility in general, though they do when labels and predictions are deterministic. Since the propensity is not observed, we restrict reweightings to a learned finite readout within confidence bins, bound the part the restriction misses by the grouping variance remaining inside readout cells, estimate the restricted profile with role-separated labels, and provide a separate split-sample lower confidence bound. On ImageNet this bound is positive in both splits for four of six primary classifiers and nine of twelve additional ones as released, and for three of eighteen after temperature scaling. Held-out drift under optimised reweightings fitted without evaluation labels tracks the estimated profile; an exploratory label-permutation diagnostic yields near-zero agreement for this statistic while largely reproducing the correlation observed for unsigned random reweightings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究与置信度分布不变的条件协变量偏移下分类器可靠性关系的最坏情况移动，提出"脆弱性剖面"概念，并给出有限读出近似与可分样本置信下界估计方法，在ImageNet上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 分类器的条件准确率可以在置信度分布完全不变的情况下发生变化，因此仅凭置信度分布无法刻画可靠性关系的稳定性。作者希望刻画在保持置信度分数分布不变的前提下，可靠性关系可能发生的最大偏移，以衡量分类器校准的脆弱性。
AI.method: 在每一置信度层级内以χ²预算约束重加权，构建脆弱性剖面（最坏情况随预算变化的函数）。理论证明：在可由源分布计算出的预算区间内，剖面恰等于预算平方根乘以正确性倾向的层级内标准差（即校准-精细化分解中的分组损失项）；超出该区间后由倾向分布的尾部决定，且整个上升剖面确定中心化的层级内分布。由于倾向不可观测，将重加权限制在置信度分箱内学得的有限读出上，用读出单元内剩余的分组方差界定被忽略部分，用角色分离标签估计受限剖面，并给出独立的分割样本置信下界。
AI.result: 在ImageNet上，该下界在六分之四的主分类器和十二个额外分类器中的九个（原始发布状态）以及十八个中的三个（温度缩放后）的两个划分中均为正。在不使用评估标签拟合的优化重加权下，留出漂移与估计剖面吻合；探索性标签置换诊断对该统计量给出接近零的一致性，同时大体复现了无符号随机重加权所观察到的相关性。
AI.conclusion: 校准残差与分组方差一般不能决定脆弱性，仅当标签与预测确定性时才可决定。所提出的受限读出估计与分割样本下界为在无法观测倾向时评估可靠性关系的脆弱性提供了可行方案，并在ImageNet上得到实证支持。

title: Does a Shared Temperature Imply a Shared Angular Scale in Probabilistic Contrastive Learning?
summary: In probabilistic contrastive learning, a shared temperature is commonly interpreted as a shared similarity scale, but this interpretation does not hold for high-dimensional distributional class representations. We study the exact von Mises-Fisher (vMF) probabilistic score used by ProCo when representation dimension and class concentration grow jointly. We prove that the score retains a class-dependent leading angular gain $g_c=A_c/τ$, where $A_c$ is the mean resultant length. This gain enters Softmax competition, pairwise decision boundaries, and feature gradients. On real CIFAR-LT, ImageNet-LT, and iNaturalist representations, the theory accurately predicts boundary movements and local gradient changes under the full vMF score. Classwise temperature adjustment also changes the cosine-zero intercept and finite-dimensional response. We construct intercept-preserving and Pure Angular controls to separate the leading gain from these accompanying changes. Complete gain equalization yields a shared-scale cosine prototype rule at leading order; a finite-dimensional margin condition guarantees agreement of the two classifiers. Across 16 frozen representation settings, prediction agreement is 98.43-99.99%, with disagreements concentrated at small cosine margins. In controlled contrastive-only training with the training-frequency prior, Pure Angular editing improves both learned representations at all tested CIFAR-10/100 imbalance factors and retains positive changes on ImageNet-LT. Thus vMF concentration not only describes class distributions, but also forms a decision and learning scale in high-dimensional probabilistic contrastive learning.

AI.tldr: 该文研究高维vMF概率对比学习中的类别相关角度增益，证明并验证其主导作用。
AI.motivation: 概率对比学习中常将共享温度理解为共享相似度尺度，但该解释在高维分布式类别表示下不成立，需要厘清vMF得分机制的精确行为。
AI.method: 在表示维度与类别集中度联合增长的设定下，推导ProCo所用vMF概率得分，证明其保留类别相关的角度主增益g_c=A_c/τ（A_c为平均合向量长度），并分析其对Softmax竞争、成对决策边界与特征梯度的影响；构造保截距与Pure Angular对照以分离主增益；提出有限维margin条件。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-LT、ImageNet-LT、iNaturalist表示上理论准确预测边界移动与局部梯度变化；16种冻结表示设置下两分类器预测一致率98.43%–99.99%，分歧集中在小余弦margin处；在受控对比训练中，Pure Angular编辑在所有CIFAR-10/100不平衡因子下提升学习表示，并在ImageNet-LT上保持正向变化。
AI.conclusion: vMF集中度不仅描述类别分布，还构成高维概率对比学习中的决策与学习尺度。

title: Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment Multimodal Federated Learning
summary: Multimodal federated learning (MFL) has emerged as a pivotal paradigm for leveraging distributed data to enhance model performance. However, existing methods predominantly rely on idealized assumptions of model homogeneity and balanced modality distributions, rendering them ill-suited for practical scenarios characterized by heterogeneous client architectures and severe modality imbalance. To address these challenges, we propose a \textbf{M}ultimodal \textbf{Fed}erated learning Prototype-guided Bilateral Alignment (MFedPBA) framework. MFedPBA facilitates robust knowledge synergy through a dual alignment mechanism: (i) at the feature level, it aligns heterogeneous feature spaces via a projection encoder optimized by contrastive learning and the Gromov-Wasserstein distance; (ii) at the decision level, it employs an entropy-weighted aggregation of naturally aligned logit prototypes. This novel design achieves robust MFL by jointly tackling heterogeneous feature spaces and collectively aggregating decisions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines under conditions of model heterogeneity and modality imbalance.

AI.tldr: 提出MFedPBA框架，通过特征级与决策级双边对齐解决多模态联邦学习中的模型异构与模态不平衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态联邦学习方法多基于模型同构与模态分布均衡的理想假设，难以适应客户端架构异构、模态严重不平衡的实际场景。
AI.method: MFedPBA采用双重对齐机制：（i）特征级：通过对比学习与Gromov-Wasserstein距离优化的投影编码器对齐异构特征空间；（ii）决策级：对自然对齐的logit原型进行熵加权聚合。
AI.result: 在模型异构与模态不平衡条件下，该方法显著优于当前最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合处理异构特征空间与协同聚合决策，MFedPBA实现了鲁棒的多模态联邦学习，验证了双边对齐设计的有效性。

title: How Accurate Is Accurate Enough?
summary: How accurate must a numerical approximation be within a learning system? Primitive error alone cannot answer this question: errors of the same magnitude can have very different consequences for losses, predictions, and gradients at different learning states. We study this question through the learning objective itself. The objective weights classwise numerical errors nonuniformly according to the current state, so the importance of an error depends not only on its magnitude but also on the class it affects and the weight that class receives. For softmax cross-entropy, we characterize this coupling between class weights and errors and derive the exact extrema of the signed loss change over pairings of fixed non-target probability and score-error multisets, with the target probability and target score error held fixed. Building on this structure, we establish finite-error guarantees that propagate primitive error to losses, probabilities, predictions, and feature gradients, then invert these guarantees to obtain a certified primitive tolerance for the current state under prescribed learning-level error requirements. We give a complete instantiation of the framework in high-dimensional von Mises-Fisher learning. Controlled interventions and a large collection of saved learning states show that identical primitive error can produce substantially different learning consequences, while certified numerical tolerances vary by orders of magnitude across states under the same learning-level requirements. These results show that the adequacy of a numerical approximation must be assessed in relation to the current learning state and the quantity to be preserved; numerical accuracy should itself be treated as part of the learning objective.

AI.tldr: 本文从学习目标本身出发刻画数值误差的非均匀权重效应，针对softmax交叉熵推导了在固定目标概率与目标分数误差下、损失变化极值的精确解，并据此建立从原始误差到损失、概率、预测与特征梯度的有限误差保证，反向得到当前状态下的认证数值容差；在von Mises-Fisher学习中验证表明，相同原始误差在不同学习状态下后果差异显著，认证容差可相差多个数量级。
AI.motivation: 数值近似的精度要求无法单凭原始误差大小判断：相同幅度的误差在不同学习状态、不同类别上对损失、预测和梯度的影响可能截然不同，因此需要结合学习目标与当前状态来评估数值误差的重要性。
AI.method: 以softmax交叉熵为对象，分析类别权重与误差的耦合关系；在目标概率与目标分数误差固定时，对固定非目标概率与分数误差多重集的所有配对求解带符号损失变化的精确极值；基于该结构建立有限误差保证，将原始误差传播至损失、概率、预测和特征梯度，并将其反演为满足给定学习层误差要求下的认证原始容差；在高维von Mises-Fisher学习上给出完整实例化。
AI.result: 受控干预实验与大量已保存学习状态显示：相同的原始误差会产生显著不同的学习后果；在相同学习层误差要求下，不同状态的认证数值容差可相差多个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 数值近似的充分性必须相对于当前学习状态和需要保持的量来评估，数值精度本身应被视为学习目标的一部分。

title: Learning What to Forget: Distributional Unlearning for LLM Representation Spaces
summary: Machine learning systems increasingly face the need to remove the influence of entire data domains, such as toxic language, harmful behavior, or topical content, rather than isolated records. Recent work formalizes this problem as \emph{distributional unlearning}: selecting a subset of a forget domain whose removal moves the training distribution away from an unwanted population while preserving proximity to the desired one. However, existing analyses often impose parametric assumptions to obtain tractable selection rules. These assumptions may be poorly suited to high-dimensional language-model representations. We introduce \textsc{Mamushi}, a framework for non-parametric distributional unlearning that ranks forget examples using a probabilistic classifier whose Bayes-optimal logit equals the forget-to-retain log-density ratio (up to an additive class-prior constant). We show that thresholding the population log-density ratio yields the optimal fixed-budget selection rule for our removal--preservation objective and establish a non-asymptotic transfer guarantee relating score-estimation and threshold-calibration errors to degradation from the population-optimal selection rule. Our empirical evaluation spans real-world datasets on toxic-language removal and topical-domain removal regimes using different representations, with \textsc{Mamushi} achieving a more favorable removal--preservation trade-off than other baselines. Our work shows that \textsc{Mamushi} can serve as an efficient selection approach for downstream machine unlearning procedures, reducing the number of forget examples required to reach a fixed forgetting target.

AI.tldr: 提出非参数分布式遗忘框架 Mamushi，用概率分类器的贝叶斯最优 logit 近似遗忘域到保留域的对数密度比来对遗忘样本排序，并给出最优阈值选择规则与非渐近迁移保证，在毒性语言和主题域移除任务上取得更优的移除-保留权衡。
AI.motivation: 机器学习系统需要移除整个数据域（如毒性语言、有害行为或特定主题内容）的影响，而非仅删除孤立样本。近期工作将此类问题形式化为分布式遗忘（distributional unlearning）：从遗忘域中选取子集，使移除后训练分布远离不期望总体同时保持接近期望总体。但现有分析多依赖参数化假设以获得可处理的选取规则，这些假设可能不适合高维语言模型表示。因此需要一种非参数的分布式遗忘方法。
AI.method: 提出 Mamushi 框架，进行非参数分布式遗忘：使用概率分类器对遗忘样本排序，该分类器的贝叶斯最优 logit 等于遗忘域到保留域的对数密度比（至多相差一个类别先验常数）。理论上证明对总体对数密度比进行阈值化可得到固定预算下移除-保留目标的最优选取规则，并建立非渐近迁移保证，将评分估计误差和阈值校准误差与相对总体最优选取规则的性能退化联系起来。
AI.result: 在毒性语言移除和主题域移除两类真实数据集、多种表示上进行了实证评估，Mamushi 相比其他基线实现了更有利的移除-保留权衡；并可减少达到固定遗忘目标所需的遗忘样本数量。
AI.conclusion: Mamushi 可作为下游机器遗忘过程的高效样本选取方法，降低达到固定遗忘目标所需的遗忘样本数，同时为分布式遗忘提供了不依赖参数化假设的理论工具。

title: Same Loss, Different Gradients
summary: Differentiable learning typically assumes that the scalar objective evaluated in the forward pass and the gradient supplied to the optimizer in the backward pass describe the same mathematical object. We show that this correspondence can fail when probabilistic objectives rely on finite special-function recurrences, custom backward rules, and numerical clipping. In high-dimensional von Mises-Fisher learning, real numerical implementations can produce identical forward scores and losses at the same learning state while supplying different gradients and following different optimization trajectories. We characterize the structure of this mismatch in finite-start Bessel recurrence and show that classwise radial mismatch can compose through probabilities into a locally nonconservative update field. Evaluating the accuracy of special-function values and derivatives separately is therefore insufficient to characterize the realized learning objective. Motivated by this observation, we introduce AR/FR, a fixed-depth analytic realization that constructs a potential and its derivative jointly, ensuring forward-backward coherence by construction. We establish a uniform cubic-order error bound relative to the exact Bessel ratio over the entire nonnegative concentration axis and propagate this guarantee to learning scores and objectives. As representation dimension increases, the original finite recurrence becomes sequentially deeper, whereas the worst-case AR/FR error guarantee tightens cubically, jointly providing coherence, certified fidelity, and fixed-depth computation. These results suggest that a differentiable numerical primitive is defined by both the values it realizes and the derivatives it actually supplies to the optimizer; together, they constitute the numerical realization of the learning algorithm.

AI.tldr: 论文指出可微学习中前向值与反向梯度常被假定描述同一数学对象，但在高维 von Mises-Fisher 学习中，有限 Bessel 递推、自定义反向规则与数值裁剪会导致前向一致而梯度不一致。作者提出 AR/FR 解析实现，联合构造势函数及其导数，实现固定深度、前向-反向一致性，并给出三次阶误差界。
AI.motivation: 传统可微学习假设前向评估的标量目标与反向传给优化器的梯度对应同一数学对象。然而当概率目标涉及有限特殊函数递推、自定义反向规则和数值裁剪时，这一对应可能失效；单独评估特殊函数值与导数的精度不足以刻画实际学习目标。作者因此希望揭示并解决这种前向-反向不匹配问题。
AI.method: 作者刻画了有限起点 Bessel 递推中不匹配的结构，说明逐类径向不匹配可通过概率组合为局部非保守更新场。为此提出 AR/FR——一种固定深度解析实现，联合构造势函数及其导数，从构造上保证前向-反向一致性；并在整个非负集中度轴上建立相对于精确 Bessel 比值的均匀三次阶误差界，将保证传播到学习分数与目标。
AI.result: 在高维 von Mises-Fisher 学习中，真实数值实现可在同一学习状态产生相同前向分数和损失，却给出不同梯度并沿不同优化轨迹；随表示维度增加，原始有限递推顺序加深，而 AR/FR 的最坏情况误差保证按三次阶收紧，同时实现一致性、可认证保真度与固定深度计算。
AI.conclusion: 可微数值原语不仅由其实现的值定义，还由实际提供给优化器的导数定义；二者共同构成学习算法的数值实现。AR/FR 通过联合构造势与导数，在固定深度下提供前向-反向一致性和认证误差界。

title: Routing Probes Can Improve Without New Information: An Exact-Null Audit of Uncertainty Beyond Model Outputs
summary: Routing signals of modern vision transformers -- expert gates, attention-residual weights and halting scores -- often improve probes that predict whether the model is correct, and the improvement is commonly read as evidence that routing carries information about errors beyond the model's outputs. We test this inference directly: keeping real output-routing pairs, we redraw correctness labels from a frozen output-only generator fitted on disjoint data, so that routing is uninformative by construction. Under this exact label null, a width-matched MLP comparison still reports a routing gain in 51.3% of confidence-only evaluations (308/600), while a linear comparison reports none. Holding each training trajectory fixed on a six-model panel and selecting the checkpoint by validation log loss instead of validation accuracy removes the detections (50/120 to 0/120, and 83/120 to 0/120 in an independently implemented probe), identifying accuracy-based checkpoint selection as the cause; across all output views the raw detection rate falls from 27.5% (528/1,920) to zero observed detections. The repaired comparison is not sensitive, detecting an implanted signal of about 0.005 nats in 0/20 replicates in each of two matched settings, whereas a conditional permutation test built on an estimated routing law detects it in 11/20 and 10/20 and rejects rarely under the null. On real correctness labels, the conditional analysis yields model-relative evidence in five DeiT attention-residual families; in four it persists under two specified variants of the conditional law, and no family passes an additional noise criterion. Fitting a better probe and testing for incremental information are different problems, and each needs its own validation.

title: LEARN-TS: LLM-Enhanced Alignment and Reconstruction with Normality Guidance for Multivariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Reconstruction errors in multivariate time-series anomaly detection may not reliably distinguish abnormal behavior from benign deviations. Language-derived semantics offer complementary context, but existing multimodal approaches may rely on time-associated paired textual information that is difficult to obtain consistently and is not provided by standard multivariate time-series anomaly detection benchmarks. This setting poses two challenges: (1) conditioning masked reconstruction on window-specific semantics without exposing exact numerical targets or anomaly-specific cues, and (2) using a window-independent concept of normality as a complementary semantic reference rather than an independent anomaly detector. We propose LLM-Enhanced Alignment and Reconstruction with Normality Guidance for Time Series (LEARN-TS), which uses a frozen language model to construct two role-separated semantic representations without requiring temporally paired external text. Window-specific observation semantics encode temporal and cross-variable context without exact numerical values to guide channel-shared patch-masked reconstruction. A fixed, dataset-agnostic normality prompt provides a window-independent semantic reference for aligning normal representations and estimating normality discrepancy. At inference, masking each temporal patch once yields timestamp-level reconstruction evidence, conditionally modulated by discrepancy from a separate unmasked view. Across four benchmarks, LEARN-TS achieves the highest mean performance in 13 of 16 dataset-metric comparisons. Controlled ablations examine observation conditioning, joint normality alignment and scoring, and reference content, showing dataset-dependent ranking benefits and modest average gains from semantic over random references.

AI.tldr: 提出 LEARN-TS，用冻结语言模型构建两种角色分离的语义表示，在无时间配对文本条件下增强多变量时间序列异常检测的掩码重建与正常性对齐。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列异常检测中，重建误差难以可靠区分异常与良性偏差；语言语义可提供互补上下文，但现有多模态方法依赖难以稳定获取、且标准基准不提供的时间配对文本。该设定带来两个挑战：（1）在不暴露精确数值目标或异常线索的前提下，以窗口特定语义条件化掩码重建；（2）将窗口无关的正常性概念用作互补语义参考，而非独立异常检测器。
AI.method: LEARN-TS 使用冻结语言模型构建两种角色分离的语义表示，无需时间配对外部文本。窗口特定观测语义编码时间与跨变量上下文但不含精确数值，用于引导通道共享的 patch 掩码重建；固定的、数据集无关的正常性提示提供窗口无关语义参考，用于对齐正常表示并估计正常性差异。推理时，对每个时间 patch 各掩码一次得到时间戳级重建证据，并由独立未掩码视图得到的差异进行条件调制。
AI.result: 在四个基准上，LEARN-TS 在 16 项数据集-指标比较中的 13 项取得最高平均性能。受控消融考察了观测条件化、联合正常性对齐与打分、参考内容，显示数据集相关的排序收益，以及语义参考相较随机参考带来的平均增益有限但为正。
AI.conclusion: LEARN-TS 表明，在标准多变量时间序列异常检测基准中，可不依赖时间配对文本，通过冻结语言模型提供窗口特定观测语义与窗口无关正常性参考，互补地提升重建式异常检测；但语义参考的平均增益有限，效果具有数据集依赖性。

title: Targeted Retrieval, Compact Representations: How CoT Reasoning Improves Long-Context Counting
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been rapidly improving in long-context tasks, powered by Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. However, the internal mechanisms underlying this improvement remain unclear. We investigate these mechanisms through a needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) counting task, where an LLM is asked to count the number of records dispersed in a long text. Across twelve model comparison groups, Thinking (or reasoning) improves counting accuracy over Non-thinking, with pronounced gains at larger counts. This motivates our mechanistic analysis, which identifies two contrasting mechanisms: (i) broad retrieval, where Non-thinking models broadly attend to multiple needles; (ii) targeted retrieval, where Thinking models use enumeration in CoT traces to successively retrieve needles. Targeted retrieval concentrates attention on individual needles and is accompanied by more compact internal representations. Moreover, causal intervention analysis suggests that Thinking models use the CoT trace to maintain and update an internal counter as needles are successively retrieved, even without explicit numbering. In small controlled experiments, both retrieval mechanisms and counter states emerge under standard autoregressive training. Together, our results connect long-context retrieval with representation geometry of counting, supporting a state-tracking account of CoT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文通过 NIAH 计数任务揭示 CoT 推理提升长上下文能力的内部机制：Thinking 模型采用"定向检索"，借助思维链枚举逐个提取目标并维护内部计数器，而 Non-thinking 模型仅做"宽泛检索"。
AI.motivation: LLM 在长上下文任务上借助 CoT 推理取得显著进步，但其内部机制尚不清晰。作者希望解释推理为何以及如何提升长上下文计数能力，并连接长文本检索与计数的表征几何。
AI.method: 采用 needle-in-a-haystack（NIAH）计数任务，让模型统计长文本中分散记录的数量；在 12 组模型对比中比较 Thinking 与非 Thinking 表现；通过机制分析（注意力模式、表征紧致度）识别两种检索机制，并用因果干预检验内部计数器，另以小型受控实验验证机制是否能在标准自回归训练下自然涌现。
AI.result: Thinking 在全部十二组对比中均优于 Non-thinking，且计数越大增益越明显。机制上呈现两类对比模式：Non-thinking 为宽泛检索，注意力分散于多个 needle；Thinking 为定向检索，通过 CoT 枚举依次定位单个 needle，注意力更集中、内部表征更紧凑。因果干预表明，Thinking 模型即使没有显式编号，也利用 CoT 轨迹维护并更新内部计数器。小型受控实验中，两种检索机制与计数器状态均可在标准自回归训练下涌现。
AI.conclusion: 研究将长上下文检索与计数的表征几何联系起来，支持 CoT 推理的"状态追踪"解释：CoT 通过定向检索与内部计数器实现逐步状态更新，从而提升长上下文计数性能。

title: Evaluating Persistent Calibration under Evolving Model Knowledge
summary: As AI systems move from static repositories to agents that are capable of continual adaptation and learning, maintaining their trustworthiness means equipping the models backing them with the ability to produce confidence estimates that dynamically reflect their changing skills and knowledge. We introduce the problem of persistent calibration, which requires a confidence estimator to faithfully reflect the knowledge contained in a model as that knowledge changes, without recurring supervision. We operationalize this by examining persistent calibration across checkpoints of open models, asking whether confidence estimators trained on earlier checkpoints can generalize to later ones. Specifically, we aim to shed light on whether confidence is dependent on knowledge, a question with implications for the reliability of confidence estimates. To measure this relationship, we define and evaluate calibration on knowledge contrast sets: subsets containing questions that one checkpoint answers correctly and another checkpoint answers incorrectly, reflecting a change in knowledge. We show that both inference-time and fine-tuning methods fall short on contrast-set calibration compared to oracle methods trained on future checkpoints, even for methods that are well-calibrated on the full dataset. We provide evidence for the hypothesis that persistent calibration is challenging because there is a vast space of possible confidence functions that are well-calibrated on a given checkpoint, out of which only some rely on meta-knowledge features that would generalize to other checkpoints. Towards improving contrast-set calibration, we show that multi-checkpoint training helps, suggesting an avenue for identifying confidence features that remain robust across changing knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"持续校准"问题：置信度估计器须在模型知识变化时忠实反映其知识，且无需反复监督。通过在开放模型不同检查点上评估对比集校准，发现现有推理时与微调方法均不足，多检查点训练可部分缓解。
AI.motivation: AI系统正从静态仓库转向具备持续适应与学习能力的智能体，其可信度要求模型能给出随技能与知识变化而动态调整的置信度估计。现有校准方法多针对单一固定检查点，缺乏对知识变化后置信度是否依然可靠的系统研究，因此需要明确"置信度是否依赖于知识"这一问题。
AI.method: 提出并形式化"持续校准"（persistent calibration）：要求置信度估计器在模型知识变化时无需重复监督即可忠实反映知识。将其操作化为跨开放模型检查点的校准：在早期检查点上训练置信度估计器，测试其能否泛化到后期检查点；并定义"知识对比集"——某检查点答对而另一检查点答错的子集，以此度量校准。
AI.result: 在对比集校准上，推理时方法与微调方法均落后于用未来检查点训练的oracle方法，即便这些方法在全数据集上校准良好。这支持以下假设：持续校准之所以困难，是因为在给定检查点上良好校准的置信度函数空间极大，其中仅一部分依赖可泛化到其他检查点的元知识特征。多检查点训练有助于改善对比集校准。
AI.conclusion: 持续校准是一个独立且具挑战性的问题，无法由常规校准方法自动满足；多检查点训练为识别跨知识变化仍稳健的置信度特征提供了可行路径，指向提升持续校准的方向。

title: Alleviating Hallucination in Reasoning Tasks with Training-Free Uncertainty-Guided Steering
summary: Recent work on hallucination detection in large language models has shown that, for a fixed pre-trained model and reasoning task, it is possible to estimate the model's confidence in the correctness of its outputs. Such uncertainty estimates have primarily been used to improve truthfulness by detecting or filtering confabulations. In this work, we ask whether these signals can instead be used more proactively to directly improve the accuracy of model-generated answers. We propose USteer, a simple, training-free steering mechanism that adjusts a model's layer-wise activations during inference using the gradient of a confidence measure with respect to the activations. This procedure nudges generation toward outputs with lower uncertainty at inference time, without modifying model parameters or requiring additional supervision. We show that this approach consistently reduces hallucination across a range of tasks, demonstrating that confidence signals can be leveraged not only for detection, but also for effective inference-time control of model behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 USteer，一种无需训练、无监督的推理期激活引导机制，利用置信度对激活的梯度来降低大模型幻觉。
AI.motivation: 已有幻觉检测工作表明可以为固定预训练模型和推理任务估计其输出正确性的置信度，但这些不确定性估计主要用于检测或过滤虚构内容（被动用途）。本文希望探索这些信号能否被更主动地利用，直接提升模型生成答案的准确性。
AI.method: USteer：在推理时调整模型逐层激活，使用某一置信度度量关于激活的梯度来引导生成。该方法无需训练、无需修改模型参数、也不需要额外监督，仅通过梯度方向将生成推向不确定性更低的输出。
AI.result: 在多种任务上，该方法一致地减少了幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 置信度信号不仅能用于检测幻觉，还可作为推理期控制模型行为的有效手段，实现主动提升答案准确性。

title: Explicit Trajectory Diversity for RL-Based Post-Training of LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents often admit multiple high-quality solutions to the same task, differing in reasoning structure, tool-use pattern, or interaction trajectory. Yet existing notions of diversity in LLM post-training are mostly implicit, arising from general stochasticity and regularization mechanisms rather than explicitly targeting task-relevant behavioral variation. While such implicit diversity can be useful, it does not directly specify which forms of behavioral variation should be encouraged for a given task. In this work, we study explicit trajectory diversity in RL-based post-training for LLMs. Our key idea is to define diversity through user-specified, task-specific trajectory descriptors, which map each sampled trajectory to an interpretable behavioral representation, and then measure diversity as a set-level functional over the resulting descriptor matrix. Building on this formulation, we introduce Trajectory-guided Joint Policy Optimization(TJPO), a single-policy framework that optimizes explicit diversity over sampled trajectory groups, avoiding the need for population-based policy training, and instantiate it within group-based policy optimization through trajectory-level learning signals. This design makes the diversity objective both interpretable and controllable. Experiments on Sokoban and ALFWorld show that TJPO improves task-specific trajectory diversity while maintaining competitive task performance. Descriptor and trajectory analyses show that the learned variation follows the specified behavioral dimensions and includes distinct successful strategies. Extra experiment results suggest that explicitly shaping trajectory diversity can help LLM agents satisfy user requirements and remain effective when task conditions change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出显式轨迹多样性（Explicit Trajectory Diversity）这一RL后训练框架，通过用户指定的任务相关轨迹描述子定义多样性，并设计TJPO算法在单策略、基于组的策略优化中直接优化显式多样性，在Sokoban与ALFWorld上提升任务特定行为多样性的同时保持竞争力性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM后训练中的多样性大多是隐式的，来自通用随机性与正则化机制，而非显式针对任务相关的行为变异。隐式多样性虽有用，但无法指定对给定任务应鼓励哪种行为变异，缺乏可解释性与可控性。
AI.method: 核心思路是用用户指定、任务特定的轨迹描述子（trajectory descriptor）将每条采样轨迹映射为可解释的行为表示，并将多样性定义为描述子矩阵上的集合级泛函。基于此提出TJPO（Trajectory-guided Joint Policy Optimization）：单一策略框架，在采样得到的轨迹组上优化显式多样性，无需基于种群（population-based）的策略训练，并通过轨迹级学习信号实例化到基于组的策略优化中，使多样性目标既可解释又可控制。
AI.result: 在Sokoban和ALFWorld上的实验表明，TJPO在保持竞争力任务性能的同时提升了任务特定轨迹多样性。描述子与轨迹分析显示，学到的变异遵循指定的行为维度，并包含不同的成功策略。额外实验结果表明，显式塑造轨迹多样性有助于LLM智能体满足用户需求，并在任务条件改变时保持有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究将轨迹多样性从隐式、不可控的副产物转变为显式、可解释、可控制的目标，提出的TJPO在单策略组优化框架下实现任务特定行为多样性与任务性能的兼顾，并展现出对用户需求与任务条件变化的适应性。

title: When Order Matters: First-Speaker Bias and Mitigation through Personality in Sequential Multi-Agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) is often used to improve large language model (LLM) reasoning, but sequential debate is rarely a neutral aggregator of agents' opinions. We show that sequential MAD suffers from a pronounced first-speaker bias: agents disproportionately shape the final answer when they speak first. As a result, placing a stronger model after weaker ones can substantially offset its reasoning advantage. We then focus on the disadvantaged strong-agent-last setting and ask whether personality prompting can mitigate this imbalance. Drawing on the Big Five model, we study agreeableness and extraversion as behavioral interventions applied to either the strong or weak side. We find that their effects are trait-specific. Influence consistently shifts in the direction of lower agreeableness, and assigning low agreeableness to the stronger agent helps restore its lost influence and improves final accuracy. Extraversion, by contrast, produces less systematic changes in influence and accuracy, with its clearest effect appearing in agents' verbosity. These findings show that effective MAD design depends not only on model capability, but also on how speaking order and induced interaction behavior shape the debate process.

AI.tldr: 顺序多智能体辩论存在"先发言者偏见"，可通过大五人格提示（宜人性）干预来缓解强弱智能体影响力失衡并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 多智能体辩论（MAD）常被用于提升大语言模型推理能力，但顺序辩论很少是智能体观点的中立聚合器；作者希望揭示其中存在的影响力偏差，并探索在"强模型后置"的不利设定下能否通过人格提示加以纠正。
AI.method: 刻画顺序MAD中的先发言者偏见，并考察强模型置于弱模型之后时其推理优势被抵消的程度；基于大五人格模型，将宜人性（agreeableness）与外向性（extraversion）作为行为干预，分别施加于强侧或弱侧智能体，比较其对影响力与最终准确率的影响。
AI.result: 发现显著的首发言者偏见：先发言者不成比例地塑造最终答案；影响力一致地朝"低宜人性"方向偏移，将低宜人性赋予强模型可恢复其失去的影响力并提升最终准确率；外向性对影响力与准确率的影响较不系统，其最明显效应体现在智能体的冗长度（verbosity）上。
AI.conclusion: 有效的MAD设计不仅取决于模型能力，还取决于发言顺序与所诱导的交互行为如何塑造辩论过程；人格提示（尤其是宜人性）可作为调节影响力分配与提升性能的手段。

title: Blackboard Intelligence Can Surpass Autoregressive on Globally Constrained Problems
summary: Next-token prediction has driven remarkable progress in large language models, yet a growing body of evidence suggests that they can struggle on problems governed by complex global constraints. In this work, we focus on this regime and ask whether some of these limitations arise from the inference interface induced by next-token prediction itself. We study this question through blackboard intelligence: an inference-time perspective in which a model works on a fixed, revisable canvas and searches over candidate solution states rather than committing to a causal, left-to-right trajectory. We instantiate this idea with diffusion language models, whose any-order prediction interface naturally exposes predictions over partially filled solution states. Our key observation is that mean confidence, a simple model-internal quantity available from the standard masked diffusion objective, provides a useful proxy for global coherence and can guide inference-time search and revision. Empirically, across ZebraLogic, Nurse Rostering, and Job-Shop Scheduling, Blackboard consistently improves inference while holding the fine-tuned LLaDA-8B-Instruct checkpoint fixed and substantially outperforms same-scale autoregressive baselines, reaching 90.4% accuracy on ZebraLogic-Hard, 76.4% exact feasibility on Nurse Rostering, and 80.2% optimality on JSSP. Stronger autoregressive search and refinement also fail to close the gap on ZebraLogic-Hard, while Blackboard surpasses tested frontier LLMs there and on JSSP despite their substantially greater scale and strong test-time reasoning. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/jwoosang1/blackboard-intelligence.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"黑板智能"（Blackboard Intelligence）推理范式，用扩散语言模型在可修改画布上搜索候选解状态，并以平均置信度引导推理时搜索与修正，在复杂全局约束任务上显著优于同规模自回归基线。
AI.motivation: 下一词预测驱动的LLM在受复杂全局约束支配的问题上表现不佳。作者追问：这些局限是否部分源自下一词预测本身所诱导的推理接口（因果、从左到右的固定轨迹，缺乏全局可修改性）。
AI.method: 提出"黑板智能"推理时视角：模型在固定且可修改的画布上工作，搜索候选解状态，而非承诺因果式左到右轨迹。用扩散语言模型实例化，其任意顺序预测接口天然暴露部分填充解状态上的预测。关键观察是：来自标准掩码扩散目标的模型内部量"平均置信度"可作为全局一致性的代理，用于引导推理时的搜索与修正。实验保持LLaDA-8B-Instruct微调检查点固定，仅改变推理过程。
AI.result: 在ZebraLogic、Nurse Rostering、Job-Shop Scheduling上，Blackboard均一致提升推理表现，显著优于同规模自回归基线：ZebraLogic-Hard达90.4%准确率，Nurse Rostering达76.4%精确可行性，JSSP达80.2%最优性。更强的自回归搜索与精化仍无法在ZebraLogic-Hard上弥合差距；Blackboard在该任务及JSSP上超过了所测前沿LLM，尽管后者规模更大且具备强测试时推理。
AI.conclusion: 部分LLM局限确实来自下一词预测的推理接口；通过扩散模型的任意顺序接口配合平均置信度引导的搜索与修正，可在不改变模型权重的前提下大幅提升复杂全局约束问题的求解能力，并在部分任务上超越更大规模的前沿LLM。

title: RealWorldShop: Benchmarking and Improving Conversational Shopping Agents in Real-World E-commerce
summary: Large language models are reshaping ecommerce from static recommenders into interactive shopping assistants, yet real-world shopping requires session-level decision support: users reveal and revise constraints, coordinate multiple goals, and expect product-grounded recommendations over a full conversation. Existing benchmarks are mostly outcome-oriented or execution-oriented, leaving this evolving decision process under-evaluated. We introduce REALWORLDSHOP, a benchmark built on 3.28M grounded products, structured shopping episodes, a profile-grounded and actioncontrolled user simulator, and role-play evaluation. Our analysis shows that current systems produce locally plausible responses but struggle with state tracking, constraint updating, and grounded convergence, especially under ambiguous intent, bundle, and multi-intent scenarios. We further propose REALSHOP_AGENT, an executable session-control framework with explicit state management, shopping-flow control, catalog-grounded retrieval, and runtime guards. Experiments show that REALSHOP_AGENT consistently outperforms strong baselines on REALWORLDSHOP.

AI.tldr: 提出REALWORLDSHOP基准（基于328万真实商品、结构化购物回合、画像驱动用户模拟器与角色扮演评估），用于评估会话级购物决策支持；并给出可执行会话控制框架REALSHOP_AGENT，在基准上稳定超越强基线。
AI.motivation: 大模型正把电商从静态推荐器转变为交互式购物助手，但真实购物需要会话级决策支持：用户会逐步透露与修订约束、协调多重目标，并期待在整个对话中获得有商品依据的推荐。现有基准多为结果导向或执行导向，对这一动态决策过程评估不足。
AI.method: 构建REALWORLDSHOP基准，包含328万条有依据的商品、结构化购物回合、由用户画像驱动且动作受控的用户模拟器，以及角色扮演式评估。同时提出REALSHOP_AGENT可执行会话控制框架，具备显式状态管理、购物流程控制、目录依据检索与运行时守卫。
AI.result: 分析显示当前系统能产生局部看似合理的回复，但在状态跟踪、约束更新和基于依据的收敛方面表现不佳，在意图模糊、捆绑和多意图场景下尤为明显。实验表明REALSHOP_AGENT在REALWORLDSHOP上持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 会话级购物决策支持是被忽视且关键的能力维度；REALWORLDSHOP提供了相应评估工具，REALSHOP_AGENT通过显式状态与流程控制、检索依据和运行时守卫有效提升表现。

title: Learning Chaos Without Seeing Chaos: Extrapolation of Global Dynamics in Autoregressive Transformers
summary: Autoregressive models are trained to predict a system's behavior one step at a time, and recursive generation allows the learned dynamics to unfold over long horizons. To what extent can such dynamics learned from local observations recover broader organization of an underlying system that was only partially observed during training? Here we study small autoregressive transformers trained from scratch on trajectories sampled from restricted parameter regimes of several non-linear dynamical systems, including logistic and sine maps, the Lorenz system, and the generalized Hopf system, with control parameters and state trajectories represented as sequences of continuous tokens. Under closed-loop evaluation at parameters far outside the training distribution, the models can recover self-similar period-doubling cascades, chaotic dynamics, and attractor structures with remarkable visual and numerical fidelity. For the logistic map, a transformer reproduces successive period doublings up to period 128, yielding a finite-order scaling ratio of 4.6687, matching the Feigenbaum constant to within $5\times10^{-4}$. We further investigate how these structures emerge over the course of training, and reveal with causal interventions how control-parameter information is processed through attention into state prediction and shapes the resulting closed-loop dynamics. These results suggest that a surprisingly narrow window into a system's local behavior may suffice for autoregressive transformers to generalize to its unseen global dynamical organization.

AI.tldr: 小型自回归Transformer在仅观测局部参数区间的情况下，通过在闭环生成中泛化，能够恢复非线性动力系统的全局组织，包括周期倍增级联、混沌与吸引子结构，并高精度复现Feigenbaum常数。
AI.motivation: 论文关注一个核心问题：从局部观测中学到的自回归动力学，是否能够恢复仅被部分观测的底层系统的更广泛全局组织。作者希望检验自回归模型在训练分布之外的闭环评估中，能否外推出非线性动力系统的全局动力学结构。
AI.method: 方法上，从头训练小型自回归Transformer，数据来自若干非线性动力系统的受限参数区间轨迹，包括logistic映射、sine映射、Lorenz系统和广义Hopf系统。控制参数与状态轨迹被表示为连续token序列。随后在远离训练分布的参数下进行闭环评估，并通过因果干预分析控制参数信息如何经注意力机制进入状态预测并塑造闭环动力学；同时考察这些结构在训练过程中如何形成。
AI.result: 结果显示，在训练分布之外的闭环评估中，模型能够以显著视觉与数值保真度恢复自相似周期倍增级联、混沌动力学和吸引子结构。对logistic映射，Transformer复现了直至周期128的连续周期倍增，得到有限阶标度比4.6687，与Feigenbaum常数误差在5×10⁻⁴以内。因果干预进一步揭示了控制参数信息通过注意力被处理并影响状态预测及闭环动力学的方式。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：对系统局部行为的一个惊人狭窄观测窗口，可能已足以让自回归Transformer泛化到其未见过的全局动力学组织。这表明从局部观测学习动力学模型具有超越训练分布的外推潜力。

title: C-STRIDE: An Observation-Driven AI Digital Twin for Predicting Basin-Wide Flood Fields from Sparse Stream-Gauge Histories
summary: Emergency managers need to know where floodwater is, how deep it is, and how it will change over the coming hours across an entire river basin. During a flood, however, real-time measurements come from only a handful of stream gauges, and high-resolution hydrodynamic models are too costly to rerun each time new data arrive or to run as large ensembles. We present C-STRIDE, an observation-driven AI digital twin that turns short records from a few stream gauges, together with terrain and rainfall, into basin-wide maps of water depth and extends these predictions up to a day ahead. It is trained on simulations from a calibrated two-dimensional hydrodynamic model and needs no separate data-assimilation step. In the Des Plaines River basin near Chicago, six gauges inform predictions over 4.2 million 30-m grid cells. Terrain improves the predictions most, rainfall keeps errors from growing over longer horizons, and together they reduce errors by about 40% compared with gauge records alone. When future rainfall is known, errors remain near 15% one day ahead, compared with nearly 40% without rainfall. Given real instead of simulated gauge records, the model shifts its predictions toward the observed hydrographs at three of six gauges without retraining, and it runs about 150 times faster than the hydrodynamic model. These results show how sparse gauges, terrain, and rainfall can be combined into fast, continuously updated flood predictions, a step toward operational flood digital twins that still requires testing with real-time data and rainfall forecasts.

AI.tldr: 提出C-STRIDE，一种观测驱动的AI数字孪生模型，将少量水文站短记录、地形和降雨转化为全流域水深图，并可提前一天预测洪水。
AI.motivation: 洪水期间实时测量仅来自少数水文站，而高分辨率水动力模型重跑成本高、难以用于大集合预报，应急管理者亟需快速、连续的流域尺度水深与演进预测。
AI.method: 基于校准的二维水动力模型模拟结果训练C-STRIDE，无需独立的数据同化步骤；以少数水文站短记录、地形和降雨为输入，输出全流域水深时空预测。在芝加哥附近Des Plaines河流域，用6个水文站驱动420万个30米网格的预测。
AI.result: 地形对预测提升最大，降雨抑制长预见期误差增长，二者结合较仅用水文站记录降低约40%误差；已知未来降雨时，提前一天误差约15%，无降雨时接近40%；输入真实而非模拟水文站记录时，模型无需重训练即在6个站中的3个向观测过程线偏移；运行速度约为水动力模型的150倍。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏水文站、地形和降雨可结合为快速、持续更新的洪水预测，是迈向业务化洪水数字孪生的一步，但仍需用实时数据和降雨预报进一步测试。

title: SparLeak: Privacy Leakage from Sparse Attention in LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
summary:
Sparse attention is widely used to accelerate long-context inference in modern large language models (LLMs), but its input-dependent execution behavior introduces previously unexplored privacy risks. We identify a new GPU micro-architectural side channel, termed Sparsity-Induced Memory Access (SIMA), which arises from secret-dependent key-value cache access patterns induced by sparse attention.
  Based on this observation, we present SparLeak, a phase-aware side-channel attack that extracts SIMA traces during LLM inference and enables two practical privacy extractions: query attribute inference from prefill-phase traces and autoregressive response reconstruction from decoding-phase traces. By reconstructing approximate token-level sparsity profiles from page-level observations and applying profiling-based learning, SparLeak accurately recovers sensitive information, including user-query attributes and private LLM response content. Extensive evaluation across three LLM architectures, three sparse attention mechanisms, and three privacy-sensitive datasets shows that SparLeak achieves average attack success rates of 90.9% for attribute inference and 87.3% for response reconstruction under real-world LLM serving settings, highlighting the significance to account for SIMA leakage when deploying sparse-attention-based LLM systems. We provide anonymized SIMA traces, trained attack models, evaluation scripts, and documentation as artifacts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Janus_artifacts/.

AI.tldr: 本文发现稀疏注意力在LLM长上下文推理中引入的新型GPU微架构侧信道SIMA，并提出阶段感知攻击SparLeak，可分别从prefill与decoding阶段提取查询属性与重构响应内容。
AI.motivation: 稀疏注意力虽被广泛用于加速长上下文LLM推理，但其依赖输入的执行行为带来了此前未被探索的隐私风险，即由密钥相关的KV缓存访问模式构成的侧信道。
AI.method: 提出SparLeak阶段感知侧信道攻击：在LLM推理中提取SIMA痕迹，从页级观测重建近似的token级稀疏度剖面，并结合基于profiling的学习，实现prefill阶段的查询属性推断与decoding阶段的自回归响应重构。
AI.result: 在三种LLM架构、三种稀疏注意力机制和三个隐私敏感数据集上评估，真实LLM服务设置下属性推断平均攻击成功率90.9%，响应重构平均成功率87.3%。
AI.conclusion: SIMA泄漏对稀疏注意力LLM系统构成实际隐私威胁，部署时需加以考虑；作者公开了匿名化SIMA痕迹、攻击模型、评估脚本与文档作为artifact。

title: Search Shapes Conclusions: Auditing Evidence Selection Bias in Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep Research agents synthesize evidence into cited reports, yet a well-cited report can still reach a misleading conclusion. Citation correctness checks whether cited sources support individual claims. It does not show whether adaptive search exposed a representative view of all documents made available for evaluation, which we call the candidate pool. Early findings redirect later queries, document choices, and stopping, so the documents an agent reads form a selective sample. Existing evaluations rarely account for this selection. We formulate the problem as adaptive evidence sampling and introduce Causal Evidence Selection Correction (CESS). CESS predicts each candidate document's evidence direction and corrects the candidate-pool average using the logged probabilities of selecting each document and reaching each search round. Shrinkage stabilizes short searches, while intervals replace point estimates when some documents cannot be sampled. We also prove that estimating the average evidence direction of a common pool differs from measuring how a change in search policy alters the evidence read. The latter requires intervention. On questions from the MS2 systematic-review benchmark, CESS reduces mean absolute error against the candidate-pool average by $9.2\%$ and reduces the estimate's change under opposing document rankings by $39.4\%$ relative to averaging the evidence scores of documents read. Across trajectories from a public Open Deep Research agent, the corresponding reductions reach $60.1\%$ and $87.2\%$. A further 4,800 trajectories under paired interventions confirm that correcting a pool estimate and measuring a policy effect are different tasks. CESS therefore audits whether the evidence direction underlying a report reflects the documents available for evaluation, while a separate intervention analysis measures the effect of search decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Causal Evidence Selection Correction（CESS）方法，用于纠正 Deep Research 智能体自适应检索带来的证据选择偏差，从而评估报告结论方向是否真实反映候选文档池的整体证据分布。
AI.motivation: 现有引用正确性检查仅验证引文是否支持单条论断，无法判断自适应检索是否暴露了候选文档池的代表性证据视图。由于早期发现会改变后续查询、文档选择与停止时机，智能体读取的文档只是选择性样本，现有评估很少考虑这种选择偏差。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为自适应证据采样，提出 CESS：预测每个候选文档的证据方向，并利用选择各文档和到达各检索轮次的记录概率，对候选池平均进行校正；使用收缩估计稳定短检索，并在部分文档不可采样时用区间替代点估计。同时证明估计共同候选池的平均证据方向与测量检索策略变化对读取证据的影响是两个不同任务，后者需要干预分析。
AI.result: 在 MS2 系统综述基准问题上，CESS 相较直接平均已读文档的证据分数，将相对候选池平均的均方绝对误差降低 9.2%，并将相反文档排序下估计变化降低 39.4%；在公开 Open Deep Research 智能体的轨迹上，相应降幅达 60.1% 和 87.2%。额外 4,800 条配对干预轨迹证实，校正池估计与测量策略效应是不同任务。
AI.conclusion: CESS 能够审计报告背后的证据方向是否反映可供评估的候选文档，而检索决策的实际影响需通过单独的干预分析来度量。

title: ReSCENE: Server-Side Replay for Structural Mitigation of Catastrophic Forgetting in Federated Continual Learning
summary: Federated continual learning must integrate new tasks over time without losing earlier-task knowledge. Most existing methods attach an anti-forgetting mechanism to the client-trained, server-aggregated loop of federated learning, which holds back new learning to preserve earlier knowledge and burdens resource-constrained clients. We propose ReSCENE, which structurally mitigates catastrophic forgetting by having each client upload a small condensed surrogate of its local data while the server keeps the surrogates of past tasks and trains the global model on them together with the current task surrogates. For efficient server memory, we introduce temporal herding, which selects the more recent surrogates from the pool accumulated over a task into a compressed buffer. Our study provides a theoretical analysis showing that this buffer can represent the original task data more closely than full accumulation of all surrogates. Across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and TinyImageNet, ReSCENE achieves the strongest accuracy over seven baselines, by up to $31.1$ points of average accuracy, while requiring as little as $0.11\times$ of the client computation and up to $179\times$ less upload than the model-update baselines. ReSCENE further demonstrates its effectiveness when scaled to larger client populations and larger models while remaining efficient, which makes it a practical method for federated continual learning.

AI.tldr: ReSCENE 通过让客户端上传本地数据的小型压缩代理而非依赖客户端防遗忘机制，由服务器保留历史任务代理并与当前任务代理共同训练全局模型，结构性地缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦持续学习方法大多在"客户端训练—服务器聚合"的循环上附加防遗忘机制，这种做法为保留旧知识而抑制新学习，并给资源受限的客户端带来沉重负担。因此需要一种从结构上缓解灾难性遗忘、同时降低客户端开销的方案。
AI.method: 提出 ReSCENE：每个客户端上传其本地数据的小型压缩代理（condensed surrogate），服务器保存过去任务的代理，并与当前任务的代理一起训练全局模型。为控制服务器内存，引入"时间牧群"（temporal herding），从单个任务累积的代理池中挑选较新的代理构成压缩缓冲区。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，该压缩缓冲区比累积全部代理更能代表原始任务数据。在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 和 TinyImageNet 上，ReSCENE 在七个基线方法中取得最高准确率，平均准确率最多高出 31.1 个百分点，同时客户端计算量低至 0.11 倍，上传量较模型更新类基线最多减少 179 倍。扩展到更多客户端和更大模型时仍保持有效与高效。
AI.conclusion: ReSCENE 以服务器端代理重放替代客户端防遗忘机制，在准确率、客户端计算与通信效率上均具优势，且可扩展至更大规模的客户端与模型，是一种实用的联邦持续学习方法。

title: Multi-LLM Collaborative Alignment via Stackelberg Games
summary: A pool of language models can collaborate and improve collectively by learning from one another's responses. These interactions depend on the instructions used during training. Existing methods typically sample instructions uniformly, even though their usefulness may change as the models improve: an instruction on which models' responses once differed in quality may later be answered equally well, while a previously difficult instruction may begin to provide a useful learning signal. We propose Stackelberg Alignment, a game-theory-inspired leader-follower framework that turns instruction selection into an adaptive curriculum. An EXP3 bandit acts as the leader, allocating a fixed sampling budget across instructions and updating its sampling distribution using a reward that combines instruction difficulty and response discriminability. The language models act as followers: they respond to the selected instructions, evaluate one another's responses, and learn from the resulting preference signals through DPO or GRPO. The framework uses Elo-style reputation-weighted peer judgment and reputation-based opponent matching to support reliable and competitive model interactions. Experiments across three heterogeneous model pools and 12 benchmarks spanning scientific discovery, reasoning, code, instruction following, and knowledge show that Stackelberg Alignment achieves the highest macro-average across three diverse model pools, outperforming the strongest training-time baseline by up to 7.4% and the best static inference baseline by 12-25%. Analysis confirms that the adaptive leader concentrates duels on the most informative instructions, and ablations show that both reputation-weighted judgment and reputation-based matching improve the effectiveness of multi-LLM evolution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Stackelberg Alignment 框架，将指令选择建模为领导者-跟随者博弈：EXP3 老虎机作为领导者自适应分配采样预算，语言模型作为跟随者通过 DPO/GRPO 从同伴偏好信号中学习，并引入声誉加权评判与对手匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有多模型协同进化方法通常对训练指令进行均匀采样，但指令的有效性会随模型能力提升而变化：曾能区分响应质量的指令可能后来变得无区分度，而原本困难的指令可能开始提供有效学习信号。因此需要一种自适应课程来动态选择最有信息量的指令。
AI.method: 提出 Stackelberg Alignment，一种受博弈论启发的领导者-跟随者框架。领导者为 EXP3 老虎机，在固定采样预算下分配各指令的采样概率，奖励由指令难度与响应可区分性共同构成；跟随者为语言模型池，对选中指令作答、互相评估响应，并通过 DPO 或 GRPO 从偏好信号中学习。框架还采用 Elo 式声誉加权同伴评判与基于声誉的对手匹配。
AI.result: 在三个异构模型池与涵盖科学发现、推理、代码、指令遵循和知识的 12 个基准上，Stackelberg Alignment 取得最高宏平均成绩，较最强训练期基线提升最多 7.4%，较最佳静态推理基线提升 12–25%。分析表明自适应领导者将对抗集中在最具信息量的指令上；消融实验显示声誉加权评判与基于声誉的匹配均提升多 LLM 进化效果。
AI.conclusion: 将指令选择建模为自适应课程（领导者-跟随者博弈）可有效提升多语言模型协同进化的集体性能，声誉机制对可靠且具有竞争性的模型交互至关重要。

title: scTrilemma: Balancing Identity, Invariance, and Fidelity in Single-Cell Representation Learning
summary: Single-cell RNA-seq representation learning is fundamentally label-free: cell identities, states, and contexts are not fixed training targets, so what constitutes signal or nuisance is analysis-dependent. A single representation must therefore preserve biological identity and state, remain robust to nuisance context, and retain the gene-level variation needed for expression analysis, three demands we call the representation trilemma. To tackle this problem, we introduce scTrilemma, a latent-bottleneck VAE that routes expression-derived variation to the embedding, the decoder, or the prior rather than forcing all of it through one embedding. It gates gene tokens by expression, routes the cell representation through the decoder, and conditions the prior on unlabeled pseudo-bulk context, under a single reconstruction objective and without target annotations or auxiliary representation losses. In release-based zero-shot evaluation on successive CZ CELLxGENE Census releases, scTrilemma leads all three demands at once and preserves biological-state, differential-expression, and pathway structure across multiple disease settings. Latent interventions further show that context can be removed at almost no cost to the other demands, leaving identity against fidelity as the remaining tension. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/yunhak0/scTrilemma.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 scTrilemma，一种隐瓶颈 VAE，用以解决单细胞 RNA-seq 表示学习的“表示三难困境”：将表达变异分别路由至嵌入、解码器或先验，在单一重建目标下同时兼顾生物身份/状态、上下文鲁棒性与基因级变异保留。
AI.motivation: 单细胞 RNA-seq 表示学习本质上是无标签的，细胞身份、状态和上下文都不是固定的训练目标，何为信号、何为噪声依赖于具体分析任务。因此单一表示需同时满足三个需求：保留生物学身份与状态、对干扰性上下文稳健、保留用于表达分析的基因级变异，作者称之为“表示三难困境”。
AI.method: scTrilemma 是一个隐瓶颈 VAE。它不把全部表达变异强制压缩进单一嵌入，而是将表达衍生的变异分别路由到嵌入、解码器与先验三处：按表达量对基因 token 进行门控，将细胞表示经解码器路由，并以无标签伪批量（pseudo-bulk）上下文作为先验条件。整个模型在单一重建目标下训练，不使用目标注释，也不使用辅助的表示损失。
AI.result: 在基于 successive CZ CELLxGENE Census 发布版本的零样本评估中，scTrilemma 同时最优地满足三项需求，并在多种疾病设定下保留了生物状态、差异表达与通路结构。潜在空间干预进一步表明，上下文几乎可以零代价地被去除，剩下的主要张力存在于身份与保真度之间。
AI.conclusion: scTrilemma 通过解耦式隐瓶颈路由，在无需注释与辅助损失的前提下同时缓解表示三难困境中的多重需求冲突；上下文可作为相对独立、易去除的干扰因素处理，而身份保留与重建保真度之间的权衡是未来需要继续解决的核心矛盾。代码已公开：https://github.com/yunhak0/scTrilemma。

title: Beyond Prediction: Steering VLM Agents with Retrospective World Modeling
summary: Equipping VLM agents with world modeling capabilities has shown strong potential for complex reasoning and long-horizon planning, while reducing the dependence of policy learning on costly real-world interactions. Existing methods mainly rely on prospective simulation to predict the consequences of candidate actions. However, this forward-only paradigm focuses on what will happen next and provides limited constraints for verifying whether an action is causally consistent with the observed state transition, which can lead to plausible-looking but physically incoherent behaviors. In this paper, we challenge the view of world modeling as only prospective prediction and introduce Retrospective World Modeling, a new agent learning paradigm that enables agents to reason backward by estimating the retrospective attribution distribution $P(\hat{a}{t}|s_t, s{t+1})$ for the action that most likely caused a given transition. Based on this capability, we formulate the Self-Consistency Reward (SCR), an intrinsic signal that measures the probabilistic consistency between the policy action and the retrospective explanation. Integrating SCR into reinforcement learning provides dense transition-level feedback and steers agents toward behaviors that are both task-effective and physically grounded. Extensive experiments across diverse agentic tasks show that our method substantially improves policy robustness and generalization over prospective-only world modeling baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出"回溯式世界建模"新范式，通过估计导致状态转移的行动归因分布实现反向推理，并设计自洽性奖励（SCR）作为内在信号融入强化学习，提升VLM智能体的鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM智能体世界建模主要依赖前瞻式模拟预测候选行动的后果，但仅关注"接下来会发生什么"，缺乏验证行动与已观测状态转移是否因果一致的约束，易产生看似合理但物理上不连贯的行为。
AI.method: 挑战"世界建模仅为前瞻预测"的观点，提出回溯式世界建模（Retrospective World Modeling），令智能体反向推理，估计最可能导致给定转移的行动归因分布 P(â_t|s_t, s_{t+1})；据此构建自洽性奖励（SCR），度量策略行动与回溯解释之间的概率一致性，并将SCR融入强化学习以提供密集的转移级反馈。
AI.result: 在多种智能体任务上的大量实验表明，该方法在策略鲁棒性和泛化性上均显著优于仅采用前瞻式世界建模的基线。
AI.conclusion: 回溯式世界建模与自洽性奖励能引导智能体学习既任务有效又符合物理规律的行为，为智能体世界建模提供了前瞻之外的新维度。

title: Scoring Higher, Answering Worse: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based RL via Protocol-Level Rubrics
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (Rubric-RL) trains language models where no verifier exists. A judge checks each criterion of a rubric, and the verdicts are aggregated into a reward, most often by a weighted sum. We show that this additive aggregation is the weak point. Under a sum, criteria compensate for one another: a policy that misses the one decision that matters can buy the points back with advice nobody asked for. On clinical consultation, such a policy scores higher and answers worse. Rubric coverage rises while appropriateness on held-out physician criteria falls below the untrained model. The medical criteria are not to blame. Grouped so that they must hold together, the same criteria, unchanged to the word, recover a third of the loss; shorter answers recover almost none. We therefore propose Protocol-level Rubrics (ProRubric), which keeps what the criteria ask for and changes how they are aggregated. It groups a checklist into a few protocol-level dimensions. A dimension counts only when all of its criteria hold and its failure clause does not fire. The grouping is done once, offline, and leaves the optimizer unchanged. ProRubric raises appropriateness by 10.8 points without losing coverage and has the best seven-benchmark average at both scales. Reward validity is set not only by what a rubric verifies, but by how it aggregates. Code is available at https://github.com/Estrellajer/ProRubric

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于评分量规（rubric）的强化学习中"加权求和"聚合方式是弱点（准则间可相互补偿），并提出 ProRubric：将清单分组为少数协议级维度、要求维度内全部准则满足且失败条款未触发才计分，从而在聚合层面恢复奖励有效性。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏可验证器（verifier）的任务中，通常由裁判逐条检查 rubric 准则并将判定聚合为奖励。作者认为问题不在准则本身，而在加法式聚合：求和允许准则间互相补偿，策略可以靠无关的额外建议"买回"关键决策失误的分数，导致覆盖率上升但实际适用性下降。
AI.method: 提出 Protocol-level Rubrics（ProRubric）：保留原有准则内容不变，只改变聚合方式。将检查清单离线分组为少数几个"协议级维度"；仅当某维度内所有准则均成立、且其失败条款（failure clause）未触发时，该维度才计分。分组一次性离线完成，不修改优化器。
AI.result: 在临床咨询场景中，加法聚合下策略得分更高但回答更差，rubric 覆盖率上升而留出的医师准则适用性低于未训练模型。改为成组约束后，同样的准则（一字未改）可挽回约三分之一的损失，而缩短答案几乎无法挽回。ProRubric 在不损失覆盖率的情况下将适用性提高 10.8 分，并在两个规模上取得七个基准的最佳平均成绩。
AI.conclusion: 奖励的有效性不仅取决于 rubric 验证了什么，还取决于它如何聚合；聚合协议是 rubric 式强化学习的关键设计点，ProRubric 提供了一种低成本、不改优化器的改进方案。

title: Reserve-Aware Contrast Certificates for Conservative Bandits with Uncertain Baselines
summary: Conservative bandits must improve an incumbent policy without exhausting a prescribed performance budget. When the incumbent is uncertain, separately bounding candidate and baseline rewards can charge twice for shared estimation error. We develop Reserve-C4B around the baseline-relative contrast itself. A shared confidence set yields an exact expression for this avoidable penalty and a tighter admissibility test at every fixed history. A reserve ledger separates statistical evidence from permitted performance deficit; a prefix-refresh extension recertifies accumulated decisions under the current confidence set without discarding previously certified credit. For linear rewards, self-normalized confidence sets provide simultaneous validity over time and adaptively generated candidates, and the resulting policy satisfies a conditional-mean performance constraint with high probability. Reproducible experiments isolate certificate coupling, prefix refresh, and historical information, showing large reductions in baseline fallback while exposing the limitations of frozen certificates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Reserve-C4B 算法，围绕"基线相对对比"构建共享置信集与储备账本，消除候选奖励与基线奖励重复计费问题，在线性奖励下实现高概率条件均值性能约束，实验大幅减少基线回退。
AI.motivation: 保守赌博机（Conservative Bandits）需在提升现行策略的同时不耗尽预设的性能预算。当基线（现行策略）本身不确定时，若分别对候选奖励与基线奖励做界，会因共享的估计误差而被"双重计费"，导致过于保守、可采纳空间被压缩。
AI.method: 1) 以基线相对对比量本身为核心构建算法 Reserve-C4B；2) 用共享置信集推导可避免惩罚的精确表达式，并在任意固定历史上给出更紧的可采纳性检验；3) 设计"储备账本"将统计证据与允许的性能缺口分离；4) 提出前缀刷新（prefix-refresh）扩展，在当前置信集下对累积决策重新认证而不丢弃已认证额度；5) 对线性奖励采用自归一化置信集，实现对时间与自适应生成候选的同时有效性。
AI.result: 理论上，所得策略以高概率满足条件均值性能约束；实验中，可复现实验分离出证书耦合、前缀刷新与历史信息三个因素，显示基线回退大幅减少，同时揭示冻结证书的局限性。
AI.conclusion: 以基线相对对比为核心的共享置信集与储备账本机制，可有效消除双重计费、提升可采纳性与性能约束的紧致度；前缀刷新在不牺牲已获信用的前提下增强认证有效性，但冻结证书的固有限制仍存在。

title: Visualizing Distribution Coverage in Generative Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion distillation is widely adopted to accelerate sampling, and the resulting few-step models are broadly believed to match or even surpass their multi-step teachers in generation. However, standard evaluations such as GenEval2 typically draw only one sample per prompt, so improved scores may fail to reveal losses in distribution coverage. We therefore revisit whether distilled models truly match their teachers beyond single-draw performance using \textbf{pass@$\mathbf{k}$}, which measures the probability that at least one of $k$ independent samples satisfies a quality criterion. At $k{=}1$, pass@$k$ reduces to standard single-draw evaluation. As $k$ grows, the curve reveals whether additional draws find genuinely different successes or merely revisit the same modes, directly exposing how broadly a model covers the space of valid outputs. We first show that classifier-free guidance (CFG), whose quality--coverage tradeoff is well established, is the clearest case: higher guidance improves pass@$1$, but its advantage shrinks and reverses at larger $k$. Applying pass@$k$ to few-step distilled models, we find the same tradeoff splits along training objectives: distribution-matching objectives concentrate the student's output distribution, boosting early-hit rates while eroding large-budget coverage, whereas consistency and trajectory-based objectives better preserve the teacher's coverage even at large $k$. We further show that this tradeoff extends to few-step causal video generation. Our findings reveal a previously overlooked cost of diffusion distillation: across both image and video generation, the choice of training objective fundamentally determines whether a few-step model inherits its teacher's distribution coverage or trades it away for single-draw quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用pass@k（k次独立采样中至少一次满足质量标准的概率）重新评估扩散蒸馏模型，发现蒸馏模型并非全面匹配教师模型：单次采样质量提升往往以牺牲分布覆盖率为代价。
AI.motivation: 标准评估（如GenEval2）每个提示只采样一次，可能掩盖蒸馏模型在分布覆盖上的损失，因此需要重新审视少步蒸馏模型是否真正匹配其多步教师模型。
AI.method: 采用pass@k指标（k次独立采样中至少一次满足质量标准的概率），k=1时退化为标准单次评估；随k增大揭示模型是否覆盖更广的有效输出空间。分别对CFG、基于不同训练目标的少步蒸馏模型（分布匹配、一致性、轨迹类目标）以及少步因果视频生成进行评测。
AI.result: CFG提高guidance可提升pass@1，但其优势随k增大而缩小甚至反转；分布匹配目标使学生的输出分布更集中，提高早期命中率但损害大预算下的覆盖率，而一致性和轨迹类目标在大k下仍能较好保留教师的覆盖率；该权衡同样存在于少步因果视频生成中。
AI.conclusion: 扩散蒸馏存在此前被忽视的代价：在图像和视频生成中，训练目标的选择从根本上决定少步模型是继承教师模型的分布覆盖率，还是以牺牲覆盖率为代价换取单次采样质量。

title: MASCRDM: Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation in Training Process of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been applied in various fields. However, ensuring compliance and safety of LLMs, such as avoiding discrimination and bias, still remains a challenge. Current efforts mainly focus on detecting and filtering inputs and outputs of the trained models, rather than studying the intrinsic architecture of the models in real-time. To tackle this challenge, we analyze the LLMs training process and discover two critical issues: 1) Most of the existing methods are predominantly static in their approach to detection and filtering, achieving only localized optimizations without systematically enhancing the compliance of LLMs. 2) Another issue with existing approaches is the lack of real-time risk detection and mitigation across the full training process, which leads to limited flexibility. Motivated by these, we propose MASCRDM (Multi-Agent System for Compliance Risk Detection and Mitigation) during the LLM training process. Firstly, we develop a set of compliance rules based on existing Artificial Intelligence (AI) laws and a compliance-specific LLM with the instruction of compliance law experts. Then, we deconstruct LLMs into several components and identify key nodes based on the compliance knowledge graph. During LLMs training, we implement our multiple agents in the whole process, giving compliance risk alerts and suggestions for LLM developers. Experiments on discrimination and bias benchmark demonstrate that our multi-agent system can effectively improve the compliance while maintaining reasonable semantic performance. The results indicate that our method provides an executable path for mitigating compliance risk from within the LLMs systematically.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MASCRDM多智能体系统，在LLM训练全过程中进行合规风险检测与缓解，通过合规规则、专用合规LLM及合规知识图谱定位关键节点并实时告警，实验表明可在保持语义性能的同时有效提升合规性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM合规与安全工作多聚焦于对训练后模型的输入输出进行检测与过滤，属于静态、局部优化，缺乏对模型内在架构的实时分析和系统性的合规增强，也缺乏覆盖全训练过程的实时风险检测与缓解机制，灵活性受限。
AI.method: 提出MASCRDM（面向合规风险检测与缓解的多智能体系统）。首先基于现行AI法律并借助合规法律专家指令，构建一套合规规则及合规专用LLM；其次将LLM解构为若干组件，并基于合规知识图谱识别关键节点；最后在LLM训练全过程中部署多个智能体，向开发者提供合规风险告警与建议。
AI.result: 在歧视与偏见基准上的实验表明，该多智能体系统能在保持合理语义性能的同时有效提升合规性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为从LLM内部系统性地缓解合规风险提供了可执行路径。

title: Mitigating the Length-Scaling Tax with Online Distillation
summary: Length scaling during reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training is often viewed as a sign of improved reasoning ability, especially on difficult problems, but may also make responses to already-solved problems unnecessarily verbose. We quantify this side effect as the length-scaling tax (LST): excess response length on already-solved queries without a commensurate accuracy gain. To mitigate LST, we propose Length Self-Distillation (LSD), which routes solved prompts to on-policy distillation and retains the original RL objective for unsolved prompts. LSD uses an exponential moving average of the online policy as its teacher, requiring no external model. We find that LSD achieves comparable or better performance than RL across multiple variants, while substantially curbing response-length growth on easy queries. LSD reduces LST from 19.0% to -3.7% on single-turn reasoning and from 31.4% to 13.7% on multi-turn agentic tasks, demonstrating that LSD effectively preserves concise response patterns on easy queries while supporting efficient exploration on difficult queries during RL post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出长度缩放税（LST）量化RL后训练在已解决问题上过度生成冗长回复的副作用，并提出长度自蒸馏（LSD）——已解决提示走同策略蒸馏、未解决提示保留RL目标，教师为在线策略的指数移动平均。LSD在多种变体上性能不劣于RL，显著抑制简单问题长度增长，单轮推理LST从19.0%降至-3.7%，多轮智能体任务从31.4%降至13.7%。
AI.motivation: RL后训练中的长度缩放通常被视为推理能力提升的标志，但在已解决的问题上会导致不必要的冗长回复，这种副作用此前缺乏量化与针对性缓解。
AI.method: 提出LST指标量化已解决查询上无准确率增益的额外长度；提出LSD：对已解决提示采用同策略蒸馏，对未解决提示保留原始RL目标，教师模型为在线策略的指数移动平均（EMA），无需外部模型。
AI.result: LSD在多个RL变体上达到可比或更优性能，并大幅抑制简单查询的长度增长：单轮推理LST由19.0%降至-3.7%，多轮智能体任务由31.4%降至13.7%。
AI.conclusion: LSD在RL后训练中能有效保持简单查询上的简洁回复模式，同时在困难查询上支持高效探索，验证了按已解决/未解决提示分流训练目标的有效性。

title: BELIEFRAG: Making Adaptive RAG State-Aware under Evolving Evidence
summary: Adaptive RAG uses signals such as confidence, relevance, support, and retrieval quality to decide when to search or correct evidence. In multi-step retrieval, however, these local signals must be combined into a persistent view of what the current evidence supports, what remains missing, and which action should follow. Existing methods often use such signals as separate triggers, making it difficult to preserve a coherent evidence state across a trajectory; we call this problem evidence-state fragmentation. We introduce BELIEFRAG, a closed-loop controller that updates an explicit state over sufficiency, reliability, conflict, uncertainty, evidence gaps, and acquisition cost, then chooses among retrieval, query rewriting, verification, answering, stopping, and abstention. Across six QA benchmarks with gpt-oss-120b, BELIEFRAG reaches mean token F1 0.572 with 3.89k tokens per question, outperforming fixed iterative retrieval (0.555 F1) while using 39% fewer tokens. The same quality-cost pattern transfers to Qwen3-32B, where BELIEFRAG reaches 0.552 F1 versus 0.523 for iterative retrieval while using 35% fewer tokens. Analysis shows that the main gains come from corrective re-retrieval rather than pruning alone, while several belief dimensions are redundant and calibrated answerability plays the strongest operational role. Calibration improves threshold stability across related evidence sources, although source shift can still invalidate the same decision signal.

AI.tldr: 提出 BELIEFRAG 闭环控制器，用显式证据状态替代分散触发信号，缓解多步检索中的"证据状态碎片化"，在六个 QA 基准上以更少 token 达到更高 F1。
AI.motivation: 自适应 RAG 依赖置信度、相关性、支持度、检索质量等局部信号决定是否检索或修正证据，但在多步检索中这些信号被当作彼此独立的触发器使用，难以在整条轨迹上维持一致的证据状态，作者将该问题称为"证据状态碎片化"。
AI.method: BELIEFRAG：一个闭环控制器。它维护一个显式状态，覆盖充分性、可靠性、冲突、不确定性、证据缺口与获取成本六个维度，并据此在检索、查询改写、验证、回答、停止、拒答等动作间进行选择。
AI.result: 在 gpt-oss-120b 上，六个 QA 基准平均 token F1 达 0.572，每题 3.89k token，优于固定迭代检索（0.555 F1）且 token 少 39%；在 Qwen3-32B 上同样成立，0.552 F1 对比迭代检索的 0.523，token 少 35%。消融分析显示收益主要来自纠错式重检索而非单纯剪枝；若干信念维度存在冗余，校准后的可回答性（calibrated answerability）起最关键的操作作用。
AI.conclusion: 显式信念状态与闭环控制能有效缓解证据状态碎片化，实现质量—成本双优；校准可提升相关证据来源间的阈值稳定性，但来源漂移仍可能使同一决策信号失效。

title: Optimal Design for Active Preference Learning with Biased LLM Judges
summary: Learning from human preferences is central to large language model (LLM) alignment, but human preference annotation is costly. Active preference learning reduces this cost by selecting informative comparisons, and LLM judges can provide additional scalable feedback. However, the preferences of the judges may deviate from those of the target human population. Even after calibration on trusted reference data, active acquisition can shift the comparison distribution and expose residual judge bias. We therefore incorporate judge deviations into the acquisition design rather than relying on a separate calibration stage. Under joint estimation, comparisons that appear highly informative about the reward may also reflect judge bias and therefore provide less information about human preferences. To address this issue, we propose Nuisance-Adjusted Optimal Design (NAOD), a comparison-selection strategy that prioritizes policy-relevant target information after nuisance adjustment and uses the Frank-Wolfe algorithm for optimization. Theoretically, we establish a sharp conditional local asymptotic minimax lower bound on policy risk and construct an estimator that attains it. We further characterize the finite-sample cost of learning the nuisance representation and show that representation error can reverse an oracle design advantage. Finally, we validate these predictions experimentally and evaluate NAOD on Chatbot Arena data across 17 judges, 15 budget configurations, and 15 random cluster-level splits. NAOD reduces the mean regret of proxy policy by 29.1% relative to a matched target-information design, outperforms existing methods, and improves human-preference prediction on held-out data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Nuisance-Adjusted Optimal Design（NAOD），将评审者偏差作为干扰项纳入主动偏好采集设计，通过Frank-Wolfe优化选择对目标人群偏好最具信息量的比较，并给出策略风险的局部渐近极小极大下界及达到该界的最优估计量，在Chatbot Arena数据上显著降低遗憾。
AI.motivation: 人类偏好标注成本高昂，主动偏好学习可通过选择信息量大的比较降低标注开销，LLM评审者还能提供可扩展反馈。但评审者偏好可能偏离目标人群偏好，即使在校准后，主动采集会改变比较分布并暴露残余评审者偏差，因此需要把评审者偏差直接纳入采集设计而非依赖独立校准阶段。
