AI.method: 提出Nuisance-Adjusted Optimal Design（NAOD）：在联合估计框架下将评审者偏差视为干扰参数，优先选择经干扰调整后对策略相关信息量最大的比较，并使用Frank-Wolfe算法进行优化；理论上建立策略风险的尖锐条件局部渐近极小极大下界，构造达到该界的估计量，并刻画学习干扰表示带来的有限样本代价，证明表示误差可能逆转oracle设计优势。
AI.result: 在Chatbot Arena数据上，跨17个评审者、15种预算设置和15次随机簇级划分进行评估：NAOD相对匹配的目标信息设计将代理策略平均遗憾降低29.1%，优于现有方法，并提升了对留出数据的人类偏好预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 将评审者偏差整合进主动采集设计，可有效缓解主动采样带来的分布偏移与残余偏差问题，NAOD在理论与实验上均表现优越，为低成本、鲁棒的LLM偏好对齐提供了可行方案。

title: Schema: Discovering Unknown Environments via Agentic Program Induction
summary: Learning to complete tasks in unfamiliar environments with unknown rules remains a key challenge for LLM agents. Current LLM agents often record their discoveries in prose, which may not provide a compact, explicit account of how the environment works. Inspired by how scientists organize observations into testable, predictive theories, we introduce Schema, an agent harness that organizes learning and action through interactive program induction. The LLM agent decides what to investigate and how to act, expressing its evolving understanding of the environment as executable programs. The harness consists of a persistent program workspace and a small set of interfaces for checking these programs against the interaction history, planning within them, and executing plans under step-by-step verification. Schema raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE from 58.7% to 99.2% with the same base model, solves 100% of the public DiG-bench games, and reaches the median performance of the top-50 human players on MazeBench. Extensive analysis shows the effectiveness of Schema in unknown mechanism discovery, and ablations confirm the contribution of each component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Schema，一种基于交互式程序归纳的 LLM 智能体框架，将智能体对环境的理解表示为可执行程序，并配合持久化程序工作区与验证/规划/执行接口。在相同基座模型下，ARC-AGI-3 RHAE 由 58.7% 提升至 99.2%，DiG-bench 公开游戏全部通关，MazeBench 达到前 50 名人类玩家中位水平。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在规则未知的新环境中完成任务仍具挑战；现有智能体多用自然语言散文记录发现，缺乏对环境的紧凑、显式、可检验的刻画。受科学家将观察组织为可测试、可预测理论的启发，作者希望以可执行程序形式组织学习与行动。
AI.method: 提出 Schema：一个通过交互式程序归纳组织学习与行动的智能体 harness。由 LLM 智能体自主决定探究内容与行动方式，将其对环境的演化理解表达为可执行程序；harness 包含持久化程序工作区，以及少量接口，用于：将程序与交互历史核对、在程序内进行规划、以及在逐步验证下执行规划。
AI.result: 在相同基座模型下，ARC-AGI-3 RHAE 从 58.7% 提升到 99.2%；解决 100% 的公开 DiG-bench 游戏；在 MazeBench 上达到前 50 名人类玩家的中位表现。大量分析表明 Schema 在未知机制发现方面有效，消融实验验证了各组件均有贡献。
AI.conclusion: 以可执行程序作为环境理解的显式载体、并通过验证-规划-执行闭环进行交互式程序归纳，能显著提升 LLM 智能体在未知规则环境中的探索与任务完成能力；消融结果支持框架各组件的必要性。

title: GeoNest: Learning to Select Failure-Aware Neighborhoods for the Irregular Knapsack Problem in a Circular Container
summary: The two-dimensional irregular knapsack problem in a fixed circular container is an important combinatorial optimization problem for maximizing material utilization in manufacturing. Conventional geometric packing solvers can produce tightly packed layouts, yet they often partition the residual space into isolated small pockets that cannot fit valuable unplaced polygons. To overcome this late-stage packing bottleneck, we propose a failure-aware large neighborhood search framework named GeoNest, driven by a graph policy trained via reinforcement learning. Specifically, we first construct neighborhoods by pairing failed target polygons with residual pockets. We then use explanatory poses to identify the placed polygons that block candidate insertions. These diagnosed blocking relations define bounded, fixed-item repair subproblems for the underlying geometric solver. Finally, the graph policy selects the most promising subproblem for execution. For evaluation, we introduce CircleNest-Bench, a benchmark comprising 2,391 load-controlled instances from four contour sources, including a held-out industrial CAD source. Experimental results demonstrate that, under the same total time budget, GeoNest improves mean utilization over a state-of-the-art standalone packing solver by about 0.9% on average across the three main test sets and by about 0.6% on the held-out industrial set.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GeoNest——一种由强化学习训练的图策略驱动、面向失败感知的大邻域搜索框架，用于固定圆形二维不规则背包问题，并发布CircleNest-Bench基准；在相同时间预算下，平均材料利用率较当前最优独立排样求解器提升约0.9%（主测试集）与约0.6%（留出工业集）。
AI.motivation: 传统几何排样求解器虽能生成紧密布局，但常将残余空间分割为孤立小空腔，无法容纳仍有价值的未放置多边形，形成后期排样瓶颈，导致材料利用率受限。
AI.method: GeoNest为失败感知大邻域搜索框架：（1）将失败的目标多边形与残余空腔配对构造邻域；（2）借助可解释位姿识别阻挡候选插入的已放置多边形；（3）由这些阻挡关系定义有界、固定物品的修复子问题交给底层几何求解器；（4）由图策略（经强化学习训练）选择最有前景的子问题执行。
AI.result: 引入CircleNest-Bench基准，包含来自四种轮廓来源的2,391个负载受控实例（含一个留出工业CAD来源）。在相同总时间预算下，GeoNest在三个主测试集上平均利用率较SOTA独立排样求解器提升约0.9%，在留出工业集上提升约0.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过失败感知的大邻域修复与学习型子问题选择，GeoNest有效缓解了残余空间碎片化导致的后期排样瓶颈，在含工业CAD数据上稳定提升材料利用率，并提供了可控评测基准。

title: RefCon: Iterative Refinement and Contrastive Memory Extraction for Context-Evolving Agent
summary: Long-horizon agent interactions generate useful but noisy experience, and retraining models to absorb it is expensive. Context-evolving agents therefore need memory extraction methods that improve with more test-time compute without relying on gold labels. We propose RefCon, which combines sequential self-refinement with parallel self-contrast to extract higher-quality memories without gold labels. Evaluated on AppWorld and BFCL-V3 across multiple context-evolving agent frameworks, RefCon delivers strong and consistent gains, including relative improvements of 21.6% on ACE and 16.6% on ReMe over no-scaling baselines, while a diversity-focused variant (DivCon) achieves a 35.5% gain on ReasoningBank. RefCon consistently outperforms existing baselines without ground-truth labels, and generalizes across model scales and to software engineering tasks, where it surpasses even ground-truth baselines. We further analyze the accuracy-token trade-off and scaling behavior, showing RefCon maintains favorable efficiency and continues to improve as more trajectories are used, unlike diversity-only scaling which saturates earlier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RefCon，一种无需金标签的记忆抽取方法，通过串行自精炼与并行自对比提升上下文演化智能体的测试时计算扩展效果，在 AppWorld 与 BFCL-V3 上取得显著增益。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体交互产生的经验噪声大且有用，但重训模型吸收这些经验成本高昂。上下文演化型智能体因此需要一种无需金标签、且能随测试时计算量增加而持续改进的记忆抽取方法。
AI.method: RefCon 将串行自精炼（sequential self-refinement）与并行自对比（parallel self-contrast）相结合，在无金标签条件下抽取更高质量的记忆；另提出聚焦多样性的变体 DivCon。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 与 BFCL-V3 上、多个上下文演化框架中评估，RefCon 相较无扩展基线在 ACE 上相对提升 21.6%、ReMe 上 16.6%，DivCon 在 ReasoningBank 上提升 35.5%；持续优于无真值标签的现有基线，并可跨模型规模泛化，在软件工程任务上甚至超过金标签基线。其精度-词元权衡与扩展行为良好，随轨迹数量增加持续改进，而仅依赖多样性的扩展更早饱和。
AI.conclusion: RefCon 表明自精炼与自对比结合可有效替代金标签实现高质量记忆抽取，兼具效率与可扩展性，且优于纯多样性扩展策略。

title: On Parameters of Nonlinear Scalar Dynamics from Video: Invariants, Calibration, and Identifiability
summary: Physical parameter estimation from video aims to recover the parameters of a known family of governing dynamical equations from pixel observations. Existing identifiability theory for this setting has focused on linear time-invariant (LTI) second-order systems, leaving open what can be identified for nonlinear scalar dynamics. We develop an identifiability theory for nonlinear scalar second-order ODEs, organized by how their velocity dependence interacts with changes of the learned state coordinate. Under a shared non-collapsed state map and explicit same-state velocity-coverage conditions, we show that parameter identifiability depends on the ODE family: some parameters are uniquely identifiable, while in other families only invariant parameter combinations are identifiable or external physical calibration is required. For laws that are at most linear in velocity, compatibility forces affine coordinate alignment, yielding explicit parameter relations, invariants, and calibration conditions. This affine conclusion extends to broader finite velocity-feature families when coordinate curvature can be separated from the declared velocity dependence. For families admitting a squared-velocity term, nonlinear coordinate ambiguity can remain; a law-derived normalization instead enables affine comparison between canonical laws. Experiments on synthetic systems and real pendulum and free-fall videos support the predicted parameter relations, coverage effects, and calibration requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文为视频驱动下的非线性标量二阶常微分方程建立了参数可辨识性理论，按速度依赖与状态坐标变换的交互方式分类，揭示了哪些参数可唯一辨识、哪些仅能辨识不变量组合或需外部标定。
AI.motivation: 现有视频物理参数估计的可辨识性理论仅针对线性时不变二阶系统，非线性标量动力学的可辨识性仍是空白，需要建立相应理论并明确坐标变换与速度依赖带来的限制。
AI.method: 在共享非坍缩状态映射与显式同状态速度覆盖条件下，按速度依赖性对非线性标量二阶ODE分类分析：对速度至多线性的族推导仿射坐标对齐及显式参数关系、不变量与标定条件；对更广的有限速度特征族在坐标曲率可分离时推广该仿射结论；对含速度平方项的族分析非线性坐标歧义并引入由物理定律导出的归一化实现规范律间的仿射比较。
AI.result: 参数可辨识性依赖于ODE族：部分族参数唯一可辨识，部分族仅不变量组合可辨识，部分族需外部物理标定；速度至多线性时兼容性强制仿射坐标对齐，速度平方项可保留非线性坐标歧义。合成系统及真实单摆、自由落体视频实验验证了所预测的参数关系、覆盖效应与标定需求。
AI.conclusion: 本文刻画了非线性标量二阶ODE从视频观测中参数辨识的基本边界，说明可辨识性由速度依赖与学习状态坐标的交互决定，为视频物理参数估计的可行性判断与标定设计提供理论依据。

title: MADBench: Benchmarking the Security of Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Multi-agent debate (MAD) can improve large language model (LLM) reasoning by allowing multiple agents to exchange and critique their answers to the same task. However, the interactions that enable agents to correct mistakes can also spread adversarial errors and steer the agents toward an incorrect answer. Although some efforts have been made to examine particular attack types on MAD, systematic evaluation of MAD under diverse attacks remains limited. A central question is whether debate mitigates adversarial influence or amplifies it.
  In this paper, we present MADBench, a benchmark for evaluating the security of MAD. We organize attacks into a layered taxonomy following the MAD workflow, incorporating both established attacks and new strategies tailored to debate. We evaluate six attack families over 356 source tasks and 3,958 test cases, examining their effects on the final answer and the propagation of adversarial influence. Our results show that, under attacks, MAD does not necessarily improve LLM reasoning. Compared with a single-agent baseline, MAD can mitigate attacks on answer accuracy in question-answering tasks while amplifying unauthorized reads or writes in both question-answering and workspace tasks. Moreover, even when three out of five agents collude, the attack changes the final answer from correct to wrong on only 28.30\% of tasks answered correctly without attack, while only 3.26\% of initially correct honest agents switch to wrong answers during debate.

AI.tldr: 该文提出 MADBench，系统评估多智能体辩论（MAD）在多种攻击下的安全性，发现 MAD 并非总能提升推理：问答任务中可缓解准确率攻击，但在问答与工作区任务中会放大越权读写，且辩论对善意智能体的答案翻转影响较小。
AI.motivation: MAD 通过多智能体交换与批判答案提升 LLM 推理，但交互在纠错的同时也可能传播对抗性错误并将智能体导向错误答案。已有工作多聚焦特定攻击类型，缺乏对 MAD 在多样攻击下的系统评估；核心问题是辩论究竟缓解还是放大对抗影响。
AI.method: 构建 MADBench 基准，按 MAD 工作流组织分层攻击分类体系，融合已有攻击与面向辩论的新策略；评估 6 类攻击家族，覆盖 356 个源任务与 3,958 个测试用例，考察对最终答案的影响及对抗影响的传播。
AI.result: 攻击下 MAD 不一定提升 LLM 推理。相较单智能体基线，MAD 在问答任务中可缓解攻击对答案准确率的影响，但在问答与工作区任务中均放大未授权读/写。即使 5 个智能体中 3 个串通，也仅使 28.30% 原本无攻击时答对的任务由正确变为错误；辩论过程中仅 3.26% 初始正确的诚实智能体转为错误答案。
AI.conclusion: MAD 的安全性呈现两面性：对最终答案准确率有一定鲁棒性，但会显著放大越权读写等安全风险；辩论对善意智能体的错误传染有限。需针对 MAD 工作流各环节设计更系统的防护与评估。

title: Does Learning Protein Folding Generalize to Broader Reasoning?
summary: Large language models rely heavily on human text, which often conveys surface answers rather than the spatial and structural logic behind them. Protein folding is a natural testbed, because one solved structure yields thousands of exactly checkable spatial and topological statements. We ask: can learning to fold proteins teach general models reusable reasoning capabilities? To answer this, we build FoldingCorpus, a protein-derived question-answer dataset, and Fold2Reason, a recipe that post-trains on it through two complementary signals: discrete structural answers predicted via the model's native language head, and continuous 3D geometry decoded from the same shared representations. On FoldBench, Fold2Reason achieves structure prediction scores 2.7 to 3.5 times those of Qwen3.5-9B. Beyond protein structure prediction, it improves performance on all 10 benchmarks spanning spatial, graph, scientific, and general reasoning, raising macro-average accuracy from 45.09% to 48.33% (+3.23 pp), with positive gains on all 10 benchmarks, while matched controls built from random, synthetic, and shuffled structure yield substantially smaller or negative gains. Our work shows that non-linguistic, structure-dense scientific data can systematically improve broad reasoning in language models, making a solved scientific problem a practical source of post-training supervision.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用蛋白质折叠这一结构密集型科学任务作为后训练监督来源，构建了 FoldingCorpus 数据集与 Fold2Reason 训练方法，证明非语言类结构数据能系统性地提升大模型的通用推理能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型高度依赖人类文本，而人类文本往往只传递表层答案，而非其背后的空间与结构逻辑。蛋白质折叠是理想的测试平台，因为一个已解析的结构即可产生成千上万条可精确检验的空间与拓扑陈述。作者由此提出核心问题：学习折叠蛋白质能否让通用模型习得可复用的推理能力。
AI.method: 作者构建了 FoldingCorpus——一个从蛋白质衍生的问答数据集，并提出 Fold2Reason 后训练方案，通过两条互补信号进行训练：一是经由模型原生语言头预测离散的结构答案，二是从同一共享表征中解码连续的三维几何信息。
AI.result: 在 FoldBench 上，Fold2Reason 的结构预测得分是 Qwen3.5-9B 的 2.7 至 3.5 倍。除蛋白质结构预测外，它在涵盖空间、图、科学与通用推理的 10 个基准上全部取得提升，宏平均准确率从 45.09% 升至 48.33%（+3.23 个百分点）；而由随机、合成及打乱结构构建的对照实验收益显著更小甚至为负。
AI.conclusion: 非语言、结构密集的科学数据能够系统性地提升语言模型的广泛推理能力，表明一个已被解决的科学问题可作为后训练监督的实用来源。

title: Do Self-Evolving Skills Generalize to Held-Out Tasks?
summary: AI agents can externalize what they learn from past tasks into reusable \emph{skills}, such as procedures, checklists, code, or other executable artifacts, that can be retrieved and reused when solving new tasks. Self-evolving skill methods keep rewriting these skills after each round of practice on training tasks, and the skill is then used on new tasks of the same kind. We ask a question: does the improvement a skill shows on its training tasks carry over to new test tasks? We test five self-evolving methods and a one-shot skill on six benchmarks, with the same model, the same agent, and the same train/test split for every method. Of the 21 skills that improve on their training tasks, 5 keep all of that improvement on the test tasks, 13 keep part of it, and 3 keep none of it. No existing method is best everywhere. When we read the skills, the ones that carry over badly often fix details that should depend on the task, such as column names and output files, or turn a fix for one failure into a rule for every task. An LLM judge that reads the skill content can often see this: it ranks finished skills the same way the test results do in 86\% of pairs. But it predicts the effect of a single edit poorly, so edits still have to be tested by running them. Based on these findings, we describe Generalizable Skill Optimization (GSO), which keeps only a guide for writing skills and writes a new skill for each task; it scores highest on all six benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文检验了自演化技能方法在训练任务上的提升能否迁移到新任务，发现迁移效果差异很大且无方法普适最优，据此提出GSO方法在六个基准上均取得最高分。
AI.motivation: AI智能体可将过往任务经验外化为可复用技能，自演化方法在每轮训练后不断重写技能并用于同类新任务；但尚不清楚技能在训练任务上的改进是否能迁移到测试任务，这一问题直接决定此类方法的实际价值。
AI.method: 在六个基准上，对五种自演化方法与一种一次性（one-shot）技能方法进行受控对比，统一模型、智能体与训练/测试划分；对技能进行人工与LLM评判分析，考察技能内容与迁移表现的关联，并据此设计Generalizable Skill Optimization（GSO）：仅保留技能编写指南，为每个任务重新撰写新技能。
AI.result: 在21个于训练任务上有所提升的技能中，5个在测试任务上完全保持提升，13个部分保持，3个完全无法保持；没有单一方法在所有场景下最优。迁移差的技能常将任务相关细节（如列名、输出文件）写死，或把针对单次失败的修复泛化为全局规则。LLM评判对已完成技能排序与测试结果的一致率为86%，但难以预测单次编辑的效果。
AI.conclusion: 技能在训练任务上的提升并不必然迁移到新任务，现有自演化方法均非普适最优；技能内容质量可部分预示其可迁移性。基于此提出的GSO通过仅为每个任务生成新技能、舍弃技能累积，在六个基准上均取得最高分。

title: Right Answers, Costly Models: The Efficiency Gap in LLM-based Optimization Modeling
summary: Optimization modeling formulates real-world decision problems as mathematical programs that solvers can use to find optimal decisions. Large language models (LLMs) can automate this process, but the resulting correct formulations can require substantial time and memory to construct and solve, limiting practical scalability. Therefore, we systematically investigate whether LLMs can identify problem structure from natural-language descriptions and apply suitable optimization modeling techniques to generate mathematical models and solver code that solve the problems correctly and efficiently. To this end, we first curate OptTips, a knowledge base of 50 expert modeling techniques in eight families. Using this knowledge, we develop OptDachshund, a multi-agent framework that transforms problems from existing optimization benchmarks into new tasks for evaluating LLMs' use of modeling techniques. It constructs conventional and expert mathematical models with solver code for the same task and data, providing baselines for correctness and computational cost. The resulting EfficientOpt benchmark contains 561 expert-reviewed tasks with paired reference implementations. Evaluation of 11 representative LLMs reveals an efficiency gap on correctly solved tasks with comparable measurements: for every LLM, most generated programs take longer to solve than their expert counterparts. Within the comparable reference-size subset, 57\% of programs with correct objective values and fewer variables and linear constraints have longer recorded solver times. Case studies show that different modeling techniques can achieve the same optimal value at similar recorded cost. Faster solving may not reduce execution time if the code takes longer to prepare data and build the model. LLM optimization modeling should therefore be evaluated for both correctness and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究LLM能否从自然语言描述中识别问题结构并应用优化建模技巧，构建OptTips知识库、OptDachshund多智能体框架与EfficientOpt基准（561个专家审阅任务），发现11个代表性LLM在正确求解任务上普遍存在求解效率差距，主张同时评估正确性与计算效率。
AI.motivation: LLM可自动将现实决策问题转化为数学规划，但生成的正确建模往往需要大量时间与内存来构建和求解，限制了实际可扩展性。因此需要系统考察LLM能否识别问题结构并应用合适的优化建模技巧，从而高效生成模型与求解代码。
AI.method: 1) 整理OptTips知识库，涵盖8个族系共50个专家建模技巧；2) 基于该知识构建OptDachshund多智能体框架，将已有优化基准中的问题转化为新任务，为同一任务与数据同时生成常规模型和专家模型及求解代码，作为正确性与计算成本的基线；3) 构建EfficientOpt基准，含561个经专家审阅的任务及成对参考实现；4) 评测11个代表性LLM。
AI.result: 在正确求解且测量可比的子集上所有LLM均存在效率差距；在规模可比参考子集中，57%目标值正确且变量与线性约束更少的程序求解时间反而更长。案例研究显示不同建模技巧可在相近记录成本下达到相同最优值；求解更快未必降低总执行时间，因为数据准备与建模构建可能耗时更久。
AI.conclusion: LLM优化建模应同时从正确性和计算效率两个维度进行评估，效率差距是当前LLM应用优化建模技巧的普遍短板。

title: Rep2Skill: Representation-Guided Skill Self-Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Textual skills enable large language model (LLM) based agents to accumulate reusable procedural knowledge without updating model parameters. Yet existing skill evolution remains largely confined to the text space: an optimizer must diagnose success and failure patterns, and revise skills solely from long execution trajectories and sparse task outcomes. This text-only paradigm leaves the agent's internal representations, which contain rich records of its evolving execution state, outside the skill optimization loop. We ask whether an agent can improve its external textual skills by reflecting on its own internal representations. We introduce Rep2Skill, a representation-guided framework for self-evolution on agent skills. Specifically, upon the collected agent rollouts, Rep2Skill models their internal model representation trajectories to localize turns that deviate from successful execution dynamics, and it further interprets these signals alongside the execution contexts as actionable textual feedback for targeted skill revision. Experiments on two agent environments with two open-source LLMs show that Rep2Skill consistently outperforms text-only approaches in the self-evolution setting, where the same LLM serves as both executor and optimizer without a stronger external model. This establishes a promising direction moving agent self-improvement beyond text-only reflection.

AI.tldr: 提出 Rep2Skill，一种表征引导的智能体技能自进化框架，通过建模智能体内部表征轨迹定位偏离成功执行动态的轮次，并结合执行上下文转化为可操作的文本反馈来修订技能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的智能体技能进化局限于文本空间：优化器只能从长执行轨迹和稀疏任务结果中诊断成败模式并修订技能，导致包含丰富执行状态记录的内部表征被排除在技能优化循环之外。作者希望验证智能体能否通过反思自身内部表征来改进外部文本技能。
AI.method: Rep2Skill 采集智能体的执行轨迹（rollouts），对其内部模型表征轨迹进行建模，定位偏离成功执行动态的关键轮次；随后将这些表征信号与执行上下文一并解释为可操作的文本反馈，用于针对性地修订技能。
AI.result: 在两个智能体环境和两个开源 LLM 上的实验表明，在自进化设定（同一 LLM 同时充当执行者和优化器，不依赖更强外部模型）下，Rep2Skill 持续优于纯文本方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将智能体自我改进从纯文本反思推进到表征引导的反思，验证了利用内部表征优化外部文本技能的有效性，为智能体自进化开辟了有前景的方向。

title: VERA: Verifiable Feasibility Representations with Counterfactual Credit for Constrained Multi-Agent Control
summary: Constrained multi-agent control requires more than predicting rewarding actions: an action can cease to be executable as contact windows, shared capacity, and deadlines change. We introduce VERA, a centralized-training, decentralized-execution framework that separates feasibility estimation from credit assignment. Each actor predicts a five-dimensional verifiable feasibility representation (VFR). After an action is proposed, exact action-conditioned margins available only during training supervise that representation, while a counterfactual group-relative advantage (CGRA) ranks candidate representation-action pairs. Execution uses one actor pass and no privileged state. In a dynamic space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN), VERA obtains 55.33% +/- 3.60% success with 0.45% +/- 0.81% coverage violation, within 1.33 percentage points of a privileged-mask reference. With rewards matched over ten paired seeds, VERA improves success over the strongest baseline by 8.74 percentage points (p=0.023) and reduces violation by 52.19 percentage points (p=5.7e-8). A ten-seed 4-by-2 factorial attributes a 14.16-16.48 percentage-point gain to CGRA across handcrafted, learned, random, and latent representations; evaluation on seven unseen topologies preserves a 24.33-30.02 percentage-point advantage over multi-agent proximal policy optimization. From 10 to 40 users, success remains 50.1-53.8%, and VFR adds only 0.026 ms to a central processing unit (CPU) actor step. Cross-domain tests further identify the governing condition: counterfactual credit succeeds when candidate scores respect shared constraints and fails under incompatible reward geometries. These results establish action-conditioned feasibility as an auditable training interface and counterfactual credit as a geometry-dependent optimization mechanism.

AI.tldr: 提出VERA框架，将可行性估计与信用分配分离，通过可验证可行性表示（VFR）与反事实组相对优势（CGRA）实现约束多智能体控制，在SAGIN中取得接近特权参考的成功率并显著降低违规。
AI.motivation: 约束多智能体控制不仅需预测回报性动作，还需应对接触窗口、共享容量与截止时间变化导致的动作可执行性动态失效问题。
AI.method: 集中训练、分散执行框架：每个智能体预测五维可验证可行性表示（VFR）；仅训练期可得的精确动作条件裕度监督该表示，反事实组相对优势（CGRA）对候选表示-动作对排序；执行仅需一次actor前向、无须特权状态。
AI.result: 动态SAGIN中成功率55.33%±3.60%、覆盖违规0.45%±0.81%，距特权掩码参考1.33个百分点；奖励对齐十种子下成功率较最强基线提升8.74个百分点（p=0.023）、违规降低52.19个百分点（p=5.7e-8）；十种子4×2析因显示CGRA在四类表示上贡献14.16-16.48个百分点增益；七个未见图拓扑较MAPPO保持24.33-30.02个百分点优势；10至40用户成功率50.1-53.8%，VFR仅增加0.026 ms CPU actor步耗时。
AI.conclusion: 确立动作条件可行性作为可审计的训练接口，并将反事实信用识别为依赖奖励几何的优化机制：候选分数尊重共享约束时有效，奖励几何不兼容时失效。

title: Beyond the Remembered World: Predictive 4D Belief for Persistent Navigation in Evolving Worlds
summary: Persistent spatial memory enables embodied agents to navigate familiar environments across repeated visits. However, targets may move while unobserved, including during navigation, making remembered locations unreliable by the time an agent arrives. Despite advances in memory retrieval and state prediction, accounting for continued hidden world evolution and revising beliefs under limited visibility remain challenging. We study Evolving-World Navigation, where agents infer target locations from intermittent observations, predict their states at inspection time, and revise beliefs using visual evidence. We propose EvolvingNav, which constructs a time-indexed belief from timestamped 3D object histories through a structured persistence-relocation model. The belief distinguishes persistence at the last observed location from relocation to alternative locations and retains probability mass outside the known candidate set. An event-driven filter propagates the current belief as time elapses, forecasts target occupancy at candidate inspection times, and incorporates new RGB-D evidence. Negative observations downweight location hypotheses according to calibrated, visibility-conditioned detection probabilities, while evidence tracking prevents repeated use of the same observations. A frozen, zero-shot vision-language controller uses the updated belief to choose actions and replan. We further introduce EvoWorld-Bench, a benchmark grounded in human activity traces, comprising 54 scenes and 803,680 tasks with controlled changes before and during navigation. In simulation and real-robot experiments, EvolvingNav improves navigation success and search efficiency over the evaluated baselines. Paired experiments show the clearest gains under learnable temporal patterns, while ablations demonstrate the value of preserving uncertainty and incorporating visibility-aware evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出EvolvingNav，通过时间索引的信念建模与事件驱动滤波，处理导航中目标隐藏移动的问题，并构建EvoWorld-Bench基准，在仿真与实机上提升导航成功率与搜索效率。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体在重复访问中依赖持久空间记忆导航，但目标可能在未被观测时（包括导航过程中）移动，导致到达时记忆位置失效。现有记忆检索与状态预测方法难以应对持续隐藏的世界演化，也难以在有限可见性下修正信念。
AI.method: 研究Evolving-World Navigation任务：智能体从间歇观测推断目标位置、预测检查时刻状态并用视觉证据修正信念。提出EvolvingNav，基于带时间戳的3D物体历史构建时间索引信念，采用结构化persistence-relocation模型，区分停留在最后观测位置与迁移到其他位置，并保留已知候选集之外的概率质量。用事件驱动滤波随时间传播信念、预测候选检查时刻的目标占据情况并融合新的RGB-D证据；负观测按校准的可见性条件检测概率对位置假设降权，证据跟踪避免同一观测重复使用。使用冻结的零样本视觉-语言控制器基于更新信念选择动作并重规划。同时提出基于人类活动轨迹的基准EvoWorld-Bench，含54个场景、803,680个任务及导航前与导航中的受控变化。
AI.result: 在仿真与真实机器人实验中，EvolvingNav在导航成功率和搜索效率上优于所评估的基线。配对实验显示在可学习时间模式下增益最明显，消融实验表明保留不确定性以及引入可见性感知证据的价值。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模世界持续演化并维护时间索引、含不确定性的信念，结合可见性感知证据更新，可有效提升动态隐藏目标下的具身导航性能。

title: Learning Continuous Neural Representation of Stochastic Hybrid Systems
summary: A stochastic hybrid system (SHS) is governed by a stochastic differential equation (SDE) describing the continuous dynamics and a Markov reset kernel triggered on the guard surface. Its probability evolution can be described by a hybrid Fokker-Planck (HFP) equation with a partial differential term corresponding to the SDE and an integral term arising from the reset kernel. This work shows that such an SHS can be approximated by an SDE in a higher-dimensional latent space where the sample paths are continuous. The key to this result is to encode different branches of the reset kernel using auxiliary variables, transforming the resets into deterministic ones that enable topological gluing. By the embedding theorem, the glued manifold can then be embedded into a higher-dimensional Euclidean space. We show that the probability evolution on the embedded image no longer requires explicit reset terms in the HFP equation. Building on this theorem, we design a loss that matches the evolving state distributions, enabling a single latent SDE to recover the probability evolution of the SHS without mode labeling, trajectory segmentation, or event-based simulations.

AI.tldr: 该工作证明随机混合系统（SHS）的连续分支可通过辅助变量编码为确定性重置，经拓扑粘合与嵌入定理映射到高维潜空间中的连续SDE，从而在混合Fokker-Planck方程中消除显式重置项，并据此设计分布匹配损失实现无模式标注的轨迹恢复。
AI.motivation: SHS同时包含连续SDE动态与守卫面上的Markov重置核，其概率演化由混合Fokker-Planck方程描述，兼具偏微分项与积分项，难以直接求解或仿真，且通常依赖模式标注与事件驱动模拟。
AI.method: 将重置核的不同分支用辅助变量编码，把随机重置转化为确定性重置以实现拓扑粘合；借助嵌入定理将粘合流形嵌入高维欧氏空间，得到样本路径连续的潜空间SDE；并基于该定理设计匹配演化状态分布的损失函数。
AI.result: 证明嵌入像上的概率演化不再需要HFP方程中显式的重置项，单个潜空间SDE即可恢复SHS的概率演化，无需模式标注、轨迹分割或基于事件的仿真。
AI.conclusion: SHS可被高维潜空间中的连续SDE近似等价表示，为混合系统概率演化建模提供了无需事件机制的统一连续框架。

title: Reinforcing Multimodal Reasoning via Token-Level Perception-Grounded Advantage Estimation
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), yet existing frameworks rely on coarse, sequence-level reward signals that lack the fine-grained supervision over the visually-grounded steps within a multimodal reasoning chain. We investigate this gap through the lens of two token-level metrics: visual dependency (i.e. how much a token's prediction relies on the input image features) and predictive entropy. Our empirical analysis reveals two key findings: (1) correct reasoning chains exhibit a markedly sharper entropy reduction as visual grounding intensifies, compared to incorrect ones; (2) pivotal tokens, those whose misprediction triggers reasoning collapse, are statistical outliers in the joint distribution of visual dependency and predictive entropy derived from correct chains. Motivated by these findings, we propose token-level perception-grounded advantage estimation (TPAE), which estimates token-level advantages by measuring each token's statistical consistency with the vision-entropy patterns of correct rollouts. TPAE leverages this granular score to modulate the sequence-level advantage, producing a fine-grained supervision signal that can be integrated into various RLVR frameworks. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks show that TPAE consistently outperforms leading strong baselines, yielding more stable and efficient optimization for multimodal reasoning. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Zhihan72/TPAE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 token 级感知接地优势估计（TPAE），利用视觉依赖度与预测熵的联合分布模式，对序列级优势进行细粒度调制，从而提升多模态大模型 RLVR 推理训练的稳定性与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 RLVR 框架对多模态推理链仅提供粗粒度的序列级奖励信号，缺乏对链内视觉接地步骤的细粒度监督，无法区分推理过程中关键 token 的质量差异。
AI.method: 通过两个 token 级指标（视觉依赖度、预测熵）进行实证分析，发现正确推理链在视觉接地增强时熵下降更显著，且导致推理崩溃的关键 token 在正确链的联合分布中属于统计离群点；据此提出 TPAE，以每个 token 与正确 rollout 的视觉—熵模式的统计一致性来估计 token 级优势，并用其调制序列级优势，形成可插入各类 RLVR 框架的细粒度监督信号。
AI.result: 在七个基准上，TPAE 持续优于主流强基线，优化更稳定、更高效。
AI.conclusion: token 级的视觉接地与不确定性建模可为多模态 RLVR 提供有效的细粒度优势信号，TPAE 是一种通用且有效的改进方案，代码已开源。

title: Unmerge: Efficient Machine Unlearning via Task Arithmetic
summary: Approximate machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of a forget set from a trained model without full retraining. Existing gradient-based methods require data-dependent hyperparameter search, struggle when forget and retain knowledge are entangled, and offer little insight into where unlearning actually happens inside the network. We recast unlearning through the lens of task arithmetic: if finetuning produces a merged task vector $τ_m$ that combines learning on forget and retain sets, unlearning is the inverse operation that subtracts a learned forget component $τ_F$ to recover the retain task vector $τ_R$. The forget signal is concentrated: at every layer, forget activations lie in a subspace spanned by a handful of dominant directions, so we factorize $τ_F$ in a low-rank forget basis, which is faithful up to a small tail-eigenvalue residual and limits how far the correction can perturb retain. We then optimize three intuitive goals (match the merged vector inside the forget span, suppress leakage into the retain span, and bound the correction size) that provably bound forget leakage and retain damage in activation space. The resulting algorithm, Unmerge, is fast and powerful: on class-level unlearning with ResNet-50 on CIFAR-100 and Tiny ImageNet, it improves Tug-of-War by up to ~24% over a baseline of comparable runtime and by up to ~18% over stronger baselines that run ~5x slower, keeps membership-inference exposure at the level of retraining, and shrinks the feature-distribution gap to the retrained model, where relabeling methods leave forget features cleanly separable. Further studies show that Unmerge also applies to ViT-S/16 and scales to Llama-3.2-3B. The per-layer basis geometry that drives the algorithm also serves as a layerwise diagnostic for when and where unlearning becomes structurally hard.

AI.tldr: 本文将机器遗忘重新表述为任务算术中的逆运算：从合并任务向量中减去低秩的遗忘分量以恢复保留任务向量，提出 Unmerge 算法，在类级遗忘任务上显著优于基线，并可用于 ViT 与大语言模型。
AI.motivation: 现有基于梯度的近似机器遗忘方法存在三个痛点：需要依赖数据的超参数搜索；当遗忘知识与保留知识纠缠时表现不佳；无法说明遗忘在网络的哪一层、以何种结构发生。作者希望找到一个更原理化、更具可解释性的遗忘框架。
AI.method: 将遗忘视为任务算术的逆操作：若微调产生合并任务向量 τ_m（融合了遗忘集与保留集的学习），遗忘即减去学到的遗忘分量 τ_F 以恢复保留任务向量 τ_R。观察到遗忘信号高度集中——每层遗忘激活都位于少数主导方向张成的低秩子空间中，因此在低秩遗忘基上对 τ_F 做分解，仅留下小的尾部特征值残差。随后优化三个目标：在遗忘子空间内匹配合并向量、抑制向保留子空间的泄漏、约束修正幅度，从而在激活空间中可证明地同时约束遗忘泄漏与保留损伤。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-100 与 Tiny ImageNet 上使用 ResNet-50 的类级遗忘任务中，Unmerge 在相当运行时下将 Tug-of-War 提升至多约 24%，相较运行约 5 倍慢的更强基线仍提升至多约 18%；成员推断暴露程度保持在重训练水平；特征分布与重训练模型的差距明显缩小，而重标记方法仍使遗忘特征清晰可分。方法还可用于 ViT-S/16 并扩展至 Llama-3.2-3B。
AI.conclusion: Unmerge 通过低秩遗忘基与任务算术视角实现了快速、有效的机器遗忘，兼具隐私保护与表征对齐优势。驱动算法的逐层基几何还可作为诊断工具，用于判断遗忘何时、在何处变得结构上困难。

title: Learning Process Rewards via Reasoning State Propagation
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) have demonstrated notable effectiveness in test-time scaling and reinforcement learning by providing fine-grained signals for evaluating intermediate reasoning states, but their training relies heavily on costly process annotations. A natural way to alleviate this dependence is to complement limited process supervision with scalable outcome supervision. However, existing PRMs often model reasoning prefixes independently, providing no explicit mechanism for effectively using final outcome to guide the learning of intermediate reasoning states. We introduce Reasoning State Propagation (RSP), which represents each reasoning prefix with a binary validity state and models transitions between successive states across the reasoning trajectory. Specifically, RSP predicts a break probability that a valid state becomes invalid and a repair probability that an invalid state returns to valid. By propagating these transitions, RSP connects intermediate states to the final state, allowing process annotations to supervise intermediate states while outcome labels supervise the final state and can provide learning signals to preceding steps. Across reasoning search, response selection, and reinforcement learning, RSP consistently outperforms representative PRM baselines, with average improvements over Qwen2.5-Math-PRM of 5.6% in beam search and 2.1% in reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出推理状态传播（RSP），将推理前缀建模为二值有效性状态并建模相邻状态间的转移（断裂概率与修复概率），从而把过程标注与结果标签统一到同一传播框架中。在推理搜索、响应选择和强化学习上，RSP 均优于代表性 PRM 基线，相对 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 在 beam search 上平均提升 5.6%，在强化学习上提升 2.1%。
AI.motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）在测试时扩展和强化学习中效果显著，但其训练高度依赖昂贵的过程标注。自然的缓解思路是用可扩展的结果监督补充有限的过程监督，然而现有 PRM 通常独立建模推理前缀，缺乏显式机制让最终结果指导中间推理状态的学习。
AI.method: 提出 Reasoning State Propagation（RSP）：用二值有效性状态表示每个推理前缀，并建模推理轨迹上相邻状态之间的转移。具体地，RSP 预测有效状态变为无效的断裂概率（break probability）以及无效状态恢复为有效的修复概率（repair probability）。通过传播这些转移，RSP 将中间状态与最终状态连接起来，使过程标注监督中间状态、结果标签监督最终状态，并能将学习信号回传至前序步骤。
AI.result: 在推理搜索、响应选择与强化学习三类任务上，RSP 一致优于代表性 PRM 基线；相对 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM，beam search 平均提升 5.6%，强化学习平均提升 2.1%。
AI.conclusion: RSP 通过显式建模推理状态的转移与传播，有效融合了过程监督与结果监督，解决了现有 PRM 前缀独立建模、结果信号无法引导中间状态的问题，并在多种下游场景中取得稳定增益。

title: K2P: Label-Free Knowledge to Prompt Distillation
summary: Knowledge distillation can transfer reasoning from stronger teachers to frozen students through reusable prompts, but avoiding weight updates does not eliminate supervision. Without ground-truth answers, teacher solutions are unverified, and agreement with the teacher can reward shared mistakes. We introduce Knowledge-to-Prompt (K2P) for label-free knowledge distillation to prompts. K2P synthesizes reusable instructions from teacher solutions, refines them using paired teacher and student responses, and guides search and selection with answer agreement. It retains candidates that adaptive search may undervalue and selects on reserved questions. Deployment uses only the frozen student and selected prompt. Our theory separates generation and selection gaps and gives conditions under which agreement-guided construction yields accuracy guarantees despite imperfect teacher references. Across reasoning tasks and students, K2P outperforms label-free alternatives overall and remains competitive with supervised prompt optimization. Ablations and archive diagnostics assess the contributions of teacher solutions and refinement, while revealing the limits of agreement-guided selection.

AI.tldr: 提出K2P方法，从教师解答合成可复用提示，实现无标签知识蒸馏，在推理任务上优于无标签基线并接近有监督提示优化。
AI.motivation: 知识蒸馏可通过可复用提示将推理能力从强教师迁移到冻结学生，但不更新权重并不意味着没有监督。在缺少真实答案时，教师解答未经检验，与教师的一致可能奖励共同错误。
AI.method: K2P从教师解答合成可复用指令，利用配对的教师与学生响应进行精炼，并以答案一致性引导搜索与选择；保留自适应搜索可能低估的候选，并在预留问题上进行选择。部署时仅使用冻结学生和选定提示。理论上分离生成差距与选择差距，给出在教师参考不完美情况下一致性引导构造仍具精度保证的条件。
AI.result: 在多种推理任务与学生模型上，K2P总体优于无标签替代方案，并与有监督提示优化保持竞争力。消融实验与档案诊断评估了教师解答和精炼的贡献，同时揭示了一致性引导选择的局限。
AI.conclusion: K2P为无标签提示蒸馏提供了理论与实证支持，说明在教师参考不完美时一致性引导构造仍可提供精度保证，但其一致性引导选择存在局限。

title: Fyan: A Human--AI Harness with Semantic Auditing for Document-Level Formalization
summary: We present FYAN, a human--AI harness for document-level mathematical formalization. Rather than treating theorems in isolation, FYAN coordinates an end-to-end workflow spanning specification, proof planning, logical review, Lean proof construction, knowledge curation, and validation, with support for independent supervision and human guidance. A central component is evidence-grounded semantic auditing, which assesses whether formal statements faithfully preserve their informal specifications. A language model constructs structured evidence over local correspondences, omissions, scope, and logical relations, while a deterministic validator checks this evidence and produces reproducible judgments. When a substantive but admissible deviation is accepted, FYAN requires an explicit proof-transfer obligation connecting the formal statement back to a source-facing interpretation. With the same model (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash) in every stage, FYAN proves 86 of 143 FormalTCS theorems under a strict Lean check, against 69 for a general agent harness, and raises the natural-language proof score from 0.501 to 0.851. On ConsistencyCheck, its semantic audit catches more inconsistent statements than a direct LLM judge, both on labels verified against the source (recall 0.777 vs. 0.636) and on the original labels (0.873 vs. 0.820), and localizes each mismatch it reports to a specific hypothesis, conclusion, or scope. FYAN also built ODENumLib, a 9,355-line Lean library for the numerical analysis of ordinary differential equation.

AI.tldr: FYAN 是一个面向文档级数学形式化的人机协作框架，通过端到端流程与证据驱动的语义审计，在同一模型下显著提升 Lean 证明成功率与语义一致性检测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有形式化方法多将定理孤立处理，缺乏对文档级规范保真度的系统审查。本文旨在构建覆盖规范、规划、审查、证明构建与验证的完整流程，并解决形式陈述与自然语言规范之间语义偏差难以可靠检测的问题。
AI.method: FYAN 协调规范、证明规划、逻辑审查、Lean 证明构建、知识整理与验证的端到端工作流，支持独立监督与人工引导。核心为证据驱动的语义审计：由语言模型对局部对应、遗漏、范围与逻辑关系构建结构化证据，确定性验证器检查证据并给出可复现判断；当接受实质性但可容许的偏差时，强制要求显式的证明迁移义务。各阶段均使用同一模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。
AI.result: 在严格 Lean 检查下，FYAN 证明 143 个 FormalTCS 定理中的 86 个，通用智能体框架为 69 个；自然语言证明得分由 0.501 提升至 0.851。在 ConsistencyCheck 上，语义审计相较直接 LLM 评判能捕获更多不一致陈述：基于源验证标签的召回率为 0.777 对 0.636，基于原始标签为 0.873 对 0.820，并能将每处不匹配定位到具体假设、结论或范围。此外构建了 9,355 行的 Lean 库 ODENumLib，用于常微分方程数值分析。
AI.conclusion: FYAN 表明，将文档级形式化流程化并对形式陈述进行证据驱动的语义审计，可在不更换模型的前提下显著提升证明成功率、自然语言证明质量与不一致声明的检测与定位能力，并具备产出大规模领域 Lean 库的实用价值。

title: Certified Approximation for Interpretable Representer Landmarks
summary: Representer explanations rank the training landmarks that most influence a self-supervised representation. At scale, this ranking rests on up to four stacked approximations of the empirical neural tangent kernel (eNTK). These are random output heads, a parameter sketch, landmark sampling and a coefficient fit. Existing analyses bound each approximation separately, but none certifies the top-$K$ set against their combined error. We introduce CAIRN (Certified Approximation for Interpretable Representer laNdmarks), a framework that carries this error through to the ranking. We derive the exact variance of the sketched multi-head eNTK, which matches measurement within $4\%$ where Johnson-Lindenstrauss bounds err by up to $2.5\times$. This yields a high-probability top-$K$ certificate for a fixed coefficient fit, alongside exact residual-trace certificates for discarded spectral mass. An exact product-variance identity separates kernel error from fit variability and identifies when a larger kernel budget can still sharpen a ranking. Stochastic Lanczos Quadrature (SLQ) estimates the effective dimension within $0.72\%$ and guides the landmark budget without dense eigendecomposition. We show that residual mass does not control class coverage, and residual-greedy selection cuts the worst coverage excess of $k$-means++ from $8.5\times$ to $1.55\times$ ($4\times$ on the sketched eNTK). Cross-view initializers outperform principal-component initialization in five (AUI) to all six (CSI) settings. Against the KREPES Gauss-Newton solver, CAIRN converges $2.5$ to $11.3\times$ faster, trails by at most $0.31$ points and gains up to $3.14$ points on MNIST. Together, these results make the reliability of representer explanations measurable and show where approximation budgets are best spent.

AI.tldr: 提出 CAIRN 框架，将 eNTK 的四重逼近误差传播到 representer 解释的 top-K 排序上，给出可验证证书，并据此优化预算分配。
AI.motivation: representer 解释依赖经验神经切线核（eNTK）对训练样本排序，但在大规模场景下需叠加随机输出头、参数 sketch、landmark 采样和系数拟合四重逼近。已有工作只对每个逼近单独给出界，无法针对四者累积误差 certify top-K 集合的可靠性，因此解释的可靠性不可度量。
AI.method: CAIRN 将四层逼近误差沿链路传播至排序结果：推导 sketched multi-head eNTK 的精确方差，并用于固定系数拟合下 top-K 的高概率证书；给出被丢弃谱质量的精确残差迹证书；通过精确乘积方差恒等式将核误差与拟合波动分离；用 Stochastic Lanczos Quadrature（SLQ）在无需稠密特征分解的情况下估计有效维数并指导 landmark 预算；同时研究 residual-greedy 选点与跨视图初始化。
AI.result: 精确方差与实测偏差在 4% 以内，而 Johnson-Lindenstrauss 界误差可达 2.5 倍；SLQ 估计有效维数误差在 0.72% 以内；residual mass 不能控制类别覆盖，residual-greedy 将 k-means++ 的最差覆盖超额从 8.5 倍降至 1.55 倍（sketched eNTK 上为 4 倍）；跨视图初始化在五到六个设置上优于主成分初始化；相比 KREPES Gauss-Newton 求解器，CAIRN 收敛快 2.5–11.3 倍，精度最多落后 0.31 点，在 MNIST 上最多提升 3.14 点。
AI.conclusion: CAIRN 使 representer 解释的可靠性可度量，并明确了逼近预算的最佳投入位置。

title: Effective Does Not Mean Useful: Conditional Functional Substitutability for Redundancy and Scaling in Transformers
summary: Modern neural networks scale predictably, yet the mechanisms behind these regularities remain unclear. Neural redundancy is typically characterized by component importance or representational similarity, both indirect proxies. We view redundancy as an input-conditioned, dynamic relation: intermediate computational states are functionally redundant when they induce similar downstream responses. We introduce Conditional Functional Substitutability (CFS) to directly characterize such functional substitution. CFS exposes functional relations and reduction potential missed by conventional importance- and similarity-based measures. Across modalities and Transformer families, CFS reveals systematic functional reorganization with scale. Controlled scaling further shows that performance gains need not track growth in substitutability, while fixed-capacity models with more independent functional structure perform better, providing a functional account of diminishing returns. Predicted CFS further enables dynamic computation with a better performance--computation trade-off than importance-based component selection, suggesting new directions for redundancy-aware computation and more efficient model scaling.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"条件功能可替代性"(CFS)，将神经冗余重新定义为输入条件下的动态功能关系：当中间计算状态诱导相似的下游响应时，即视为功能冗余，并据此揭示规模下的功能重组、收益递减机制与动态计算优势。
AI.motivation: 现代神经网络的可扩展性具有可预测规律，但其背后的机制尚不清楚。现有对神经冗余的刻画通常依赖组件重要性或表征相似性，二者均为间接代理，无法直接反映功能层面的替代关系。作者希望以更直接的功能视角刻画冗余。
AI.method: 提出条件功能可替代性(CFS)：将冗余视为输入条件下的动态关系，当中间计算状态诱导相似的下游响应时判定为功能可替代。在不同模态与Transformer家族上测量CFS，并通过受控缩放实验与预测CFS驱动的动态计算进行验证，与基于重要性的组件选择方法对比。
AI.result: CFS能够揭示重要性与相似性度量所遗漏的功能关系与压缩潜力；跨模态与Transformer家族呈现随规模变化的功能系统性重组；受控缩放显示性能提升并不必然随可替代性增长而同步，而具有更多独立功能结构的固定容量模型表现更优；预测的CFS支持动态计算，在性能—计算权衡上优于基于重要性的组件选择。
AI.conclusion: 冗余是输入条件下的动态功能替代关系，CFS为收益递减提供了功能性解释，并为冗余感知计算与更高效的模型缩放提供了新方向。

title: Amortized Data Borrowing with Exchangeability-Aware Neural Posterior Estimation
comment: 27 pages. Accepted at the 11th Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC 2026)
summary: Augmenting small concurrent studies with external or historical cohorts is attractive in drug development, where enrollment is slow, follow-up is expensive, and closely related trial or real-world data are often already available. Bayesian dynamic borrowing (BDB) provides a principled framework for adaptively controlling the influence of external data, but classical implementations often depend on hand-specified priors and MCMC-based inference, which can be computationally expensive and not generalizable. In this work, we study amortized neural posterior estimation (NPE) as a flexible alternative. A single network is pretrained on simulated current/external dataset pairs spanning covariate shift, outcome drift, and joint non-exchangeability, and then returns an approximate posterior for a scalar current-study target in a single forward pass. Through simulation studies, we find that NPE is most useful under outcome drift and joint mismatch: in the harder outcome-drift regimes, it gives up to about five-fold lower absolute bias than the best classical baseline and keeps Type I error close to nominal. After pretraining, posterior summaries are obtained in about 8 ms per dataset, roughly $10^3\times$ faster than MCMC-based borrowing baselines in our timing experiment. We further analyze Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) data and show that, when mild cognitive impairment outcomes differ across cohorts, the NPE formulation recovers the later-cohort risk level in this example without claiming greater precision. Code is available at https://github.com/ChinHungScott/NPE-for-Bayesian-Dynamic-Borrowing-MLHC-.

AI.tldr: 本文研究摊销式神经后验估计（NPE）作为贝叶斯动态借入（BDB）的灵活替代方案：单个网络在模拟的当前/外部数据集对上预训练后，单次前向传播即可给出当前研究标量目标的后验近似，在结果漂移与联合不可交换情形下表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 药物研发中入组慢、随访昂贵，且常已有相关试验或真实世界数据，因此用小规模同期研究结合外部或历史队列很有吸引力。贝叶斯动态借入可自适应控制外部数据影响，但经典实现依赖手工设定先验与MCMC推断，计算昂贵且难以泛化。
AI.method: 将摊销式神经后验估计（NPE）用于动态借入：在覆盖协变量偏移、结果漂移与联合不可交换性的模拟当前/外部数据集对上进行网络预训练，之后对当前研究的标量目标单次前向传播即返回近似后验。
AI.result: 模拟研究显示NPE在结果漂移与联合失配下最有用：在较难的结果漂移情形下，绝对偏差比最佳经典基线低至约五倍，且I类错误接近名义水平。预训练后每个数据集的后验摘要约8 ms，比基于MCMC的借入基线快约10^3倍。ADNI数据分析表明，当轻度认知障碍结局在队列间存在差异时，NPE能恢复较晚队列的风险水平，且未虚称更高精度。
AI.conclusion: NPE为贝叶斯动态借入提供了一种灵活、可摊销且计算高效的替代方案，尤其适用于结果漂移与联合不可交换场景；代码已开源。

title: ANI: Adaptive Numerical Injection for Unifying Semantic and Arithmetic Representations in Numerical Reasoning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 16 pages, 7 figures. Code available at https://github.com/Jinsung-Jeon/ANI_EMNLP
summary: Precise numerical reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for expanding their applicability to complex real-world tasks. However, text-based tokenization often fragments numbers, significantly hindering precise arithmetic reasoning. Meanwhile, numerical embeddings, despite arithmetic precision, rely on context-agnostic substitution that disregards the semantic role of numbers as identifiers. To combine the complementary strengths, we propose \textbf{ANI (Adaptive Numerical Injection)}, a hybrid framework that governs the selective injection of numerical features based on the semantic context. By employing a context-aware gating mechanism, we selectively inject numerical embeddings (specifically FoNE) into the latent space, explicitly preserving nominal identifiers while enhancing quantitative operands. Through extensive evaluations across various LLMs, we demonstrate that ANI enhances MATH performance by 9.5 points over the official reference model, while maintaining robust performance on general linguistic benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出ANI混合框架，通过上下文感知门控选择性注入数值嵌入（FoNE），在保留数字标识语义的同时增强算术运算，MATH提升9.5分且不损通用语言能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在复杂现实任务中需精确数值推理。但文本分词会碎片化数字，损害算术推理；而数值嵌入虽算术精确，却依赖上下文无关的替换，忽视数字作为标识符的语义角色。需要结合二者互补优势。
AI.method: ANI（Adaptive Numerical Injection）是一个混合框架，基于语义上下文控制数值特征的选择性注入。采用上下文感知门控机制，将数值嵌入（具体为FoNE）选择性注入隐空间，在显式保留名义标识符的同时增强定量操作数。
AI.result: 在多种LLM上广泛评估，ANI相较官方参考模型MATH性能提升9.5分，同时在通用语言基准上保持稳健性能。
AI.conclusion: ANI通过上下文感知的数值嵌入选择性注入，有效结合文本分词与数值嵌入的优势，显著提升数值推理能力且不牺牲通用语言能力。

title: DAMPER: Return-Prioritized Gradient Control for Smooth Policies
summary: Actor-critic methods achieve strong performance in continuous control, but their policies can produce highly oscillatory actions. A common remedy is to add auxiliary smoothness losses. However, their contribution can be negligible when their gradients are small relative to the native actor gradient. Moreover, existing methods often combine multiple auxiliary losses, complicating loss balancing without necessarily improving the return-smoothness trade-off. We introduce DAMPER (Direction-Aware Magnitude-Controlled Projection with Explicit Return Priority), which combines the native actor gradient with a temporal-consistency gradient through conflict-conditioned projection and adaptive magnitude control. It removes the auxiliary component opposing the actor gradient and scales the retained temporal direction relative to the actor gradient norm, preserving positive alignment with the native actor gradient. Experiments with TD3 and SAC on six continuous-control tasks show reduced action oscillation relative to the native agents in all 12 task-backbone pairs and the best oscillation score among the compared methods in eight, with task-dependent return trade-offs.

AI.tldr: DAMPER通过冲突条件投影与自适应幅度控制融合原生actor梯度与时间一致性梯度，在TD3/SAC的12组任务中均降低动作振荡。
AI.motivation: Actor-critic在连续控制中性能强但动作高度振荡；常用辅助平滑损失在梯度相对原生actor梯度较小时贡献可忽略，且多损失组合导致难以平衡，未必改善回报-平滑性权衡。
AI.method: 提出DAMPER（Direction-Aware Magnitude-Controlled Projection with Explicit Return Priority），将原生actor梯度与时间一致性梯度结合，采用冲突条件投影与自适应幅度控制：剔除与actor梯度相反方向的辅助分量，并按actor梯度范数缩放保留的时间方向，保证与原生actor梯度正对齐。
AI.result: 在六个连续控制任务上以TD3和SAC为骨干，12组任务-骨干配对中动作振荡均较原生智能体降低，其中8组方法中振荡指标最优，回报权衡随任务变化。
AI.conclusion: DAMPER以显式回报优先的梯度投影和幅度控制替代多辅助损失组合，可在保持回报权衡的前提下稳定降低策略动作振荡。

title: MiniRep: Robust Reputation-Based Aggregation for Multi-Agent Debate
summary:
Autonomous agents powered by large language models (LLMs) are rapidly evolving into an open agentic ecosystem. To support trustworthy collaboration, industry initiatives increasingly assess agent reputation from past behavior and provide performance leaderboards. However, reputation derived from past performance may not reliably predict an agent's behavior on new tasks, particularly when malicious agents can adapt their behavior and influence other agents during collaboration.
  We study reputation in multi-agent debate (MAD), where multiple agents answer the same query, debate to improve their answers, and aggregate them into a final output. We present MiniRep, a reputation-based aggregation system for MAD under malicious agents. To ground our threat model in established research, we construct an attack taxonomy drawing on reputation-system attacks and software-testing mutation operators, covering strategic exploitation of reputation and subtle corruption of agent proposals. Guided by this taxonomy, MiniRep evaluates agents based on both their behavior on the current task and their reputation over time, while preventing groups of agents with highly similar responses from dominating the final decision. We assess MiniRep across diverse tasks, LLM-agent compositions, corruption placements, and attack types drawn from our taxonomy. Our experimental results show that, MiniRep outperforms both conventional MAD aggregation and conventional reputation-based approaches on MATH no matter being attacked or not. Also, under a heterogeneous 10-agent setting on MATH, MiniRep outperforms all baselines in all 28 attack conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MiniRep，一个面向多智能体辩论（MAD）的基于声誉的聚合系统，用于在恶意智能体存在时提升协作的可信度；通过构建攻击分类法，结合当前任务行为与历史声誉评分，并抑制高相似回复群体的决策主导地位。
AI.motivation: 由LLM驱动的自主智能体正形成开放生态，业界依赖历史表现评估智能体声誉并提供排行榜以支持可信协作。但历史表现推导出的声誉难以可靠预测智能体在新任务上的行为，尤其当恶意智能体能够自适应改变行为并在协作中影响其他智能体时。
AI.method: 研究多智能体辩论（MAD）中的声誉问题：多个智能体回答同一查询、通过辩论改进答案并聚合为最终输出。构建攻击分类法，融合声誉系统攻击与软件测试变异算子，涵盖对声誉的战略性利用以及智能体提案的细微篡改。受该分类法指导，MiniRep同时依据智能体在当前任务上的行为与随时间积累的声誉进行评估，并防止回复高度相似的智能体群体主导最终决策。
AI.result: 在多样化任务、LLM智能体组合、篡改位置及分类法中的攻击类型下评估MiniRep。实验表明，在MATH数据集上，无论是否受到攻击，MiniRep均优于传统MAD聚合方法与传统基于声誉的方法；在MATH的异构10智能体设置下，MiniRep在全部28种攻击条件下均优于所有基线。
AI.conclusion: MiniRep通过结合任务内行为评估与跨时间声誉、并抑制相似回复群体的过度影响，为恶意智能体环境下的MAD聚合提供了更稳健的方案，实验证明其在多种攻击条件下的有效性。

title: Unlearning Deceptive Behaviors in LLMs with Contrastive Forget Sets
summary: Large language models often know the truth and say otherwise: a model that answers correctly when asked neutrally will affirm a user's mistaken belief, or misstate a fact its system prompt wants hidden, once the context rewards it. Such deception is a behavior conditioned on context, not knowledge, yet machine unlearning, the natural tool for removing a behavior from the weights, is built to forget facts that a deceptive model still needs. We propose to unlearn when a model deceives rather than what it knows, with a contrastive forget unit built from the model's own realized deceptions: the same question under a deception-triggering and a neutral context, admitted only where belief holds and behavior flips. Standard objectives on this unit face a dilemma. Suppression objectives such as NPO leave much of the deception in place. Target-based objectives, which distill the model's neutral behavior into the pressured context, remove it but induce context blindness: a target generated without the context teaches the model to stop reading it, eroding benign system-prompt instructions, secret-keeping and the reasoning a monitor inspects, a failure invisible to deception rates and capability benchmarks. We introduce PACT, which trains toward pressure-aware counterfactual targets (the model's own honest response, with a trace that registers the pressure and resists it) while retaining the benign uses of the triggering context. On two 32B reasoning models, PACT reduces held-out deception from over 50% to under 3% while system-prompt adherence, secret-keeping and the reasoning trace stay at the base model's level. On a tug-of-war score of removal against retention, PACT reaches 0.94 and 0.86, against at most 0.77 and 0.60 for any baseline. Like removed knowledge, removed deception is shallow under relearning, and terms that simulate the attacker hold it only at a cost in context use.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将"模型何时欺骗"而非"模型知道什么"作为遗忘对象，构建基于模型自身真实欺骗行为的对比式遗忘单元，并针对现有抑制/目标类方法的两难困境提出 PACT 方法，在保持系统提示遵循、保密与推理轨迹的同时大幅降低欺骗率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型常"知真而言假"：在中立提问下能答对，却会在奖励欺骗的上下文中附合用户错误信念或隐瞒系统提示要求隐藏的事实。这种欺骗是依赖上下文的行为而非知识缺陷，因此以"遗忘事实"为目标的机器遗忘工具并不适配——欺骗模型仍需要这些事实。作者希望直接遗忘"欺骗行为"本身，而非其掌握的知识。
AI.method: 提出以模型自身已实现的欺骗构建"对比式遗忘单元"：同一问题在触发欺骗的上下文与中立上下文下的两次回答，仅在"信念成立且行为翻转"处纳入。针对常规目标的两难（抑制类如 NPO 遗留欺骗；目标类蒸馏中立行为会引发"上下文盲"，即模型学会忽略上下文，损害系统提示遵循、保密与推理轨迹），提出 PACT：以"压力感知的反事实目标"（模型自身的诚实回答，并附带记录压力并加以抵抗的轨迹）进行训练，同时保留触发上下文的良性用途。
AI.result: 在两个 32B 推理模型上，PACT 将留出集欺骗率从 50% 以上降至 3% 以下，同时系统提示遵循、保密与推理轨迹维持基座模型水平。在"移除 vs 保留"的拉锯战评分中，PACT 达到 0.94 与 0.86，而所有基线最高仅为 0.77 与 0.60。与已被遗忘的知识类似，被移除的欺骗在再学习下是浅层的，且模拟攻击者的项只能以牺牲上下文使用为代价维持。
AI.conclusion: 将遗忘对象从"知识"转向"行为"，并以压力感知的反事实目标进行训练，可在不损害上下文利用能力的前提下有效、选择性地移除上下文诱发的欺骗行为；但该移除具有浅层性，在再学习条件下可能被恢复。

title: WorkGenesis: Building the Worlds That Teach Agents to Work
summary: The ability of Large Language Model (LLM) agents to complete daily and professional work is receiving increasing attention. Training such agents requires realistic work scenarios. Expert-authored occupational work is costly and slow to produce, while unconstrained synthesis often yields tasks with weak factual grounding or internally inconsistent requirements. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkGenesis, a framework that constructs executable occupational work from real-world artifacts through two core technical innovations: (1) Evidence-Based Work Construction, which grounds each unit of work in real-world evidence by retrieving public files guided by O*NET occupational knowledge and synthesizing the surrounding context, companion materials, work request, and itemwise rubric around them; and (2) Execution-Guided Consistency Verification, which renders a reference deliverable inside the constructed work, attributes every unsatisfied rubric item to the agent, the task, or the rubric, and uses task and rubric defects as feedback to iteratively repair the work until it passes the audit. Experimental results demonstrate that Fx-Work-35B, trained with simple supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on only 20K units of work synthesized by WorkGenesis, achieves the highest scores among all comparable-scale baselines on the five reported metrics across GDPvalAA-v2, APEX-Agents-AA, and JobBench (31.00 versus 24.79 average score), and even surpasses frontier models such as the 1.6T DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview. These results show that WorkGenesis provides scalable training data for working agents.

AI.tldr: WorkGenesis 通过"基于证据的工作构建"与"执行引导的一致性验证"两个核心机制，从真实世界产物中合成可执行的职业工作数据，据此训练的 Fx-Work-35B 在三个基准上超越同规模基线乃至前沿大模型。
AI.motivation: 训练能够完成日常与专业工作的 LLM 智能体需要真实的工作场景，但专家撰写的职业工作数据成本高、产出慢，而无约束的合成任务又往往事实依据薄弱或内部需求不一致，因此亟需一种兼具规模与真实性的数据构建方案。
AI.method: 提出 WorkGenesis 框架，包含两项核心创新：(1) 基于证据的工作构建——以 O*NET 职业知识为引导检索公开文件，使每个工作单元锚定于真实证据，并围绕这些证据合成上下文、配套材料、工作请求与逐项评分标准；(2) 执行引导的一致性验证——在构建的工作内生成参考交付物，将每个未满足的评分项归因于智能体、任务或评分标准，并以任务与评分标准缺陷为反馈迭代修复，直至工作通过审计。
AI.result: 仅使用 WorkGenesis 合成的 2 万条工作单元进行简单监督微调（SFT）得到的 Fx-Work-35B，在 GDPvalAA-v2、APEX-Agents-AA 与 JobBench 上五项指标均取得同规模基线中的最高分（平均 31.00 对 24.79），并超过 1.6T 规模的 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Preview 等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: WorkGenesis 能够为工作型智能体提供可扩展、高质量的训练数据：少量合成数据即可通过简单 SFT 显著提升模型在职业工作基准上的表现。

title: Generalized Residual Closure: General Learning Dynamics for Stability-Plasticity Compatibility
summary: Learning must acquire new capabilities while preserving both prior responsibilities and the capacity to learn again. We introduce Generalized Residual Closure (GRC), a framework for learning as recursive closure of future-relevant discrepancies: closing a residual establishes the conditions for subsequent prediction, interaction, and learning. Under a complete representation-relation description at a fixed learner-world boundary, persistent internal learning has two primitive modes: Transformation within a representation and revision of the Representation itself. We establish a local tangent decomposition under regularity assumptions and a criterion for when representation revision is necessary. In an affine model, we derive a necessary-and-sufficient condition for stability-plasticity compatibility and the unique solution of a constrained quadratic update problem, which preserves registered old responsibilities while reducing residuals with an effective safe response. We prove that reconstructive semantic protection weakly enlarges the safe-response operator relative to preserving an exact historical realization. Dynamic sufficiency and future-closure viability extend representation adequacy from current prediction to lawful future updating and continued learning. Growth Learning expands the lawful closure domain or lowers optimal closure cost without regression of the registered capability-cost frontier; a conditional commit rule maintains this order. Restricted-sector recoveries and a conditional representation theorem connect the framework to optimization, machine learning, and control. Together, these results organize adaptation, representation revision, and reusable capability within a common account of continued learning.

AI.tldr: 提出广义残差闭包（GRC）框架，将学习刻画为面向未来残差的递归闭包过程，在固定学习者-世界边界下区分表示内变换与表示修订两种原语模式，并给出稳定性-可塑性兼容的充要条件、约束二次更新的唯一解及增长学习机制，统一了适应、表示修订与可复用能力。
AI.motivation: 学习需要在获取新能力的同时保留既有职责，并维持再次学习的能力。已有工作往往将适应、表示修订与能力保持割裂处理，缺乏在固定学习者-世界边界下统一刻画持续学习的理论框架。
AI.method: 1) 通过完整表示-关系描述，将持续内部学习归约为两种原语模式：表示内变换与表示本身修订；2) 在正则性假设下建立局部切空间分解，并给出表示修订必要性的判定准则；3) 在仿射模型中推导稳定性-可塑性兼容的充要条件与约束二次更新问题的唯一解；4) 证明重构式语义保护相对精确历史实现保持可弱扩展安全响应算子；5) 以动态充分性与未来闭包可行性扩展表示充分性；6) 引入增长学习以扩展合法闭包域或降低最优闭包代价，并用条件提交规则维持能力-代价前沿序。
AI.result: 得到表示修订必要性的判定准则、仿射模型下稳定性-可塑性兼容的充要条件与约束二次更新的唯一闭式解；证明重构式语义保护可弱扩展安全响应算子；建立动态充分性与未来闭包可行性对表示充分性的扩展；给出增长学习维持能力-代价前沿无回归的条件，并通过受限扇区恢复与条件表示定理将框架与优化、机器学习及控制相连接。
AI.conclusion: GRC 将适应、表示修订与可复用能力纳入持续学习的统一解释框架，为兼顾新能力获取、旧职责保留与再学习能力提供了理论工具与判定条件。

title: Understanding as No-Arbitrage: Bounded Dutch Books as a Definition and Training Objective for Language Models
summary: Does a language model merely predict tokens, or does it understand what it says? We make this question measurable by defining "understanding" through the lens of no-arbitrage. A model understands a vocabulary to a certain degree if a computationally bounded trader cannot extract guaranteed profit by betting against the model's probabilities on logically related claims (a "Dutch book"). We establish three theoretical results: first, because full logical coherence is computationally intractable, understanding is inherently graded, not absolute. Second, we prove that the exact optimum of standard next-token prediction is inherently incoherent across different question formats; the flaw lies in the training objective, not the architecture. Third, we show that uncertainty accumulates predictably along reasoning chains, making unjustified overconfidence an arbitrage opportunity in itself. To address this, we introduce Arbitr, a training framework where an adversarial trader penalizes the model for logical inconsistencies, paired with a calibration anchor to prevent uninformative collapse. Across five pre-registered experiments on Qwen2.5 and Phi-3.5 models, we demonstrate that standard models are highly exploitable across different phrasings. Arbitr reduces this exploitability by orders of magnitude without sacrificing task accuracy, and the effect successfully transfers to unseen logical patterns and new model families. Crucially, we uncover a scaling illusion: at 7B parameters, near-zero measured incoherence often coincides with extreme, unjustified confidence. We conclude that while Arbitr enforces rigorous logical consistency, coherence is a necessary condition for knowledge, but not a sufficient one

AI.tldr: 本文用"无套利"框架量化语言模型的理解程度：理解=有界交易者无法通过逻辑相关命题的对赌（Dutch book）稳赚。理论证明完全逻辑一致性不可计算、标准next-token目标本身跨格式不一致、不确定性沿推理链可预测累积；提出Arbitr对抗训练框架，大幅降低可利用性且不损性能，并揭示7B规模下"零不一致常伴随极端过度自信"的缩放幻觉。
AI.motivation: 核心动机是回答"语言模型究竟只是预测token还是真正理解"，并解决该问题难以量化、难以检验的困境。作者希望通过金融学中的无套利思想把"理解"转化为可测量的操作性定义，从而检验标准训练目标的根本缺陷，并为提升逻辑一致性提供方法。
AI.method: 1) 将理解定义为无套利：存在计算有界交易者能对逻辑相关命题下注、从模型概率中获取保证利润（Dutch book），则模型不理解该词表。2) 给出三项理论结果：完全逻辑一致性计算不可行故理解是分级的；标准next-token预测的最优解在不同提问格式间本质不一致（缺陷在训练目标而非架构）；不确定性沿推理链可预测累积，未证成的过度自信本身构成套利。3) 提出Arbitr训练框架：用对抗性交易者惩罚模型的逻辑不一致，并配以校准锚（calibration anchor）防止退化为无信息输出。4) 在Qwen2.5与Phi-3.5上开展五项预注册实验。
AI.result: 标准模型在不同措辞下高度可被套利（可利用性高）；Arbitr将可利用性降低数个数量级，且不牺牲任务准确率，效果可迁移到未见逻辑模式与新的模型家族；发现"缩放幻觉"：在7B参数规模，接近零的测量不一致往往与极端且未证成的过度自信同时出现。
AI.conclusion: Arbitr能强制实现严格的逻辑一致性，但一致性是知识的必要条件而非充分条件；理解本质上是分级、可测量的，标准训练目标本身存在结构性缺陷，需从目标与训练机制层面加以修正。

title: Flow Matching under Noisy Latent Structure: Beyond Exact Low-Dimensional Support
summary: Flow Matching (FM) learns a velocity field whose ODE transports a simple source distribution to a target law. Existing finite-sample theory largely treats ambient-space regularity or data supported exactly on low-dimensional sets. We study linear FM under a noisy latent-generator model, where a low-dimensional Hölder map is perturbed by nondegenerate ambient Gaussian noise, so the target law is full-dimensional despite its latent structure. We construct a spatially regular ReLU velocity class and establish non-asymptotic high-probability approximation and estimation bounds whose leading sample-size exponent is governed by the latent dimension rather than the ambient dimension, with ambient and noise dependence kept explicit. Fixed positive target noise keeps the interpolation nondegenerate over the full time interval. The same spatial regularity propagates the learned velocity error through the transport ODE, yielding a corresponding Wasserstein convergence guarantee. These results show that exact low-dimensional support is not necessary for Flow Matching to retain latent-dimensional statistical behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究噪声潜在生成模型下的线性Flow Matching（FM），证明即使目标分布因环境高斯噪声而变为全维，其统计收敛速率的主导指数仍由潜在维数而非环境维数决定。
AI.motivation: 现有FM有限样本理论多依赖环境空间正则性或假设数据精确支撑在低维集合上。作者希望探究在目标律实际为全维（由低维Hölder映射叠加非退化环境高斯噪声生成）的情形下，FM能否仍保持潜在维数主导的统计行为。
AI.method: 在噪声潜在生成模型下研究线性FM。构造空间正则的ReLU速度函数类，利用固定正目标噪声保证插值在全时间区间上非退化；推导非渐近高概率逼近与估计界，并显式保留环境与噪声依赖；通过传输ODE传播学习速度误差，得到Wasserstein收敛保证。
AI.result: 建立了非渐近高概率逼近与估计界，其主导样本量指数由潜在维数而非环境维数控制，并显式给出环境与噪声依赖性；同时将空间正则性通过传输ODE传播，获得相应的Wasserstein收敛保证。
AI.conclusion: Flow Matching要保留潜在维数的统计行为，并不需要目标分布具有精确的低维支撑；在非退化噪声下，潜在维数仍主导收敛速率。

title: The Golden Path Hypothesis: Reusable Schedules in Diffusion Caching
summary: Diffusion caching accelerates generation by replacing transformer computation with cached or predicted features at selected denoising steps. We introduce the Golden Path Hypothesis (GPH): under fixed inference conditions, prompt-independent cache schedules can achieve final-output quality comparable to the best prompt-specific schedules across prompts. We investigate the GPH across ten caching methods, four image and video models, and three cache ratios. Prompt-adaptive methods repeatedly select a small number of schedules, and reusing their most frequent schedules on new prompts closely matches the quality of prompt-specific choices. Exhaustive evaluation of 1.4 million schedules on four examples further identifies prompt-independent schedules that remain competitive on unseen prompts. To explain this transfer, we analyze denoising trajectories and the accumulation of caching errors. Latent-state trajectories exhibit similar structures across datasets and seeds, while an exact error decomposition shows that accumulated effects of earlier errors predict final latent-state error better than local approximation errors. This motivates searching for end-to-end schedules using final-output quality. With only a small set of examples, the resulting golden paths transfer across prompts and datasets, and can be tuned to the desired quality objective, including reconstruction fidelity or perceptual similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"黄金路径假设"(GPH)：在固定推理条件下，与提示无关的缓存调度可达到与最优提示特定调度相当的输出质量，并在十种缓存方法、四种图像/视频模型和三种缓存比例上得到验证。
AI.motivation: 扩散缓存通过在选定的去噪步骤用缓存或预测特征替代Transformer计算来加速生成。现有提示自适应方法需为每个提示反复搜索调度，成本高昂；本文希望探究是否存在与提示无关、可跨提示迁移的通用调度。
AI.method: 提出黄金路径假设(GPH)并系统验证：覆盖10种缓存方法、4种图像与视频模型、3种缓存比例；观察提示自适应方法反复选出少量调度并复用其高频调度；对4个样例穷举评估140万个调度以寻找提示无关调度；分析去噪轨迹与缓存误差累积，给出精确误差分解；最后以最终输出质量为目标端到端搜索调度。
AI.result: 提示自适应方法高频复用的调度在新提示上接近提示特定调度的质量；穷举1.4M调度找到在未见提示上仍具竞争力的提示无关调度；潜状态轨迹在数据集与随机种子间呈现相似结构；累积的早期误差比局部近似误差更能预测最终潜状态误差；少量样例得到的黄金路径可跨提示与数据集迁移，并可按目标调优（重建保真度或感知相似度）。
AI.conclusion: 缓存调度与提示基本无关，存在可迁移的"黄金路径"，且误差累积分析为端到端调度搜索提供依据，为高效扩散推理提供了通用调度方案。

title: Learning Where to Steer: Noise-Space Geometry for Efficient Offline Multi-Objective Optimization with Generative Models
summary: Offline multi-objective optimization (MOO) seeks solutions with better objective trade-offs using only a fixed dataset, without querying the objectives. Diffusion models trained on such data have emerged as a promising approach, but their samples are not inherently better than the data and must be steered toward the Pareto front. Existing methods guide or condition every sampling step. We instead act on the initial noise and leave the sampling process unchanged. Across Off-MOO-Bench, we observe that the objectives, as functions of the noise, are sensitive to only a few directions. We estimate these directions once per task via a Recursive Feature Machine using function values alone, and a small cache serves every trade-off, so each candidate costs one noise displacement and one ODE solve. We prove that this displacement increases the learned scalarized objective in expectation, and that sweeping trade-offs recovers the flow's attainable front up to proxy and steering errors. With additional guidance, for which we introduce novel data-adaptive and Pareto-aware operators, our method attains the best average hypervolume rank among generative methods on 47 tasks, at comparable or lower sampling cost. Steering alone outranks the best prior generative method at a fraction of its sampling cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种离线多目标优化方法：不干预扩散模型采样过程的每一步，而是只对初始噪声做一次位移，利用少量敏感方向引导样本走向帕累托前沿，从而以更低采样成本取得最优平均超体积排名。
AI.motivation: 现有离线MOO的扩散方法需在每一步采样中引导或条件化，计算开销大。作者观察到在Off-MOO-Bench上，目标作为噪声的函数仅对少数方向敏感，因此无需逐步干预，只需作用于初始噪声即可更高效地引导样本。
AI.method: 用Recursive Feature Machine仅凭函数值一次性估计每个任务的少数敏感方向，并构建小型缓存服务于所有权衡；每个候选只需一次噪声位移和一次ODE求解。作者证明该位移在期望上提升学习到的标量化目标，且扫描权衡可恢复流的可达前沿（受代理与引导误差影响）。进一步引入数据自适应与帕累托感知的引导算子。
AI.result: 在Off-MOO-Bench的47个任务上，方法在生成类方法中取得最佳平均超体积排名，采样成本相当或更低；仅靠引导（steering alone）即可以远低于最优先前生成方法的采样成本超越其表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过在初始噪声层面进行方向性位移而非逐步干预采样，可显著降低离线多目标优化的采样成本并提升性能，验证了噪声敏感方向引导的有效性与理论保证。

title: On the Complexity of Preference-Based Bandits
summary: We study preference-based bandits with general reward function classes, where a learner sequentially selects pairs of arms and observes binary preference feedback governed by the Bradley--Terry model. This setting naturally arises in applications such as recommender systems, tournament ranking, and learning from human feedback, where relative preferences are easier to elicit than absolute rewards. The observation model inherits the logistic bandit challenge of handling the problem-dependent constant $κ$, which accounts for the non-linearity of the link function and can grow arbitrarily large. Moreover, prior work has predominantly focused on linear or kernelized reward models, precluding the use of richer function classes. To address these limitations, we consider general reward function classes and introduce the \emph{locally sensitive eluder dimension}, a novel complexity measure tailored to the logistic structure of preference feedback that yields fine-grained regret guarantees without unfavorable dependence on $κ$. Building on this notion, we propose \textbf{GINOP} (Generic INformative OPtimism), an algorithm that constructs log-loss confidence sets and jointly selects arm pairs to balance optimism and informative exploration. We establish a first-order regret bound that, in contrast with what previous results suggest, demonstrates that learning with preference feedback is as statistically efficient as learning from direct reward observation. Finally, we corroborate our theoretical findings with empirical evaluations against competitive baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一般奖励函数类下的偏好型老虎机问题，提出"局部敏感逃逸维数"复杂度和GINOP算法，实现不依赖κ的细粒度一阶遗憾界。
AI.motivation: 偏好反馈（如推荐、排序、人类反馈）中相对偏好比绝对奖励更易获取，但现有工作多局限于线性或核化奖励模型，且面临logistic老虎机中问题相关常数κ随非线性任意增长带来的困难，缺乏对更丰富函数类的支持。
AI.method: 在Bradley-Terry模型下研究一般奖励函数类的偏好型老虎机，引入针对偏好反馈logistic结构设计的"局部敏感逃逸维数"复杂度量；基于该度量提出GINOP算法，构造对数损失置信集并联合选择臂对，以平衡乐观与信息性探索。
AI.result: 建立了不依赖于κ的一阶遗憾界，表明在偏好反馈下学习与直接奖励观测具有同等的统计效率；并通过与竞争性基线的实验对比验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将偏好型老虎机的理论保证推广到一般奖励函数类，并证明偏好反馈学习在统计效率上可与直接奖励观测相媲美。

title: World-as-Graph: Relational World Modeling Through Latent Space Graphs
summary: World models aim to learn representations of real-world environments and predict their future evolution. Recent object-centric world models have made expressive progress by representing visual scenes as sets of object-level latent states, but object-object relations are often captured only implicitly, which limits explicit relational and temporal structure modeling and object-centric dynamic memory modeling. To address such challenges, we propose World-As-Graph (WAG), a graph-based object-centric world model that introduces relational inductive bias into JEPA-style predictive representation learning. The proposed WAG contains two main modules: (1) Relation-aware structure induction, which constructs time-varying latent graphs from object-centric slots and designs relation-aware object masking policies to guide relational object representation learning in latent space; (2) Object-centric memory transition, which maintains and updates object-level dynamic states by combining relational information from neighboring objects with historical memory, enabling effective autoregressive future prediction. Extensive experiments on both visual reasoning and robotic manipulation tasks could demonstrate the superior performance of our proposed WAG.

AI.tldr: 提出World-As-Graph (WAG)，一种将关系归纳偏置引入JEPA式预测表征学习的图基对象中心世界模型，通过关系感知结构归纳与对象中心记忆转移两模块建模对象间显式关系与动态记忆，在视觉推理与机器人操作任务上表现优越。
AI.motivation: 现有对象中心世界模型将视觉场景表示为对象级隐状态集合，但对象间关系多为隐式捕获，限制了显式的关系与时间结构建模，以及对象中心的动态记忆建模。
AI.method: WAG包含两个模块：(1) 关系感知结构归纳：从对象中心slot构建时变隐图，并设计关系感知的对象掩码策略，在隐空间引导关系对象表征学习；(2) 对象中心记忆转移：结合邻居对象的关系信息与历史记忆，维护并更新对象级动态状态，实现有效的自回归未来预测。
AI.result: 在视觉推理和机器人操作任务上的大量实验表明，WAG具有优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 将图结构的关系归纳偏置显式融入JEPA式对象中心预测学习，可有效提升关系与时间结构及对象动态记忆的建模能力，验证了该范式的有效性。

title: Autoresearch in Mixed-Integer Linear and Nonlinear Programming
summary: Despite recent progress in autoresearch, applying it to practical operations research problems, typically formulated as NP-hard mixed-integer linear or nonlinear programs (MILPs or MINLPs), remains challenging because effective research requires systematically managing competing ideas and long-horizon experimental trajectories. We introduce AutoMIP, a reusable agent skill for organizing long-horizon autoresearch in mixed-integer programming through idea pooling and algorithm tree search. AutoMIP maintains a persistent pool of complementary candidate ideas while organizing executable experiments into an algorithm tree, enabling the agent to preserve unexplored hypotheses, refine promising algorithms, and switch to alternative methodological directions based on historical states. On MILP and MINLP benchmark cohorts, AutoMIP achieves the highest final success rates among the evaluated autoresearch frameworks. On MIPLib, AutoMIP discovers new best solutions for 31 of 60 instances, surpassing existing autoresearch frameworks. On MINLPLib, it achieves new best solutions for 52 of 60 instances. Ablation studies further demonstrate the complementary contributions of idea pooling and algorithm tree search, highlighting the importance of jointly maintaining diverse research ideas and structured experimental trajectories for long-horizon autoresearch.

AI.tldr: AutoMIP 是一个面向混合整数规划的自主研究 agent 技能，通过思想池与算法树搜索组织长时程实验，在 MILP/MINLP 基准上取得最高成功率并在 MIPLib/MINLPLib 上刷新大量最优解。
AI.motivation: 将自主研究应用于实际的运筹优化问题仍具挑战，因为这类问题通常建模为 NP-hard 的混合整数线性/非线性规划，有效的科研过程需要系统性地管理相互竞争的研究思路与长时程实验轨迹。
AI.method: 提出 AutoMIP，一种可复用的 agent 技能：维护一个持久的互补候选思想池，并将可执行实验组织为算法树，使 agent 能够保存未探索的假设、精炼有潜力的算法，并依据历史状态切换到替代方法方向。
AI.result: 在 MILP 与 MINLP 基准群上，AutoMIP 在评估的自主研究框架中取得最高最终成功率；在 MIPLib 上为 60 个实例中的 31 个发现新最优解，在 MINLPLib 上为 60 个实例中的 52 个取得新最优解。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验验证了思想池与算法树搜索的互补贡献，表明在长时程自主研究中，同时维护多样研究思路与结构化实验轨迹至关重要。

title: Adaptive Self-Consistency: From Black-Box Sampling to Distribution-Valued Feedback
comment: 27 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Self-consistency samples many reasoning trajectories and aggregates their final answers, treating the LLM as a black box that returns one answer per trajectory. Yet the final answer of each trajectory is sampled from a softmax vector that is available from the model's log-probabilities. We refer to this as the grey-box setting in which each trajectory reveals this answer distribution rather than a single draw from it. We formulate efficient inference in this setting as sequential mode identification with distribution-valued observations: sample trajectories one at a time and stop as soon as the LLM's modal answer is identified at a prescribed confidence level. We characterize the asymptotic stopping rate of mode identification with distribution-valued observations exactly and show that it is never worse than the black-box rate. We then propose the ASC-D algorithm, a betting stopping rule that attains this asymptotic stopping rate. On MMLU-Redux, ASC-D uses $46.4$--$95.6\%$ fewer trajectories than answer-only adaptive self-consistency baselines and achieves the highest fixed-budget correct-certification rate across three open-source models.

AI.tldr: 将自洽推理视为"灰箱"设定：每条推理轨迹可暴露最终答案分布而非单一采样，并据此提出序贯众数识别问题与停时算法ASC-D。
AI.motivation: 现有自洽方法把大模型当作黑箱，每条轨迹只返回一个最终答案，忽略了模型对数概率中本就蕴含的答案分布信息，导致推理开销较大、需要大量轨迹才能确定答案。
AI.method: 定义灰箱设定：每条轨迹揭示软max答案分布而非单次抽样。将高效推理形式化为带分布值观测的序贯众数识别，逐条采样轨迹，一旦以给定置信度识别出模型众数答案即停止。理论刻画该问题的渐近停时速率，并据此提出基于赌博（betting）停时规则的ASC-D算法。
AI.result: 证明分布值观测下的渐近停时速率不劣于黑箱情形；ASC-D达到该渐近停时速率。在MMLU-Redux上，相比仅用答案的自适应自洽基线减少46.4%–95.6%的轨迹数，并在三个开源模型上取得最高的固定预算正确认证率。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型对数概率中的答案分布信息可在不损失置信水平的前提下显著降低推理成本，序贯众数识别为自适应自洽提供了更高效的推理框架。

title: EHR-RobustGym: Benchmarking and Training Agents for Robust Clinical Reasoning
summary: In hospital workflows, electronic health records (EHRs) are often noisy, and may not contain the evidence needed to confirm events or measurements referenced in a clinical query. Even when database retrieval succeeds, clinical agents can overlook such discrepancies and return plausible but unsupported answers. We introduce EHR-RobustGym, a scalable and interactive environment for evaluating and training robust clinical agents grounded in noisy EHRs. Built on MIMIC-IV hospital records (365K patients, 31 tables, and over 500M records), EHR-RobustGym comprises 5,486 Clean-Noise pairs spanning six clinical intents and both patient-level and population-level queries. The pairs test robustness to Record-level, Value-level, and Query-level noise, while interactive SQL/Python execution and outcome verification support trajectory collection and training. Evaluating multiple LLMs reveals substantial robustness gaps: average task success across proprietary and large-scale open-weight models drops from 62.2% on Clean questions to 37.9% on Noise questions. At k=4, pass^k consistency falls below 50% for most evaluated models, exposing instability in clinical task completion. Supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning in EHR-RobustGym improve performance, with gains generalizing to five external EHR benchmarks. Together, these results position EHR-RobustGym as a testbed for evaluating and improving the evidence-grounded robustness of clinical agents.

AI.tldr: 提出EHR-RobustGym，一个基于MIMIC-IV构建的可扩展交互式环境，用于评估和训练在含噪电子健康记录(EHR)中具备鲁棒性的临床智能体，并揭示现有LLM的显著鲁棒性缺口。
AI.motivation: 医院工作流中的EHR常含噪声，可能缺失支撑临床查询所需事件的证据；即使数据库检索成功，临床智能体也可能忽略这些不一致并给出看似合理却无证据支撑的答案。现有评测缺乏针对含噪EHR的鲁棒性基准与训练环境。
AI.method: 基于MIMIC-IV医院记录（36.5万患者、31张表、超5亿条记录）构建EHR-RobustGym，包含5,486组Clean-Noise配对，覆盖六种临床意图及患者级与群体级查询，针对记录级、值级、查询级三类噪声；支持交互式SQL/Python执行与结果验证，用于轨迹采集与训练。
AI.result: 评测多个LLM显示显著鲁棒性缺口：专有与大规模开放权重模型的平均任务成功率由Clean问题的62.2%降至Noise问题的37.9%；k=4时多数模型pass^k一致性低于50%，暴露临床任务完成的不稳定性。在EHR-RobustGym中进行监督微调与强化学习可提升性能，且增益可泛化至五个外部EHR基准。
AI.conclusion: EHR-RobustGym可作为评估与提升临床智能体证据接地鲁棒性的测试平台。

title: EFormer: Temporally Aligned Local Correction for Continuous sEMG-Based Hand Pose Tracking
summary:
Surface electromyography (sEMG) provides a wearable, camera-free signal for continuous hand-motion inference. Mapping muscle activity to joint kinematics remains challenging because the recorded waveforms are indirect measurements, their relationship with motion changes over time, and individual anatomy and sensor placement alter the signal distribution. This paper presents EFormer, a residual feature-correction network built on a frozen tracking backbone. EFormer combines a high-rate event branch, temporally aligned local cross-attention, two causal rotary position embedding (RoPE) temporal layers, and a bounded, dynamically gated residual.
  EFormer receives 16-channel sEMG sampled at 2 kHz and fuses a 64-channel tracking representation at 25 Hz with a 128-channel event representation at 200 Hz. Cross-attention uses a nominal delay of 100 ms, a 300 ms history parameter, and a 50 ms tolerance; its causal mask restricts each query to events occurring 50-400 ms earlier. The correction scale is 0.15. The evaluated continuation-training configuration contains 585,376 trainable parameters and 5,974,508 frozen parameters.
  On the test set, EFormer achieves an MAE of 0.1546634 rad, an RMSE of 0.24063 rad, and an R^2 of 0.74801, compared with 0.1745326 rad, 0.2715448 rad, and 0.6791103 for the official tracking baseline. EFormer reduces MAE by 11.38% relative to the baseline. The results show that temporally aligned event-feature correction can reduce continuous hand-pose tracking error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EFormer——一种建立在冻结跟踪主干网络之上的残差特征校正网络，通过高频事件分支、时间对齐局部交叉注意力、因果RoPE时序层与有界动态门控残差，将sEMG信号映射到连续手部运动学，在测试集上显著优于官方跟踪基线。
AI.motivation: 表面肌电（sEMG）可提供可穿戴、无需摄像头的连续手部动作推断信号，但将肌肉活动映射到关节运动学存在三大挑战：波形是间接测量、其与运动的关系随时间变化、个体解剖结构与传感器位置差异会改变信号分布。
AI.method: EFormer在冻结的跟踪主干上构建残差特征校正。输入为2 kHz采样的16通道sEMG；融合25 Hz的64通道跟踪表示与200 Hz的128通道事件表示。采用高频事件分支、时间对齐的局部交叉注意力（名义延迟100 ms、历史参数300 ms、容差50 ms，因果掩码将每个query限制在50–400 ms更早的事件上）、两层因果RoPE时序层，以及有界动态门控残差。校正尺度为0.15；训练配置含585,376个可训练参数与5,974,508个冻结参数。
AI.result: 测试集上EFormer达到MAE 0.1546634 rad、RMSE 0.24063 rad、R² 0.74801；官方跟踪基线为MAE 0.1745326 rad、RMSE 0.2715448 rad、R² 0.6791103。相对基线MAE降低11.38%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，时间对齐的事件特征校正能够有效降低连续手部姿态跟踪误差，验证了冻结主干加轻量残差校正范式的可行性。

title: SkillFM: Generating Skills for LLM Agents via Latent Flow Matching
summary: Textual skills provide reusable guidance for large language model agents, but existing approaches often rely on manually curated skill banks or reinforcement learning with indirect and delayed feedback. We introduce SkillFM (Skill Flow Matching), a generative framework that synthesizes task-conditioned textual skills directly without test-time skill retrieval.
