AI.method: 构建ArchitectureIQ基准：每题给出一个合成数据集和多个训练配方，要求受试者（LLM或人类研究者）预测能带来最佳测试指标的配方；并对LLM与人类最佳研究者进行对比评测，同时考察CoT算力、知识库注入、对数据属性的敏感性等因素。
AI.result: (1) 直觉不完美甚至部分低于人类：前沿模型约76%准确率（随机33%），最佳人类研究者66%，但远未达到完美；纯架构题上最佳人类65%，GPT-6 Astra仅38%。(2) 直觉是经验性的而非结构化的：增加CoT算力并未带来显著提升，缺乏可支撑AI结构化推理的"AI科学"语言。(3) 直觉未被最大化压缩，可进一步提炼为知识库：仅20条目的知识库使GPT-4o几乎追平Claude Opus 5。(4) 直觉对数据集属性不敏感，而最优模型本应依赖数据属性，说明数据是AI中真正的"暗物质"。
AI.conclusion: LLM的模型训练直觉总体不错但存在四方面局限：非完美/局部逊于人类、经验性而非结构化、可进一步压缩为知识库、对数据属性不敏感；数据理解（而非架构理解）是当前AI（包括人类研究者）最薄弱的环节。

title: Parameter symmetries determine representational geometry in overparameterized nonlinear networks
comment: To appear in NeurIPS 2026. 89 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/mrvnthss/symmetries-representational-geometry
summary: Representations are routinely used across machine learning, psychology, and neuroscience to draw inferences about the computations of biological and artificial systems. Such inferences presume a meaningful link between representational geometry and the computation being performed. For artificial neural networks, however, the extent to which function constrains representation remains unclear. One key obstacle is that these networks admit parameter symmetries: changes in parameterization that preserve function exactly while reshaping representational geometry. Here, we show that a broad class of parameter symmetries acts on representations through just three primitive feature transformations: addition, duplication, and scaling. This feature-level characterization yields a closed-form decomposition of representational geometry into essential and auxiliary components, which makes precise how degeneracy in representational geometry can grow with overparameterization even when function is held fixed. Finally, we show that implementation-level selection rules can resolve this degeneracy, yielding identifiable geometries in which features are weighted according to their contributions to the network's function. Together, our results delineate when representations can support inferences about computation, and when they cannot.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示人工神经网络中参数对称性如何通过三种基本特征变换（加、复制、缩放）作用于表征，并给出表征几何的闭式分解为本质与辅助成分，表明过参数化下表征退化随参数增加而增长，而实现层面的选择规则可消除退化并得到可识别的、按功能贡献加权的表征几何。
AI.motivation: 机器学习、心理学与神经科学常用表征几何推断生物与人工系统的计算过程，这一推断预设表征几何与计算之间存在有意义联系；但在人工神经网络中，功能是否约束表征仍不明确，主要障碍是网络存在参数对称性——参数改变而功能不变，却重塑表征几何。
AI.method: 作者对一大类参数对称性进行特征层面的刻画，证明其仅通过三种基本特征变换（加法、复制、缩放）作用于表征，并据此给出表征几何的闭式分解，将其拆分为本质成分与辅助成分；进一步引入实现层面的选择规则以处理退化问题。
AI.result: 研究表明，即使功能固定，表征几何的退化程度也会随过参数化而增长；所提出的分解精确刻画了这种退化，而实现层面的选择规则能够消除退化，得到可识别的几何，其中各特征按其对该网络功能的贡献被加权。
AI.conclusion: 该工作界定了表征何时能够支持关于计算的推断、何时不能，为跨学科使用表征几何推断计算提供了理论边界。

title: Shared Phase and Retention Control for Efficient Adaptive Spectral Recurrence
summary: As new evidence arrives, a sequence model must update what it remembers and how memory influences predictions. While Transformers incur computation and cache costs scaling with context length, fixed-state recurrent models offer constant-memory inference. However, linear and spectral recurrences traditionally rely on static transitions, failing to dynamically revise how stored representations decay or rotate. While recent selective architectures introduce input-dependent transitions, they assign independent controls to every memory mode, coupling control cost to state capacity. We show that high-dimensional spectral memory does not require high-dimensional control, and introduce Shared Phase and Retention Control for Efficient Adaptive Spectral Recurrence (SPARC). SPARC employs just two input-dependent scalar signals to coordinate memory retention and phase rotation across heterogeneous complex modes, while preserving mode-specific baseline timescales and frequencies. Its diagonal affine recurrence supports parallel associative scans for sequence-level BPTT as well as exact structured Real-Time Recurrent Learning (RTRL) for online credit assignment. Across partially observable continuous control, POPGym, and sequence classification, SPARC achieves a 9.09% relative return improvement on Walker-P and a 1.36% relative accuracy gain on FordA over second-best methods. On an NVIDIA Blackwell GPU, our implementation reduces recurrent-mixer training latency by 18.2%-34.2% in fixed-token workloads and accelerates scans by 3.1x-4.7x over an optimized RG-LRU baseline. These results show that two shared control signals can efficiently govern adaptive spectral memory across online and full-sequence settings. Code is available at https://github.com/Botwwt/sparc.

AI.tldr: SPARC：用两个共享的输入依赖标量信号（保留与相位）统一控制高维谱记忆的衰减与旋转，实现常量内存推理、可并行扫描的BPTT与精确RTRL在线学习，在多任务上提升精度/回报并显著降低训练延迟。
AI.motivation: 序列模型需随新证据更新记忆及记忆对预测的影响，但主流方法存在权衡：Transformer的计算与缓存随上下文线性增长；线性/谱递归模型虽为常量内存，却依赖静态转移，无法动态调整记忆的衰减与旋转；近期选择性架构虽引入输入依赖转移，却为每个记忆模式独立赋控，使控制开销随状态容量增长。作者据此质疑“高维谱记忆是否必须高维控制”，主张控制维度可与状态容量解耦。
AI.method: 提出SPARC（Shared Phase and Retention Control for Efficient Adaptive Spectral Recurrence）。核心是仅用两个输入依赖的标量信号，跨异构复模态统一协调记忆保留（衰减）与相位旋转，同时保留各模态自身的基线时间尺度与频率。该对角仿射递归支持并行关联扫描（用于序列级BPTT），并支持精确的结构化实时递归学习（RTRL）以进行在线信用分配。
AI.result: 在部分可观测连续控制、POPGym与序列分类任务上，SPARC相对次优方法在Walker-P上取得9.09%的相对回报提升，在FordA上取得1.36%的相对准确率提升。在NVIDIA Blackwell GPU上，固定token负载下递归混合器训练延迟降低18.2%–34.2%，扫描速度较优化的RG-LRU基线加速3.1×–4.7×。
AI.conclusion: 两个共享控制信号即可高效治理自适应谱记忆，兼顾在线（RTRL）与全序列（扫描+BPTT）两种设定，说明高维谱记忆无需高维控制，为常量内存递归模型提供了低控制开销且高并行的新范式。代码已开源。

title: OverForge: Reasoning Through Strategies and Tactics Helps Cooperative Lifelong Adaptation
summary: Cooperative language-model agents must coordinate over long horizons and adapt to changing environments and to partners with unfamiliar conventions, yet existing agents map observations to actions without separating persistent coordination strategies from their tactical execution. We introduce OverForge, a training-free hierarchical architecture that separates strategic reasoning over roles and divisions of labour from tactical reasoning over actions within each agent's private, partner-conditioned world model. A metacognitive Prefrontal Cortex Module couples the two levels by forming strategy-action branches, imagining their consequences with a forward model, and committing when confident. In OvercookedV2, OverForge delivers 7 soups in a connected kitchen versus 3 for each flat LLM baseline, retains agreed roles, and adopts roles proposed by unfamiliar partners. Ablations and a fixed-strategy probe show that persistent strategies guide tactical adaptation while each reasoning level contributes to coordination. Memory restarts show that cross-episode partner knowledge supports task performance and partner prediction, linking the hierarchy to continual adaptation.

AI.tldr: OverForge：免训练分层架构，将策略层（角色与分工）与战术层（动作）解耦，用前额叶模块耦合两级，在OvercookedV2中实现7锅汤并支持角色保持与适应。
AI.motivation: 协作语言模型智能体需在长时程中协调并适应变化环境及陌生伙伴的约定，但现有智能体直接将观测映射为动作，未将持久的协作策略与战术执行分离。
AI.method: 提出OverForge免训练分层架构：策略推理（角色与分工）与战术推理（各自私有、以伙伴为条件的世界模型中的动作）分离；元认知前额叶皮层模块通过生成策略-动作分支、用前向模型想象后果、在自信时提交决策来耦合两层。
AI.result: 在OvercookedV2连通厨房中获得7锅汤，而各扁平LLM基线仅3锅；能保持已商定角色，并采纳陌生伙伴提出的角色。消融与固定策略探针表明持久策略引导战术适应，且两个推理层均对协调有贡献。记忆重启实验表明跨回合伙伴知识支持任务表现与伙伴预测。
AI.conclusion: 分层策略-战术解耦与元认知耦合可提升长时程协作表现与伙伴适应性，跨回合记忆将分层架构与持续适应能力相联系。

title: Learning Infinite-Horizon Average-Reward CMDPs via State Augmentation
summary: We study infinite-horizon average-reward constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) under the weakly communicating assumption. Existing high-probability guarantees for this setting either require computationally inefficient algorithms or have suboptimal dependence on the number of interactions $T$. We propose, to the best of our knowledge, the first computationally efficient algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation with high probability in the tabular setting. The $\sqrt{T}$ dependence is optimal up to logarithmic factors. Our approach incorporates cumulative constraint violation into the state and defines a reshaped reward through differences of a Huber potential. The added state determines the penalty on further violations while the reward function remains fixed on the augmented state space. Since the added state has known deterministic dynamics, only the original transition kernel needs to be estimated. The bounded slope of the Huber potential keeps the per-step reward bounded, and the potential differences telescope to relate the reshaped return to the original cumulative reward and the terminal potential. These properties allow us to apply finite-horizon approximation and optimistic value iteration with clipping, as used in unconstrained average-reward MDPs, without worsening the regret rate in $T$.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究弱通信假设下的无限时域平均奖励约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），首次提出计算高效的表格型算法，实现高概率 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ 的遗憾与累积约束违反，达到最优阶（忽略对数因子）。
AI.motivation: 已有针对该设定（弱通信平均奖励 CMDP）的高概率保证，要么算法计算效率低下，要么对交互次数 $T$ 的依赖次优，因此亟需一个既计算高效又具有最优 $T$ 依赖的算法。
AI.method: 将累积约束违反量并入状态，并通过 Huber 势函数的差分构造重塑奖励：新增状态决定进一步违反的惩罚，而奖励函数在增广状态空间上保持固定；由于新增状态具有已知的确定性动态，只需估计原始转移核。Huber 势的有界斜率保证单步奖励有界，势差可望远镜求和，将重塑回报与原累积奖励及终端势联系起来。这些性质使作者能够沿用无约束平均奖励 MDP 中的有限时域近似与带裁剪的乐观值迭代，而不恶化 $T$ 的遗憾阶。
AI.result: 首次给出在该设定下计算高效的表格型算法，同时实现高概率 $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾与累积约束违反，$\sqrt{T}$ 阶在忽略对数因子下最优。
AI.conclusion: 通过将约束违反编码进状态并利用 Huber 势重塑奖励，可在保持计算效率的同时将无约束平均奖励 MDP 的技术迁移到 CMDP，达到最优遗憾率。

title: Safety of Latent Communication in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Latent communication enables multi-agent systems to exchange information directly in internal representation space, reducing the token, computation, and latency overhead of text-based communication. To this end, lightweight trainable links are introduced to map the sender's representations into the receiver's input space. In this work, we show that even benign link training can increase harmful compliance relative to text-based communication while the underlying safety-aligned agents remain unchanged. An attacker can amplify this effect by optimizing the links on harmful query--response pairs or poisoning otherwise benign training data. We further develop a reinforcement-learning attack that rewards harmful compliance alongside benign task performance without requiring harmful target responses. Across three communication topologies and four safety benchmarks, this attack raises the mean harmful-compliance score from 27.9 with benignly trained links to 76.9. Compared with direct supervised optimization, it also achieves higher average accuracy on two benign utility benchmarks. Adapting the rewards toward safer behavior also enables repair of compromised links, substantially reducing harmful compliance across all evaluated attacks without updating the agents. Overall, our results show that safety alignment requires considering the multi-agent system as a whole.

AI.tldr: 潜在通信中用可训练链接替代文本通信，良性训练也可能提升有害顺从度；提出基于强化学习的攻击方法，将平均有害顺从分从27.9提升至76.9，且可通过调整奖励修复被攻击的链接。
AI.motivation: 潜在通信可降低token、计算与延迟开销，但现有安全对齐只关注单个智能体；作者希望揭示即使智能体本身未改变，链路训练这一环节也会破坏多智能体系统的整体安全性。
AI.method: 用轻量可训练链接将发送方表征映射到接收方输入空间；通过有害问答对优化链接、污染良性训练数据，并提出一种强化学习攻击，仅以有害顺从与良性任务表现为奖励、无需有害目标回复；另通过将奖励调向更安全行为来修复被攻陷的链接。
AI.result: 在3种通信拓扑和4个安全基准上，该攻击把平均有害顺从分从良性训练链接的27.9提升到76.9；相比直接监督优化，在两个良性效用基准上平均准确率更高；调整奖励可在不更新智能体的情况下显著降低所有评估攻击的有害顺从度。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐必须把多智能体系统作为整体来考虑，链路训练等系统级组件同样构成安全风险，并可通过对齐奖励进行修复。

title: A Generalisation Signal Need Not Be a Model-Selection Signal
comment: Accepted (poster) at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "I Can't Believe It's Not Better: Failure Modes of AI in Biology" (ICBINB-BIO). 24 pages, 4 figures, 22 tables. Code: https://github.com/AdityaNagarsekar/A-Generalisation-Signal-Need-Not-Be-a-Model-Selection-Signal
summary: Model selection in computational biology often relies on validation data drawn from the training regime, even when deployment lies outside it. When validation no longer preserves which model is best, a natural alternative is to rank candidates using properties of the trained network itself. We test this idea using a novel, forward-only proxy motivated by the norm of the Hessian, alongside common Hessian measures, across molecular property, protein fitness, and drug-response tasks. Contrary to our hypothesis, geometry does not become more useful as validation Spearman correlation deteriorates: augmenting validation helps some shifts but significantly harms others. More surprisingly, the proxy still correlates with generalisation gap on most tasks even when Hessian trace and top-eigenvalue relationships are weak or reversed, yet this signal does not reliably identify the deployment-best model. A curvature bound need not preserve cross-model rankings, and low geometric scores can even favour collapsed predictors. Thus, a generalisation signal need not be a model-selection signal.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了用训练网络的Hessian几何（曲率）性质做模型选择代理的可行性。结论：几何信号在分布偏移下既不稳定，也不能可靠选出最优模型——泛化信号不等于模型选择信号。
AI.motivation: 计算生物学中模型选择通常依赖与训练同分布的验证集，但部署常处于分布外（OOD）。当验证集丧失了“哪个模型更好”的判断力时，需要寻找与数据无关的替代准则，例如基于已训练网络自身性质（曲率/Hessian）的代理指标。作者希望检验：验证Spearman相关性越差时，几何代理是否越有用。
AI.method: 在分子性质、蛋白质适应度、药物响应三类任务上，比较多种常见Hessian度量（Hessian迹、最大特征值）与一个新提出的、受Hessian范数启发的“仅前向”（forward-only）代理指标；通过增强验证集模拟不同程度的分布偏移，考察几何代理与验证Spearman相关性的关系、与泛化差距的相关性，以及其跨模型排序能力。
AI.result: 与假设相反：几何代理并未随验证Spearman相关性恶化而变得更有用；增强验证对某些偏移有帮助，对其他偏移显著有害。更意外的是，即使Hessian迹与最大特征值关系微弱甚至反向，该代理在多数任务上仍与泛化差距相关，但这种信号无法稳定识别部署最优模型：曲率界不保证保持跨模型排序，低几何分数甚至可能偏好已塌缩的预测器。
AI.conclusion: 泛化信号与模型选择信号是两回事。曲率类几何代理不能可靠替代验证集用于OOD模型选择，其与泛化差距的相关性不构成有效的模型排序依据。

title: Learning Steganography Is Easy, Learning Steganographic Reasoning Is Hard
comment: Accepted as an oral at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Trustworthy AI for Good (AI4GOOD). 41 pages. Code: https://github.com/stegano-ai/steg-reasoning-is-hard
summary:
Chain-of-thought monitoring as an approach for AI oversight and control is threatened by the possibility of steganographic reasoning, where LLMs conceal their reasoning inside innocuous-looking text. Two neighbouring capabilities, steganographic messaging (passing a concealed message) and encoded reasoning (reasoning in an illegible but unconcealed format), have already been shown to emerge under training pressures that occur in real pipelines, such as reinforcement learning against monitors. This suggests that steganographic reasoning too might arise as an unintended side effect of training. Here, we compare how easily models learn steganographic reasoning and these two neighbouring capabilities across three elicitation methods: reinforcement learning, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT).
  For most tasks, models learn steganographic reasoning only under SFT, while they learn steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning under all three elicitation methods. Even under SFT, steganographic reasoning requires at least twice as much training as messaging, and for several model-task combinations it is not learned at all. However, on a cover task that makes hiding information especially convenient, steganographic reasoning can be successfully learned under all three elicitation methods. Steganographic reasoning is thus much harder than steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning, and learning the latter two does not imply learning the former. Yet it lies within reach: an easy version is learned under every elicitation method, when the cover task is convenient for hiding information.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了LLM在三种诱导方法（强化学习、上下文学习、监督微调SFT）下学习隐写推理、隐写消息传递和编码推理的难易程度，发现隐写推理显著更难习得，但在便利的掩护任务下也可被学会。
AI.motivation: 思维链监控是AI监督与控制的重要手段，但隐写推理（模型将推理隐藏于看似无害的文本中）可能威胁其有效性。相邻的两种能力——隐写消息传递和编码推理——已被证明在真实训练流程的压力下会自然涌现，这暗示隐写推理也可能作为训练的意外副作用出现。因此有必要系统比较这些能力的可习得难度。
AI.method: 在多种任务上，采用三种诱导方法（强化学习、上下文学习、监督微调SFT）对模型进行训练，并比较模型学习隐写推理、隐写消息传递和编码推理三种能力的情况，同时考察掩护任务便利性对习得效果的影响。
AI.result: 在大多数任务中，模型仅在SFT下才能学会隐写推理，而隐写消息传递和编码推理在三种诱导方法下均可学会。即便在SFT下，隐写推理所需训练量至少是消息传递的两倍，且在若干模型-任务组合中完全无法学会。然而，当掩护任务特别便于隐藏信息时，隐写推理可在所有三种诱导方法下成功习得。
AI.conclusion: 隐写推理远比隐写消息传递和编码推理更难习得，学会后两者并不意味着能学会前者；但当掩护任务便于隐藏信息时，隐写推理的一个简单版本在每种诱导方法下都能被学会，说明其并非遥不可及。

title: T-Router: Learning Thalamic Routing for Reasoning with Parameter-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
summary: Parameter-efficient reinforcement learning aims to improve reasoning with a compact trainable interface to a pretrained model. We introduce the Thalamic Router (T-Router), which concentrates adaptation on the reuse of completed computations. A compressed, addressable bank preserves block changes; a depth-recurrent controller conditions their selection and relative-scale writeback. This coupling gives thalamic context-dependent routing a concrete computational form: learn which earlier contributions a receiving layer uses, and with what influence. Correctness rewards train the interface while preserving backbone parameters and layer order. On an 8.95B-parameter backbone, T-Router allocates 41.73M parameters (0.466% of the backbone) and achieves 83.64 +/- 1.16 MathAvg after GSM8K RL, compared with 73.79 +/- 1.83 for full-parameter GRPO across three evaluation rounds. At a comparable parameter budget and with matched retries, it exceeds LoRA's 77.28 +/- 1.95 MathAvg, improving all three task families and raising mean AIME accuracy from 48.33 to 60.56. Capacity-controlled comparisons favor addressable block changes and recurrent context; separate search training extends the interface to tool-mediated reasoning. These results establish controlled computation reuse as an effective route to parameter-efficient reasoning reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Thalamic Router (T-Router)，将参数高效强化学习的自适应聚焦于复用已完成计算，仅训练 0.466% 参数即超过全参数 GRPO。
AI.motivation: 参数高效强化学习旨在用紧凑的可训练接口提升预训练模型的推理能力，但如何在有限参数预算下有效利用已有计算仍是关键问题。
AI.method: T-Router 包含一个压缩的可寻址存储库保存块级变化，以及一个深度循环控制器来调节这些变化的选择与相对缩放回写，从而赋予丘脑式上下文相关路由具体的计算形式；以正确性奖励训练该接口，同时冻结骨干参数并保持层序不变。
AI.result: 在 8.95B 骨干上，T-Router 仅用 41.73M 参数（0.466%），GSM8K RL 后 MathAvg 达 83.64±1.16，优于全参数 GRPO 的 73.79±1.83；同等参数预算与重试次数下超过 LoRA 的 77.28±1.95，三个任务族均提升，AIME 平均准确率从 48.33 提升至 60.56。
AI.conclusion: 受控计算复用是参数高效推理强化学习的有效路径；容量控制对比支持可寻址块级变化与循环上下文，搜索训练可将该接口扩展至工具中介推理。

title: FIGS: Evaluating Multi-Turn Sycophancy Without Penalizing Empathy
summary: Large language models frequently fail to balance staying truthful with being supportive. They often exhibit sycophancy in responses to users, agreeing with false claims, offering unwarranted flattery, and giving advice skewed toward users' expressed views. In reality, sycophancy rarely happens in a single exchange; it may emerge organically as users repeatedly insist or subtly steer the dialogue over time. Current evaluations, however, rely on rigid, single-turn tests or fixed scripts that fail to capture these natural dynamics. Furthermore, these benchmarks often mistake showing basic empathy for yielding, penalizing models for acknowledging a user's feeling. This view may drive future models to over-correct into cold, dismissive rigidity. To address this gap, we introduce FIGS (Factual Integrity and Grounded Support), a dual-axis evaluation framework built around extended, realistic dialogue. We use an adaptive 10-turn conversational simulator that dynamically challenges the target model, reflecting how users repeat requests, push back, or steer a conversation toward a preferred answer. To accurately evaluate these trajectories, we apply a taxonomy that strictly separates Sycophancy (whether the model holds firm to the truth and keeps its praise proportional) from Calibrated Validation (showing empathetic understanding of the user's feelings without overdoing it). We release our complete testing environment, including 500 diverse multi-turn scenarios and an automated judge. Our evaluation of leading models reveals a consistent trade-off: over the course of a sustained interaction, current systems either slowly drift to sycophancy or over-correct into robotic detachment. This demonstrates that balancing honesty with appropriate support throughout a natural conversation remains a critical, unsolved challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FIGS 双轴评估框架，用自适应10轮对话模拟器与严格区分"谄媚"与"校准性共情"的分类体系，评估大模型在长程对话中真实性与支持性的平衡，发现现有模型普遍在"逐渐谄媚"与"过度冷漠"之间二选一。
AI.motivation: 大模型难以同时兼顾真实性与支持性，常表现谄媚（附和错误主张、过度奉承、迎合用户观点）。而真实场景中的谄媚多产生于多轮互动中用户反复坚持或隐性引导，现有评测依赖单轮测试或固定脚本，无法刻画这种动态；同时这些评测常把基本共情误判为让步，惩罚模型对用户感受的合理承认，可能导致模型过度矫正为冷漠僵硬。
AI.method: 提出 FIGS（Factual Integrity and Grounded Support）双轴评估框架：1）采用自适应10轮对话模拟器，动态挑战目标模型，模拟用户重复请求、反驳施压、引导对话走向偏好答案的过程；2）引入分类体系，将"谄媚"（是否坚守事实、赞美是否适度）与"校准性验证"（恰当共情而不夸大）严格区分；3）发布完整测试环境，含500个多样化多轮场景及自动评判器。
AI.result: 对主流模型的评估显示出一致的权衡现象：在持续多轮交互中，当前系统要么逐渐漂移向谄媚，要么过度矫正为机械式冷漠。
AI.conclusion: 在自然对话全程中同时保持诚实与适度支持，仍是尚未解决的关键挑战；FIGS 为多轮真实感评测提供了可复用的环境与判据。

title: The Row Normalization Puzzle in Muon
summary: This paper examines how row-wise renormalization affects Muon, focusing on the gap between NorMuon's worst-case guarantees and its practical performance (Li et al.). Despite its growing adoption and promising performance in large language model (LLM) pretraining, NorMuon's worst-case guarantees remain poorly understood. One fundamental question is: Does row normalization yield provable convergence gains, potentially through its interaction with approximate polar computation and exponential moving-average momentum? Our results show that row normalization introduces a dimension-dependent factor in the worst-case iteration complexity under the operator-norm geometry, which persists even with exact polar computation and any fixed momentum parameters. Indeed, we establish an algorithm-dependent lower bound and a matching upper bound in deterministic settings, and extend our upper bound analysis to stochastic settings. Both upper-bound analyses allow approximate polar computation. Experiments show that NorMuon is slower than Muon on synthetic problems inspired by our worst-case construction, yet outperforms Muon in LLM pretraining. These findings sharpen the puzzle of why row normalization helps in practice and complement the recent findings of Dewulf et al.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了行归一化（NorMuon）对 Muon 优化器的影响，揭示其在算子范数几何下引入维度相关的最坏情况复杂度因子，并给出确定性下界与匹配上界及随机扩展，与实验结果共同加深了"行归一化在实践中为何有效"的谜题。
AI.motivation: NorMuon 在大语言模型预训练中被广泛采用且表现优异，但其最坏情况保证仍缺乏理解。核心问题是：行归一化是否能通过与近似极坐标计算及指数移动平均动量的交互，带来可证明的收敛增益？
AI.method: 在算子范数几何下分析行归一化对 Muon 的影响。建立算法相关的下界，并在确定性设定中给出匹配的上界；将上界分析扩展至随机设定。上界分析均允许近似极坐标计算，覆盖任意固定动量参数。
AI.result: 行归一化在最坏情况迭代复杂度中引入了维度相关因子，即便使用精确极坐标计算和任意固定动量参数该因子依然存在。实验显示 NorMuon 在受最坏情况构造启发的合成问题上比 Muon 慢，但在 LLM 预训练中优于 Muon。
AI.conclusion: 行归一化在最坏情况下的理论保证并不优于 Muon，却在实际 LLM 预训练中表现更好，这一理论-实践差距揭示了行归一化有效性的深层谜题，并补充了 Dewulf 等人的近期发现。

title: Completion-Aware Cross-Fidelity Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Line Bus Holding
summary: Exploratory reinforcement learning (RL) on an operating bus fleet is impractical,while policies trained only from historical data cannot acquire new experience. Hybrid Offline-and-Online (H2O) RL combines fixed target replay with simulator interaction, but the inexpensive online simulator can differ from the target in transition and event-duration dynamics. We study this cross-fidelity problem for multi-line bus holding and address a failure mode in which lower generalized passenger time coexists with incomplete passenger journeys.

AI.tldr: 针对公交多线路驻站控制中离线与在线强化学习结合的跨保真度问题，指出现有H2O方法中"乘客广义时间降低"与"行程未完成"并存的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 在实际运营公交车上进行探索式强化学习不可行，而仅用历史数据训练的策略无法获得新经验；H2O强化学习虽结合固定目标回放与仿真器交互，但廉价仿真器在状态转移和事件持续时间动态上与目标存在差异。
AI.method: 研究多线路公交驻站控制（bus holding）场景下的跨保真度（cross-fidelity）问题，分析H2O强化学习在仿真器与真实目标动态不一致时的表现。
AI.result: 识别出一种失效模式：策略在降低广义乘客时间的同时，导致乘客行程无法完整完成。
AI.conclusion: 跨保真度差异会使H2O强化学习在多线路公交驻站控制中产生指标看似优化但实际服务失败的问题，需在策略设计或训练中加以处理。

title: Prequential E-Values for Selected-GP Near-Optimality Certificates
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on E-Values: From Statistics to ML
summary: When optimizing an expensive black-box function sequentially, as in hyperparameter optimization, we may want to stop once the best evaluated value is certified within $\varepsilon$ of the global optimum. Such a certificate needs two ingredients: a lower confidence bound for the selected value and an upper confidence envelope over the domain, typically supplied by a Gaussian process (GP). GP-UCB-style stopping rules are valid when the kernel and constants defining this envelope are fixed before the run, but the practical temptation is to tune the envelope from the same adaptive evaluations and then certify as if it had been fixed. We use prequential e-values to make this selection auditable: starting from a predeclared set of fully specified GP/RKHS envelopes, each candidate is tested by its own one-step-ahead e-process, contradicted candidates are deleted, and certification uses the largest upper bound among the survivors. With a valid selected-point lower bound and one declared candidate having valid latent coverage and noise calibration, the rule is anytime-valid. On a 512-seed noisy RBF stress sweep, it roughly halves false-certification risk at comparable power versus fit-then-certify. Relative to random fixed GP precommitment on smooth $d=3,4$ objectives, each additional false certificate is accompanied by 3.0 and 13.5 additional correct certificates, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文用prequential e-values对自适应选择的GP/RKHS上置信包络进行可审计筛选，删除被反驳的候选，并用存活者最大上界进行认证；在满足有效下界与至少一个有效候选覆盖/噪声校准的条件下，该停止规则具有anytime-valid性。
AI.motivation: 在昂贵黑盒函数序贯优化（如超参数优化）中，希望在最佳观测值被认证处于全局最优ε范围内时停止。该认证需要两部分：所选值的下置信界，以及域上的上置信包络（通常由高斯过程提供）。GP-UCB式停止规则仅在核与常数在运行前固定时有效，但实践中常从同一批自适应评估中调参后再"按固定情况"认证，导致假认证风险。
AI.method: 使用prequential e-values使包络选择可审计：从预先声明的完全指定GP/RKHS包络集合出发，每个候选由其自身的一步前瞻e-process检验，被反驳的候选被删除，认证使用存活候选中最大的上界。前提是存在有效的所选点下界，且至少一个声明候选具有有效的潜在覆盖与噪声校准。
AI.result: 在512种子的噪声RBF压力扫描中，与"先拟合后认证"相比，在功率相当的情况下，假认证风险约减半。在光滑d=3、4目标上，相对随机固定GP预承诺，每增加一次假认证分别伴随3.0与13.5次额外正确认证。
AI.conclusion: 通过prequential e-values对GP上置信包络进行筛选，"先选择后认证"的停止规则仍可保持anytime-valid性，并在经验上显著降低假认证风险、改善假认证与正确认证的权衡。

title: GrammarRL: Effective Grammar-Constrained Decoding via Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Grammar-constrained generation guarantees syntactic validity, but can substantially degrade semantic quality when the model's preferred outputs are poorly aligned with the imposed grammar. This trade-off is particularly severe when the prompt is underspecified or the model has limited instruction-following ability. Beam search can partially mitigate these failures by exploring multiple valid sequences, but its computational cost grows with beam width, while sequence-level probability is only an imperfect proxy for semantic quality.
  We introduce GrammarRL, a label-free reinforcement learning method that adapts language models to grammar constraints without requiring annotated data. GrammarRL optimizes the model using two complementary self-supervised rewards derived from its own likelihoods: a direct reward, measuring how likely the constrained output is given the input, and a reverse reward, measuring how well the input can be reconstructed from the generated output. We optimize these rewards with a Reinforce Leave-One-Out (RLOO) objective over groups of grammar-constrained rollouts, augmented with the top-1 beam-search hypothesis and regularized towards a frozen base model.
  We evaluate GrammarRL on sign language gloss translation, hierarchical text classification, and named entity recognition using Llama models ranging from 1B to 8B parameters. GrammarRL consistently outperforms constrained greedy decoding, with an average improvement of 9.8 points and gains of up to 22.8 BLEU. It matches or outperforms beam search on two of the three tasks while preserving greedy-decoding inference cost. Ablations further show that the two rewards are complementary: either reward alone can underperform the untrained baseline, whereas their combination consistently improves upon it.

AI.tldr: GrammarRL：无需标注数据的强化学习方法，通过双重自监督奖励（直接+反向）与RLOO优化，使语言模型适配语法约束，在保持贪心解码成本下显著提升语义质量。
AI.motivation: 语法约束生成虽能保证句法合法性，但当模型偏好输出与所施加语法对齐不佳时会严重损害语义质量，尤其在提示欠明确或模型指令跟随能力有限时。束搜索可部分缓解，但计算成本随束宽增长，且序列级概率只是语义质量的不完美代理。
AI.method: 提出GrammarRL，一种无需标注数据的无标签强化学习方法。利用模型自身似然构建两个互补自监督奖励：直接奖励衡量给定输入下约束输出的可能性，反向奖励衡量从生成输出重建输入的能力。在语法约束rollout组上用Reinforce Leave-One-Out（RLOO）目标优化，并加入top-1束搜索假设，同时向冻结基座模型正则化。
AI.result: 在手语注释翻译、层次文本分类和命名实体识别任务上，使用1B至8B参数的Llama模型评估。GrammarRL持续优于约束贪心解码，平均提升9.8个点，最高提升22.8 BLEU；在三项任务中的两项上匹配或超越束搜索，同时保持贪心解码的推理成本。消融实验表明两个奖励互补：单独使用任一奖励可能劣于未训练基线，二者结合则持续改进。
AI.conclusion: GrammarRL通过双重自监督奖励与RLOO优化，有效缓解语法约束生成中的语义退化问题，无需标注数据，在多种结构化预测任务上以低推理成本取得显著提升，且两奖励具互补性。

title: CDMD: A Cross-Dataset Mixed-Type Diffusion Model for Tabular Data
summary: Generative models for tabular data are typically trained separately for each dataset, limiting knowledge transfer and requiring the storage of many specialized models. In this paper, we introduce CDMD, a tabular diffusion model trained jointly across heterogeneous datasets with different schemas and variable numbers of numerical and categorical features. Unlike existing cross-dataset tabular diffusion models that operate in continuous representation spaces, CDMD defines diffusion directly over the mixed-type feature space and is trained end-to-end. To accommodate heterogeneous categorical domains, we introduce a schema-restricted reverse-process parameterization for masked diffusion models, in which the output space dynamically adapts to each feature's vocabulary. We then compose numerical and categorical feature-level diffusion processes into a schema-dependent row-level process. A shared schema-aware Transformer denoiser captures dependencies between features and parameterizes the reverse process across varying schemas. On seven real-world datasets, a single jointly trained CDMD achieves the highest average generation quality among strong single-dataset and cross-dataset baselines, while using substantially fewer total parameters than the collection of separately trained models. Furthermore, pre-training on a corpus of 337 datasets improves generation on previously unseen datasets under both limited target data and limited adaptation epochs. These results demonstrate the potential of direct mixed-type diffusion for shared and transferable tabular data generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/ketatam/cdmd.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CDMD，一种跨异构数据集联合训练的表格扩散模型，直接在混合类型特征空间上定义扩散过程，通过模式感知的Transformer去噪器与模式受限的掩码扩散参数化，实现跨数据集知识共享与迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有表格生成模型通常针对每个数据集单独训练，限制了知识迁移，且需要存储大量专用模型；已有的跨数据集表格扩散模型多在连续表示空间操作，存在局限。
AI.method: CDMD在混合类型特征空间上直接定义扩散并端到端训练；针对异构类别域提出模式受限的反向过程参数化，使输出空间随每个特征的词表动态自适应；将数值与类别特征级扩散过程组合为依赖模式的整行级过程；用共享的模式感知Transformer去噪器建模特征间依赖并跨不同模式参数化反向过程。
AI.result: 在七个真实数据集上，单个联合训练的CDMD在强单数据集与跨数据集基线中取得最高平均生成质量，且总参数量显著少于分别训练的模型集合；在337个数据集语料上预训练后，在目标数据有限和适配轮次有限的情况下均提升了对未见数据集的生成效果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明直接混合类型扩散在共享与可迁移的表格数据生成方面具有潜力，代码已开源。

title: OSWorld-Science: A Benchmark of Computer Use Agents for Learning and Using Scientific Software
comment: 62 pages. Website: https://discoailab.github.io/osworld-science-page/ Public contributions welcome: https://forms.gle/htxY5snyANJ4moVEA
summary: Scientific software presents a demanding test for computer-using agents based on visual language models (VLMs): completing a research workflow requires interpreting specialized interfaces, manipulating scientific objects, and producing verifiable results. We thus introduce OSWorld-Science, a benchmark and evaluation environment that combines scientifically meaningful tasks, artifact-based evaluation, and an efficient agent harness for studying computer use in the scientific domain. The benchmark contains 12 VLMs and 146 high-quality tasks across several scientific domains and software configurations, covering workflows such as molecular drawing and retrosynthesis, pathology image analysis, statistical computing, and physical simulation. Tasks are developed through expert proposals and iterative human--AI co-design, with selection guided by scientific value and difficulty. Task-specific execution-based evaluators inspect application states and generated artifacts, including molecular structures, segmentation masks, plots, and numerical results, and award partial credit for incomplete outcomes. Our special harness integrates model adapters, interaction-loop control, and trajectory logging to support comparisons of models and interaction strategies. Our results show that current state-of-the-art VLMs with a strong harness still face challenges in addressing key questions in the scientific domains. We also analyze the benchmarking results across multi-linguistics, reasoning efforts, context length and other factors and derive several important conclusions and directions to assist future development. Overall, we provide an integrated framework connecting expert-defined scientific goals to verifiable software outcomes, enabling systematic evaluation of both agent capabilities and harness design in scientific workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OSWorld-Science，一个面向科学领域计算机使用智能体的基准与评测环境，包含 12 个 VLM 与 146 个科学任务，通过基于执行与产物的评测器并支持部分得分，揭示了当前最强 VLM 在科学工作流上的能力瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 科学软件对基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的计算机使用智能体构成高难度考验：完成科研工作流需要解读专业界面、操作科学对象并产出可验证结果。然而现有评测缺乏兼具科学意义任务、基于产物评测与高效智能体框架的一体化基准。
AI.method: 构建 OSWorld-Science 基准与评测环境：涵盖分子绘制与逆合成、病理图像分析、统计计算、物理仿真等领域的 146 个高质量任务与 12 个 VLM；任务经专家提案与人机协同迭代设计，按科学价值与难度筛选；设计任务专属的基于执行的评测器，检查应用状态与生成产物（分子结构、分割掩码、图表、数值结果）并给予部分得分；同时提供集成模型适配器、交互循环控制与轨迹日志的高效评测框架（harness）。
AI.result: 当前最先进 VLM 即便配合强 harness，在科学领域关键问题上仍面临显著挑战；论文进一步从多语言、推理投入、上下文长度等多因素分析评测结果，得出若干重要结论与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了连接专家定义科学目标与可验证软件产物的集成框架，可系统评测科学工作流中的智能体能力与 harness 设计。

title: Characterizing High Bandwidth Flash for LLM Serving
summary: Large language model (LLM) serving requires substantial memory to store model weights and KV caches. As models grow larger and contexts become longer, memory capacity and bandwidth increasingly become bottlenecks for serving performance. Agentic workloads compound this pressure through repeated interactions over growing contexts, making it increasingly important to retain KV state for reuse. High-bandwidth flash (HBF) offers a way to expand accelerator memory capacity for large language model (LLM) serving, but its access costs and limited write endurance complicate its use. We evaluate HBF for high-throughput agentic serving across system design and scheduling choices to understand when additional capacity improves serving performance and energy efficiency. We introduce an HBM-HBF-host hierarchical storage system and buffered cache-aware scheduling, and use trace-driven simulations to analyze their effects on performance, energy consumption, and HBF write lifetime. Across the evaluated workloads, the fastest HBF-augmented systems reduce completion time by 36.1-87.0% relative to HBM-only systems. Modeled energy savings reach 55.8%, although HBF increases energy consumption on some light workloads. Buffered cache-aware scheduling extends estimated HBF write lifetime from 4.77 to 14.82 years in the evaluated configuration. These results demonstrate the importance of coordinating data placement and scheduling to improve serving efficiency while sustaining a practical HBF write lifetime.

AI.tldr: 本文评估高带宽闪存（HBF）用于高吞吐代理式 LLM 服务的可行性与收益，提出 HBM-HBF-主机分层存储系统与带缓冲的缓存感知调度，通过轨迹驱动仿真表明其可大幅缩短完成时间、降低能耗并延长 HBF 写入寿命。
AI.motivation: LLM 服务需大量内存存放模型权重与 KV 缓存，随模型规模与上下文增长，内存容量和带宽成为性能瓶颈；代理式工作负载因上下文累积与重复交互而进一步加剧压力，保留并复用 KV 状态愈发重要。HBF 可扩展加速器内存容量，但其访问开销与写入耐久性受限，何时增加容量能真正提升服务性能与能效尚不清晰。
AI.method: 提出 HBM-HBF-主机三级分层存储系统，并设计带缓冲的缓存感知调度（buffered cache-aware scheduling）；采用轨迹驱动仿真，在不同系统设计与调度选择下评估其对性能、能耗与 HBF 写入寿命的影响。
AI.result: 在评估负载中，最快的 HBF 增强系统相对纯 HBM 系统将完成时间缩短 36.1%–87.0%；建模能耗节省最高达 55.8%，但在部分轻负载下 HBF 反而增加能耗。带缓冲的缓存感知调度在评估配置下将 HBF 估计写入寿命从 4.77 年延长至 14.82 年。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，协调数据放置与调度对提升服务效率、同时维持实用的 HBF 写入寿命至关重要。

title: ConflictGuide: AutoResearch Improves When Competing Behaviors Are Made Visible
summary: When designing machine learning models, desirable properties are often in tension: improving one behavior can impair another, so task progress can depend on alleviating the conflict. LLM-based AutoResearch systems, which iteratively edit model code and retain edits based on scalar task-performance feedback, have largely ignored this trade-off. We find that scalar feedback supports broad exploration early in search, but it does not reveal how edits affect competing behaviors. In matched-budget experiments, introducing competing-behavior feedback as task gains diminish increases the share of proposals that improve both behaviors and sustains progress beyond scalar-only plateaus. Obtaining this feedback for a given model requires identifying its competing behaviors and designing probes to measure them. To make competing-behavior feedback actionable, we introduce ConflictGuide. Its reusable ConflictGuide-Skill combines a literature-grounded taxonomy with model-specific evidence to identify competing behaviors and specify probes for a code agent to implement as metrics. Evolution proceeds in two stages: Stage I explores with task feedback; Stage II uses probe feedback to steer proposals toward conflict alleviation and retains marginal-gain edits only when probes indicate sufficient alleviation. Across five diverse model families, ConflictGuide reduces task and conflict-related errors by up to 28% and 14%, respectively, relative to scalar-only AutoResearch, with gains extending to other code agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出LLM驱动的自动研究系统仅依赖标量任务反馈而忽视模型行为间的冲突权衡，提出ConflictGuide，通过识别竞争行为并设计探针为其提供反馈，在五类模型家族上将任务与冲突相关错误分别降低最多28%和14%。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型设计中，理想属性常相互冲突，提升某一行为可能损害另一行为，任务进展取决于缓解这种冲突。然而基于LLM的AutoResearch系统通过迭代编辑模型代码并依据标量任务性能反馈保留编辑，基本忽略了这种权衡：标量反馈在搜索早期支持广泛探索，却无法揭示编辑如何影响相互竞争的行为。
AI.method: 作者在匹配预算实验中引入竞争行为反馈，并提出了ConflictGuide。其可复用的ConflictGuide-Skill将文献支撑的分类体系与模型特定证据相结合，用于识别竞争行为并指定探针，由代码智能体将其实现为度量指标。演化过程分两阶段：Stage I用任务反馈进行探索；Stage II利用探针反馈引导提案朝向冲突缓解，且仅当探针显示缓解充分时才保留边际收益编辑。
AI.result: 在五个不同的模型家族上，相较于仅用标量反馈的AutoResearch，ConflictGuide将任务相关错误和冲突相关错误分别最多降低28%和14%，且该增益可迁移到其他代码智能体。
AI.conclusion: 随着任务增益递减，引入竞争行为反馈能提高同时改善两种行为的提案比例，并突破仅依赖标量反馈的停滞。使竞争行为反馈可操作的关键在于识别模型特定竞争行为并设计探针度量，ConflictGuide提供了可复用方案并在多模型家族上验证有效。

title: ID Balancing: Stable Training of Extremely Sparse MoE via PID-Based Load Control
summary: Scaling Large Language Models (LLMs) via Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) enables massive parameter growth with nearly constant per-token computation. However, further scaling the parameter count requires increasingly sparse routing, where expert load imbalance becomes more severe. This imbalance reduces parameter utilization and training efficiency, and can undermine training stability, becoming a bottleneck to reliable scaling. In this work, we unify two representative auxiliary-loss-free methods as incomplete Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers: DeepSeek's loss-free method acts as a fixed-step integral controller, while Kimi K3's Quantile Balancing functions as a generalized proportional controller. Building on this control perspective, we propose ID Balancing, an Integral-Derivative controller. It scales its integral term with load error and activates its derivative term only when imbalance worsens, enabling stronger corrections for large or worsening errors and smaller updates near balance. Evaluated across Top-$10$, Top-$5$, and Top-$3$ routing over $768$ experts, ID Balancing reduces worst-case backbone MaxVio and training-average backbone MinVio by over $50\%$ and $12\%$, respectively, relative to the best baselines in the Top-$3$ setting. When the total parameter count increases from $18.9$B to $69.9$B (Top-$10$-of-$768$), ID Balancing's worst-case backbone MaxVio remains nearly unchanged and is approximately $89.6\%$ lower than that of the auxiliary-loss baseline. ID Balancing also maintains competitive language-modeling and downstream performance. The advantages of ID Balancing grow as sparsity increases, making it a promising solution for scaling larger, sparser MoE models.

AI.tldr: 该论文将两种无辅助损失的路由负载均衡方法统一为不完整的PID控制器，并提出ID Balancing（积分-微分控制器），通过随负载误差缩放积分项、仅在失衡恶化时激活微分项，显著降低大规模稀疏MoE训练的专家负载失衡。
AI.motivation: MoE通过稀疏路由实现参数规模增长而每token计算近似恒定，但进一步扩大参数量需要更稀疏的路由，导致专家负载失衡加剧，降低参数利用率与训练效率并危及训练稳定性，成为可靠扩展的瓶颈。现有无辅助损失方法（如DeepSeek的loss-free方法、Kimi K3的Quantile Balancing）各自有效，但缺乏统一视角与进一步改进的框架。
AI.method: 作者将两种代表性无辅助损失方法统一为不完整的PID控制器：DeepSeek的无损失方法相当于固定步长的积分控制器，Kimi K3的Quantile Balancing相当于广义比例控制器。基于该控制视角，提出ID Balancing——一个积分-微分控制器：积分项随负载误差缩放，微分项仅在失衡恶化时激活，从而在大误差或恶化时施加强修正，在接近均衡时减小更新幅度。
AI.result: 在768个专家、Top-10/Top-5/Top-3路由设置下评估：相对最优基线，ID Balancing在Top-3设置下将最坏情况backbone MaxVio降低超过50%，训练平均backbone MinVio降低超过12%。当总参数量从18.9B增至69.9B（Top-10-of-768）时，其最坏情况backbone MaxVio几乎不变，且比辅助损失基线低约89.6%。同时保持有竞争力的语言建模与下游任务性能。
AI.conclusion: ID Balancing从控制理论角度统一并扩展了现有无辅助损失负载均衡方法，随稀疏度增加优势愈发明显，是扩展更大、更稀疏MoE模型的有前景方案。

title: Coverage Before Control: Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering for Controllable Retrosynthesis
summary: Single-step retrosynthesis models are commonly evaluated by their ability to recover recorded reactions. In practice, chemists may need to choose among several precursor sets for the same product, for example to preserve a particular motif. Recovering a recorded answer alone does not establish this ability to follow a preference. Satisfying such requests requires both coverage of relevant alternatives and control over which alternatives are favored. We introduce Route-Instruction Grounding and Steering (RIGS), a two-stage framework for instruction-conditioned retrosynthesis. Stage A trains a language projector, teaching it which alternatives an instruction favors or discourages. Stage B uses the projector learned in Stage A to steer a frozen generative model through lightweight residual adapters. We construct nested one-to-many training supports by pairing each product with increasing numbers of candidate precursor sets. Extensive experiments demonstrate that broader support helps the model generate a wider range of alternatives, and RIGS can learn to guide generation according to instructions. The relationship between coverage and control is consistent across model scales but non-monotone.

AI.tldr: 提出RIGS两阶段框架，用于指令条件下的逆合成，在扩大候选前体集覆盖的同时实现对偏好选择的可控生成。
AI.motivation: 现有单步逆合成模型通常以恢复已记录反应为评价标准，但化学家实际需要在同一产物的多个候选前体集中按偏好（如保留特定基团）进行选择。仅能恢复记录答案无法体现这种遵循偏好的能力，因此需要兼顾候选覆盖度与对偏好选择的控制。
AI.method: RIGS为两阶段框架：阶段A训练一个语言投影器，使其学习指令偏好或抑制哪些备选方案；阶段B利用阶段A学到的投影器，通过轻量级残差适配器对冻结的生成模型进行引导。同时构建嵌套的一对多训练支持集，将每个产物与数量递增的候选前体集配对。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，更广泛的支持集有助于模型生成更多样的备选方案，且RIGS能够学会依据指令引导生成。覆盖度与控制力之间的关系在不同模型规模下保持一致，但呈非单调性。
AI.conclusion: 逆合成评估应从单答案恢复扩展到偏好条件下的备选生成，RIGS通过解耦的投影学习与残差适配实现覆盖度与可控性的联合优化，但二者关系非单调，需在支持集规模与指令控制之间权衡。

title: Sharp Stationary Gaussian Approximation for Constant-Stepsize SGD
comment: To be presented at 2026 NeurIPS workshop on "Optimization for Machine Learning" (OPT2026)
summary: We prove a sharp Gaussian approximation for the invariant law of constant-stepsize SGD with bounded additive noise generated by an exogenous uniformly ergodic Markov chain. For a smooth, strongly convex objective with a Lipschitz Hessian and nondegenerate long-run noise covariance, the centered iterate normalized by the square root of the stepsize is $O(\sqrtα)$-close in 1-Wasserstein distance to its limiting Gaussian. The proof combines blockwise Gaussian comparison with long-run contraction. A four-state example gives a matching lower bound although the one-time noise marginal is symmetric and every nonzero-lag autocovariance vanishes. In this example, an adjacent third-order mixed moment produces the leading correction.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了恒定步长SGD（噪声来自外生一致遍历马尔可夫链）不变律的尖锐高斯近似：中心化并以步长平方根归一后的迭代量在1-Wasserstein距离下以O(√α)逼近极限高斯分布，且该阶数通过四状态例子给出匹配下界。
AI.motivation: 理解SGD不变分布的近似高斯性对统计推断与不确定性量化很重要，但已有工作多假设独立同分布噪声或未给出尖锐阶数；本文针对由外生马尔可夫链生成的有界加性噪声，需求得尖锐的高斯近似速率并厘清其主导误差来源。
AI.method: 在目标函数光滑、强凸、Hessian Lipschitz且长期噪声协方差非退化条件下，结合分块（blockwise）高斯比较与长期收缩（long-run contraction）技术，对中心化并按√α归一化的迭代量与极限高斯进行1-Wasserstein距离比较；并构造四状态例子分析高阶混合矩。
AI.result: 得到O(√α)的1-Wasserstein距离上界；四状态例子给出匹配下界，尽管其单步噪声边际对称且所有非零滞后自协方差为零，此时相邻三阶混合矩产生了主导修正项。
AI.conclusion: 该结果为马尔可夫噪声下恒步长SGD不变律的高斯近似提供了尖锐速率，表明仅凭噪声的边际对称性与二阶（自协方差）结构不足以刻画偏差，需考虑三阶混合矩等高阶依赖。

title: Better Deck or Different Judge? Evaluating Agentic Harness Gains in Corporate and Investment Banking
summary: Corporate and investment banking teams use presentations to support credit decisions and advise clients on financing and transactions. Producing these decks requires reconciling financial data, tracing sources and turning analysis into a recommendation. We retrospectively study the development of an agentic harness combining a 27B language model, financial calculations, narrative templates and validation checks. LLM judges guide engineering changes and assess the resulting decks, raising the question of whether higher scores reflect better documents or changes in grading. In shared-session text-only grading with template markers removed, five judges score the complete system 20.4 to 33.6 points out of 95 above the same model generating directly from a short prompt. Every judge scores the system higher on all seventeen development deliverables. Margins against direct Opus generation from a short prompt range from -4.7 to +0.8 points. Judges agree on broad progress across development rounds but agree less on final-deck rankings than on pooled scores. Repeated grading also shifts scores on unchanged decks, making small improvements difficult to distinguish from judge variability.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾性研究了一个"智能体框架"（agentic harness）的开发：该框架将27B语言模型与财务计算、叙事模板和验证检查相结合，用于投行演示文稿（deck）生成。以LLM裁判指导工程迭代并评估成品，比较其与直接由短提示生成的基线。结果显示，五名裁判在盲评条件下给系统的评分比基线高20.4至33.6分（满分95分），且在全部17项开发交付物上均优于基线；但与Opus短提示基线相比优势较小（-4.7至+0.8分）。裁判在总体进展上较为一致，但对最终成品排序一致性较低，且对未修改文稿的重复评分存在漂移，使微小改进难以与裁判变异性区分。
AI.motivation: 公司金融与投资银行团队需用演示文稿支持信贷决策、融资与交易建议，制作过程涉及财务数据核对、来源追溯与分析结论转化，工作量大且要求严谨。作者希望探索：能否用智能体框架将语言模型与财务计算、模板和校验机制结合，以自动化方式产出可用的投行演示文稿，并检验系统是否真正带来实质性质量提升，而非仅仅提高评分。
AI.method: 采用回顾性（retrospective）研究设计，考察一个智能体框架的开发过程：该框架整合27B参数语言模型、财务计算模块、叙事模板与验证检查。以LLM作为裁判（LLM judges）指导工程变更，并评估生成的演示文稿。评估设置采用共享会话（shared-session）、纯文本（text-only）评分，移除模板标记以避免线索泄露。将系统输出与同一模型直接由短提示生成的结果对照，并额外与Opus短提示生成结果比较；覆盖17项开发交付物及多轮开发迭代，包含重复评分以检验裁判稳定性。
AI.result: 在共享会话纯文本盲评条件下，五名裁判给完整系统的评分为每95分制中高于同模型短提示直接生成20.4至33.6分；每名裁判在全部17项开发交付物上均给系统更高分。与Opus短提示直接生成相比，分差为-4.7至+0.8分。裁判在多轮开发总体进展上较一致，但在最终成品排序上一致性低于汇总分数。对未修改文稿的重复评分会出现分数漂移，导致小幅改进难以与裁判变异性区分。
AI.conclusion: 智能体框架（27B模型+财务计算+模板+校验）相较同模型直接短提示生成，在裁判评分上具有明显、稳定的优势，并在每项交付物上均体现；但相对更强模型（Opus）短提示基线的提升有限。研究同时警示：LLM裁判评分受评分设置、重复评分漂移影响，细粒度排序与微小改进的判定可靠性不足，因此"分数更高"未必等同于"文档更好"。

title: QuanVI: Score-based Variational Inference via Quantum Maximally Mixed States
summary: Score-based variational inference (VI) provides an alternative to Kullback--Leibler (KL)-based VI by minimizing the Fisher divergence between the variational distribution and the target. A prior score-VI approach formulates this optimization as an eigenvalue problem, with the variational distribution constructed from low-energy eigenstates. However, this eigenvalue-based formulation faces two high-dimensional obstacles: an intractably large parameter count due to exponential scaling and non-uniqueness of individual eigenvectors in degenerate or nearly degenerate low-energy subspaces. We propose QuanVI, a scalable quantum-inspired algorithm that combines a mixed-state density-operator formulation with a quantum tensor network (QTN) parameterization using the matrix product operator (MPO) structure. In degenerate low-energy subspaces, the density-operator formulation represents the subspace by its maximally mixed state rather than relying on a non-unique individual eigenvector, while the QTN parameterization compresses the density operator to avoid exponential parameter growth. Experiments and ablations show that QuanVI agrees with exact solutions in low dimensions and scales to high-dimensional synthetic and Bayesian posterior-approximation benchmarks, including challenging non-Gaussian targets.

AI.tldr: QuanVI结合混合态密度算子表述与基于矩阵乘积算子(MPO)的量子张量网络参数化，提出可扩展的量子启发式评分变分推断算法，解决传统特征值方法在高维下的参数爆炸与简并子空间特征向量不唯一问题，并在高维合成与贝叶斯后验基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 评分变分推断(Score-based VI)通过最小化变分分布与目标分布间的Fisher散度，为基于KL的VI提供了替代方案。已有的评分VI方法将该优化表述为特征值问题，用低能本征态构造变分分布，但存在两个高维障碍：(1) 指数级扩展导致参数数量不可控；(2) 在简并或近简并低能子空间中，单个本征向量不唯一。
AI.method: 提出QuanVI，一种可扩展的量子启发式算法，包含两个核心组件：(1) 混合态密度算子表述，在简并低能子空间中以最大混合态表示整个子空间，而非依赖不唯一的单个本征向量；(2) 量子张量网络(QTN)参数化，采用矩阵乘积算子(MPO)结构压缩密度算子，避免参数指数增长。
AI.result: 实验与消融研究表明：QuanVI在低维情形下与精确解一致；可扩展至高维合成数据及贝叶斯后验近似基准，包括具有挑战性的非高斯目标分布。
AI.conclusion: 将密度算子表述与MPO张量网络参数化相结合，可有效克服评分VI特征值表述中的参数爆炸与简并子空间非唯一性两大高维障碍，使QuanVI在保持精度的同时具备高维可扩展性。

title: AIMS: An Agentic AI Framework for Sim-to-Real Multi-Modal ISAC
summary: Multi-modal integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables environmental perception and reliable connectivity for intelligent wireless networks. Data-driven multi-modal ISAC models depend heavily on annotated real-world data to learn relationships across sensing and wireless observations, thereby constraining scalable deployment. Although synthetic data generation reduces the burden, adapting existing simulation pipelines to a target deployment requires consistent scene, sensing, wireless, and learning configurations, while mismatches among these coupled components impair sim-to-real transferability. To address the challenge, we propose an agentic artificial intelligence (AI) framework for sim-to-real multi-modal ISAC, named AIMS. Given a natural-language deployment request specifying the target task, deployment conditions, and real-data budget, AIMS derives a deployment-specific sim-to-real configuration and coordinates its execution to produce a deployment-specific task model. A two-agent architecture coordinates scene construction with task learning. A scene construction agent generates geographically grounded, synchronized sensing and wireless records from shared physical states, while a scene understanding agent configures task-relevant modalities and mixture-of-experts (MoE) learning for zero-shot inference or few-shot adaptation. Structured domain knowledge guides dependency-aware planning, while validation evidence supports feedback-driven revision of affected decisions. Experiments on the real-world DeepSense~6G dataset demonstrate improved vehicle detection and beam prediction over the considered simulation and fusion baselines. A separate orchestration benchmark evaluates task interpretation, dependency reasoning, and feedback-driven replanning across diverse deployment requests, showing improved plan correctness with structured domain knowledge and validation feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIMS，一种面向仿真到现实（sim-to-real）多模态ISAC的智能体AI框架。给定自然语言部署请求，AIMS自动推导部署专用配置并协调执行，通过场景构建智能体与场景理解智能体协作，结合结构化领域知识与验证反馈，生成部署专用任务模型，在DeepSense 6G数据集上提升了车辆检测与波束预测性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态ISAC的数据驱动模型依赖大量标注真实数据，制约可扩展部署；合成数据虽能减轻负担，但现有仿真流水线适配目标部署时需保证场景、感知、无线与学习配置一致，耦合组件间的失配会损害sim-to-real迁移能力。
AI.method: 提出AIMS智能体AI框架：输入为指定目标任务、部署条件与真实数据预算的自然语言部署请求，输出部署专用配置并协调执行以产生任务模型。采用双智能体架构：场景构建智能体从共享物理状态生成地理接地且同步的感知与无线记录；场景理解智能体配置任务相关模态与MoE学习，以支持零样本推理或少样本自适应。结构化领域知识引导依赖感知规划，验证证据支持反馈驱动的决策修订。
AI.result: 在真实DeepSense 6G数据集上，车辆检测与波束预测性能优于所对比的仿真与融合基线。另设编排基准评估跨多样部署请求的任务理解、依赖推理与反馈驱动重规划能力，结果显示结构化领域知识与验证反馈提升了规划正确性。
AI.conclusion: AIMS通过智能体化、知识引导与反馈驱动的配置推导与协调，有效缓解了多模态ISAC中仿真到现实迁移的配置失配问题，实现部署专用模型的自动生成，并在真实数据任务与编排规划基准上均取得改进。

title: Whitening Improves Robustness to Spurious Correlations in Linear Probes
summary: Deep neural networks tend to rely on simple features that may be spurious and thus fail to generalize. We study this problem in the setting of linear probes, where a (generalized) linear model is fitted on the representations of a (pretrained) model. We use the connection of these models to the max-margin classifier, and show they favor directions associated with large eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. Whitening removes this preference by equalizing the eigenvalues of the covariance matrix. This observation motivates whitening as a preprocessing step that can reduce reliance on spurious correlations without requiring prior knowledge of their presence or labeled data. We examine the effect of whitening on a synthetic data-generating process and standard spurious correlation benchmarks, and find that it improves robustness. We also find that whitening can improve robustness when added to existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上解释了线性探针偏好协方差矩阵大特征值方向的倾向，并提出白化作为无需先验知识或标注的预处理步骤来减少对虚假相关的依赖，实验表明可提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络倾向于依赖简单但可能虚假的特征，导致泛化失败。作者希望找到一种无需先验知识或标注数据即可减少对虚假相关依赖的方法。
AI.method: 在线性探针设置下，将(广义)线性模型与最大间隔分类器建立联系，分析其偏好协方差矩阵大特征值方向的性质；通过白化均衡协方差矩阵特征值，消除这一偏好，并将其作为预处理步骤。在合成数据生成过程和标准虚假相关基准上进行验证。
AI.result: 白化能够提升鲁棒性，且在添加到现有方法上时同样能提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 白化作为一种简单有效的预处理手段，可在无先验知识和标注的情况下减少模型对虚假相关的依赖，改善鲁棒性，并与现有方法互补。

title: What Can Component-Replacement Evidence Establish? A Critical Scoping Review of Local Decisions in LLM Agents
comment: 36 pages, 3 figures. The authors contributed equally
summary: Background. A component replacement in a language-model agent changes an execution trajectory, potentially altering later observations, resource use, and recovery opportunities. Different evidence is needed to assess its task-level benefit and the contribution of local decision quality. Methods. This critical scoping review maps 348 studies and examines 90 comparison records: 88 from 40 included studies and two from supplementary studies. Eight purposively selected cases structure the synthesis around the replaced decision, executed conditions, measurement comparability, controls, and remaining explanations. Results. Of 222 studies reporting local decision metrics, 142 also report measured task endpoints and 49 report proxies. These counts identify studies that report both types of measurement, without establishing that the measurements come from matched comparisons. Outcome Monitors reports a package-level completion gain whose attribution to detector quality remains limited; First-chunk selection reports a local improvement assessed against an offline proxy endpoint; Evidence-Carrying Termination reports fewer premature unsupported terminations and completion non-inferiority, without establishing completion superiority. Cross-case analysis identifies three candidate mechanisms involving recovery and disruption, intervention timing, and downstream use. Attribution and deployment depend on the comparison controls, label definitions, and information available to the controller. Conclusions. The review distinguishes the task-level benefit of a component replacement from the contribution of local decision quality and derives eight claim-specific reporting items. Neither online execution nor simultaneous gains in local and task metrics alone establish that better local decisions explain the task-level gain.

AI.tldr: 该文是一项批判性范围综述，梳理348项研究并分析90条对比记录，旨在区分"组件替换的任务级收益"与"局部决策质量的贡献"，并提出8条针对具体论断的报告条目。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体中替换某个组件会改变执行轨迹，进而影响后续观测、资源使用与恢复机会。因此，评估其任务级收益与局部决策质量的作用需要不同类型的证据，而既有研究常将二者混为一谈。
AI.method: 采用批判性范围综述方法，映射348项研究，检视90条对比记录（88条来自40项纳入研究，2条来自补充研究）；并通过8个目的性选取的案例，围绕被替换的决策、执行条件、测量可比性、对照组设置及剩余解释进行结构化综合分析。
AI.result: 在222项报告局部决策指标的研究中，142项同时报告实测任务终点，49项报告代理指标；但这些计数仅表明研究同时报告两类测量，并不能证明其来自匹配的对比。案例显示：Outcome Monitors的包级完成度增益对检测器质量的归因仍有限；First-chunk selection的局部改进是相对于离线代理终点的评估；Evidence-Carrying Termination减少了过早的无支持终止且完成度非劣，但未确立完成度优越性。跨案例分析识别出三类候选机制：恢复与中断、干预时机、下游使用。归因与部署取决于对照控制、标签定义以及控制器可获得的信息。
AI.conclusion: 综述区分了组件替换的任务级收益与局部决策质量的贡献，并推导出8条针对具体论断的报告条目。仅凭在线执行或局部指标与任务指标同时提升，均不足以证明更好的局部决策解释了任务级收益。

title: Low-Discrepancy Dither for Quantized Recurrent State Caches
summary: Mamba-style and hybrid language models compress their past into a fixed-size recurrent state that is rewritten at every generated token. Storing this state in low precision saves memory bandwidth, but every rounding error is fed back into the next update and can accumulate over long generations. Production systems round the state stochastically; we ask which rounding rule such caches should use. We find that a deterministic golden-ratio Weyl dither, which needs no random numbers, consistently brings the quantized model closer to the full-precision one than stochastic rounding, across pure and hybrid models, storage formats, and long decoding horizons, at no extra cost. Round-to-nearest behaves differently: because it discards small updates, its error keeps growing, so it can look best in short evaluations yet falls far behind over long generations. A discrepancy analysis explains this ordering, and we document implementation pitfalls that silently remove the benefit.

AI.tldr: 在Mamba式与混合语言模型的低精度循环状态缓存中，确定性的黄金比例Weyl抖动优于随机舍入，能在无额外成本下使量化模型更接近全精度模型。
AI.motivation: Mamba式与混合语言模型将历史压缩为固定大小的循环状态，并在每生成一个token时重写；低精度存储该状态虽节省内存带宽，但每次舍入误差都会反馈到下一次更新并随长序列累积。生产系统采用随机舍入，但尚不清楚此类缓存应采用哪种舍入规则。
AI.method: 作者对比不同舍入规则：提出使用无需随机数的确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动，并与随机舍入、就近舍入（round-to-nearest）进行比较；在纯模型与混合模型、多种存储格式以及长解码时域上评估量化模型与全精度模型的接近程度，并进行误差差异分析，同时记录会悄然消除该收益的实现陷阱。
AI.result: 确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动在纯模型与混合模型、不同存储格式及长解码时域上，均持续比随机舍入更接近全精度模型，且无额外成本。就近舍入表现不同：因其丢弃小更新，误差持续增长，在短评估中可能看似最优，但在长生成中远远落后。差异分析解释了这一排序。
AI.conclusion: 对于Mamba式与混合语言模型的低精度循环状态缓存，推荐采用确定性黄金比例Weyl抖动作为舍入规则，它无需随机数、无额外成本且长期误差更小；同时需注意避免会悄然抹除其收益的实现陷阱。

title: Who Verifies the Graph? Misspecification Attacks on Causal Action Verification for Language Agents
comment: Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop "Who Verifies the Agents?"
summary: Causal action verifiers gate an agent's state-changing tool calls by checking whether each proposed intervention is identifiable against a committed action-state graph, and they issue a certificate that carries the identification argument and a one-sided lower confidence bound. One such verifier, CIVeX, reports zero false executions on a confounded tool-use benchmark. We red-team it by corrupting only the committed graph. Omitting a single bidirected edge takes it from zero false executions to 15.3% at the benchmark's published confounding strength, with 91% of its executions harmful and utility falling from +2.27 to +0.35. Reversing one arrowhead, so that a mediator is committed as a confounder, gives 48.9% false executions and no correct ones. Every one of these actions carries an internally valid certificate. An attestation step that tests each observationally certified execution against a bounded randomised sample detected both attacks, with 2 false alarms in 555 executions on a truthful graph; refusing what fails the test, or cannot be tested, gave zero false executions in every setting we measured. It does not restore beneficial execution: at the published strength 97.1% of beneficial actions are still never executed, because the same misspecification rejects them before attestation runs. Those rejections carry certificates too, and auditing them works, but its cost scales with the number of rejections rather than the number of executions. Recovering safety costs 127 experiments per 1,050 actions; recovering the lost value costs 614 more, at which point the audited verifier makes the honest graph's decisions on every instance and spends exactly its experiment budget. An audit that inspects only executions protects against wrongful action. Wrongful inaction has to be paid for separately.

AI.tldr: 本文对因果动作验证器 CIVeX 进行红队测试：仅篡改承诺的动作-状态图（漏掉一条双向边或反转箭头方向），即可使其产生大量错误执行（15.3%~48.9%），且每个错误执行仍携带内部有效的证书；加入基于有界随机采样的"证明/免责"（attestation）步骤可检测两种攻击并实现零错误执行，但不会恢复被同一图误设所拒绝的有益动作，恢复安全性需每 1050 个动作 127 次实验，恢复价值再需 614 次实验。
AI.motivation: 因果动作验证器通过证书式识别论证为一侧置信下界背书，据称可消除混杂工具使用中的错误执行；作者质疑其鲁棒性来源——证书的有效性依赖于"承诺图正确"这一未经验证的假设，因此需要红队检验：若仅图本身被篡改（而非观测或算法），验证器与证书是否仍会失效。
AI.method: 红队攻击仅针对承诺的动作-状态图：(1) 删除一条双向（混）边；(2) 反转一个箭头方向，使中介变量被错误承诺为混杂变量。对 CIVeX 在已发表的混杂强度下测量错误执行率与效用。随后引入 attestation 步骤：对每个被观测性认证的执行，用有界随机采样进行检验，拒绝未通过检验或无法检验的动作。并对照实图测量误报率、有益动作执行率，以及审计拒绝项（其同样带证书）所需的实验成本。
AI.result: 删除一条双向边使错误执行从 0 升至 15.3%（其中 91% 有害），效用由 +2.27 降至 +0.35；反转一个箭头方向得到 48.9% 错误执行且无一次正确执行；所有错误动作均携带内部有效证书。Attestation 能检测两种攻击，在真实图上 555 次执行仅 2 次误报；拒绝未通过或不可检验者后，所有测量设置下错误执行为零。但未恢复有益执行：已发表强度下 97.1% 的有益动作仍从未被执行，因同一图误设在 attestation 之前就已将其拒绝；这些拒绝同样带证书且可审计，但审计成本随拒绝数而非执行数增长。恢复安全需每 1050 个动作 127 次实验，恢复丢失价值再需 614 次实验，此时审计式验证器在每个实例上做出诚实图的决策并恰好用完实验预算。
AI.conclusion: 仅审计执行过程的机制只能防止错误行动（wrongful action），无法防止错误的不作为（wrongful inaction）——后者必须另行付出实验成本来补救。承诺图的误设会同时造成两类失效，且两者都表现为内部有效的证书，因此证书的"内部有效性"不足以作为端到端安全保证。

title: Attention Function as an Intrinsic Inductive Bias: How Models' Behavior Diverges in Novel Contexts
comment: Accepted as a full paper (poster) at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Developmental Perspectives on AI (DevAI 2026)
summary: Developmental psychology holds that certain priors are given to infants prior to experience rather than induced from data, and that the influence of such priors is suppressed under strong, well-constrained conditions but reasserts itself under weak ones. We ask whether an analogous principle holds for the Transformer: can the activation function given to attention heads serve as an intrinsic inductive bias? We propose Mixture of Function Attention (MoFA), a parameter-free modification to multi-head attention that fixes a ratio of softmax and sigmoid heads before training. Across five ratios, a 124M-parameter GPT-2 model, and five seeds, we find that this given ratio has little effect in-distribution -- differences between ratios are statistically negligible for moderate mixtures and remain small even at the extremes -- but its influence re-emerges sharply under zero-shot distribution shift across 15 out-of-distribution domains. Perplexity gaps between ratios widen by more than an order of magnitude on several domains, and the best-performing ratio tracks a single axis of domain structure, separating short, informal text (softmax-favoring) from technical, long-form text (sigmoid-favoring), that explains 78.3% of the variance in domain response. This reorganization is visible at the head level: sigmoid heads show an accelerating drop in attention entropy as their ratio increases, while softmax heads respond more modestly, yielding a consistent division of labor between the two head types. Our results suggest that activation choice functions as a given prior whose influence is masked in-distribution and re-emerges out-of-distribution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出MoFA（Mixture of Function Attention），在训练前固定注意力头中softmax与sigmoid的比例，验证激活函数可作为Transformer的内在先验：该给定比例在分布内影响可忽略，但在零样本分布偏移下影响显著再现。
AI.motivation: 发展心理学认为某些先验先于经验而存在，其影响在强约束条件下被抑制、在弱约束下重新显现。作者追问Transformer是否遵循类似原则：赋予注意力头的激活函数能否充当一种"给定的内在归纳偏置"，而非从数据中习得。
AI.method: 提出Mixture of Function Attention（MoFA），一种无参数的注意力修改：在训练前固定多头注意力中softmax头与sigmoid头的比例。在5种比例、124M参数的GPT-2模型、5个随机种子上进行实验，评估分布内表现与跨15个域的零样本分布偏移表现，并对注意力熵进行头级别分析。
AI.result: 分布内各比例差异统计上可忽略（适度混合下），极端设置下差异也较小；但在15个分布外域上差异急剧放大，多个域的困惑度差距扩大一个数量级以上。最佳比例沿单一域结构轴分布，将短文本、非正式文本（偏好softmax）与技术性长文本（偏好sigmoid）分开，解释了78.3%的域响应方差。头级别上，sigmoid头随比例增加注意力熵加速下降，softmax头响应较温和，形成稳定的分工。
AI.conclusion: 激活函数的选择可作为"给定先验"，其影响在分布内被掩盖、在分布外重新显现，为Transformer中的归纳偏置提供了与发展心理学类比的经验证据。

title: PTNO: Training Neural Operators with Noisy Monte Carlo Estimates for Particle Transport Problems
summary: Particle transport under multiple scattering is central to radiative transfer and plasma physics, yet high-fidelity Monte Carlo (MC) simulations must trace prohibitively many particles. Learning-based surrogates can amortize this cost, but typically train on expensive, well-converged MC solutions. We propose the Particle Transport Neural Operator (PTNO), a neural operator that learns particle transport surrogates directly from noisy, low-cost MC labels. Such labels pose two challenges: (1) high variance, which destabilizes standard supervised learning, and (2) a high dynamic range (HDR) spanning many orders of magnitude. For the first, we learn the solution operator from noisy labels of many configurations, amortizing MC cost and generalizing to unseen configurations. Because MC labels are unbiased, we show that the squared loss on them shares its minimizer with the loss on converged solutions, and our budget-allocation study over training scenes $M$, MC samples per render $N$, and independent renders per scene $K$ shows that many noisy scenes beat fewer converged ones. For the second, a nonlinear transform such as the logarithm biases noisy supervision. Instead, PTNO keeps labels in physical space and enforces positivity with a softplus output layer that represents small values effectively. We further train with a pointwise relative $L_2$ loss (PRelL2), the stop-gradient relative loss of HDR denoising and neural rendering, which normalizes each residual by the stop-gradient prediction instead of the noisy label. We demonstrate PTNO on neutron transport in fusion reactors and radiative transfer in participating media. On the two neutronics tasks, PTNO is $10^4$-$10^5\times$ faster than converged MC on the same CPU and $10^3$-$10^5\times$ cheaper than MC at matched accuracy; on the two radiative-transfer tasks, MC at matched accuracy costs $0.8$-$11\times$ as much as PTNO.

AI.tldr: PTNO 是一种直接从含噪、低成本蒙特卡洛标签中学习粒子输运解的神经算子代理模型，通过多配置摊销训练、softplus 正性输出层与逐点相对 L2 损失应对高方差和高动态范围挑战，在中子输运与辐射传输任务上实现相对收敛 MC 的 10^3–10^5 倍加速或成本降低。
AI.motivation: 粒子输运在辐射传输与等离子体物理中至关重要，但高保真 MC 模拟需追踪极大量粒子，成本过高。现有基于学习的代理模型虽能摊销成本，却依赖昂贵且已收敛的 MC 解作为训练标签，限制了实用性。作者希望直接从低成本、含噪的 MC 标签中学习，从而进一步降低数据获取成本。
AI.method: 提出 PTNO 神经算子，从多配置的含噪 MC 标签中直接学习解算子。理论证明：由于 MC 标签无偏，含噪标签上的平方损失与收敛解上的损失共享同一极小值点；并通过预算分配研究（训练场景数 M、每次渲染 MC 采样数 N、每场景独立渲染次数 K）表明多噪声场景优于少收敛场景。针对高动态范围：不在对数等非线性空间训练（会引入偏差），而在物理空间保留标签，用 softplus 输出层强制正性并有效表示小值；训练采用逐点相对 L2 损失（PRelL2），以停止梯度的预测而非含噪标签归一化残差。
AI.result: 在聚变反应堆中子输运与参与性介质辐射传输任务上验证。两个中子学任务中，PTNO 在相同 CPU 上比收敛 MC 快 10^4–10^5 倍，在同等精度下比 MC 便宜 10^3–10^5 倍；两个辐射传输任务中，达到同等精度的 MC 成本是 PTNO 的 0.8–11 倍。
AI.conclusion: PTNO 证明可从未收敛的含噪 MC 标签中直接学习有效的粒子输运代理，且通过合理的损失设计与输出层约束可稳定处理高方差与高动态范围问题，显著降低计算成本，具备跨中子学与辐射传输的通用性。

title: Dynamics to decision: A mathematical theory of Lyapunov spectra and decision boundaries in deep classifiers
summary: A deep classifier is defined not only by the decision it produces, but also by the sequence of transformations through which that decision is formed. Treating this evolution as a dynamical system across layers provides a natural framework for asking how decision geometry emerges through depth and how far back we can trace a boundary's dynamical signature. We model a feed-forward classifier as a finite, nonautonomous discrete dynamical system, with layers playing the role of discrete time steps. We study the Finite-Time Maximum Lyapunov Exponent (FTMLE) of the data samples' dynamical trajectory through depths of the classifier. The FTMLE measures the rate of convergence/divergence of nearby trajectories. We move the observation endpoint backward from probabilities to logits and then to hidden representations. For Gaussian classes, we prove that probability-level FTMLE carries a clear geometric signature of the decision boundary, with its dominant direction aligned with the boundary normal. Moving one step backward to the logits, we prove this relationship is no longer universal but depends critically on how the classifier is trained, particularly on the choice of loss function. Moving further backward to the hidden representation, the connection becomes more conditional: boundary-related FTMLE can persist, but only under identifiable structural conditions. We propose geometry-aware fine-tuning for restructuring the classifier's hidden FTMLE, and propose conditions for guaranteed concentration of high hidden FTMLE near the decision boundary. Through our numerical results, we show the generality and validity of our theoretical results. Understanding the evolution of data samples as traveling through the layers of classifier provides a principled foundation for identifying where boundary-relevant sensitivity emerges and for developing layer-aware regularization strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文将前馈分类器建模为有限、非自治的离散动力系统，以层为时间步，研究数据样本轨迹的有限时间最大Lyapunov指数（FTMLE），并追溯从概率、logits到隐表示中决策边界的几何特征。
AI.motivation: 深度分类器不仅由最终决策定义，还由形成该决策的逐层变换序列定义。作者希望把这一逐层演化视为动力系统，从而追问：决策几何如何随深度涌现，以及边界动力特征能回溯到多深的层。
AI.method: 将前馈分类器视为有限、非自治离散动力系统，层对应离散时间步；计算样本轨迹的有限时间最大Lyapunov指数（FTMLE），衡量邻近轨迹的收敛/发散速率；将观察端点从概率后移至logits，再后移至隐表示，分别进行理论分析；提出面向几何的微调以重塑隐层FTMLE，并给出高隐层FTMLE集中于决策边界附近的可保证条件；通过数值实验验证理论。
AI.result: 对高斯类，证明概率层FTMLE具有决策边界的清晰几何特征，其主导方向与边界法向对齐；后移到logits层时，该关系不再普遍成立，而关键取决于训练方式，尤其是损失函数选择；进一步后移到隐表示层时，联系更具条件性，边界相关的FTMLE仅可在可识别的结构条件下持续存在；数值结果支持上述理论。
AI.conclusion: 将样本演化理解为穿越分类器各层，为识别边界相关敏感性在何处涌现以及开发层感知正则化策略提供了原理性基础。

title: Agent Error Dataset: Scaling 50,000 Error--Diagnosis Pairs for Failure Analysis and Error-Aware Post-Training
summary: An unsuccessful LLM agent rollout contains more information than its final reward: the observations available to the agent, the actions it chose, and the environment's responses. Reusing this experience for learning requires identifying a decision to revise and testing a concrete alternative. We introduce the Agent Error Dataset (AED), comprising 50,228 error-diagnosis pairs from 9,961 source tasks across 33 environments, 19 harness families, and 23 policy models in text-based agent systems. We retain source traces and execution metadata to support cross-setting failure analysis and re-diagnosis without repeating the original rollout. Our five-stage Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) pipeline collects natural failures, generates diagnoses and proposed corrections, and checks them against recorded evidence. Where replay is supported, we compare corrections with original-action retries from the same checkpoint under matched execution settings. We then construct separate training views for diagnosis and actor recovery. Across 3,062 matched replay pairs, first-proposal corrections raise verifier pass rates from 18.4% to 51.1%, a gain of 32.7 percentage points. Using a separately frozen diagnosis release, full-diagnosis fine-tuning on 1,656 source tasks raises Qwen3-8B's exact-step agreement with internal teacher labels from 47.2% to 63.6%, averaged over three seeds on a 943-case holdout. The strongest prompted reference in this comparison scores 54.7%, and mean agreement improves at each of four increasing training-set sizes. In a single-seed comparison of actor-training recipes, action-only repair training scores 6.67 percentage points higher on WebShop-lite than success-only training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Agent Error Dataset (AED) 与 Agentic Error-to-Training (AET) 五阶段流水线，将失败 rollout 转化为可复用的误差诊断与纠错训练数据，显著提升纠错通过率与模型诊断一致性。
AI.motivation: 失败的 LLM agent rollout 中蕴含的信息远多于其最终奖励：包括观测、所选动作与环境反馈。但要将这些经验用于学习，必须能识别需要修正的决策并验证具体的替代方案，当前缺乏系统化的误差诊断数据与流程。
AI.method: 1) 构建 AED 数据集：来自 33 个环境、19 个 harness 家族、23 个策略模型、9,961 个源任务的 50,228 个误差诊断对，保留源轨迹与执行元数据以支持跨设定失败分析与再诊断；2) 设计五阶段 AET 流水线：采集自然失败、生成诊断与修正建议、依据记录证据校验；3) 在支持 replay 的情形下，将与原动作重试在相同 checkpoint 与匹配执行设定下对比；4) 分别构建面向诊断与 actor 恢复的训练视图。
AI.result: 在 3,062 对匹配 replay 中，首次提案修正将 verifier 通过率从 18.4% 提升至 51.1%（+32.7 个百分点）。使用单独冻结的诊断版本，在 1,656 个源任务上进行全诊断微调，使 Qwen3-8B 与内部教师标签的 exact-step 一致性从 47.2% 提升至 63.6%（943 个 holdout 上三 seed 平均）；最强 prompting 基线为 54.7%，且一致性在四种递增训练集规模上均提升。单 seed 的 actor 训练对比中，action-only repair 训练在 WebShop-lite 上比 success-only 训练高 6.67 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 失败 rollout 中的过程信息可被系统化转化为可复用的诊断与纠错训练信号；通过匹配 replay 校验与分离的诊断/actor 训练视图，该方法在纠错通过率与模型诊断一致性上均带来稳定且显著的提升。

title: Importance-Aware Feature Sparsification for Wireless Split Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Journal on Selected Areas in Communications
summary: Wireless split learning (SL) reduces on-device computation by offloading upper layers to a server, yet transmitting high-dimensional intermediate features at each iteration remains a major communication bottleneck. Existing methods select features at the client side using task-agnostic criteria such as magnitude, statistics, or clustering, which increases client-side processing and often degrades accuracy under non-independent and identically distributed (non-i.i.d.) client data. We propose importance-aware class-balanced sparsification (ICS), a lightweight approach in which the server ranks feature channels using Grad-CAM-based scores obtained from the true-class logit during backpropagation. The per-class scores are aggregated into a class-balanced, label-agnostic importance vector that mitigates head-class bias under label skew, and each client reuses this vector in the next round to retain the top-$N$ feature channels, incurring no additional client-side forward or backward passes. We further derive a non-asymptotic convergence bound that isolates the sparsification-induced error and characterizes how the sparsification ratio and mini-batch size jointly affect convergence under a fixed communication budget, and we analyze the communication and computational overhead of ICS against representative baselines. Beyond sequential CNN-based SL, we extend ICS to parallel split learning and to transformer-based models. Experiments show that ICS consistently outperforms the baselines, with larger gains under severe non-i.i.d. partitions.

AI.tldr: 无线分割学习(SL)中高维中间特征传输是通信瓶颈，本文提出重要性感知的类平衡稀疏化(ICS)：服务器用Grad-CAM分数对特征通道排序，聚合为类平衡且标签无关的重要性向量，客户端下轮据此保留Top-N通道，不增加额外前向/反向开销。
AI.motivation: 无线分割学习通过将上层卸载到服务器减少端侧计算，但每次迭代传输高维中间特征成为主要通信瓶颈。现有客户端侧特征选择方法依赖幅度、统计量或聚类等任务无关准则，增加了客户端处理负担，且在非独立同分布(non-i.i.d.)客户端数据下常导致精度下降。
AI.method: 提出ICS方法：服务器基于反向传播中真实类logit的Grad-CAM分数对特征通道排序；各类分数聚合为类平衡、标签无关的重要性向量，缓解标签偏斜下的头部类偏置；客户端在下一轮复用该向量保留Top-N特征通道，不产生额外客户端前向或反向传播。进一步推导非渐近收敛界，分离稀疏化引入的误差，刻画固定通信预算下稀疏率与mini-batch大小的联合影响，并分析ICS相对代表性基线的通信与计算开销。将ICS从串行CNN-based SL扩展到并行分割学习与Transformer模型。
AI.result: 实验表明ICS持续优于基线方法，在严重non-i.i.d.划分下增益更大。
AI.conclusion: ICS以极低的客户端开销实现了通信高效的无线分割学习，并通过类平衡重要性向量提升了标签偏斜下的精度，同时扩展至并行SL与Transformer架构，兼具理论收敛保证。

title: Unlearnable, or Unmeasured? On the Reliability of Difficulty Labels in RLVR
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training. Project page: https://syed-nazmus-sakib.github.io/Unlearnable-RLVR/
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important approach for improving reasoning during post-training. Recent work suggests that some difficult prompts remain resistant to learning even when they occasionally produce correct solutions. We revisit this unlearnability phenomenon and find that the affected prompts do improve, at roughly one third of the learnable rate, while the difficulty-defined set used to study them is much less reproducible than expected. These difficulty labels are estimated from a limited number of sampled responses. Combining them across seeds can further change which prompts are selected instead of simply reducing measurement noise. We develop a sampling-based framework for quantifying this instability and determining how much evaluation is required for difficulty assignments to reproduce reliably. We also revisit the gradient-similarity evidence proposed to explain unlearnability and show that part of the observed separation arises because difficult prompts provide fewer correct rollouts from which their gradients can be estimated. Matching this sample count weakens the gradient difference but does not remove it. Overall, the slow-learning phenomenon survives our reanalysis, while both the prompts used to define it and the evidence used to explain it require more careful measurement.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视RLVR中"难提示词不可学习"现象：这类提示词实际仍会以约1/3的可学习速率提升；而用于界定它们的难度标签可复现性远低于预期，梯度相似性证据也部分源于正确采样数不匹配。
AI.motivation: RLVR已成为提升复杂推理能力的重要后训练手段，但有研究提出部分难提示词即便偶尔能采样出正确解仍"学不动"。作者认为该结论依赖的难度标签与解释性证据可能存在测量偏差，因此需要重新检验这一现象的真实性与稳健性。
AI.method: （1）对所谓"不可学习"提示词重新进行学习率估计，检验其是否真的不提升；（2）指出难度标签由有限采样响应估计而来，考察跨随机种子的标签合并对提示词筛选的影响；（3）构建基于采样的量化框架，衡量难度划分的不稳定性及达到可靠复现所需的评估量；（4）重新检验梯度相似性证据，控制难提示词可提供的正确 rollout 数量后进行对比。
AI.result: 受影响的提示词确实会提升，速率约为可学习提示词的1/3；难度定义的提示词集合可复现性远低于预期，跨种子合并标签会改变筛选结果而非仅降低噪声；梯度相似性观察到的分离部分来自难提示词正确 rollout 更少，匹配采样量后梯度差异被削弱但未完全消失。
AI.conclusion: "慢学习"现象在重新分析后依然成立，但用于定义该现象的提示词集合和用于解释它的梯度证据都需要更严谨的测量与评估设计。

title: In a Streaming World, Should You Stand Still? A Comprehensive Benchmark of Anomaly Detection in Streams
summary: Time series anomaly detection (TSAD) is increasingly deployed in streaming settings, where data arrive sequentially and may exhibit non-stationarity. As a result, several works from the recent literature propose streaming anomaly detection methods that rely on incremental updates to adapt over time. However, most of these approaches originate from the streaming outlier detection literature and largely ignore core characteristics of time series anomalies. Moreover, their empirical evaluation is typically conducted on synthetic or small-scale benchmarks with limited diversity, making it unclear whether streaming methods are truly advantageous in realistic TSAD scenarios. In this work, we carry out the first large-scale experimental study comparing streaming and static TSAD methods under a unified streaming evaluation benchmark. We consider a realistic setting in which an initial batch of data is available for model training, followed by online evaluation of both detection accuracy and computational efficiency. In addition, we propose a distribution-drift dataset of real time series, called TSB- drift, to isolate scenarios where streaming updates are theoretically justified. Our results show that, contrary to common assumptions, static TSAD methods significantly outperform streaming approaches in most streaming settings. Such finding highlights a critical gap between the design of existing streaming methods and the requirements of modern TSAD, and calls for a rethinking of how streaming capabilities should be integrated into TSAD.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在大规模统一流式基准下系统比较流式与静态时间序列异常检测方法，并构建分布漂移数据集 TSB-drift，发现静态方法在多数流式场景中显著优于流式方法。
AI.motivation: 时间序列异常检测日益部署于流式场景，数据顺序到达且可能非平稳，近年文献提出依赖增量更新的流式检测方法。然而，这些方法多源于流式离群点检测文献，忽略了时间序列异常的核心特征；其经验评估通常基于合成或小规模、多样性有限的基准，难以判断流式方法在真实 TSAD 场景中是否真正具有优势。
AI.method: 作者开展首个大规模实验研究，在统一的流式评估基准下比较流式与静态 TSAD 方法。采用现实设定：初始批次数据用于模型训练，随后在线评估检测精度与计算效率。此外，提出基于真实时间序列的分布漂移数据集 TSB-drift，用于隔离流式更新在理论上具有合理性的场景。
AI.result: 结果显示，与常见假设相反，静态 TSAD 方法在大多数流式设置中显著优于流式方法。这一发现揭示了现有流式方法设计与现代 TSAD 需求之间的关键差距。
AI.conclusion: 该研究呼吁重新思考应如何将流式能力整合进时间序列异常检测，以弥合现有流式方法设计与现代 TSAD 实际需求之间的鸿沟。

title: Learning from Research: Toward Lifelong Agent Harness Evolution
summary: Language agents are expected to solve increasingly complex tasks, creating a growing need for continual improvement. One promising approach is to evolve the agent harness, the software that governs tool use, memory management, and task execution, while keeping the underlying language model fixed. Recent methods automate this process by using a meta coding agent to modify the harness based on execution feedback. However, relying on that agent's existing knowledge and observed failures can restrict exploration and make adaptation reactive. Inspired by how human experts learn from the research literature for new solutions, we introduce ScholarEvolve, a framework that automatically draws on state-of-the-art research to guide harness evolution. ScholarEvolve organizes the harness evolution directions into functional modules and uses topic modeling to identify distinct improvement strategies for each module. It implements these strategies and evaluates their combinations to improve task performance. Moreover, the framework is designed to incorporate new publications over time, allowing research advances to drive proactive lifelong evolution. Experiments demonstrate improvements on AppWorld and Tau2-Bench. ScholarEvolve raises Qwen3.5-27B task goal completion from 49.6% to 63.6% on AppWorld Challenge, and raises GPT-5.4-mini pass@1 from 72.7% to 81.9% on Tau2-Bench Telecom.

AI.tldr: 提出 ScholarEvolve 框架，利用前沿研究文献自动指导语言智能体 harness 的演化，在 AppWorld 与 Tau2-Bench 上显著提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体任务日趋复杂，需要持续改进。在固定底层语言模型的前提下，演化 agent harness（管理工具使用、记忆与任务执行的软件）是可行路径。但现有自动化方法依赖元编码智能体的既有知识与已观测到的失败，探索受限且改进呈被动反应式。
AI.method: 受人类专家从研究文献中学习新方案启发，ScholarEvolve 自动引入前沿研究来引导 harness 演化：将演化方向按功能模块组织，用主题建模为每个模块识别不同的改进策略；随后实现这些策略并评估其组合以提升任务表现；框架还支持随时间纳入新发表文献，实现由研究进展驱动的主动式终身演化。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 上，ScholarEvolve 将 Qwen3.5-27B 的任务目标完成率从 49.6% 提升至 63.6%（AppWorld Challenge）；在 Tau2-Bench Telecom 上，将 GPT-5.4-mini 的 pass@1 从 72.7% 提升至 81.9%。
AI.conclusion: 以研究文献驱动的 harness 演化可在不改变底层模型的情况下带来稳定增益，并具备随新文献持续终身演化的潜力。

title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly moving toward lower precision to realize the throughput of hardware accelerators, but aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ) can degrade model quality. We present QATFactory, an open-source framework for deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation (QAD) and reinforcement learning (QARL).
