The results show that resistance to the planted premise varies more strongly by model family and generation than by scale, while brief-reading competence forms a partly separate dimension. These behaviours are not captured by conventional world-correctness scores or single-shot evaluation. We release the implementation, spatial briefs, model outputs, and claim-level labels as a reproducible workflow at github.com/perezjoan/NSCR-LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于步行街道路网的开放空间上下文检索流程（NSCR），构建"忠实性基准"，检验LLM在获得结构化空间上下文后是从上下文推理还是以其参数化记忆覆盖上下文，并在16个开源模型配置、3个城市上评估。
AI.motivation: LLM虽编码了大量潜在地理知识，但对空间推理能力差，仅凭坐标查询不可靠；只有在提示中提供结构化空间上下文时才表现出有用行为。地理评估领域尚未考察一个关键问题：上下文供给后，模型究竟是基于上下文推理，还是用自身参数化回忆覆盖它。
AI.method: 提出开放流程NSCR：以行人街道路网定义"可步行到达"的空间范围，仅用开放数据与开源权重模型，从OpenStreetMap与GHS-POP人口栅格检索特征，在代码中于网络汇水区上计算指标，并注入为紧凑的"空间简报"。据此构建忠实性基准：对模型每条论断按来源（基于简报/来自训练知识）与正确性打标签，并用简报可反驳的植入式错误前提逐例探测。评估Qwen、Gemma（两代）、Llama三族、四个规模档、含思考与非思考模式共16个开源权重配置，在3个对比城市上每例重采样10个种子。
AI.result: 对植入错误前提的抵抗能力，按模型族与代际的差异强于按规模的差异；而"阅读简报的能力"构成一个相对独立的维度。这些行为无法由传统世界正确性分数或单次评估捕获。
AI.conclusion: 模型对结构化空间上下文的忠实性是多维且与规模弱相关的现象，需以基于来源标注与对抗性前提的忠实性评测替代传统正确性指标；作者公开实现、空间简报、模型输出与论断级标签于github.com/perezjoan/NSCR-LLM。

title: Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters: A Causal Intervention for Routing Collapse in Time Series Foundation Models
summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) commonly adapt to new data by attaching a single trainable head to a frozen backbone, a one-size-fits-all setup that underfits heterogeneous regimes. Replacing the head with a mixture of experts is the standard upgrade, but on instance-normalized backbones (the dominant TSFM design class) it fails: routing entropy collapses to zero and one expert absorbs every input, a failure we call normalization-induced routing collapse. Standard MoE rescue mechanisms do not repair it, because the cause is in the router's input, not its optimization. Pre-encoder normalization strips the statistics a router would need to tell regimes apart. A mutual-information decomposition makes this precise and yields a signal-ratio that, computed before training, predicts dataset vulnerability (Spearman $ρ= -0.88$). Eight causal controls, including a vision-modality replication, isolate instance normalization as the cause. The prescription is a minimal causal intervention: Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters (RR-MoA), which routes on the raw, pre-normalization input. Under a strictly frozen backbone, RR-MoA wins 54/54 comparisons against the strongest fixed adapter and significantly outperforms LoRA, TRACE, AdaMix, and full fine-tuning. The effect generalizes across six backbones and an imputation task. Frozen RR-MoA also beats full fine-tuning by 12-79% (the Frozen Paradox); two architecturally distinct variants confirm the principle generalizes beyond this specific router.

AI.tldr: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在冻结主干上接单一适配头会欠拟合异构数据；改用专家混合（MoE）在实例归一化主干上会因“归一化诱导路由坍缩”而失效。作者提出在原始（归一化前）输入上路由的 RR-MoA，作为最小因果干预，在冻结主干下取得 54/54 全胜并显著优于多种微调方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 TSFM 适配采用单一可训练头，属“一刀切”方案，难以覆盖异构数据机制（regimes）。常规升级为 MoE，但在占主导地位的实例归一化（instance-normalized）主干设计上会失效——路由熵坍缩为零、单个专家吸收全部输入。既有 MoE 救援机制无法修复，因为问题根源在路由器的输入（统计量被预编码归一化剥离），而非其优化过程。
AI.method: 1) 通过互信息分解精确定位坍缩成因，推导出训练前即可计算的 signal-ratio，用于预测数据集脆弱性；2) 设计八项因果控制实验（含视觉模态复现）以隔离实例归一化为致因；3) 提出最小因果干预方案 Raw-Routed Mixture of Adapters（RR-MoA），在原始、归一化前的输入上进行路由；4) 在严格冻结主干条件下，与最强固定适配器、LoRA、TRACE、AdaMix 及全量微调对比，并跨六个主干与插补任务验证；5) 用两个架构上不同的变体验证原则的普适性。
AI.result: signal-ratio 对数据集脆弱性的预测达到 Spearman ρ = -0.88；八项因果控制（含视觉模态复现）确认实例归一化为致因。冻结主干下 RR-MoA 对最强固定适配器取得 54/54 全胜，并显著优于 LoRA、TRACE、AdaMix 与全量微调；效果在六个主干及一个插补任务上可泛化。冻结的 RR-MoA 还比全量微调高出 12–79%（“冻结悖论”）。
AI.conclusion: 在实例归一化的 TSFM 主干部署 MoE 时，路由坍缩源于预编码归一化剥离了路由器所需的数据统计量，而非优化问题；将路由放置在原始输入上即可修复。RR-MoA 以最小因果干预实现了对异构机制的强适配，并在冻结主干约束下全面超越固定适配与主流参数高效微调及全量微调，且原则可跨主干、跨任务、跨架构推广。

title: Mutual Equilibrium: Multimodal Representation Learning through Reciprocal Feedback
summary: This work proposes a mutual feedback architecture, MEQ, that refines the two inputs, of possibly different modalities, into a pair of coupled embeddings such that each embedding reflects the information of the other. The core idea is to incorporate continuous interchange of information between the two inputs. This idea leads to a mutual feedback architecture consisting of two components whose outputs are fed back into the other. The final output of this model is defined as the fixed point of this interaction. We provide theoretical analysis that offers interpretation of this model as well as design choices to prevent failure cases. We show the benefits of MEQ through classification and visual grounding tasks spanning various datasets. Quantitatively, our model outperforms or shows competitive performance on concatenation-based multimodal classification problems. Qualitatively, the proposed interactive mechanism allows the model to progressively refine the visual grounding when paired with complementary modality, thus demonstrating the power of mutual feedback under such settings.

AI.tldr: 提出互反馈架构MEQ，将两种模态输入精炼为一对耦合嵌入，每者蕴含对方信息，输出定义为交互的不动点。
AI.motivation: 多模态输入融合通常采用简单拼接等方式，缺乏模态间持续的信息交换，难以充分挖掘互补模态的交互潜力。
AI.method: 构建由两个组件组成的互反馈架构，组件输出互相回馈至对方，形成信息连续交换；模型最终输出定义为该交互过程的不动点，并进行理论分析以解释模型并防止失败情形。
AI.result: 在多数据集上的分类与视觉定位任务中，定量上优于或媲美基于拼接的多模态分类方法；定性上，与互补模态配对时可逐步精炼视觉定位。
AI.conclusion: 互反馈机制在多模态场景下具有有效性，能够通过迭代交互提升性能，尤其在互补模态辅助视觉定位时展现出优势。

title: Understanding Head Geometry and Dynamics in Federated Regression through a Natural Solution Selection Rule: An Unconstrained Feature Model Analysis
summary: In federated averaging, local objectives can admit multiple optimal heads, making the aggregate depend on which heads clients return. We study this ambiguity in federated multivariate regression with private backbones and a shared linear head, using an unconstrained feature model (UFM) that treats training-sample features as free variables. We introduce a natural selection rule: each client returns the optimal head closest to the broadcast head. We show that global minimization with a vanishing proximal penalty on the head realizes this rule. When the clients' optimal Gram matrices and the initial shared Gram matrix are positive definite, the shared Gram matrix follows a closed recursion and converges to the unique Bures-Wasserstein barycenter of the clients' optimal Gram matrices. Even with this alignment, the limit generally differs from the centralized optimal Gram matrix. We decompose this gap into three positive-semidefinite terms arising from differences in client target means, covariance heterogeneity, and averaging the aligned heads. A correction based on a one-time exchange of target means and covariances recovers the centralized optimal Gram matrix in one round under exact local optimization and the same selection rule. We verify these results numerically in the UFM and test its predictions on five tabular and five image regression datasets using deep networks with feature regularization and long local training. In these experiments, ordinary training approaches the predicted barycenter, while a weak proximal penalty improves endpoint agreement and yields trajectories that closely follow the predicted Gram dynamics. The correction moves the final Gram matrices close to the centralized UFM prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究联邦多元回归中因局部最优头不唯一导致的聚合歧义问题，基于无约束特征模型（UFM）提出“返回最接近广播头的最优头”选择规则，证明共享Gram矩阵按闭式递推收敛到各客户端最优Gram矩阵的唯一Bures-Wasserstein重心，并给出与集中式最优之间的差距分解及一次性校正方法。
AI.motivation: 联邦平均中，各客户端局部目标可能存在多个最优头（optimal heads），导致聚合结果依赖于客户端实际返回哪个头，产生不确定性；同时私有的backbone与共享线性头结构下，这种歧义如何影响全局解、能否刻画其收敛行为并缩小与集中式训练的差距，尚缺乏理论分析。
AI.method: 采用无约束特征模型（UFM），将训练样本特征视为自由变量；引入选择规则：每个客户端返回最接近广播头的最优头；用消失的近端惩罚（vanishing proximal penalty）对头做全局最小化以实现该规则；在客户端最优Gram矩阵与初始共享Gram矩阵正定条件下推导共享Gram矩阵的闭式递推；将极限与集中式最优Gram矩阵的差距分解为三个半正定项；提出基于一次性交换目标均值与协方差（one-time exchange of target means and covariances）的校正；在UFM下数值验证，并在5个表格与5个图像回归数据集上用深度网络（含特征正则与长局部训练）测试预测。
AI.result: 当客户端最优Gram矩阵与初始共享Gram矩阵正定时，共享Gram矩阵遵循闭式递推并收敛到客户端最优Gram矩阵的唯一Bures-Wasserstein重心；即使对齐，极限一般仍不同于集中式最优Gram矩阵；差距可分解为来自客户端目标均值差异、协方差异质性以及对齐头平均的三个半正定项；一次性交换目标均值与协方差的校正，在精确实局部优化与相同选择规则下可一轮恢复集中式最优Gram矩阵；实验中普通训练趋近预测重心，弱近端惩罚改善端点一致性并使轨迹贴近预测的Gram动态，校正后最终Gram矩阵接近集中式UFM预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为联邦平均中局部最优头歧义提供了基于UFM的理论刻画：共享Gram矩阵收敛到Bures-Wasserstein重心，并可通过差距分解与一次性统计量交换校正显著逼近集中式最优解；数值与深度网络实验支持该预测。

title: T-ARC: Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering via Distributionally Robust Stochastic Block Models
summary:
In this work, we introduce a new clustering method, namely T-ARC (Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering), that corrects the geometric bias of K-means by embedding topological information directly into the optimization objective. Building on the assumption that the data admits an underlying hidden structure modeled via a latent graph, the idea is to uncover this information through the interplay between the standard K-means data-fidelity term and a graph-cut penalty, which discourages cluster assignments inconsistent with the connectivity structure of the data.
  To render this coupling tractable, the latent graph is modeled as a random realization from a Stochastic Block Model (SBM), whose scalar parameter is optimized within a Distributionally Robust Optimization (DRO) framework, yielding a closed-form proximal update. Both SBM and DRO are informed by a persistence-based similarity matrix derived from zero-dimensional persistent homology ($H_0$), which translates the multiscale connectivity structure of the data into a pairwise topological prior. The overall optimization proceeds via Block Coordinate Descent; convergence is established through a global Lyapunov functional: the deterministic blocks satisfy monotonic descent, while the stochastic graph update satisfies descent in expectation, so that the expected energy converges.
  Experiments on synthetic datasets with non-convex geometries and on random subsets of Fashion-MNIST show that T-ARC recovers latent topological structures where K-means fails, achieving the highest accuracy on curved and interleaved clusters while remaining competitive, and markedly more stable than K-means, on real data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 T-ARC（Topology-Aware Randomized Clustering），通过将拓扑信息直接嵌入优化目标来纠正 K-means 的几何偏置；在潜在图上以随机块模型（SBM）建模并由分布式鲁棒优化（DRO）优化其标量参数，结合来自零维持久同调（H₀）的相似度矩阵，以块坐标下降求解并借助全局 Lyapunov 泛函证明收敛，在非凸合成数据与 Fashion-MNIST 子集上优于或媲美 K-means。
AI.motivation: K-means 存在几何偏置，倾向于产生球形、凸的聚类，难以恢复数据中非凸、弯曲或交织的潜在拓扑结构。作者希望在不放弃 K-means 数据保真项简洁性的前提下，弥补其几何假设的不足。
AI.method: 提出 T-ARC：假设数据存在由潜在图刻画的隐藏结构，将标准 K-means 数据保真项与图割惩罚耦合，以惩罚与数据连通结构不一致的簇分配。为使其可解，潜在图被建模为随机块模型（SBM）的一次随机实现，其标量参数在分布式鲁棒优化（DRO）框架内优化，得到闭式近端更新。SBM 与 DRO 均由基于零维持久同调（H₀）的持久性相似度矩阵驱动，将多尺度连通结构转化为成对拓扑先验。整体优化采用块坐标下降，并通过全局 Lyapunov 泛函证明收敛：确定性块单调下降，随机图更新在期望意义下下降，从而期望能量收敛。
AI.result: 在具有非凸几何结构的合成数据集以及 Fashion-MNIST 的随机子集上，T-ARC 能恢复 K-means 失败的潜在拓扑结构；在弯曲与交织簇上取得最高准确率，在真实数据上表现具有竞争力，且显著比 K-means 更稳定。
AI.conclusion: T-ARC 通过将持久同调导出的拓扑先验与 SBM/DRO 驱动的随机图惩罚融入 K-means 目标，有效纠正其几何偏置，在非凸结构恢复与稳定性上优于 K-means，同时保持竞争力；块坐标下降与 Lyapunov 泛函分析为其收敛性提供了理论保证。

title: Also Small Models Can Reasonably Self-Evaluate Their Confidence
summary: This study systematically evaluates self-evaluation-based uncertainty quantification across different language models of varying sizes on question-answering tasks spanning general to specialized knowledge domains. Using various self-evaluation methods where models judge their own predictions, we examine how model scale and domain specificity affect the quality of self-assessed confidence signals. Our results reveal that while accuracy predictably declines with smaller models and more specialized domains, the reliability of self-evaluated confidence remains largely stable across both dimensions. This independence means the most capable model is not necessarily the best at self-assessing prediction reliability. These findings suggest that smaller models can achieve reasonable self-assessed confidence despite lower accuracy, making them viable for resource-constrained deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了不同规模语言模型在通用到专业问答任务上的自评估式不确定性量化，发现自评估置信度的可靠性在模型规模和领域专业性两个维度上基本保持稳定，与准确率的变化趋势相独立。
AI.motivation: 自评估式不确定性量化（模型对自身预测的置信度判断）对于可靠部署至关重要，但尚不清楚模型规模与领域专业性是否会削弱这种自评估置信信号的质量。作者希望厘清准确率与置信度可靠性之间的关系，尤其是在资源受限场景下小模型是否可用。
AI.method: 采用多种自评估方法，让模型对自身预测进行判断，在覆盖通用到专业知识的问答任务上，跨不同规模的语言模型系统地评估其不确定性量化表现，并沿模型规模与领域专业性两个维度进行对比分析。
AI.result: 准确率如预期般随模型规模减小和领域更专业化而下降；但自评估置信度的可靠性在这两个维度上大体保持稳定，即自评估能力与准确率并不同步变化。
AI.conclusion: 自评估置信度的可靠性与模型规模和领域专业性相互独立，能力最强的模型未必最擅长评估自身预测的可靠性；小模型虽准确率较低，但仍能给出合理的自评估置信度，因而适用于资源受限的部署场景。

title: Correcting CondOT: Exact Finite-Step Sampling in Gaussian Flow Matching
summary: Flow matching generates samples by gradually transforming noise into data. In practice, using a finite number of sampling steps introduces a numerical error that depends on the chosen schedule. We study this dependence for Gaussian targets and the explicit midpoint sampling method, using the exact flow field. We measure sampling error by the squared Wasserstein distance between the target distribution and the final distribution produced by the midpoint sampler. We show that the standard conditional optimal transport (CondOT) schedule cancels the leading midpoint error and improves the general convergence bound, even when the sampling steps are unequally spaced. On a uniform grid of $S$ sampling steps, we fix the signal schedule at $α_t=t$ and prove the existence of scalar noise schedules $β_t$ that approach the CondOT noise schedule $1-t$ at rate $1/S$ and yield exact Gaussian sampling for every sufficiently large $S$. Controlled Gaussian experiments illustrate the convergence rates and exact calibration.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究高斯目标下流匹配（flow matching）采样误差对调度（schedule）的依赖，采用精确流场与显式中点法，以Wasserstein距离平方度量误差，证明CondOT调度可消除中点法的主阶误差并存在接近CondOT噪声调度的精确高斯采样调度。
AI.motivation: 流匹配通过将噪声逐步变换为数据来生成样本，但有限采样步数会引入依赖所选调度的数值误差。作者希望理解并量化该误差对调度的依赖，从而改进采样调度。
AI.method: 针对高斯目标，使用精确流场和显式中点采样法；以目标分布与中点采样器输出分布间的Wasserstein距离平方作为误差度量；分析标准条件最优传输（CondOT）调度对主阶中点误差的抵消作用，并在均匀网格（S步）上固定信号调度α_t=t，构造标量噪声调度β_t。
AI.result: CondOT调度能够抵消主阶中点误差并改进一般收敛界，即使采样步非等距也成立；在均匀网格上，存在以速率1/S逼近CondOT噪声调度1-t的噪声调度β_t，对每个足够大的S实现精确高斯采样；受控高斯实验验证了收敛速率与精确校准。
AI.conclusion: 调度选择对流匹配的有限步采样误差有决定性影响；CondOT调度可消除中点法主阶误差，且存在近似CondOT的噪声调度可实现精确高斯采样，理论与实验一致。

title: Towards Robust Time Series Learning via Capacity-Centric Modulation
summary: Sample-level reliability heterogeneity is common in deep time series learning. Standard training pipelines apply a uniform regularization setting to all samples, which can under-regularize corrupted samples and over-restrict clean samples. Common robustness approaches filter observations in data space or impose priors on latent representations. We propose Capacity-Centric Modulation (CCM) as a complementary, sample-adaptive regularization principle. Under this principle, we introduce SACM (Sample-Adaptive Capacity Modulation), a task-agnostic framework that exploits spectral sparsity to assign sample-wise dropout probabilities along internal activation paths. SACM integrates into existing backbones without architectural redesign and preserves the deterministic inference pipeline. Across 301 real-world dataset-backbone pairs covering 9 forecasting, 32 classification, and 4 anomaly-detection datasets, SACM reduces forecasting MSE by 6.7% on average and improves classification accuracy and point-adjusted F1 by 3.04% and 17.05%, respectively, relative to unmodified backbones, with zero test-time overhead.

AI.tldr: 针对深度时间序列学习中样本级可靠性异质性问题，论文提出以样本自适应正则化为核心的CCM原理，并实现任务无关框架SACM，利用频谱稀疏性为内部激活路径分配样本级dropout概率。在301个真实数据集-骨干网络组合上，SACM平均降低预测MSE 6.7%，提升分类准确率3.04%、点调整F1 17.05%，且无额外测试开销。
AI.motivation: 深度时间序列学习中样本级可靠性存在异质性，但标准训练流程对所有样本使用统一正则化设置，导致对损坏样本正则不足、对干净样本过度约束。现有鲁棒性方法多在数据空间过滤观测或对潜在表示施加先验，缺乏一种补充性的样本自适应正则化机制。
AI.method: 提出Capacity-Centric Modulation（CCM）作为样本自适应正则化原理，并据此设计SACM（Sample-Adaptive Capacity Modulation）任务无关框架。SACM利用频谱稀疏性，为内部激活路径分配样本级dropout概率，可直接集成到现有骨干网络而无需重新设计架构，并保持确定性推理流程。
AI.result: 在301个真实数据集-骨干网络组合上评估，覆盖9个预测、32个分类和4个异常检测数据集。相对于未修改的骨干网络，SACM平均降低预测MSE 6.7%，分类准确率提升3.04%，点调整F1提升17.05%，且测试阶段零额外开销。
AI.conclusion: SACM作为一种通用、即插即用的样本自适应正则化方法，通过频谱稀疏性驱动的激活路径dropout有效缓解样本可靠性异质性问题，在预测、分类与异常检测任务上均取得一致增益，且不增加推理成本，具有良好的实用性与泛化性。

title: When the Right Answer Is Missing: An Arithmetic-Dependent Rejection Bottleneck in Jev
summary: Typed decision models such as Jev offer an efficient alternative to generative LLMs in decision-making workflows by selecting directly from predefined options. When candidate sets contain no valid answer, TypeSafe recommends including an "other" or "none-of-the-above" option to enable rejection. In this report, however, we identify an arithmetic-dependent rejection bottleneck: Jev reliably selects correct numerical answers when available but frequently accepts incorrect alternatives when they are absent despite an explicit rejection option. On paired arithmetic problems, answer-present accuracy reaches 99%, while correct rejection falls to 7%. Moreover, this gap persists across numerical magnitudes, operation depths, contextual formulations, and rejection labels, and extends to scenarios such as time calculation and capacity rounding. Yet native Boolean verification achieves 99% exact-match accuracy on the same answer-absent arithmetic cases, showing that categorical rejection can fail even when the model successfully verifies candidate correctness. Finally, we show that a simple decision threshold selected on separate development problems raises arithmetic rejection accuracy from 7% to 79% while retaining 97% answer-present accuracy, substantially mitigating the failure without retraining or additional inference.

AI.tldr: 类型化决策模型(如Jev)在算术问题上存在"拒答瓶颈":有正确答案时准确率99%,但在无正确答案且提供拒答选项时,正确拒答率仅7%;原生布尔验证可达99%准确率,说明拒答失败并非能力不足,而可通过决策阈值调整显著缓解。
AI.motivation: 类型化决策模型(如Jev)通过从预定义选项中选择来决策,相较生成式LLM更高效。TypeSafe建议在候选集无有效答案时加入"other/none-of-the-above"选项以实现拒答。但作者发现:当候选集中不含正确答案时,这类模型频繁接受错误选项,即使存在显式拒答选项,形成算术依赖的拒答瓶颈,需要揭示并缓解。
AI.method: 构造成对的算术问题(有答案/无答案),测试Jev的答案存在准确率与正确答案缺失时的拒答率;在不同数值量级、运算深度、语境表述、拒答标签下检验差距的稳健性,并扩展至时间计算、容量取整等场景;对比模型原生布尔验证在同一无答案算术样本上的表现;最后在独立开发集上选取单一决策阈值,无需重训练或额外推理。
AI.result: 答案存在时准确率达99%,而正确答案缺失时正确拒答率仅7%;该差距在不同数值量级、运算深度、语境形式与拒答标签下持续存在,并延伸至时间计算与容量取整等任务。原生布尔验证在相同无答案算术样本上达到99%精确匹配准确率。在独立开发问题上选取的简单决策阈值,将算术拒答准确率从7%提升至79%,同时保持97%的答案存在准确率。
AI.conclusion: 类型化决策模型的拒答失败并非源于无法验证候选正确性,而是分类式拒答机制本身的缺陷;通过简单的决策阈值调整即可在无重训练、无额外推理的条件下显著缓解该失败,为可靠性提升提供低成本方案。

title: The Geometry of Randomized Smoothing on Feasible Sets
summary: Randomized smoothing certifies the probability of a fixed output event as the center of Gaussian noise moves. Feasibility or confidence filtering reports label probabilities only among retained proposals, producing a ratio. Its numerator is a fixed Gaussian event mass, while its denominator is the probability of retention and can change with the center. Substituting this ratio into the ordinary smoothing formula can therefore certify a ball that contains a decision boundary. We separate the problem into a geometric question and a certification question. Geometry determines when conditioning preserves Gaussian comparisons. Convex retained sets preserve the full comparison, while general sets require geometric control of the retained law as the center moves. Without such control, conditional probabilities imply no positive universal radius. Joint retention-and-label probabilities always yield a valid certificate for the same filtered predictor. A uniform covariance bound transfers divergence certificates to the retained law and can yield larger radii even when the Gaussian event comparison fails. Both methods admit finite-sample bounds. For a learned image classifier with a training-selected nonconvex filter, conditional Rényi bounds certify more images than joint-mass bounds without additional model evaluations. A released confidence filter exhibits verified label changes inside radii obtained by conditional substitution. An application of adaptive Gaussian composition covers causal finite-horizon executions with history-dependent center shifts under a pathwise energy bound.

AI.tldr: 本文分析随机平滑在置信/可行性过滤场景下的认证问题，区分条件概率与联合概率两条路径：条件替换可能认证含决策边界的球，联合质量始终有效；在几何控制或协方差界下可恢复有效认证，并在分类器与因果执行场景实验验证。
AI.motivation: 可行性或置信过滤只报告保留提案之间的标签概率，形成比值：分子是固定高斯事件质量，分母是保留概率且随中心变化。将该比值直接代入普通平滑公式，可能认证包含决策边界的球（伪认证）。因此需要厘清何时条件化保持高斯比较、何时失效，并给出有效替代认证方案。
AI.method: 将问题拆为几何问题与认证问题。几何上：凸保留集保持完整高斯比较；一般集合需对中心移动下保留分布做几何控制，否则条件概率不蕴含正的全域半径。认证上：1）联合保留-标签概率对同一过滤预测器始终给出有效证书；2）均匀协方差界把散度证书迁移到保留分布，即使高斯事件比较失效也可能获得更大半径；两者均给出有限样本界。另用自适应高斯组合处理因果有限时域执行中的历史相关中心偏移（路径能量界下）。
AI.result: 在学习型图像分类器上，训练选择的非凸过滤器下，条件Rényi界比联合质量界认证更多图像，且不增加模型评估；某公开置信过滤器在条件替换获得的半径内出现已验证的标签变化。协方差界迁移与联合质量法均具有限样本保证。
AI.conclusion: 条件式替换一般不安全，可能覆盖决策边界；有效认证应由联合质量或受几何/协方差控制的迁移证书给出。条件Rényi界在非凸过滤下更紧、认证更多样本，但必须辅以几何或协方差条件；该方法可扩展至自适应高斯组合下的因果执行。

title: Can Domain Generalization be Guaranteed in Small-Sample Learning?
summary: The small-sample learning problem remains a fundamental challenge in machine learning because limited training data lead to unstable model estimation and generalization. Structural Risk Minimization (SRM) has long been regarded as a principled solution under the classical i.i.d. assumption. However, domain generalization (DG) violates this assumption, leaving the theoretical role of SRM in DG largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we establish the first theoretical guarantees for SRM in DG under mild assumptions. Specifically, based on the concept of stability, we derive learning consistency and generalization error bounds and prove that these bounds become tight when the hypotheses satisfy the stability condition. Building upon this, under a specific hypothesis space assumption, we establish stability, learning, and generalization bounds for SRM. We further discuss the applicability of these bounds to deep learning. This work establishes theoretical foundations for SRM under distribution shifts and sheds light on the design of robust DG algorithms in small-sample scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为域泛化(DG)场景下的结构风险最小化(SRM)建立理论保证，基于稳定性概念推导出学习一致性与泛化误差界。
AI.motivation: 小样本学习仍是机器学习的根本挑战：有限的训练数据导致模型估计与泛化不稳定。SRM在经典i.i.d.假设下被视为原则性解决方案，但域泛化(DG)违背了i.i.d.假设，使SRM在DG中的理论作用长期未被探索，存在理论空白。
AI.method: 基于稳定性(stability)概念，在温和假设下为DG中的SRM建立理论保证：推导学习一致性与泛化误差界，证明当假设满足稳定性条件时界变紧；在特定假设空间假设下，进一步建立SRM的稳定性界、学习界与泛化界，并讨论这些界在深度学习中的适用性。
AI.result: 得到DG下SRM的首个理论保证：学习一致性与泛化误差界，且证明在稳定性条件满足时界变紧；在特定假设空间假设下给出SRM的稳定性、学习与泛化界，并说明其对深度学习的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为分布偏移下的SRM奠定了理论基础，并为小样本场景下鲁棒DG算法的设计提供了理论启示。

title: CIDER-FM: Foundation Models for Causal Inference from Diverse Experimental Regimes
summary: Causal foundation models (CFMs) amortise causal inference over priors of synthetic structural causal models (SCMs), predicting the effect of an experiment on a specific variable. However, observational data alone may leave multiple causal models compatible with available evidence, while experimental data with interventions on exactly the variable of interest might be unavailable. This work studies CFMs as a method to combine finite observational and surrogate-interventional datasets in order to predict a target conditional interventional distribution (CID) more accurately than with observational data alone. We first formalise the conceptual benefits of surrogate experiments. Building on this analysis, we introduce \textsc{Foundation Models for Causal Inference from Diverse Experimental Regimes} (\emph{CIDER-FM}), a causal foundation model that uses an intervention-aware representation and hierarchical three-axis attention to exchange information across variables, samples, and experimental regimes. We evaluate CIDER-FM against a wide range of baselines across diverse synthetic graph and mechanism families, as well as on both simulated and real-world data from Causal Chambers. Our results demonstrate strong CID prediction performance and show that incorporating experimental context can improve predictions over observational data alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CIDER-FM，一个因果基础模型，通过结合有限观测数据与代理干预数据，预测目标条件干预分布（CID）。模型采用干预感知表示与三轴分层注意力机制，跨变量、样本和实验体制交换信息。在合成图与机制族、仿真及真实 Causal Chambers 数据上，CID 预测性能优于多种基线，且引入实验上下文可提升仅用观测数据的预测。
AI.motivation: 因果基础模型（CFMs）依赖合成结构因果模型先验摊销因果推断，但仅凭观测数据可能无法唯一确定因果模型，而对目标变量的精确干预实验数据又往往不可得。因此需要研究如何融合有限的观测数据与代理干预数据，以更准确地预测目标条件干预分布。
AI.method: 首先形式化代理实验的概念性收益；在此基础上提出 CIDER-FM，采用干预感知表示与分层三轴注意力机制，在变量、样本和实验体制三个维度上交换信息。
AI.result: 在多种合成图与机制族、以及来自 Causal Chambers 的仿真与真实数据上，与广泛基线对比，CID 预测性能强，且引入实验上下文能改善相对仅观测数据的预测。
AI.conclusion: CIDER-FM 表明将代理实验与观测数据结合可提升目标条件干预分布预测，验证了实验上下文对因果基础模型的价值。

title: Learning Reliable GUI Agents under Imperfect Priors
summary: GUI agents built on large language and vision-language models still struggle on unseen applications and complex multi-step tasks, as completing real GUI tasks depends on app-specific, temporally volatile operational knowledge that is scarce in pretraining corpora. Retrieval-augmented execution offers a natural remedy but faces two coupled bottlenecks: knowledge at scale is hard to acquire, and self-collected priors inevitably drift from the live environment due to version updates, promotions, ads, A/B tests, and personalization. We therefore argue that GUI agents should not pursue perfect knowledge but learn to act correctly under imperfect priors, and propose our framework that couples knowledge acquisition with noise-robust utilization: a structured exploration strategy traverses interactive elements, builds a UI state-transition graph, and synthesizes (task, trajectory) pairs via a VLM without human annotation; a noise-aware training strategy, grounded in a taxonomy of real GUI drift patterns, injects five types of realistic errors into self-explored trajectories to teach the agent to assess prior reliability before acting. Experiments on physical devices and online emulator benchmarks show that our method discovers more unique screens, covers more benchmark tasks, and more effectively rejects erroneous priors while leveraging correct ones, with accuracy gains that transfer across datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向GUI智能体的框架，将知识获取与噪声鲁棒利用结合：用结构化探索自动构建UI状态转移图并合成(任务,轨迹)数据，再通过注入五类真实漂移错误的噪声感知训练，使智能体在不完善先验下仍能正确行动。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言与视觉语言模型的GUI智能体在未见应用和复杂多步任务上表现不佳，因为完成真实GUI任务依赖应用专属且随时间快速变化的操作知识，而预训练语料中此类知识稀缺。检索增强执行虽可缓解，但面临两个耦合瓶颈：大规模知识难以获取，且自采集先验会因版本更新、推广、广告、A/B测试和个性化而与实际环境漂移。作者据此主张不应追求完美知识，而应学会在不完美先验下正确行动。
AI.method: 框架包含两部分：1）结构化探索策略，遍历交互元素、构建UI状态转移图，并借助VLM在无人工标注下合成(任务,轨迹)对以获取知识；2）噪声感知训练策略，基于真实GUI漂移模式分类体系，向自探索轨迹注入五类现实错误，训练智能体在行动前评估先验可靠性。
AI.result: 在物理设备和在线模拟器基准上的实验表明，该方法能发现更多独特屏幕、覆盖更多基准任务，更有效地拒绝错误先验并利用正确先验，且精度提升可跨数据集泛化迁移。
AI.conclusion: GUI智能体的知识获取与鲁棒利用应协同设计；接受先验不完美并通过噪声感知训练提升可靠性判别能力，是实现跨应用、跨环境泛化的可行路径。

title: Hyperbolic Prototype Routing for Rehearsal-Free Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to continually learn new classes while preserving prior knowledge. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning with pre-trained models enables CIL with minimal parameter updates, but existing approaches still suffer from catastrophic forgetting caused by cumulative interference and suboptimal module-sample matching at inference. We propose Hyperbolic Prototype Routing (HyPro), a rehearsal-free framework for continual learning. HyPro allocates a dedicated LoRA-Expert module to each incremental task for isolated representation learning, then projects routing features onto a Poincare ball and performs geodesic nearest-prototype matching for reliable task-level discrimination. Extensive experiments on standard CIL and Few-Shot CIL benchmarks show that HyPro consistently improves average and final-stage accuracy over strong baselines.

AI.tldr: HyPro是一个免回放的类增量学习框架，为每个增量任务分配专属LoRA-Expert模块实现表示隔离，并利用庞加莱球上的测地最近原型匹配进行任务判别，在标准与少样本CIL基准上持续提升平均及最终阶段准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于预训练模型参数高效微调的CIL方法仍受灾难性遗忘困扰，其根源是累积干扰，以及推理阶段模块与样本匹配不佳。
AI.method: 免回放框架：1) 为每个增量任务分配专用LoRA-Expert模块，实现隔离式表示学习以缓解累积干扰；2) 将路由特征投影到Poincare球（双曲空间），通过测地最近原型匹配实现可靠的任务级判别。
AI.result: 在标准CIL与Few-Shot CIL基准上的大量实验表明，HyPro在平均准确率和最终阶段准确率上均持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: HyPro通过任务隔离的LoRA-Expert分配结合双曲原型的测地路由匹配，有效缓解灾难性遗忘，为免回放类增量学习提供了有效的参数高效解决方案。

title: Self-Repulsive Sampling for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Sampling several responses and voting over their answers can improve a language model's accuracy, but repeated answers limit the benefit of additional samples. Raising temperature increases diversity at a potential cost to per-sample accuracy. We introduce Self-Repulsion (SR), a sampler for masked diffusion language models that uses peer commitments to diversify the pool. At each penalized denoising step, each path lowers a token's logit according to how many peers have committed that token at the same position. Paths share a batched forward pass and then commit in sequence, so later paths observe choices made earlier in the same step. This coupling requires no training or additional forward or backward pass and can produce distinct paths even at temperature zero. When all paths commit a position together from identical logits, the update exactly maximizes total logit minus a convex duplication cost. On LLaDA-8B-Instruct with ten paths and 128 denoising steps, deterministic SR reaches 80.38% plurality accuracy on GSM8K, compared with 70.17% for the unpenalized greedy decoder. At temperature 0.6 and matched model-evaluation budgets, the count penalty improves over self-consistency by 2.06 percentage points in blocks of 32 and 14.50 under pure diffusion. Experiments on GSM8K, MATH and TruthfulQA show that voting gains arise mainly from higher coverage of correct answers, with gains that vary by benchmark and decoding regime.

AI.tldr: 提出 Self-Repulsion（SR）采样器，利用同伴已提交 token 的惩罚来多样化掩码扩散语言模型的多路径采样，无需训练或额外前向/反向传播，显著提升投票准确率。
AI.motivation: 对语言模型多次采样并投票可提升准确率，但重复答案使额外样本收益递减。提高温度能增加多样性却可能牺牲单样本准确率，因此需要一种在保持单样本质量的同时增强样本多样性的采样方法。
AI.method: Self-Repulsion 针对掩码扩散语言模型：在每个施加惩罚的去噪步，每条路径根据同伴在同一位置已提交该 token 的数量来降低相应 logit。各路径共享批量前向传播后按序提交，使后续路径能观察到同一步中较早的提交结果。该耦合同样无需训练及额外前向或反向传播，即使温度为零也能产生不同路径。当所有路径在相同 logit 下同时提交某位置时，更新等价于最大化总 logit 减去凸的重复代价。
AI.result: 在 LLaDA-8B-Instruct 上，采用 10 条路径与 128 步去噪，确定性 SR 在 GSM8K 上取得 80.38% 的多数投票准确率，超过无惩罚贪心解码的 70.17%。温度 0.6 且模型评估预算相同时，计数惩罚在块大小为 32 时比自一致性高 2.06 个百分点，在纯扩散下高 14.50 个百分点。GSM8K、MATH 与 TruthfulQA 实验表明，投票增益主要来自正确答案覆盖率的提高，且增益随基准与解码机制而变化。
AI.conclusion: Self-Repulsion 通过同伴承诺惩罚实现免训练、无额外前向/反向传播的多路径多样化采样，在掩码扩散语言模型上提升了投票准确率，其增益主要源于正确答案覆盖率的增加，效果因基准和解码机制而异。

title: Candidate Retention for Abductive Learning
summary: Abductive learning combines neural perception with symbolic reasoning, using explanations generated by abduction to supervise the perception model. Multiple valid explanations of the same symbolic target can assign conflicting labels to the same inputs. Common policies select a single candidate as a pseudo-label, which may reinforce mistaken assignments, or weight all candidates, which may spread supervision across competing labels. These risks motivate selecting a retained subset to balance supervision sharpness and model-mass coverage. To guide this choice, we bound the coordinate-level supervision error using retained uncertainty, discarded model mass, and model mismatch. For a fixed model and training pair, only the first two terms depend on the retained set. We propose Abductive Candidate Retention (ACR), which uses these terms to guide greedy additions, accepting a candidate when its recovered mass exceeds the increase in retained uncertainty. Experiments show that ACR improves concept accuracy over single-candidate baselines and A3BL in most evaluated aggregated mod-addition settings. Objective ablations support the joint use of uncertainty and posterior mass.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对溯因学习中同一符号目标存在多个有效解释导致监督标签冲突的问题，提出基于保留不确定性与丢弃模型质量的误差界，并据此设计溯因候选保留（ACR）方法。
AI.motivation: 溯因学习用溯因生成的解释监督感知模型，但同一符号目标可能有多个有效解释，会对相同输入赋予冲突标签。现有策略要么选单一候选作伪标签（可能强化错误分配），要么对所有候选加权（会把监督分散到竞争标签上），因此需要选择保留子集以平衡监督锐度与模型质量覆盖。
AI.method: 论文用保留不确定性、丢弃模型质量和模型不匹配来界定坐标级监督误差；在固定模型和训练对时，仅前两项依赖保留集。据此提出 Abductive Candidate Retention（ACR），利用这些项指导贪心加入：当候选恢复的质量超过保留不确定性的增量时接受该候选。
AI.result: 实验表明，在多数评估的聚合 mod-addition 设置中，ACR 相比单候选基线和 A3BL 提升了概念准确率；目标消融支持不确定性与后验质量的联合使用。
AI.conclusion: ACR 通过误差界指导候选保留选择，为溯因学习中的冲突解释监督提供了一种兼顾监督锐度与模型质量覆盖的策略，并在实验中验证了其有效性。

title: Robust Transfer Learning for Paper ECG Recognition
summary: Paper ECG recognition is challenging because real-world ECG images vary in layout, physical artifacts, and label availability. We introduce RobECG-CL, a rank-aware contrastive learning framework for robust paper ECG representation learning. Starting from standard 12-lead ECG recordings, we construct progressively degraded paper ECG views with heterogeneous layouts and train the model to balance same-recording invariance with degradation-aware ordering. Across synthetic stress tests on CODE-II and EchoNext, RobECG-CL improves robustness under severe degradation and few-shot transfer, outperforming contrastive learning baselines and surpassing the waveform-based foundation model, ECG-FM, in the 1% labeled setting. On 312 samples of hospital data with 37 labels, RobECG-CL achieves the best macro AUROC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RobECG-CL，一种秩感知对比学习框架，用于纸质ECG图像的鲁棒表征学习，通过构建渐进退化视图并平衡同记录不变性与退化感知排序，在严重退化和少样本迁移场景下取得优于对比学习基线和ECG-FM的性能。
AI.motivation: 真实场景下纸质ECG图像在版式、物理伪影和标签可得性方面差异大，导致识别任务困难，亟需能够应对这些异构与退化因素的鲁棒表征学习方法。
AI.method: 从标准12导联ECG记录出发，构造具有异构版式的渐进退化纸质ECG视图，训练模型在保持同记录不变性的同时学习退化感知的相对排序，形成秩感知对比学习框架。
AI.result: 在CODE-II和EchoNext的合成压力测试中，RobECG-CL在严重退化与少样本迁移下鲁棒性提升，优于对比学习基线，并在1%标注设置下超过基于波形的基座模型ECG-FM；在医院312样本、37标签数据上取得最佳宏AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效提升了纸质ECG表征在退化与低标注条件下的鲁棒性与迁移能力，验证了秩感知对比学习策略的实际价值。

title: Convergence of Practical Muon with Finite Newton-Schulz Iterations and Nesterov Momentum
summary: Practical Muon maintains momentum and performs a small, fixed number of Newton--Schulz iterations separately for each parameter matrix, often with a Nesterov correction. We analyze these layer-wise finite-step updates jointly on a coupled nonconvex objective, rather than replacing them by exact polar factors or one global orthogonalization. Under gradient-dependent $(\mathcal L_0,\mathcal L_1,q)$-smoothness and conditionally unbiased stochastic gradients with bounded layer-wise variance, we establish an $\mathcal O(T^{-1/4})$ bound on the expected average Frobenius gradient norm. The analysis retains the Nesterov recursion and requires neither bounded stochastic gradients, symmetric noise, nor a uniform positive lower bound on the nonzero output singular values. Its constants contain no explicit matrix-dimension or rank factors when the number of blocks and problem constants are fixed. The proof follows a descent inequality and a decomposition of the momentum tracking error into initialization, noise, and drift. For the original five-step quintic, we verify the required scalar-map bounds analytically; the result also allows step-dependent coefficients satisfying the same bounds. A complementary nuclear-norm result quantifies rank dependence under a stronger spectral condition. The vanishing rate uses coupled learning-rate and momentum schedules, including the standard single-coefficient Nesterov rule.

AI.tldr: 本文分析实用Muon优化器（逐层保留动量并做固定少量Newton–Schulz迭代，含Nesterov修正）在耦合非凸目标上的收敛性。在梯度依赖的(𝒮₀,𝒮₁,q)-光滑性与条件无偏、逐层有界方差的随机梯度假设下，得到期望平均Frobenius梯度范数的O(T^{-1/4})界，且常数不含显式矩阵维度或秩因子。
AI.motivation: 已有分析常把Muon的逐层有限步Newton–Schulz更新替换为精确极分解因子或一次全局正交化，从而偏离实际算法；本文旨在直接分析逐层有限步更新与Nesterov动量的耦合非凸优化过程，给出更贴近实用Muon的收敛保证。
AI.method: 保留Nesterov递推与逐层少量Newton–Schulz迭代；采用梯度依赖的(𝒮₀,𝒮₁,q)-光滑性及条件无偏、逐层有界方差的随机梯度假设；通过下降不等式与将动量跟踪误差分解为初始化、噪声与漂移三部分进行证明；对原始五步五次情形解析验证所需标量映射界，并允许满足同样界的步依赖系数；采用耦合学习率与动量调度（含标准单系数Nesterov规则）。
AI.result: 在所述假设下建立了期望平均Frobenius梯度范数的O(T^{-1/4})收敛界；常数在块数与问题常数固定时不含显式矩阵维度或秩因子；无需有界随机梯度、对称噪声或非零输出奇异值的统一正下界；补充的核范数结果在更强谱条件下刻画秩依赖。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为实用Muon提供了贴近算法实现的逐层有限步Newton–Schulz收敛分析，给出O(T^{-1/4})的维度无关常数保证，并讨论步依赖系数与核范数下的秩依赖。

title: Hybrid Methods for Robust Tabular Data Imputation
summary: Missing data are a fundamental challenge in statistical analysis and machine learning, as the choice of imputation method substantially impacts downstream inference. In this work, we propose two hybrid imputation methods called NuclearForest and SoftForest, which combine nuclear-norm-based low-rank initialization using Singular Value Thresholding (SVT) and SoftImpute, respectively, with a non-iterative Random Forest refinement. For the SVT-based component, we further introduce an adaptive step-size rule, prove adaptive step-size bounds, and establish convergence for the corresponding zero-initialized iteration. The low-rank initialization provides a structured warm start that captures the global covariance patterns in the data, while the subsequent Random Forest step recovers residual nonlinear signals encoding local dependencies. We conduct an extensive benchmark on diverse datasets from different application domains, comparing the proposed methods with seven established imputation methods under the Missing Completely at Random (MCAR), Missing at Random (MAR), and Missing Not at Random (MNAR) mechanisms across varying missingness rates. Our results demonstrate that NuclearForest and SoftForest match or exceed the imputation fidelity of state-of-the-art iterative methods such as MissForest, while significantly reducing computational cost. In particular, they achieve speedups of approximately 5.81 times and 9.52 times over MissForest by replacing iterative cycles with a single refinement step. Our approach effectively exploits the low-rank structure of real-world tabular data and accommodates mixed-type variables, providing an efficient and robust solution for data imputation in bioinformatics, economics, and beyond.

AI.tldr: 提出NuclearForest与SoftForest两种混合插补方法，将基于SVT/SoftImpute的核范数低秩初始化与非迭代随机森林精炼结合，并给出自适应步长理论保证；在MCAR/MAR/MNAR多种缺失机制下匹配或超越MissForest精度，同时分别取得约5.81倍与9.52倍加速。
AI.motivation: 缺失数据是统计分析与机器学习的核心挑战，插补方法的选择会显著影响下游推断。已有迭代式方法（如MissForest）精度较高但计算代价大，而低秩方法或树方法单独使用难以同时兼顾全局结构与局部非线性依赖，亟需在精度与效率间取得平衡的混合方案。
AI.method: 1) 以核范数低秩初始化作为结构化热启动：分别采用奇异值阈值（SVT）与SoftImpute；2) 针对SVT分量引入自适应步长规则，证明自适应步长界，并建立零初始化迭代的收敛性；3) 在低秩初始化之后接单次（非迭代）随机森林精炼，用以恢复编码局部依赖的残差非线性信号；4) 支持混合类型变量，适配真实表格数据。
AI.result: 在跨领域多数据集基准上，与七种成熟插补方法在MCAR、MAR、MNAR三种机制及不同缺失率下比较：NuclearForest与SoftForest的插补保真度匹配或超过MissForest等最先进迭代方法，且计算成本显著降低——以单次精炼替代迭代循环，相较MissForest分别实现约5.81倍和9.52倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效利用真实世界表格数据的低秩结构，兼容混合类型变量，为生物信息学、经济学等领域提供了一种高效稳健的插补方案；其核心价值在于低秩全局初始化与非迭代森林局部精炼的互补结合，以及相应的自适应步长理论保障。

title: Parameterization method of reservoir properties for ensemble-based data assimilation using intermediate latent space of StyleGAN
summary: Ensemble smoothers are the most successful and efficient techniques currently available for history matching. However, because these methods rely on Gaussian assumptions, their performance is severely degraded when the prior geology is described in terms of complex facies distributions (non-Gaussian). In this way, for these methods, we need to apply efficient parameterization techniques. Currently, the most efficient methods for performing parameterization are deep learning models. However, given the variety of existing deep learning models, studies have not identified which is most suitable for use with ensemble-based methods, although some important models had already been evaluated. Based on a recent literature review, the most promising models selected were VAE-GAN, Latent Diffusion, and StyleGAN models. As a novel aspect of this work, data assimilation with the second generation of StyleGAN (StyleGAN2) model was performed using the latent z-space and intermediate w-space, separately. They were applied in two 2D case studies: one categorical (three facies) and the other continuous. The results demonstrated that all three models are highly efficient, with the StyleGAN2 model standing out for generating samples with geological realism and achieving excellent data matching in the cases studied. Our findings show that performing data assimilation with StyleGAN2 using the intermediate space (w-space) yielded better results than the traditional application in the latent space (z-space). This is due to the fact that ESMDA uses linear updates and the w-space is much more linear and disentangled than the highly entangled z-space, thereby ensuring that the updated vectors remain close to realistic geological patterns. These results were validated using main geostatistical and history matching metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种深度学习参数化模型（VAE-GAN、Latent Diffusion、StyleGAN2）在集合平滑器历史拟合中的应用，并首次对比了StyleGAN2在潜在z空间与中间w空间进行数据同化的效果。
AI.motivation: 集合平滑器依赖高斯假设，当面岩相分布为复杂非高斯时性能严重下降，需借助高效参数化技术；而现有深度学习参数化模型种类繁多，尚不清楚哪一种最适合与集合类方法配合使用。
AI.method: 基于文献综述筛选出最有前景的VAE-GAN、Latent Diffusion和StyleGAN2模型；作为创新点，分别利用StyleGAN2的潜在z空间和中间w空间进行数据同化（ESMDA，线性更新）；应用于两个二维算例，一个为三类相的分类算例，另一个为连续算例。
AI.result: 三种模型均高效，其中StyleGAN2在地质真实感和数据拟合方面表现突出；使用中间w空间的效果优于传统潜在z空间，原因是ESMDA采用线性更新，而w空间比高度纠缠的z空间更线性、更解耦，使更新向量更接近真实地质模式。结果通过主要地质统计学和历史拟合指标得到验证。
AI.conclusion: StyleGAN2结合中间w空间是集合平滑器历史拟合中最优的参数化方案，为复杂非高斯先验地质条件下的数据同化提供了更有效途径。

title: MIND: Marginal-Invariant Neural Dependency Diffusion for Mixed-Type Tabular Generation
summary: This paper proposes MIND, a marginal-invariant neural dependency diffusion model for mixed-type tabular data. MIND does not directly learn the joint distribution in the original heterogeneous feature space. Instead, it first maps different variable types into a unified latent dependency space via column-wise marginal transport. A conditional diffusion model then learns cross-column relationships. Copula-tangent denoising separates known marginal components from learnable dependency residuals. Rank projection during the sampling phase further mitigates marginal shift in reverse diffusion. Experiments across nine diverse tabular benchmarks show that MIND consistently improves marginal fidelity and dependency preservation over existing unified approaches. By explicitly isolating marginal modelling from dependency learning, MIND achieves a strong and stable balance among marginal fidelity, joint dependency preservation, and downstream prediction utility. This work supports separating marginal and dependency modelling as a principled and highly effective paradigm for complex mixed-type tabular generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MIND，一种面向混合类型表格数据的边缘不变神经依赖扩散模型，通过显式分离边缘建模与依赖学习实现高质量的表格数据生成。
AI.motivation: 混合类型表格数据在原始异构特征空间中直接学习联合分布困难，不同变量类型（连续、离散等）的异质性与边缘分布漂移给依赖关系建模带来挑战，现有统一方法难以平衡边缘保真度、联合依赖保持与下游预测效用。
AI.method: MIND不直接在原始异构特征空间学习联合分布：首先通过列级边缘传输将不同变量类型映射到统一的潜在依赖空间；再用条件扩散模型学习跨列关系；通过Copula切空间去噪将已知边缘成分与可学习的依赖残差分离；采样阶段引入秩投影以缓解逆向扩散中的边缘漂移。
AI.result: 在九个多样化表格基准上，MIND在边缘保真度和依赖保持方面持续优于现有统一方法，并在边缘保真度、联合依赖保持与下游预测效用之间实现了强而稳定的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 将边缘建模与依赖建模分离，是复杂混合类型表格生成中一种有原则且高效的范式。

title: Certification-Based Differentially Private Learning
summary: Differential privacy (DP) in machine learning is typically achieved by adding noise to model parameters (private learning) or to model outputs (private prediction). Recent work uses formal methods, namely abstract interpretation, to provide tighter privacy guarantees, but only for private prediction in classification settings. In this work, we investigate the use of formal methods as a general tool for tighter privacy analysis. First, we generalize the abstract gradient training (AGT) framework to private prediction in continuous, unbounded regression. Second, by reducing learning in parameterized models to a regression problem over the parameter space, we introduce Abstract Gradient Sampling (AGS), an algorithm that enables reachability-based analysis to provide guarantees for private learning. In both private prediction and private learning, we provide tightened privacy accounting for the AGT framework and a theoretical analysis demonstrating when our smooth sensitivity upper-bounds yield favourable privacy-utility trade-off. In practice, we validate that our regression bounds are tighter than global-sensitivity baselines on regression benchmarks, and, notably, yield the first finite privacy guarantees in settings where global prediction sensitivity is a priori unbounded. We also find that under matched conditions, our private learning algorithm can outperform standard private learners.

AI.tldr: 本文将形式化方法（抽象解释）从分类场景的隐私预测推广到连续无界回归，并提出抽象梯度采样（AGS）算法，使基于可达性分析的方法可服务于隐私学习，同时给出更紧的隐私核算与隐私-效用权衡的理论分析。
AI.motivation: 现有差分隐私机器学习通常通过向模型参数加噪（隐私学习）或向模型输出加噪（隐私预测）实现；近期借助形式化方法（具体为抽象解释）可获得更紧的隐私保证，但仅限于分类设定下的隐私预测，缺乏对回归与隐私学习的通用支持。
AI.method: 1）将抽象梯度训练（AGT）框架推广至连续、无界回归的隐私预测；2）通过把参数化模型的学习归约为参数空间上的回归问题，提出抽象梯度采样（AGS）算法，利用基于可达性的分析为隐私学习提供保证；3）针对 AGT 框架在隐私预测和隐私学习两种场景给出更紧的隐私核算，并从理论上分析平滑敏感度上界在何种条件下能带来有利的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.result: 实验验证所提回归界在回归基准上比全局敏感度基线更紧，尤其是在全局预测敏感度先验无界的场景下首次给出有限隐私保证；在匹配条件下，所提隐私学习算法可优于标准隐私学习器。
AI.conclusion: 形式化方法可作为更紧隐私分析的通用工具，既适用于连续无界回归的隐私预测，也通过归约与 AGS 拓展到隐私学习；所提方法在理论与实证上均展现出更紧的界与更好的隐私-效用权衡。

title: PEG-Tab: Sampling-Time Record Repair and Release Control for Tabular Synthesis
summary: Pretrained tabular generators can reproduce training records even when aggregate utility remains high. When retraining is unavailable or too costly, sampling and release are the remaining intervention points. We present PEG-Tab (Post-Training Energy Guidance for Tabular Synthesis), a post-training repair and release-control framework for frozen tabular generators. For each generated row, a generator-native operator creates two alternatives. A shared calibrated score compares the three candidates, favours lower-risk records, and applies a final release check. We instantiate this interface for GReaT, CTGAN, TVAE, and TabDDPM without updating their parameters. Across five datasets and four generator families, PEG-Tab reduces mean Near Copy from $0.078$ to $0.027$ and lowers aggregate Exact Copy to zero. Relative to a $3\times$ post hoc filter, it retains higher utility in 12 of 16 transfer settings and Pareto-dominates the filter in eight. Gains are concentrated in copy and proximity-related risks.

AI.tldr: PEG-Tab 是一个面向冻结表格生成器的后训练修复与发布控制框架，通过生成器原生算子产生两个备选行并结合校准打分筛选低风险记录，在不重训练的前提下显著降低复制风险并保持效用。
AI.motivation: 预训练表格生成器即使聚合效用量高，仍可能复现训练记录；当重训练不可行或成本过高时，采样与发布成为仅剩的干预点，因此需要一个后训练层面的修复与发布控制手段。
AI.method: 对每个生成行，由生成器原生算子生成两个替代候选；使用共享的校准分数对三个候选进行比较，偏向低风险记录，并执行最终发布检查；该接口已在 GReaT、CTGAN、TVAE 与 TabDDPM 上实例化，且不更新其参数。
AI.result: 在五个数据集与四个生成器家族上，PEG-Tab 将平均 Near Copy 从 0.078 降至 0.027，并将总体 Exact Copy 降为零；相比 3 倍事后过滤，在 16 个迁移设置中有 12 个保持更高效用，并在 8 个上实现帕累托占优；收益集中在复制与邻近相关风险上。
AI.conclusion: PEG-Tab 提供了一种无需重训练的后训练修复与发布控制方案，可在多个生成器家族上有效降低复制与邻近风险，同时在多数迁移设置中保持优于事后过滤的效用表现。

title: Towards Better Exploration in Sequential Test-Time Scaling
summary: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute at inference. However, both classes of existing methods often fail to continue improving over long timescales. Parallel methods repeatedly sample independent answers from the model, scaling poorly on problems the model is unlikely to solve in a single attempt. In contrast, sequential methods build on previous answers to access new ideas, yet so far have not been shown to reach answers beyond those found by parallel scaling. First, we show that sequential scaling often stops improving because it becomes prematurely trapped in an attractor: a set of answers that prevents exploration of different answers once entered. Across 27 combinations of scaling methods, models, and benchmarks, we find that 53.8% of sequential scaling trajectories enter an attractor within four iterations. Second, we show that a simple model-mixing intervention helps escape attractors. This reduces the attractor hit rate by 21.2 percentage points on average, expands solution coverage beyond a compute-matched parallel baseline, and improves accuracy of recursive self-aggregation by at least 2.2 percentage points. Our results motivate refocusing long-horizon test-time scaling from parallel methods to sequential methods that improve previous answers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究测试时扩展在长时程推理中的失效问题：并行方法重复独立采样、在难问题上扩展性差；顺序方法虽能基于先前答案探索新思路，但此前未被证明能超越并行扩展。作者发现顺序扩展常因"吸引子"（attractor）而过早停止改进，并提出模型混合干预来帮助逃逸吸引子。
AI.motivation: 现有两类测试时扩展方法在长时程下均难以持续改进：并行方法独立重复采样，对模型单次难以解决的问题扩展性差；顺序方法虽能基于先前答案获得新思路，但目前尚未证明能达到超越并行扩展的答案。因此需要理解顺序扩展为何停止改进，并寻找提升其长时程能力的途径。
AI.method: 1. 定义并检测顺序扩展中的"吸引子"现象：即一旦进入某组答案后便阻碍探索不同答案的状态。2. 在27种扩展方法、模型与基准的组合上测量顺序扩展轨迹进入吸引子的比例。3. 引入简单的模型混合（model-mixing）干预以帮助逃逸吸引子，并与算力匹配的并行基线对比。
AI.result: 1. 在27种组合中，53.8%的顺序扩展轨迹在四次迭代内进入吸引子。2. 模型混合干预平均将吸引子命中率降低21.2个百分点，将解覆盖范围扩展至超过算力匹配的并行基线，并使递归自聚合（recursive self-aggregation）的准确率至少提升2.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 顺序扩展停止改进的根因是过早陷入吸引子；简单的模型混合干预可有效逃逸吸引子并提升覆盖度与准确率。研究结果支持将长时程测试时扩展的研究重心从并行方法转向能改进先前答案的顺序方法。

title: Free Everywhere, Exact on Trees: PPO's Dropped Correction Buys Sample Efficiency Under Aggressive Reuse
summary: Common policy improvement methods, including TRPO, PPO, and GRPO, estimate policy improvement under the behavioral policy's state-visitation distribution rather than the improved policy's own. The substitution makes the objective estimable from the behavioral policy's rollouts but adds a bias growing with policy divergence, hence the trust region or clip, and hence no reuse of a batch far off-policy. We show that under history-injective dynamics, where each state is reached by exactly one history, the dropped state-visitation ratio equals the product of per-step policy ratios along the sampled prefix, on every trajectory and not only in expectation. The ratio is therefore restored exactly, from log-probabilities PPO already computes. Autoregressive generation and canonical-order constructive optimization are both history-injective. The exact correction pays importance-sampling variance that grows with the horizon, so we generalize it to a one-parameter family with PPO ($α{=}0$) and the full correction ($α{=}1$) as endpoints: a single bias--variance knob. A gradient-level analysis of the unclipped surrogate identifies two channels the correction acts through and three conditions under which it carries signal; an enumerable testbed confirms the conditions' predictions. On hard credit-assignment scheduling tasks, a short corrected warmup with aggressive early sample reuse learns faster than PPO and than the same reuse uncorrected; the marginal gain grows with task difficulty ($+0.02$ to $+0.09$ learning-curve AUC), and the early win over PPO tracks the prefix bias that reuse incurs. A correction held throughout, or applied where clipping already contains the reuse bias, is null to harmful.

AI.tldr: 论文指出PPO/TRPO/GRPO等策略改进目标使用行为策略的状态访问分布而非改进策略自身分布，带来随散度增长的偏差。作者证明在"历史单射"动态下，被丢弃的状态访问比恰好等于采样前缀上逐步策略比的乘积，可精确还原，并推广为含PPO(α=0)与完全修正(α=1)两端的一参数族，形成偏差-方差调节旋钮。实验显示短程修正预热配合早期样本重用可加速学习。
AI.motivation: 主流策略改进方法（TRPO、PPO、GRPO）在行为策略的状态访问分布下估计策略改进，而非改进策略自身分布。这一替代虽使目标可从行为策略轨迹中估计，但引入随策略散度增长的偏差，因而需要信任域或裁剪，也导致无法重用远离当前策略的批次。作者希望消除这一偏差，实现更激进的离策略样本重用。
AI.method: 作者在"历史单射动态"（每个状态仅由唯一历史到达）假设下证明：被丢弃的状态访问比等于沿采样前缀逐步策略比的乘积，且在每条轨迹上精确成立而非仅期望意义成立；该比值可直接由PPO已计算的log概率还原。自回归生成与规范序构造式优化均满足历史单射性。由于精确修正需付出随视界增长的重要性采样方差，作者将其推广为单参数族，以PPO(α=0)与完全修正(α=1)为端点，作为偏差-方差旋钮。此外对未裁剪代理做梯度级分析，识别修正起作用的两条通道及三个信号条件。
AI.result: 可枚举测试平台验证了三个信号条件的预测。在困难信用分配调度任务上，短程修正预热配合激进的早期样本重用学习快于PPO，也快于未修正的相同重用；边际收益随任务难度增长（学习曲线AUC +0.02至+0.09），且早期对PPO的优势与重用所引入的前缀偏差相关。全程施加修正、或在裁剪已包含重用偏差之处施加修正，则效果为零甚至有害。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一个精确还原状态访问比的方法，并可通过单参数旋钮在偏差与方差之间权衡。结论表明修正应作为短程预热使用并配合早期样本重用，能带来随难度增长的收益；无差别地全程施加修正或在裁剪已控制偏差处施加修正并无益处。

title: RiboUnmix: Learning Shared Translational Dynamics from Biased and Noisy Ribo-seq Measurements
summary: Ribosome profiling (Ribo-seq) measures ribosome distributions along mRNAs, but observed occupancy profiles also contain experiment-specific distortions and stochastic variability. Consequently, models that accurately predict measured profiles may reproduce technical effects rather than recover the underlying biology. We ask whether jointly modeling datasets collected under different experimental conditions can reveal shared, sequence-dependent patterns of ribosome occupancy. We introduce RiboUnmix, a probabilistic multi-dataset framework in which each expected measured profile is represented as a shared sequence-dependent signal modulated by a dataset-specific multiplicative factor. A negative-binomial observation model captures variability across replicates. We evaluate RiboUnmix on a controlled synthetic benchmark combining programmed translation kinetics, ribosome traffic, stochastic count sampling, and sequence-dependent experimental distortions. Because the underlying kinetics and distortions are known, recovery of the shared profile and dataset-specific effects can be assessed separately. Both inferred components correlate strongly with their targets, demonstrating that RiboUnmix can disentangle shared kinetic patterns from experimental effects. Across four organism-specific real-data benchmarks, RiboUnmix outperforms sequence-to-profile baselines in predicting measured profiles. Models trained independently on subsets of 114 HEK-derived datasets recover concordant shared profiles for held-out transcripts, and experiments varying the number and composition of training datasets show that the learned representation remains stable. RiboUnmix thus converts variation across experiments into evidence for reproducible sequence-dependent patterns of ribosome occupancy, supporting biological hypothesis generation from diverse Ribo-seq datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出RiboUnmix，一个概率多数据集框架，将每个实验的核糖体占据谱建模为共享序列依赖信号与数据集特有效应的乘积，从而从Ribo-seq实验差异中分离出可重复的生物学模式。
AI.motivation: Ribo-seq测量的占据谱包含实验特异的失真和随机波动，导致能够精确预测测量谱的模型可能只是在复现技术效应，而非揭示真实生物学规律。作者希望探究：联合建模不同实验条件下的数据集，能否提取出共享的、序列依赖的核糖体占据模式。
AI.method: RiboUnmix将每个数据集的期望测量谱表示为共享的序列依赖信号乘以数据集特异的乘性因子；采用负二项观测模型刻画重复样本间的变异。在合成基准上进行评估，该基准同时模拟程序化翻译动力学、核糖体拥堵、随机计数采样和序列依赖实验失真，使共享谱与数据集特异能分别被独立检验；并在四个物种特异的真实数据基准上与序列到谱的基线方法对比。
AI.result: 在合成基准上，推断出的共享谱与数据集特异效应均与真实目标强相关，表明模型能有效分离共享动力学模式与实验效应；在四个真实数据基准上，RiboUnmix在预测测量谱方面优于序列到谱的基线；在114个HEK数据集子集上独立训练能对留出转录本恢复一致的共享谱，改变训练数据集数量与组成时学到的表示保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: RiboUnmix将实验间的变异转化为对可重复的序列依赖核糖体占据模式的证据，支持从多样化Ribo-seq数据集中进行生物学假设生成。

title: Beyond Uniform Compression: Budgeted Transmission Allocation for Extreme Federated Learning
summary: Federated learning faces severe communication bottlenecks when clients upload high-dimensional model updates. Existing methods often compress these updates uniformly across all layers. This uniform approach ignores the heterogeneous value of different parameter blocks and wastes limited bandwidth on insensitive layers. To address this issue, we propose Layer-wise Budgeted Adaptive Transmission (LBAT). LBAT reframes federated communication under extreme uplink budgets as a resource allocation problem. Our framework dynamically estimates the transmission value of different layers utilising local training signals. It then employs an exact byte dynamic programming allocator to determine optimal rank and bit configurations under strict budgets. We validate LBAT on highly heterogeneous federated tabular prediction and data generation tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LBAT consistently outperforms uniform rank, uniform quantisation, and fixed compression baselines across various extreme budget regimes. Furthermore, it achieves significantly better communication and utility tradeoffs while preserving essential distributional fidelity.

AI.tldr: 提出 LBAT（逐层预算自适应传输）框架，将联邦学习上行通信建模为资源分配问题，利用本地训练信号动态评估各层传输价值，并通过精确字节动态规划分配器在严格预算下确定最优秩与比特配置。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中客户端上传高维模型更新导致严重通信瓶颈；现有方法对所有层进行统一压缩，忽略了不同参数块的异质价值，在低敏感层浪费有限带宽。
AI.method: LBAT 将极端上行预算下的联邦通信重构为资源分配问题：基于本地训练信号动态估计各层的传输价值，随后采用精确字节动态规划分配器，在严格预算约束下求解最优的秩（rank）与量化比特配置。
AI.result: 在高度异质的联邦表格预测与数据生成任务上验证，LBAT 在多种极端预算区间下持续优于统一秩、统一量化及固定压缩基线，并实现了更优的通信—效用权衡，同时保持必要的分布保真度。
AI.conclusion: 分层自适应、按价值分配带宽的压缩策略可有效缓解联邦学习上行通信瓶颈，在极端预算下兼顾通信效率、模型效用与分布保真度。

title: From Modes to Memories: Characterizing the Scale-Space Dynamics of Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models are typically viewed as stochastic processes that transform noise into data. We take a complementary perspective: a diffusion model defines a family of deterministic dynamical systems indexed by noise scale. At each fixed scale $σ$, we treat the denoiser as a self-map and study its dynamics. For an exact denoiser, fixed points correspond to critical points of the smoothed data density, while attractors correspond to its modes; as $σ$ increases, sample-level modes merge into progressively coarser ones. This suggests a geometric view of memorization: examples that receive excess probability mass due to duplication or overfitting, as well as outliers, should remain distinguishable under stronger smoothing than ordinary examples. We quantify this persistence by the critical scale $σ_c$, the largest noise scale at which an example is retained by the fixed-scale dynamics. In conditional models, the same construction extends naturally to image--caption pairs. Experiments in controlled settings and on large-scale models show that $σ_c$ tracks memorization arising from duplication, overfitting, and outliers, and identifies both memorized and partially memorized examples in Stable Diffusion. Moreover, $σ_c$ yields interpretable measures of the image spatial distribution and caption dependence of memorization.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将扩散模型视为按噪声尺度索引的确定性动力系统族，用去噪器的不动点与吸引子刻画平滑数据密度的临界点与模态，并以临界尺度σ_c量化记忆的持续性。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型通常被理解为将噪声映射为数据的随机过程，但缺乏对样本级记忆现象（重复、过拟合、离群点）的几何与动力学刻画工具。作者希望从确定性动力学角度补充这一视角，解释并度量记忆。
AI.method: 在每个固定噪声尺度σ下把去噪器视为自映射并研究其动力学：精确去噪器的不动点对应平滑数据密度的临界点，吸引子对应模态，σ增大时样本级模态逐级合并。以此定义样本的临界尺度σ_c，即样本仍被固定尺度动力学保留的最大噪声尺度；对条件模型自然扩展到图像—文本对。
AI.result: 在受控实验与大规模模型上，σ_c能追踪由重复、过拟合和离群点引起的记忆，并在Stable Diffusion中识别出完全记忆和部分记忆的样本；σ_c还提供了关于图像空间分布与标题依赖性的可解释度量。
AI.conclusion: 将去噪器视为尺度索引的确定性动力系统，可给出记忆的几何观点与可计算的持续性指标σ_c，为理解与检测扩散模型中的记忆提供统一框架。

title: Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion: SNR-Equalized Heat Flow for Graph Signals
summary: Diffusion models generate data by reversing a forward corruption process that typically approaches a simple Gaussian prior. Recent work has extended this framework to signals supported on fixed graphs, e.g., road-network traffic and sensor-network measurements. Many graph signals have nonuniform spectral energy, whereas isotropic corruption adds the same conditional noise variance to every graph-frequency mode. Driving all modes to near-zero terminal signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) requires strong corruption, which increases the noise range that must be covered under a fixed sampling budget. We introduce Graph Residual Conjugate Diffusion (GRCD), which replaces the shared clock of graph heat diffusion with a mode-dependent clock that gives every graph-Fourier mode the same conditional SNR. GRCD fits a zero-mean graph-spectral Gaussian reference on the training split and stops at a finite terminal SNR at which the propagated reference still carries the fitted spectral variances. The Gaussian component has an exact modewise propagator in the probability-flow ODE, so sampling advances it analytically and integrates only the learned residual score numerically. We evaluate GRCD on five settings (METR-LA traffic, Molene weather, and three stochastic block models) against seven comparators under a matched protocol: Graph-Aware Diffusion (GAD), EDM (graph backbone), two adaptations of Whitened Score Diffusion (WSD), and three preconditioning controls. At four function evaluations (NFEs), GRCD lowers averaged maximum mean discrepancy (aMMD) by 22 to 36 times over the best comparator on all five settings, reaching 0.054 on METR-LA, where it clears an aMMD 0.1 target with 87% less sampling wall-clock time than the cheapest comparator that reaches it. Fitting the terminal reference reduces aMMD by 2.7 to 7.3 times at finite terminal SNR, while the factors shrink to 1.00 to 1.01 near zero.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图残差共轭扩散（GRCD），用"模式依赖时钟"替代图热扩散的共享时钟，使每个图傅里叶模式具有相同条件信噪比(SNR)，并拟合零均值图谱高斯参考及在有限终端SNR处停止，从而在极少采样步数下显著提升图信号生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有图扩散模型沿用各向同性加噪，即对所有图频率模式添加相同条件噪声方差。但许多图信号（如路网流量、传感器网络测量）的谱能量分布不均匀，导致强噪声扩散下所有模式被推到近零终端SNR，在固定采样预算下需要覆盖过大的噪声范围，采样效率低。
AI.method: GRCD将图热扩散的共享时钟替换为模式依赖时钟，为每个图傅里叶模式分配相同条件SNR；在训练集上拟合零均值图谱高斯参考分布，并在有限终端SNR处停止扩散（此时传播的参考仍保留拟合的谱方差）。由于高斯分量在概率流ODE中具有精确的模式传播子，采样时可解析推进高斯部分，仅对学习到的残差分数进行数值积分，从而降低函数评估次数。
AI.result: 在五个数据集（METR-LA交通、Molene气象、三个随机块模型）上与七个对比方法（GAD、图骨干EDM、两种WSD适配、三种预处理控制）在统一协议下评测：仅用4次函数评估(NFEs)时，GRCD在全部五个设置上将平均最大均值差异(aMMD)较最优对比方法降低22至36倍，METR-LA上达到0.054，并以比最省时的达标对比方法少87%的采样墙上时钟时间满足aMMD<0.1目标。在有限终端SNR下，拟合终端参考使aMMD降低2.7至7.3倍，而在近零SNR时该增益缩小至1.00至1.01倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过模式依赖时钟与有限终端SNR的谱保持参考，GRCD实现了图信号扩散模型的高效采样，在极低NFE预算下大幅优于现有图扩散与EDM类方法，验证了非均匀谱能量下"逐模式等SNR"加噪设计的有效性。

title: NodeGround: A Node Classification Benchmark in the Graph Foundation Model Era
summary: Can a pretrained graph model replace training and tuning a separate predictor for each dataset? Answering this requires evaluating prediction quality alongside computational cost. We present NodeGround, a node classification benchmark that puts graph foundation models (GFMs) and dataset-specific supervised learning under a common evaluation framework. The benchmark spans 51 datasets and evaluates six GFMs alongside 15 supervised methods under two label-availability regimes. Shared data partitions, validation-only model selection, controlled hyperparameter searches, and multiple predictive metrics make comparisons systematic, while workflow measurements account for adaptation, training, tuning, and inference. The results favor carefully tuned graph neural networks overall. GraphPFN reaches third place by Elo when more labels are available, yet its relative strengths vary substantially with dataset properties. Efficiency comparisons further qualify the benefits of pretrained reuse: GVT and GraphPFN appear on the Pareto frontiers when supervised methods are represented by their default and fully tuned configurations. Adding intermediate tuning budgets removes this advantage for GVT and leaves GraphPFN extending the estimated frontier in the label-rich setting alone. Thus, reusing pretrained parameters does not yet provide a broadly reliable route to either stronger predictions or cheaper workflows. We release the evaluation pipeline, run-level records, and an open leaderboard at https://github.com/nums-ai/nodeground.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NodeGround 基准，在统一框架下对比图基础模型（GFM）与数据集专属监督学习，从预测质量与计算成本两方面评估“预训练图模型能否替代逐数据集训练”。结论是复用预训练参数目前尚不能稳定带来更强预测或更低成本。
AI.motivation: 核心问题在于：预训练图模型能否取代针对每个数据集单独训练与调参的预测器。回答该问题不能只看预测质量，还需同时核算计算成本，而以往研究缺乏统一的评估口径。
AI.method: 构建 NodeGround 节点分类基准：覆盖 51 个数据集，在两种标签可获得性设置下评估 6 个 GFM 与 15 个监督方法。通过共享数据划分、仅用验证集做模型选择、受控超参搜索与多预测指标保证可比性，并以工作流测量统计适配、训练、调参和推理开销。
AI.result: 整体结果更有利于精心调参的图神经网络。GraphPFN 在标签较充足时按 Elo 排名第三，但其相对优势随数据集属性显著变化。效率方面，当监督方法采用默认配置或完全调参配置时，GVT 与 GraphPFN 出现在 Pareto 前沿；引入中间调参预算后，GVT 的优势消失，仅 GraphPFN 在标签丰富场景下仍扩展估计前沿。
AI.conclusion: 复用预训练参数目前尚未成为通向更强预测或更廉价工作流的普适可靠路径。作者公开了评估流程、运行级记录与在线排行榜（https://github.com/nums-ai/nodeground）。

title: GFD-OPD: Guidance-Folded On-Policy Distillation of Diffusion Models Across Scales
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has demonstrated two important capabilities in language models: compressing large teachers into smaller students and merging expert models into a single model. Existing diffusion OPD, however, mostly focus on the latter, with teachers and students sharing the same backbone and scale. We investigate large-to-small diffusion opd from large teachers to a small student and find that the standard recipe fails. To find the underlying cause, we propose Fixed-State KL, an effective and fair way to measure the distribution gap between student and teacher during OPD training for diffusion models. We are the first to clarify why large-to-small OPD is challenging for diffusion models: a smaller student struggles to perfectly match the distribution of a larger teacher, while classifier-free guidance can accumulate and amplify the distributional discrepancies between the student's conditional and unconditional branches and those of the teacher. To solve this problem, we propose GFD-OPD, a simple yet effective method that reduces the student-teacher gap while avoiding the error amplification of the CFG composition. Across numerous experiments, GFD outperforms previous baselines in both training efficiency and final performance, achieving state-of-the-art results on all benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散模型的大到小在线策略蒸馏（OPD），提出Fixed-State KL度量学生与教师的分布差距，首次阐明该任务失败的原因，并提出GFD-OPD方法取得SOTA效果。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散OPD多聚焦于将多个专家模型合并为单一模型，且教师与学生共享相同骨干网络和规模；对于从大教师到小学生的大到小蒸馏研究不足，且标准配方在该场景下失效，作者希望找出失败原因并解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出Fixed-State KL，一种公平有效测量扩散OPD训练中学生与教师分布差距的指标；基于该指标分析失败原因；提出GFD-OPD方法，在缩小学生-教师差距的同时避免CFG组合带来的误差放大。
AI.result: GFD在大量实验中于训练效率和最终性能上均优于先前基线，在所有基准上达到state-of-the-art。
AI.conclusion: 大到小扩散OPD的困难根源在于小学生难以完美匹配大教师分布，且无分类器引导会累积放大条件与无条件分支的分布差异；GFD-OPD可有效缓解该问题并实现最优性能。

title: A library for differentiable signal processing and machine learning on the sphere
summary: The two-dimensional sphere embedded in three-dimensional Euclidean space S2, plays a central role in a variety of scientific and engineering domains, including geophysics, planetary science, geodesy, atmospheric physics, quantum chemistry, cosmology, and virtual reality, among many others. As machine learning increasingly permeates these fields, the demand grows for robust tools that process and model functions on the sphere, while respecting the inherent topological and symmetry properties of the domain. We present torch-harmonics, a comprehensive library that offers efficient, differentiable implementations of advanced signal processing and machine learning (ML) methods for spherical data. These include the spherical harmonic transform (SHT), the spherical analogue of the Fourier transform, vector spherical harmonics, discrete-continuous and spectral convolutions, as well as both global and neighborhood spherical attention mechanisms. Beyond traditional representations, torch-harmonics provides the building blocks for state-of-the-art spherical ML architectures such as spherical transformers in order to enable scalable, rotationally-aware learning and inference in modern scientific and engineering applications.

AI.tldr: torch-harmonics：处理球面数据的可微球谐变换与球面卷积/注意力库
AI.motivation: 球面S2在地球物理、行星科学、大气物理、量子化学、宇宙学及虚拟现实等领域广泛应用，机器学习渗透这些领域后，亟需能在球面上处理函数、并保持其拓扑与对称性质的鲁棒工具。
AI.method: 提出torch-harmonics库，提供高效可微的球面信号处理与机器学习方法实现，包括球谐变换（SHT，傅里叶变换的球面类比）、矢量球谐、离散-连续与谱卷积，以及全局与邻域球面注意力机制。
AI.result: 该库除传统表示外，还提供构建先进球面ML架构（如球面Transformer）的基础模块，支持可扩展、旋转感知的学习与推理。
AI.conclusion: torch-harmonics为现代科学与工程应用中的球面数据分析提供了可微、旋转感知的机器学习基础工具。

title: CNCGEN: A Dataset and Framework for Machining Process Planning and Toolpath Generation from B-rep Models
summary: Learning to generate machining process plans and toolpaths from B-rep CAD requires coupling discrete operation decisions with continuous tool motion as the workpiece evolves. Correctly predicting an operation sequence does not by itself ensure correct material removal, because each toolpath acts on the stock left by preceding cuts. We formulate this problem around persistent manufacturing objects: object identity determines the target of an operation, while the evolving stock state conditions the generation of its toolpath. Based on this formulation, we propose CNCGEN, a dataset and learning framework for three-axis machining. CNCGEN-Dataset contains approximately 50k geometrically verified synthetic machining flows and 800 held-out real CNC records. Each flow aligns B-rep geometry with object-referenced operations, parameterized toolpaths, intermediate stock states, and verification outcomes, enabling supervision of the correspondence between planning decisions and their geometric effects. CNCGEN generates operations and toolpaths for selected objects step by step, updating a compact machining state to guide subsequent predictions. During training, a learned surrogate verifier provides material-removal feedback that links local predictions to their geometric consequences. Experiments on synthetic and held-out real CNC records show that CNCGEN improves the resulting workpiece geometry and reduces residual material and overcut compared with adapted CNC generation baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CNCGEN数据集与学习框架，将三轴加工的过程规划与刀具路径生成统一为随工件形态演化的持久制造对象建模问题，并引入可学习代理验证器提供材料去除反馈。
AI.motivation: 从B-rep CAD生成加工工艺规划与刀具路径，需要同时耦合离散的工序决策与连续的刀具运动，且工件在加工过程中不断演化。仅预测正确的工序序列并不能保证正确的材料去除，因为每条刀具路径都作用在前序切削留下的毛坯上。因此需要一种能同时刻画工序对象身份与其几何效果对应关系的建模方式。
AI.method: 论文以"持久制造对象"为核心形式化该问题：对象身份决定工序的作用目标，演化的毛坯状态约束刀具路径的生成。基于此提出CNCGEN数据集与学习框架。CNCGEN-Dataset包含约5万条经过几何验证的合成加工流程，以及800条留出的真实CNC记录。每条流程对齐B-rep几何、以对象为参照的工序、参数化刀具路径、中间毛坯状态与验证结果。CNCGEN逐步为选定对象生成工序与刀具路径，并更新紧凑的加工状态以引导后续预测；训练时使用可学习代理验证器提供材料去除反馈，将局部预测与其几何后果关联。
AI.result: 在合成数据与留出真实CNC记录上的实验表明，与适配的CNC生成基线相比，CNCGEN改进了生成工件的几何质量，并降低了残料与过切。
AI.conclusion: 将工序规划与刀具路径生成围绕持久制造对象进行耦合建模，并借助代理验证器引入材料去除反馈，可有效提升三轴加工的几何正确性，减少残料与过切。

title: Stable Transformers for Graph Generation
summary: Graph generative models increasingly rely on Graph Transformers (GT) to capture complex dependencies among nodes and edges. While deeper architectures should provide greater expressive capacity and a broader receptive field, their effectiveness can decline with depth: repeated self-attention progressively contracts node representations, impeding information flow and gradient propagation. We analyse this phenomenon from a dynamical systems perspective, focusing on how the denoiser's spectral dynamics affect graph generation. We show that standard GT denoisers become increasingly dissipative as depth grows, leading to vanishing gradients and representation collapse. To isolate the effect of these dynamics, we construct a permutation-equivariant GT with inherently stable, non-dissipative transport. We also introduce a damping mechanism that continuously interpolates between non-dissipative and increasingly contractive regimes, enabling a direct assessment of how dissipation influences generation. Experiments on synthetic and molecular graph generation benchmarks show that the gap between these regimes widens with depth: non-dissipative dynamics preserve representation diversity and gradient flow, sustaining strong generative performance, whereas greater contraction progressively impairs it. These findings identify the denoiser's dynamical regime as a key design factor for deep graph generative models.

AI.tldr: 该论文从动力系统视角分析深层图Transformer去噪器的谱动力学，发现随深度增加去噪器趋于耗散，导致梯度消失与表征坍缩；通过构建非耗散传输与阻尼机制进行对照实验，证实非耗散动力学能保持表征多样性和梯度流，是深层图生成模型的关键设计因素。
AI.motivation: 图生成模型日益依赖Graph Transformer来建模节点与边间的复杂依赖，但更深架构虽理论上具备更强表达力和更大感受野，实际效果却随深度下降：重复自注意力逐步收缩节点表征，阻碍信息流动与梯度传播。作者希望从动力系统角度揭示这一现象的机理。
AI.method: 从动力系统视角分析去噪器的谱动力学对图生成的影响；证明标准GT去噪器随深度增加愈发耗散；构建具有内在稳定、非耗散传输的置换等变GT以隔离动力学效应；引入阻尼机制，在非耗散与逐渐收缩两种机制间连续插值，从而直接评估耗散对生成的影响。
AI.result: 在合成图与分子图生成基准上，两种动力学机制间的性能差距随深度扩大：非耗散动力学保持表征多样性与梯度流，维持强劲生成性能；而更强收缩则逐步损害生成表现。
AI.conclusion: 去噪器的动力学机制是深层图生成模型的关键设计因素，非耗散、稳定的传输动力学对深层图Transformer的生成性能至关重要。

title: The Nixtlaverse: An Open-Source Ecosystem for Forecasting
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Submitted to the International Journal of Forecasting. Code and benchmark artifact: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.33399445
summary: Large forecasting applications often combine statistical, machine-learning, and neural models. These families solve the same problem but differ in fitted state, training procedures, and how they parallelize work. Forecasting software must therefore either hide these differences behind a single estimator interface, or keep the families in separate packages, forcing users to rewrite data preparation and evaluation for every package. We present the Nixtlaverse, an ecosystem of open-source Python libraries for time series forecasting, as a case study of a third design: all libraries share the same long-format panel data and keyed forecast outputs, while every model family keeps its own specialized implementation. We demonstrate this design through three use cases on the public M5 competition data. First, we evaluate statistical, machine-learning, and neural models, and an external engine from a separate ecosystem, in a single rolling-origin evaluation with per-series and hierarchy-weighted metrics. Second, we profile runtime and peak memory from 100 to 30,490 series and locate each family's bottleneck: statistical fitting scales approximately linearly in the number of series, feature construction dominates machine-learning memory, and neural training time is nearly independent of panel size under a fixed training budget. Third, we reconcile the forecasts of multiple engines, including the external one, over all 42,840 series of the M5 hierarchy, with sparse reconciliation where dense implementations exhausted memory. These use cases establish the costs, boundaries, and utility of shared data and output contracts. The Nixtlaverse has seen substantial public distribution, scholarly reuse, and adoption through other forecasting frameworks, and is released under permissive open-source licenses with public datasets, reproducible examples, and verifiable benchmark artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出Nixtlaverse生态系统，通过共享长格式面板数据与带键预测输出、各模型族保留专用实现的设计，在M5数据上验证其成本、边界与效用。
AI.motivation: 大型预测应用常组合统计、机器学习与神经模型，但这些模型族在拟合状态、训练流程和并行化方式上各异。现有软件要么用单一估计器接口掩盖差异，要么将各模型族分置于独立包中，迫使用户为每个包重写数据准备与评估流程，亟需第三种设计方案。
AI.method: 提出Nixtlaverse开源Python库生态系统：所有库共享同一长格式面板数据与带键（keyed）预测输出契约，同时每个模型族保留各自专用实现。在公开M5竞赛数据上通过三个用例验证：(1) 在单一滚动原点评估中对统计、机器学习、神经模型及外部生态引擎进行比较，采用逐序列与层级加权指标；(2) 从100到30,490序列剖析运行时与峰值内存；(3) 在M5全部42,840序列上对多引擎（含外部引擎）预测进行稀疏式协调。
AI.result: 定位了各族瓶颈：统计拟合随序列数近似线性扩展；特征构建主导机器学习内存；固定训练预算下神经训练时间与面板规模近乎无关。稀疏协调在密集实现内存耗尽时仍可完成全部42,840序列的协调。Nixtlaverse已获广泛公开分发、学术复用并通过其他预测框架被采用。
AI.conclusion: 共享数据与输出契约的设计可行且有效，确立了其成本、边界与效用；所有库以宽松开源许可发布，附带公开数据集、可复现示例与可验证基准工件。

title: Validity-Preserving Hierarchical RL for Joint Routing and Switch Placement in EDA
summary: Routing and switch placement are fundamental combinatorial optimization problems in chip design, requiring the joint optimization of routing topology and physical placement under strict structural, geometric and logical constraints. Existing approaches typically rely on carefully engineered heuristics that incorporate strong problem-specific biases to navigate the enormous space of possible designs. In this work, we introduce a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for joint routing and switch placement at the level of logical communication routes. Starting from a minimal routing graph, our method progressively constructs increasingly expressive solutions through three coupled operations: switch expansion, switch placement, and route refinement. These operations preserve routing validity by construction, restricting exploration to feasible configurations where every communicating initiator-target pair has one assigned loop-free route. We explore the induced solution space using Gumbel Monte Carlo Tree Search, showing that neural-guided search substantially improves solution quality over non-learning optimization methods. Furthermore, pretraining across floorplans provides a strong initialization for fine-tuning on unseen instances.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层强化学习框架，用于芯片设计中的联合布线与开关布局，通过开关扩展、开关布局和路径细化三种耦合操作，从最小布线图逐步构建解，并使用Gumbel蒙特卡洛树搜索在保持布线有效性的可行空间中探索，神经引导搜索显著优于非学习方法，跨布局图预训练可有效迁移至新实例。
AI.motivation: 联合布线与开关布局是芯片设计中的基础组合优化问题，需要在结构、几何和逻辑约束下同时优化布线拓扑与物理布局。现有方法多依赖人工设计、带有强问题特定偏置的启发式算法来搜索庞大的设计空间，缺乏通用性和可学习性。
AI.method: 提出面向逻辑通信路径层面的分层强化学习框架。从最小布线图出发，通过三种耦合操作——开关扩展、开关布局、路径细化——逐步构造表达力更强的解；这些操作在构造上保持布线有效性，将探索限制在满足每个通信发起者-目标对均具有唯一无环路径的可行配置空间中；采用Gumbel蒙特卡洛树搜索（Gumbel MCTS）探索所诱导的解空间，并结合神经网络引导搜索。
AI.result: 神经引导搜索在解质量上显著优于非学习的优化方法；此外，跨不同布局图（floorplans）的预训练能为在未见实例上的微调提供强初始化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将联合布线与开关布局建模为分层构造式决策问题，验证了学习型搜索方法在该组合优化任务中的有效性，以及跨实例预训练的可迁移性。

title: Revisiting On-policy Adversarial Black-Box Distillation: Calibrating Groupwise Reward Geometry for Effective Advantage Construction
summary: Black-box distillation is a practical route for transferring capabilities from API-accessible large language models that expose only text outputs into smaller student models. Recent on-policy adversarial methods such as GAD improve over SeqKD by forming an adversarial loop between a critic and a student, where the critic provides rewards for GRPO-based student policy optimization over the student's sampled responses. However, GRPO computes advantages from the within-group relative rewards of student samples for the same prompt, whereas the critic is trained primarily to distinguish teacher responses from student responses. This objective mismatch can produce reward groups with collapsed scale or fragile margins, leading to brittle grouped optimization signals. We propose Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning (GRGC), a two-stage framework that improves advantage construction by shaping student-side reward groups during both critic training and policy optimization. To improve critic-side conditioning, Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport calibration regularizes the critic during training to produce reward groups with non-collapsed spread and smooth rank-wise gaps by matching sorted prompt-wise rewards to group-centered Gaussian quantiles. Building on this conditioned reward geometry, policy-side group power modulation reshapes the prompt-wise reward groups before they are converted into advantages, preserving the critic-induced ordering while increasing optimization-relevant margin separability. Extensive experiments across diverse teachers, student model families and scales, and training datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of GRGC on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution evaluations, while introducing negligible overhead over GAD. The code is available at https://github.com/2018cx/GRGC.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRGC两阶段框架，通过对学生侧奖励组进行几何塑形，改善黑盒蒸馏中GRPO优势构建，缓解批评者目标与策略优化目标不匹配的问题。
AI.motivation: 黑盒蒸馏中，GAD等在线对抗方法通过批评者-学生对抗改善SeqKD，但GRPO基于同组学生样本的相对奖励计算优势，而批评者主要学习区分教师与学生响应，二者目标不匹配，易导致奖励组尺度塌缩或边界脆弱，使分组优化信号不稳定。
AI.method: 提出Groupwise Reward Geometry Conditioning (GRGC)两阶段框架。阶段一在批评者训练侧，采用高斯分组最优传输校准（Gaussian groupwise Optimal Transport calibration），将排序后的提示级奖励匹配到组中心高斯分位数，正则化批评者，使奖励组具有非塌缩离散度和平滑的序位间距；阶段二在策略优化侧，采用组幂次调制（group power modulation），在转换为优势前重塑提示级奖励组，在保持批评者诱导排序的同时增强优化相关边界可分性。
AI.result: 在多种教师模型、学生模型族与规模以及训练数据集上开展实验，GRGC在分布内与分布外评测中均有效，且相对GAD引入的额外开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: GRGC通过协调批评者训练与策略优化的奖励几何，提升黑盒蒸馏中分组优势构建质量，是一种高效实用的改进方案。代码已在GitHub公开。

title: How Does Local Landscape Geometry Evolve in Language Model Pre-Training?
summary: The scale and expense of pre-training language models make efficient hyperparameter tuning essential, yet a principled guidance is still missing. In this work, we analyze language model pre-training dynamics from a local landscape geometry perspective. Our study reveals two distinct phases. In Phase I, sharpness of the local landscape is initially high, leading to instability and loss plateaus under large learning rates (LRs). The landscape shifts from sharp to flatter regions early in training. This dynamic explains the necessity of LR warmup and further suggests that larger peak LRs require proportionally longer warmup periods. In Phase II, the local landscape is governed by the gradient noise scale. Our theory identifies a depth flatness trade-off: high noise from smaller batches widens the loss basin, whereas reduced noise from larger batches deepens it. This theory motivates a dynamic batch-size (BS) scheduler that begins with a small BS and increases it late in training. Together, we provide a unified view of loss landscape evolution, which translates into actionable tuning strategies for large-scale pre-training.

AI.tldr: 本文从损失景观局部几何视角分析语言模型预训练动态，揭示训练分为两个阶段：第一阶段景观由陡峭转向平坦，解释了LR预热必要性及峰值LR与预热时长的比例关系；第二阶段景观受梯度噪声尺度支配，提出深度-平坦度权衡，并据此设计由小到大的动态批大小调度器，统一了两阶段景观演化并给出可操作调参策略。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型规模大、成本高，高效超参调优至关重要，但缺乏有原则的指导。作者希望从局部损失景观几何的角度理解预训练动态，为大规模预训练提供可操作的调参策略。
AI.method: 从局部景观几何角度分析语言模型预训练动态，将训练划分为两个阶段。第一阶段分析景观锐度（sharpness）从高到低的变化及其对学习率（LR）稳定性的影响；第二阶段用梯度噪声尺度刻画景观，建立批大小（BS）与损失盆地宽/深的"深度-平坦度权衡"理论。
AI.result: 发现Phase I中初始锐度高导致大LR下不稳定与损失平台，景观早期由陡峭转向平坦，解释了LR warmup的必要性，并表明更大的峰值LR需要按比例更长的预热期；Phase II中梯度噪声尺度主导景观，小批量高噪声使损失盆地更宽、大批量低噪声使盆地更深，据此提出的动态批大小调度器从小批量开始、在训练后期增大批量。
AI.conclusion: 提供了损失景观演化的统一视角，将两阶段几何分析转化为大规模预训练中可操作的超参调优策略（LR预热与动态批大小调度）。

title: Riemannian Flow Models with Reinforcement Learning for Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
summary: Crystal structure governs material properties, making crystal structure prediction (CSP) a fundamental problem in materials science. Generative models are a promising approach for solving this problem, but the prevalence of polymorphism, coupled with large unit cells and complex packing geometry, makes the molecular CSP task challenging for existing models. To address this, we introduce Coarse-Grained Open Materials Generation (CG-OMatG), an equivariant Riemannian flow-based generative model. CG-OMatG predicts molecular crystal structures \textit{via} a coarse-grained, hierarchical representation.
